Medius is a United Nations–awarded company specializing in the development of complex custom software and artificial intelligence models. As a recognized technology partner, we help organizations achieve greater business impact through the implementation of innovative, modern, data-driven technologies.Our focus is on solutions that cannot be purchased off the shelf – we design and build them specifically for each client.
Medius is also locally recognized with the GoDigital 2023 Award for the best digital/AI project, FrodoAI, presented by the Chamber of Commerce and Industry of Slovenia. In 2024, Deloitte recognized Medius as the national winner in the prestigious “Deloitte Top 50 Tech Companies Central Europe – Impact Stars” category, confirming our leadership in software solutions that generate a positive societal and environmental impact.
Since 2002, we have successfully completed more than 350 data-driven projects across various industries, with a 100% returning client rate. We serve clients in nine sectors, including manufacturing, pharmaceuticals, transport, telecommunications, energy, insurance, and others. Our clients include internationally recognized companies such as Volvo Group, SKF, Novartis, and Hisense. We help every client leverage data to strengthen their competitiveness.
Known for our boldness and innovative approach, Medius specializes in building large-scale data platforms based on machine learning and artificial intelligence, as well as SaaS and PaaS solutions that address complex industrial data challenges. We excel at solving demanding use cases and translating applied research into complex industrial business environments. Our strong commitment to research and development ensures that we remain at the technological forefront and continuously introduce advanced solutions.
In our development processes, we apply machine learning methodologies, open APIs, data streaming architectures, semantic data interoperability, data lakes, CI/CD practices, containerization, and cloud-based application orchestration. A key advantage of our approach is that machine learning is an integral part of the application solutions themselves. The architecture and development methodology are built on a proven, production-grade platform composed of best-of-breed open-source technologies.
This approach gives both the client and the project team a head start, enabling immediate focus on use case analysis, data consolidation and validation, feature engineering, and machine learning model development—rather than spending time selecting technologies or searching for suitable ML solutions.
Based on many years of experience, Medius has developed Gamayun AI, a real-time streaming machine learning platform that integrates best-of-breed technologies for microservices orchestration (Kubernetes), real-time data streaming (Kafka), data lakes (Elastic, OpenSearch, Cloudera, Hadoop), machine learning model development (PyTorch, TensorFlow, Spark, NLP), and CI/CD (Maven, Nexus, GitLab).

entityDescription:
EPAK GmbH is a German engineering and development company specializing in advanced communication, radar, and sensor technologies. With more than 25 years of experience, the company covers the full innovation chain from fundamental research and system design to prototyping, manufacturing, and operational validation. EPAK’s activities span satellite communications for maritime and land-mobile “on-the-move” scenarios, high-frequency and radar engineering, optical communications, robotics, and multi-sensor systems.
EPAK contributes to national and European research programs and serves as an established industrial partner for scientific institutions and high-technology industries. Technologies developed by EPAK are utilized, among others, in the SABBIA project of the Fraunhofer Institute for High Frequency Physics and Radar Techniques (FHR), enabling object localization through the analysis of DVB-S2 signal waveforms from geostationary satellites. A long-standing collaboration with the Fraunhofer Institute for Integrated Circuits (IIS) includes system-level testing of automatically steered antenna systems in the FORTE measurement chamber in Ilmenau. These tests address dynamic motion profiles, objective performance evaluation, and methodological improvements for mobile antenna systems.
EPAK has established a broad portfolio of satellite-communication technologies deployed worldwide and maintains long-term partnerships with industrial stakeholders. In cooperation with AIRBUS, the company supplies maritime SATCOM systems for the German Armed Forces. EPAK has also participated in several development programs with the German Aerospace Center (DLR), including UniLandKom-Pro (FKZ 50RK1927), UniLandKom (FKZ 50YB1604), PROSAT-Pro (FKZ 50YB1413) and PROSAT (FKZ 50YB1318).
Building on extensive experience with mechanically stabilized VSAT terminals for GEO and LEO satellites, EPAK has expanded its research focus toward electronically steerable antenna systems. The proliferation of large LEO constellations (e.g., SpaceX, OneWeb) has accelerated work on phased-array architectures, which now represent a central component of the company’s technological roadmap. Current research includes high-frequency front-end modules, beamforming and calibration algorithms, multi-sensor fusion for stabilization and tracking, and low-latency control concepts for mobile platforms.
EPAK maintains comprehensive in-house capabilities in power electronics, digital and analog circuit design, RF engineering, antenna and feed-system development, sensor-integration, and control-algorithm engineering. CAD-based mechanical design and strong links to regional manufacturing partners enable rapid realization of prototypes and small-series demonstrators. This integrated capability supports efficient translation of research results into validated system prototypes and technology demonstrators.

entityDescription:
Moon Trades S.R.L. is a Romanian deep-tech micro-enterprise dedicated to lunar In-Situ Resource Utilisation (ISRU), regolith intelligence, and autonomous robotics for planetary exploration. Headquartered in Iași, Romania, Moon Trades develops foundational technologies that bridge terrestrial mining heritage and the emerging space resources economy.
Core focus areas:- Lunar geotechnical characterisation and core sampling — addressing the foundational measurement gap in current ISRU roadmaps, drawing on three generations of terrestrial mining and engineering heritage.- Real-time multi-spectral mineral analysis through the company's flagship technology platform (A.P.E.X. — Apollo-Powered Exploration eXpedition), enabling in-situ assessment of lunar regolith composition during exploration and mining operations.- Autonomous robotics and soil intelligence systems designed for the lunar surface and post-gravity operational environments.- Systems-architecture services for partners building lunar infrastructure, ISRU pilot plants, and the broader Mearth (Moon-Earth) economy.
Moon Trades operates under the principle of design with discipline — engineering rigour combined with ethical, human-centred, and decentralised system thinking. The company actively seeks collaboration with ESA programmes, European primes, research institutions, and SMEs working on Terrae Novae, PROSPECT, Moonlight, lunar lander payloads, ISRU demonstrators, and related initiatives.

entityName: Associazione Foresta Modello delle Montagne Fiorentine ETS
entityDescription:
The Montagne Fiorentine Model Forest Association (FMMF) it was the first Model Forest established in Italy and is located in Tuscany, in the eastern area of the Metropolitan City of Florence. Covering around 548 km² and involving seven municipalities, FMMF is a non-profit, voluntary association that promotes sustainable forest and rural landscape management through an inclusive, participatory governance approach.
FMMF brings together public institutions, private companies, local communities, researchers and civil society to enhance the environmental, social and economic value of forest ecosystems. Its activities focus on sustainable wood supply chains, biodiversity conservation, local development, eco-tourism, environmental education and innovation in rural areas. The association aims to strengthen cooperation among stakeholders and improve the resilience of forest territories.
Model Forests (MFs) are internationally recognized governance platforms that originated in Canada in the early 1990s. They are based on multi-stakeholder partnerships working together to balance forest conservation, sustainable resource use and community development at landscape scale.
FMMF is part of the International Model Forest Network (IMFN), the largest global network dedicated to sustainable landscape governance, connecting more than 60 Model Forests worldwide. It also plays an active role in the Mediterranean Model Forest Network Secretariat (MMFNs) managed by Tuscany Region, fostering collaboration, knowledge exchange and joint actions among territories facing similar ecological and socio-economic challenges across the Mediterranean region.

Amathounta Municipality is one of Cyprus's newest municipalities, established on 1 July 2024 as part of the country's local government reform. It is located in the eastern part of the Limassol District and is headquartered in Agios Athanasios. The municipality was formed by merging the former municipalities of Agios Athanasios and Germasogeia with the communities of Agios Tychonas, Mouttagiaka, Akrounta, Armenochori, Foinikaria, and Mathikoloni. 
Named after the ancient city-kingdom of Amathus, Amathounta combines a vibrant coastal urban area with scenic inland villages. It has a population of approximately 43,000 (based on the 2021 census) and plays an important role in the Limassol metropolitan area, offering residential neighbourhoods, tourism facilities, business activity, and access to beaches, cultural heritage sites, and natural landscapes. The municipality focuses on providing modern public services while preserving the area's rich historical and environmental character.

entityDescription: Open & Agile Smart Cities & Communities (OASC) is a global network of over 190 cities in more than 40 countries. Its goal is to shape and create a market for smart city data and services by connecting cities and communities to learn from each other and exchange digital, data-driven solutions based on Minimal Interoperability Mechanisms (MIMs) - a set of practical capabilities based on open technical specifications to replicate and scale solutions globally. OASC works directly with city administrations and represents them to a diverse set of stakeholders, including international standards-setting organisations such as ITU and ETSI, European and international institutions, as well as research and industry. The OASC Academy provides theoretical and practical knowledge concerning the digital transformation of cities and communities, including tools to implement innovative AI solutions. The OASC Catalogue showcases deployed solutions, highlighting best practices and enabling cities around the world to learn from each other. OASC currently has a team of 20 people and extensive experience in coordinating and managing large-scale projects. It has been involved in numerous European projects and tenders, including coordinating the HEU CommuniCity and DIGITAL DS4SSCC and LDT4SSCC projects.

entityName: Cyprus University of Technology - Cyprus International Institute for Environmental and Public Health
entityDescription: A significant development for the public health sector of Cyprus is the official establishment of the Cyprus International Institute for Environmental and Public Health (CII / Institute) as a Public Health Research Unit. The Institute is now officially part of the School of Health Sciences of the Cyprus University of Technology (CUT), by decision of the House of Representatives, as published in the Official Gazette of the Republic of Cyprus, on 20 June 2025 (G.O.P. 174/2025).The Cyprus International Institute for Environmental and Public Health is the longest-standing scientific entity in Cyprus that focuses exclusively on the study of the impact of environmental factors on public health. The Institute offers specialized educational and research programs, while over time it has substantially contributed to society through initiatives, epidemiological studies and interventions on key issues related to environmental and public health, with particular emphasis on chronic disease prevention and control, including health promotion and education. The institutionalization of the Institute strengthens its development and sustainability, promotes extroversion for the expansion of its international collaborations in the Eastern Mediterranean and Europe, making it the strategic pillar of public health in the region, and beyond.The Institute was established in 2004, based on the agreement between the Republic of Cyprus and the Harvard School of Public Health. In 2009, the Institute was integrated into the Cyprus University of Technology, based on a tripartite agreement with the Harvard School of Public Health and the Republic of Cyprus. After the end of the official collaboration with HSPH in 2016, it continued its upward trajectory within the School of Health Sciences at CUT, utilizing the know-how and experience acquired through the valuable transatlantic collaboration with Harvard University.Since its establishment, the Institute has established itself as one of the most reputable academic and research institutions in the field of Environmental and Public Health in the Republic of Cyprus. With a presence spanning over two decades, it consistently offers successful postgraduate and doctoral programs, conducts important population-based public health studies, and produces scientific data with substantial social impact. It has created an international network of more than 200 alumni –Cypriot and international – who excel in Europe, America, Asia, and Africa, contributing to the visibility of Cyprus on a global level. During the last ten consecutive years, it has been annually organizing the Pancyprian Public Health Conference, offering an open platform for information and communication on health issues between scientists, policymakers and civil society.In the post-pandemic era, where public health is at the top of the priorities of both the European Union and the Republic of Cyprus, the role of the Institute becomes even more crucial. The systematic production and utilization of scientific data for monitoring the health of the population is a cornerstone for the development of effective and sustainable health policies. Public health is not limited to the provision of services, but extends to the prevention, early diagnosis and control of diseases. Modern, smart health systems must be based on the principles and best practices of public health, in order to ensure social cohesion and the quality of life of citizens.

description: PONTOS SAS is a French deeptech company and mission-driven company, registered in Bordeaux with operations in Toulouse, and a spin-off from INRIA. PONTOS develops Prisma, a fleet intelligence system for commercial fishing fleets, delivered across two surfaces: Prisma at sea, a voice and text companion supporting captains on the deck, and Prisma at shore, a business intelligence layer supporting shipowners across fleet management and operating economics. Prisma is powered by a multi-layer simulation engine developed in partnership with INRIA. It fuses satellite-derived ocean observation data with vessel operational data, turning Earth observation into operational decisions at sea covering routing and fuel reduction.
entityDescription:
At PONTOS, we are pioneering the future of sustainable fisheries with our cutting-edge interactive software that delivers predictive analytics for the fisheries value chain. 

Our technology equips fishing companies with the insights needed to optimize their operations and production efficiently, minimizing costs and mitigating risks. We ensure the integrity and quality of fishing hauls, offering invaluable benefits to fleet managers and captains by identifying prime fishing locations, enabling product traceability, diversifying catches to align with market demands, and facilitating the timely and sustainable landing of catches in line with global Sustainable Development Goals (SDGs). 

Our commitment extends to meeting the growing consumer demand for transparency and freshness, providing details about the catch's origin, the fisherman's identity, the fishing techniques used, and the exact fishing locations. PONTOS leverages advanced satellite imagery, socio-economic, and oceanographic data to deliver personalized analytics and visualization tools, supporting sustainable fishing practices. We are dedicated to fostering an information ecosystem that benefits all stakeholders in the professional fishing industry, from boat captains to maritime fleet managers. 
Recognizing the impact of fishing on biodiversity and the socio-economic landscape, PONTOS is committed to ensuring the fishing sector's resilience against environmental and social challenges. 

Our sustainable fishing initiatives are centered around three core pillars: 
1. Social: Reducing the volatility associated with unsustainable fishing practices, enabling local fishermen to thrive. 
2. Economic: Boosting the local fishing economy and reducing dependency on international imports. 
3. Environmental: Empowering fishermen to safeguard the natural ecosystems they operate within, preserving these invaluable resources for future generations.

Furthermore, the Municipal Department of Technical Services, Planning and Works is currently developing a number of projects with strong potential to attract European Union funding. The Municipality employs approximately 400 staff members across its various departments and services.
Following the Local Government Reform implemented in Cyprus on 1 July 2024, the Municipality of Larnaka was administratively restructured through its merger with the former local authorities of Livadia and Voroklini (Oroklini). The newly established municipality covers an area of approximately 56.95 km², comprising Larnaka (32.9 km²), Livadia (8.65 km²) and Voroklini (15.4 km²).
Based on the most recent population data published by the Statistical Service of Cyprus, the respective populations, DEGURBA classifications and LAU Codes are as follows:
• Larnaka: 52,038 inhabitants, DEGURBA 1, LAU Code 4000
• Livadia: 8,581 inhabitants, DEGURBA 1, LAU Code 4011
• Voroklini (Oroklini): 7,575 inhabitants, DEGURBA 2, LAU Code 4102
Accordingly, the total population of the newly established Municipality of Larnaka amounts to 68,194 inhabitants, serving an area of approximately 56.95 km². The Municipality plays a key role in promoting sustainable urban development, environmental protection, social inclusion and economic growth, while supporting the broader strategic vision of Larnaka as a resilient, innovative and attractive Mediterranean city.

entityDescription:
Thales Digital Solutions Inc. leverage the experience and expertise accrued from many other country business units and supporting suppliers. With more than 100 employees across two offices located in the province of Quebec, it has proven expertise, capability, and experience in the design, delivery, and support of best-in-breed digital technologies.
AI is a cornerstone of Thales Digital Solutions’ strategy to drive digital transformation for its clients across multiple domains. The cortAIx platform centralizes AI innovation, making it a reusable and scalable resource that enriches Thales’ portfolio of services and products. By embedding AI technologies into their digital solutions, Thales enhances capabilities such as real-time decision support, predictive maintenance, cybersecurity threat detection, identity verification, and autonomous systems operation. The AI capabilities developed through cortAIx help deliver smarter, more agile, and more secure technologies that meet the evolving needs of governments and industries worldwide. Thales cortAIx – with its Labs and Factory components – is a key enabler within Thales Digital Solutions, facilitating the end-to-end journey from AI research and innovation to production-ready intelligent systems, ensuring that AI becomes a strategic advantage in delivering value-added digital services.
cortAIx is Thales’ advanced AI-powered platform designed to accelerate the development and deployment of innovative digital solutions. It acts as a comprehensive ecosystem combining AI capabilities with the company’s expertise in security, data, and systems engineering. The cortAIx platform is structured around two main components: (1) cortAIx Labs representing the innovation and research arm of the platform where AI models, algorithms, and pilot projects are developed and experimented with. cortAIx Labs focuses on leveraging cutting-edge AI techniques – including machine learning, deep learning, natural language processing, and advanced analytics – to create proof-of-concept solutions addressing real-world challenges. It serves as a creative environment for multidisciplinary teams to collaborate and rapidly explore new AI-driven ideas, particularly tailored to sectors like defense, aerospace, cybersecurity, transportation, and identity management. (2) cortAIx Factory: Once AI solutions are validated in the Labs, they transition into the cortAIx Factory, which is dedicated to scaling, industrializing, and operationalizing those AI models. The Factory ensures that AI applications are robust, secure, compliant, and efficiently integrated into Thales’ broader digital ecosystem and customer infrastructures. It also supports continuous monitoring, maintenance, and lifecycle management of AI models in production environments, facilitating smooth deployment at scale.
With more than 25 scientists (with MSc, PhD, or postdoc), Thales Digital Solutions’ senior scientists are not only coaching internally but also acting as research collaborators with our academic partners and government agencies and co-supervise MSc and PhD students through NSERC and MITACS research agreements. Thales Digital Solutions’ senior scientists are also affiliated to academic partners as associate professors, regularly contributing as jury members/evaluators for master and PhD theses. They are also peer-reviewing journal papers and conference articles, are editorial board members for journals, are members of national and international scientific workgroups and participate in organizing international conferences.

entityName: UNIMORE - Artificial Intelligence Research and Innovation Center (AIRI)
entityDescription:
Artificial Intelligence Research and Innovation Center is University of Modena and Reggio Emilia’s Research Centre focused on ICT technologies and, in particular, Artificial Intelligence. It was promoted by the “Enzo Ferrari” Department of Engineering and the “Marco Biagi” Department of Economics of the University of Modena and Reggio Emilia. Recently, the Department of Physical, Computer and Mathematical Sciences and the Department of Sciences and Methods for Engineering have also become part of AIRI. AIRI is an accredited laboratory of the Emilia-Romagna Region High Technology Network and one of the leading laboratories of the Modena Technopole.
AIRI promotes, coordinates and carries out applied research, industrial research and technology transfer activities in the ICT sector, with particular reference to technologies based on Artificial Intelligence, including Machine Learning, Computer Vision, Natural Language Processing and cognitive robotics, as well as Bioinformatics and Big Data. It also works on the related organizational and business models, positioning itself as a reference partner for companies that produce or use advanced ICT tools, and for public bodies wishing to support the innovation and competitiveness of such companies.
To this end, the Centre provides consultancy and applied research services for companies that produce or use ICT solutions and intelligent services; participates in technological research and development projects at regional, national, European and international levels; collaborates with regional, national, European and international public and private organizations; organizes conferences and specialized seminars; and carries out training activities for companies.
Over the last three years, AIRI has developed public and private research projects in Artificial Intelligence and related and complementary disciplines, mainly oriented towards Augmented Intelligence: systems and services for people, aimed at improving the cognitive capabilities of workers, citizens and individuals from a Human-Centric AI perspective. Examples include services for medicine, cultural heritage, intelligent maintenance, worker safety, anomaly analysis and citizen safety.
AIRI has participated in several national clusters and is actively involved in numerous national and international research projects on AI applied to computer vision and multimodal data analysis.
Over the last three years AIRI has been involved in more than 20 research projects with companies on AI topics related to industrial processes.

Natural Synergies Ltd (NS) was established in May 2012 as a technology development company aiming to develop and commercially establish specific aspects of renewable energy, environment and sustainable engineering technologies.NS has been awarded grants through the UK Department of Energy & Climate Change (DECC), Innovate UK and by the Bill & Melinda Gates Foundation (BMGF), leading to pre-commercialisation testing of two specific innovative technologies that can operate independently or synergistically. 
1 Natural Synergies–Advanced Thermophilic Anaerobic Digestion (NS-ATAD) was developed through grants received form DECC, Innovate-UK, for utilising biomass wastes, proven on wetland biomass and human wastewater (primary sludge) at a UK wastewater treatment plant. NS-ATAD plant is particularly designed for operation and use in both developing and developed countries.
2 NS has further developed, with funding by BMGF (Bill & Melinda Gates Foundation) and Innovate UK, a faecal sludge, animal slurry and wastewater dewatering and sanitation patented technology called NS-SONEK which will be engineered and manufactured in the UK and shipped to various countries for use as an independent system or integrated into any existing or new AD plant. Most of the components of NS-SONEK can be built and installed in most developing countries. 
NS team consists of a number of experienced technology innovators: 
Victoria Melchor (B.Eng., MSc.) 
a commercially focused innovator, experienced in environmental and biological innovative process and plant development and design, commissioning & operations. 
Faisal Salam (PhD, MEI, CEng)
has experience in innovative development and commercialisation in AD, combustion, gasification and solar based RE system. 
NS retains at its core all intellectual property (IP) rights and know-how in its developments of NS-SONEK and NS-ATAD. 
NS will seek to establish a working relationship and/or joint venture with established organisations and it is envisaged that this co-operation could be developed into technology roll-out delivery company.

About OneEpsilon
OneEpsilon is a specialist provider of engineering services and consultancy, delivering advanced technical solutions across a broad range of industries and applications. Our core capabilities include:
Multi-Physics Simulation
We possess deep expertise in the application of Finite Element Analysis (FEA), Computational Fluid Dynamics (CFD), and Discrete Element Methods (DEM) to complex engineering challenges. Our team is experienced in developing conjugate simulation models that integrate multiple physical domains within a single framework — including thermal-structural analysis, fluid-structure interaction, and flow-acoustics.
Data Science & Technical Software Development
We apply data science and machine learning techniques to engineering environments where datasets are often sparse or complex. Design & Optimisation
Our in-house design capability, combined with our simulation and data science expertise, enables us to take concepts from initial design through development and qualification — delivering optimised engineering solutions with a rigorous analytical foundation.

Arcane Aerospace Inc. is a Canadian space technology company developing capabilities to defend and protect spacecraft from attack in orbit. The company is building a mass-manufacturable spacecraft bus designed to host a wide range of payloads, with the same platform, hardware, and software supporting both defence and civil missions depending on the payload it carries. This gives Arcane a dual-use foundation across applications including space defence and space control, intelligence, surveillance and reconnaissance (ISR), Earth observation and other hosted payloads.
The company is led by one of the most flight-experienced teams in the Canadian space sector, with two founders who have contributed to more than 50 rocket launches between them, alongside depth in spacecraft operations, autonomous systems, and robotics, including the integration of AI into physical platforms. Arcane is currently designing and building its first spacecraft, a 100 kg platform (V0), targeting a Q2 2027 launch on a SpaceX Transporter mission. Our research is grounded in sustainability science and brings together different fields, such as landscape ecology, planning theory, spatial analysis and impact assessment theory and practice.
We conduct inter-disciplinary and mostly empirical research, often in collaboration with local stakeholders. Our current study areas range from European cities to Alpine nature parks, and from temperate regions in South-America to urban watersheds in the Horn of Africa and landscapes/seascapes in the EU Overseas. In these areas we address a variety of challenges, including climate change, nature conservation, urban regeneration, urban sprawl, tourism development, and infrastructure siting.

entityDescription: YAPE is an autonomous systems technology company developing a modular, vehicle-agnostic software platform for off-highway, robotic and special-purpose vehicles. The company provides an autonomy layer that enables machines to perceive their environment, navigate, follow planned paths, operate remotely, exchange data, and evolve toward semi-autonomous or autonomous operation. YAPE’s technology can be integrated into different types of vehicles and robotic platforms, including agricultural machines, urban service vehicles, industrial mobility systems and specialized autonomous platforms. Its value lies in the reusable autonomy stack, which combines perception, navigation, control, connectivity and diagnostics in a scalable software architecture. This modular approach makes YAPE suitable for applications where autonomous mobility, remote operation, environmental perception and reliable machine control are required in complex or constrained environments.

entityDescription:
Invenco Engineering: Advanced Mechanical Engineering and Simulation for High-Reliability Space Systems
Invenco Engineering is a Polish SME offering specialized mechanical engineering and advanced computer-aided simulation services. With over two decades of expertise, we have cultivated a robust design and analysis methodology in safety-critical applications, where structural integrity, reliability, and performance in extreme environments are paramount. Our legacy in demanding terrestrial transport sectors has provided a strong foundation for addressing the unique challenges of the space industry.
Our engineering philosophy is rooted in a Finite Element Analysis (FEA) driven process, rigorously validated against experimental test data for static, dynamic, and fatigue loads. 
Core Competencies for Space Applications
Our expertise is directly transferable to the design and verification of space systems, including satellite structures, launcher components, and ground support equipment.
- Structural Analysis and Design for Extreme Environments: We possess deep expertise in the conceptual and detailed design of steels, aluminum alloys and layered composite structures. Our analysis capabilities cover the full spectrum of space mission load cases, from ground handling and launch to in-orbit operations.
- Launch Vehicle Vibration and Fatigue Analysis: We specialize in vibration engineering, including the analysis of structures subjected to the intense random vibration loads experienced during launch. Our fatigue analysis capabilities (compliant with rigorous standards like FKM) are essential for predicting the lifespan of components subjected to mechanical and thermal cycling.
- Shock, Impact, and High-Energy Dynamic Events: Our extensive background in crashworthiness, plasticity and failure, utilizing explicit dynamics codes like LS-Dyna or Radioss, translates directly to the analysis of a various critical space events. 
- Component and Joint Integrity: We provide detailed analysis of critical structural connections. Our proficiency in codified methodologies for bolted joint analysis (VDI 2230) ensures the reliability of fastened joints, a common point of failure in complex assemblies. This rigorous approach is readily adaptable to ESA's ECSS standards.
- Advanced CAE and Multiphysics Simulation: Our competencies extend across a range of CAE fields crucial for space applications:
- Thermal and Thermo-elastic analysis for components subjected to extreme temperature gradients.
- Mechanical systems analysis for mechanisms and deployable structures.
- Large and complex assembly management and DFMEA analysis to ensure system-level reliability.
- Advanced CAD Design using industry-standards.
R&D and Custom Tool Development
Beyond standard analysis, Invenco possesses an in-house team dedicated to advanced algorithmics and programming (Python, C, C++). This unique capability allows us to develop specialized, proprietary engineering tools to solve non-standard problems, automate complex analysis workflows, and support R&D activities with bespoke software solutions. Core specialy of the team is computer vision and alghoritms for mechanical engineering.

entityName: ASOCIACIÓN DE INVESTIGACIÓN DE LAS INDUSTRIAS CERÁMICAS-ITC
entityDescription:
ITC-AICE is a technology institute with more than five decades of experience, recognised as a pioneer in fostering collaboration between universities and industry. It plays a key role in driving innovation, sustainability, and digital transformation in the ceramic sector and related industries, through applied research and close cooperation with companies at both national and international levels.
The institute has strong expertise in the development and manufacturing of advanced ceramic materials, particularly for high-performance applications such as aerospace and defense. Its core strengths include deep knowledge of material design, processing, and industrial implementation, as well as advanced capabilities in forming, sintering, post-processing, and comprehensive material characterization. This allows ITC to optimise material performance and ensure scalability for real-world applications.
In addition, ITC specialises in the development of advanced materials with tailored thermal andmechanical properties for structural and functional applications. These solutions are designed for components required to operate under extreme conditions of temperature, mechanical load and aggressive environments, maintaining their structural and functional integrity alongside low weight. Its work includes precise control of raw materials through colloidal chemistry and powder processing, as well as the engineering of lightweight and highly resistant ceramic solutions. These capabilities are supported by innovative manufacturing approaches, including additive manufacturing technologies such as binder jetting, fused filament fabrication, and digital light processing, enabling the production of complex and efficient components.
The centre also develops functional coatings and advanced carbon-based materials through high-temperature graphitisation processes, contributing to applications such as electromagnetic shielding and signal absorption. Its activities are supported by cutting-edge scientific infrastructure and a multidisciplinary team that integrates expertise in materials science, processing, simulation, and data analysis, ensuring a comprehensive and application-oriented approach.
Finally, ITC stands out for its strong commitment to innovation and technology transfer, with extensive experience in collaborative R&D projects, including dual-use initiatives. Its portfolio of patents and technological developments, especially in additive manufacturing and advanced ceramic systems, reinforces its position as a leading centre for the development of high-value technological solutions.

Rinnoco LTD is a research, innovation, and education company, which enables the development of new unique products from design to deployment targeting international markets.

The founders of the company have over 30 years of diverse research experience, including SQL and NoSQL databases, big data and data streams, spatiotemporal systems, mobile computing, sensor networks and internet of things (IoT), machine learning applications, quantum mechanics, and significant scientific contributions published in international top-tier conferences and scientific journals.

RSOE is committed to give rise to the information society therefore it does its best to make the technological innovations widespread public. It safeguards and fears for the natural and built environment, and in order to protect it RSOE uses the most modern technologies, the help of the global navigation satellite system (GNSS) and the geographic information system (GIS), especially in the field of inland navigation and disaster management. The Association also through its proposals and projects supports the European integration and cohesion, in terms of the principles of regionality, partnership and transparency. RSOE develops and keeps a wide spectrum of European and international relations, presenting the Hungarian innovation.

The National Association of Radio Distress-Signalling and Infocommunications was established in 1982. Currently, as a prominently public benefit organization, the Association in cooperation particularly with governmental administrations or rather with organizations which the latter have control over implement those activities, with that according to the relating regulations and agreements it constantly supports the work of the governmental sphere. Besides this the Association pays accentuated attention to the tasks of Hungary steamed from its EU membership, therefore RSOE with its international partners constantly takes part in different national and other projects co-financed by the EU.

Main professional areas of the Association’s is to operate and develop river information services and port management system in Hungary (www.pannonris.hu). By virtue of the contract signed with the ministry responsible for transport, RIS in Hungary is provided by RSOE. Operation and development of information and emergency systems. To ensure the order and safety on national waters RSOE operates different information and emergency systems on the Danube, Tisza rivers and Lake Balaton.
RSOE through its proposals and projects supports the European integration and cohesion, therefore also in the field of disaster managements and river information services writes tender applications with its partners for support from the European Union, in order to study, implement and test new professional ideas. entityDescription:
VMEL International is a software development and technology consulting company based in Limassol, Cyprus, working with clients across Europe and worldwide. We build custom software, modernise legacy systems, design cloud architecture, and advise on system design and technology strategy.
We develop agentic AI platforms and AI agents, including multi-agent systems, LLM orchestration, retrieval-augmented generation (RAG), and intelligent automation built on OpenAI, Claude, and Mistral. We also offer human-led agentic software development, using AI coding agents to speed up delivery while our engineers keep control of architecture, security, and quality.
Our backend work covers Java, Go, Node.js, and TypeScript, with microservices, distributed systems, event-driven architecture, REST and GraphQL APIs, and real-time systems. For web and mobile we use React, Next.js, Angular, Vue.js, and React Native, alongside native iOS and Android with Flutter and/or Capacitor. We run cloud-native workloads on AWS, Azure, and Google Cloud with Docker, Kubernetes, Terraform, and CI/CD, backed by PostgreSQL, MongoDB, MySQL, and Redis.
Our project experience covers fintech, payments, e-money, SaaS, e-commerce, real estate, and on-demand platforms, with a focus on high-availability, scalable, and secure systems, including PCI-DSS compliance, test automation, and agile delivery.

Founded in 1983 and part of the Trefin Group, 3F&EDIN was established as a software house specializing in the Industry, Defence, and Banking & Insurance sectors. Over the years, the company has continuously expanded its expertise, establishing itself as a qualified technology partner.
The company operates in software development and the implementation of innovative Artificial Intelligence-based solutions, supporting organizations in their digital transformation journey and in the optimization of decision-making and operational processes. Throughout its history, 3F&EDIN has developed advanced expertise across several AI application domains, including Machine Learning, Deep Learning, Predictive Analytics, Natural Language Processing (NLP), and Computer Vision.
Its core offerings include data analytics and decision-support platforms, intelligent systems for business process automation, chatbots and virtual assistants aimed at enhancing customer experience, as well as predictive models for preventive maintenance, risk management, and resource optimization. Particular attention is given to the integration of AI technologies with existing information systems, collaborative robots (cobots), drones, and UAV platforms, ensuring solutions characterized by scalability, security, and reliability.
Through a customer-oriented approach, 3F&EDIN develops tailored solutions designed to address the specific requirements of each operational environment, generating tangible value in terms of operational efficiency, cost reduction, and performance improvement. entityDescription:
Founded in 1992, Lincoln is an international Human Resources consulting firm dedicated to supporting leaders and managers throughout their professional lifecycle. Over more than three decades, Lincoln has developed extensive expertise in identifying, assessing, developing and supporting leadership talent across a wide range of industries and international environments.
Lincoln’s approach is based on a deep understanding of business ecosystems, industry dynamics, organisational challenges and the human factors that drive sustainable performance. We believe that leadership effectiveness can only be assessed and developed through the combined understanding of strategic business requirements, organisational context and individual capabilities.
To address these challenges, Lincoln brings together complementary expertise across Executive Search, Executive Interim Management, Leadership Advisory and Career Transition services. Through specialised industry practices and dedicated expert communities, Lincoln supports organisations in critical talent decisions, advisory, leadership assessment, executive development, coaching and succession planning.
A key differentiator of Lincoln lies in its dual perspective: combining deep sector expertise with advanced assessment and leadership evaluation capabilities. This enables our consultants to understand not only the strategic and operational requirements of leadership positions, but also the behavioural, cognitive and interpersonal factors that contribute to leadership effectiveness and long-term success.
Our experience includes the conception of leadership frameworks, assessment and development of senior managers, executives and leadership teams operating in highly demanding, international and complex environments. We regularly support organisations facing transformation, technological change, organisational complexity and increasing uncertainty, where leadership quality becomes a critical success factor.
Lincoln operates in a highly competitive market where excellence in talent identification and evaluation is essential. This environment continuously challenges us to refine our methodologies and maintain the highest standards of professional practice.
Convinced that uncertainty, complexity and continuous change are not only challenges but also drivers of innovation and development, Lincoln has invested in collaborative innovation initiatives aimed at advancing the understanding of leadership success. This commitment has led us to combine evidence-based psychological assessment, leadership research, behavioural observation methodologies and practical organisational experience in order to provide robust, fair and decision-relevant assessments.

ISAAK INDEPENDENT is an early-stage, independent aerospace and clean-energy technology startup operating as a registered Sole Proprietorship in the province of Alberta, Canada (Registration No: TN28189629). Currently positioned in the pre-seed bootstrapping phase, the firm specializes in the mathematical optimization, trajectory design, and network architecture modeling of advanced space-to-Earth wireless microwave power transmission systems.
Our core mission profile is to design highly resilient, cold-climate-optimized orbital energy delivery configurations (Project MAPDS v3.0) capable of bypassing traditional terrestrial grid vulnerabilities. By leveraging integrated space-and-ground systems, the entity develops solutions to deliver continuous, 24/7 baseload electricity directly to off-grid industrial platforms, isolated northern communities, and automated vertical farming modules (such as the CSA-backed CANGrow system) in extreme environments.

entityDescription:
DAPCOM Data Services is a software engineering company participated by the University of Barcelona (UB) and the Technical University of Catalonia (UPC). It produces professional software solutions mainly focused on scientific data, data processing pipelines, high-performance computing and efficient data compression strategies, including our own implementations and protected software as well as open source software (FOSS).
The company commercializes FAPEC, a patented data compression algorithm originally created for space communications but later extended with several algorithms including tailored designs. FAPEC offers an optimum compromise between CPU resource consumption and compression ratio, offering good performance even with noise and outliers present in the data to be compressed. FAPEC can have multiple applications in processing, transfer and storage of large data sets, such as in scientific research, supercomputers or in companies dealing with Big Data scenarios. Since 2023, it is being used in the maritime sector. DAPCOM also commercializes FARSHY, an advanced image viewer supporting raw hyperspectral imagery and watercolumn files.
DAPCOM was one of the first companies in Spain selected to take part in the European Space Agency Business Incubation Centre Programme in Barcelona (ESA BIC). The aim of this programme is the technology transfer from space developed technologies to terrestrial applications.

SaidGor Drone Service UG (haftungsbeschränkt) is a Karlsruhe-based micro-enterprise
(Baden-Württemberg, Germany) developing an autonomous spray-drone system for steep-slope viticulture
(Steillagen-Weinbau). The company develops its own technology stack — airframe, flight-control
firmware, onboard computing, custom electronics and mission software for computer vision, autonomous
mission planning and precise application control. Navigation is based on multi-GNSS positioning
including the European Galileo system, with a development path toward Galileo/EGNOS high-accuracy
(RTK) positioning to reach the centimetre-class precision targeted for automated spraying on steep
terrain. SaidGor holds an operating authorisation from the German Federal Aviation Office
(Luftfahrt-Bundesamt) and is listed by the Julius Kühn-Institut (JKI) for spray equipment suitable
for steep-slope viticulture. The system aims to reduce plant-protection-product use and spray drift
and to remove operators from hazardous slopes. The company is currently in a pre-commercial phase and
is preparing its first documented field spray demonstration.

description:
Kurs Orbital expands human activities beyond Earth by providing rendezvous and docking technology to start-ups and companies which would like to offer in-orbit servicing or logistics missions, but cannot afford the development time and cost for this technology.
ARCap is a standardised module, which enables any kind of spacecraft to perform such missions in a totally autonomous way, dealing also with non-cooperative targets like space debris, malfunctioning or out-of-fuel spacecrafts.
The algorithms running the ARCap module come from the soviet Kurs rendezvous-acquisition system, used continuously since 1985 and responsible for more than 300 successful dockings in orbit between Soyuz-Progress vehicles, the MIR and the International Space Station.

entityDescription:
The Municipality of South Nicosia–Idalion has been established through the 2024 local government reform. The Municipality covers an area of approximately 100 km² and serves a population of around 25,000 inhabitants. The municipality includes the communities of Idalion, Lympia, Pera Chorio, Nisou, Alambra and Potamia, representing a diverse landscape that combines urban, semi-urban and rural environments.
The area hosts one of Cyprus’ largest agricultural production zones, with significant activities in dairy farming and olive cultivation, while also including one of the largest industrial areas on the island, creating a complex interaction between agricultural, industrial and residential systems. This mixed territorial profile generates increasing demands for climate resilience, smart resource management, sustainable land use, sustainable mobility and resilient infrastructure development.
The Municipality also holds strong cultural significance, as Idalion was one of the most important ancient kingdoms of Cyprus, contributing to a landscape where cultural heritage coexists with modern development needs. Due to increasing pressures from climate change, including water scarcity, heat stress and environmental degradation, the area presents a relevant case for testing integrated approaches that support the development of a more inclusive, sustainable and climate-resilient urban and rural environment.

entityDescription:
Hochschule Geisenheim University was founded in 2013 as the result of a merger between the Geisenheim Research Institute and the Geisenheim faculty of the Hochschule RheinMain. Our university combines comprehensive research with application-oriented, practical teaching across a unique range of subjects, from wine and beverages to food, horticulture, and landscape architecture. The overarching topics of climate protection and sustainability are also an integral part of all of our degree programs and are at the center of our research.
Our Approach
We are Germany’s first Hochschule neuen Typs – a ‘new type’ of university – and are proud to have over 150 years of history behind us. Our origins date back to October 1872, with the founding of the Royal Prussian College for Fruit Growing and Viticulture in Geisenheim.
At the center of our approach is the holistic consideration of the entire value chain of specialty crops, including grapevines, fruits, vegetables, and ornamental plants. We are committed to studying the diverse production and processing methods of these crops, as well as food safety, food logistics, and the economics and marketing of wine and other beverages. Other focus areas at the university include cultural landscape development, urban open space design, landscape architecture, and conservation.

Our Mission
Research, education, praxis: this triad is at the beating heart of Hochschule Geisenheim University. Our goal is to find new and unique ways to make use of the interplay between these three areas; we conduct both applied and basic research, go far beyond fundamental teaching approaches with a range of practice-oriented study programs, and promote the transfer of knowledge into real-world application.
We currently offer a total of 7 practice-oriented bachelor’s degree programs, 5 of which are available as integrated work-study programs and all of which lead to a professional qualification. Additionally, we offer 10research-based master’s degree programs and also have the right to award doctoral certificates.
With around 50 professors (incl. apl, honorary and co-vocation professors) and numerous scientific staff members, our students are provided with extensive support and an excellent learning environment. Our students and researchers also benefit from our global network of renowned partner universities, institutions, and companies. Our degree programs, including two programs that are taught entirely in English, bring together students from over 50 different nations; approximately 14% of our current 1,400 students are from countries outside of Germany.
With more than 550 employees, Hochschule Geisenheim University is also a major regional employer. Our campus is nestled in the unique cultural landscape of the Rheingau region and has excellent connections to the broader Rhine-Main metropolitan area.

entityDescription:
Recycllux has built the end-to-end platform that connects satellite-based marine litter detection with coordinated field intervention and blockchain-secured impact verification. Earth Observation is the foundation of the system: the platform ingests Sentinel-1 (SAR) and Sentinel-2 (optical) imagery via Google Earth Engine, applies proprietary AI models trained on multi-temporal radar and optical data fusion, and identifies floating marine litter hotspots in coastal accumulation zones. Detection operates continuously, regardless of weather, cloud cover, or water turbidity, and achieves over 80% accuracy against in-situ ground-truth data, with ongoing optimisation targeting 85% and above. A patent on the core data-fusion method is being filed in H1 2026. 

The satellite intelligence is operationalised through a digital Intervention Portal that dispatches the nearest registered local actors, fishing communities and coastal NGOs, to recover and sort waste at the identified coordinates. Every kilogram collected is recorded and secured on blockchain, generating audit-ready reporting for MARPOL, CSRD, and EPR compliance. The model is asset-light: no proprietary vessels, no offshore hardware, and a carbon footprint approximately 46 times lower than conventional industrial cleanup approaches. 

The platform is commercially validated. In September 2025, Recycllux completed its first paid intervention on the Romanian Black Sea coast, coordinating 15 fishers and two environmental NGOs to recover 87 kg of marine waste with 88.24% recycling rate and 131.82 kg CO₂ avoided. Two paying customers are active in the cosmetics and pharmaceutical sectors at a validated 10,000 EUR per mission price point. Over 500,000 EUR in funding has been secured to date, including equity investment from Climate KIC B.V. and grants from the European Commission (Women TechEU) and Google (Social Tides Grow AI). The platform has reached TRL 6 and is published on the European Commission Horizon Results Platform (ID58919; ID99021). 

Recycllux Malta, incorporated December 2025, is positioned to advance the platform's EO capabilities within ESA's PECS framework, with specific development priorities in detection model accuracy, integration of additional Copernicus data streams and multi-basin transferability starting with the Mediterranean across pan european coastal seas. 

Recycllux operates with a team of ten across eight countries, with 60% women in leadership, and is officially included in the EU Mission "Restore Our Ocean and Waters" Charter.

entityDescription:
MONTFORT Laser develops and manufactures extremely compact pulsed DPSSL lasers that deliver performance unmatched at their form factor, with excellent long-term stability. The M-NANO series of compact Nd:YAG nanosecond lasers generates pulse energies exceeding 200 mJ from a palm-sized laser head, serving applications such as LIBS, PIV, LIF, photoacoustics, and LIDT testing. Our core expertise lies in making high-energy nanosecond lasers exceptionally compact, robust, and lightweight relative to their energy and peak power output.
As an example, the M-NANO model PR193 — weighing approximately 2 kg — is a fully self-contained nanosecond laser: no external boxes, no chiller, no water cooling. Simply connect 24 VDC power (a laptop-style supply is included), provide your commands and triggers, and the system is ready to pulse. The entire M-NANO series is optimized for low power consumption, high beam quality, and long operational lifetime.
MONTFORT Laser also offers precision and high laser damage IBS coatings through its NANEO brand.

entityDescription:
The Nicosia District Local Government Organization, is a newly constituted Local Government Authority established under the District Organizations of Local Government Law of 2022. The Organization now serves as the central authority responsible for key public service functions in the Nicosia District.
The Organization consolidates and coordinates critical services previously delivered by multiple local authorities, enhancing cohesion, efficiency and the overall quality of services provided to citizens.
Within its remit, the Organization is responsible for the following sectors:
•Water Supply:Distribution of water, management and maintenance of water networks, ensuring water quality, installation of modern GLS tanks, telemetry systems and smart water metering.
•Sewerage:Creation and integrated operation of the sewage system across the District.
•Stormwater Management:Design and implementation of flood-protection projects tailored to the needs of the District and its communities.
•Development Permitting:Receipt, assessment and issuance of building and development permits using modern digital procedures for the benefit of citizens.
•Solid Waste Management:Supervision and operation of Green Points, along with the management of special and bulky waste.
In addition, the Organization is responsible for the planning and implementation of infrastructure projects, including GLS water tanks, sewage system development and the establishment of new Green Points.
The mission of the Organization is focused on the continuous improvement of public service delivery and the development of a modern and sustainable District. In this context, the strategy and planning of the Nicosia District Local Government Organization are fully aligned with the policies, priorities and objectives of the European Union on sustainable development, as set out in the European Green Deal and the EU Circular Economy Action Plan. Particularemphasis is placed on the efficient use of natural resources, environmental protection and the strengthening of infrastructure resilience at local level.
At the same time, the Organization integrates the principles of the circular economy into the design and implementation of its policies, with a focus on waste prevention, reuse and the rational management of materials and resources. Through the operation and expansion of Green Points, modern solid waste management practices, water resource conservation and the deployment of smart and digital technologies, the Organization actively contributes to the transition towards a sustainable, efficient and environmentally responsible model of local governance, fully aligned with the European regulatory framework.
The Organization seeks to develop cooperation with international institutions and NGOs that share common principles and objectives, with the aim of exchanging expertise and implementing initiatives that benefit the residents of the District.

entityDescription:
cepezedbouwteam
realizes designs in direct collaboration with building partners. We monitor the starting points for budget and planning and coordinate the optimal implementation of the design. The process and all its steps are always fully transparent for the client.

cepezedbouwteam can be deployed as the connecting link between the design and implementation of projects designed by cepezed and other architects. On behalf of the client, we organize the tendering, work preparation and execution of all work tasks. We combine this with carrying out building management. Our way of working has significant advantages: process continuity, maximum quality and financial transparency. Shorter turnaround time is also an important plus.

coordination without main contractor
We organize and coordinate the construction without the intervention of a main contractor. For this purpose, we divide the implementation into separately tendered sub-contracts, so that we can select the construction partners directly and carefully on the basis of knowledge, price and quality. Whenever possible, we make the selection before the design is completed, so that we can move forward quickly when it is ready. This way of working fits in well with cepezed’s specific design philosophy, where buildings are realized as prefabricated building kits.

financial transparency
In each phase of tendering and implementation, we continually compare the actual construction costs against the design estimates. This enables us to anticipate both positive and negative financial developments in a timely and effective manner. The client has continuous financial insight and ultimately decides on all sub-tasks and expenses themself.

optimum knowledge-sharing and collaboration
Our way of working guarantees direct cooperation between the designers and construction partners. The designers continue to be involved and all knowledge of the specific issues is fully retained and can be used for the detail engineering. The designers and construction partners work together on the basis of complete and transparent provision of information. This results in optimal quality and a more efficient construction process. cepezedbouwteam brings all the parties together and coordinates the collaboration.

entityDescription:
ANOX AS is a Norwegian deep-tech company developing a reliability intelligence for unmanned remotely operated systems. The company helps engineers identify, understand, and troubleshoot failures faster by combining telemetry, logs, system knowledge, operational history, and contextual information into a unified diagnostic workflow.
ANOX's technology is designed to provide engineers with actionable insights into what happened, why it happened, and potential paths to resolution. Beyond troubleshooting individual incidents, the platform aims to identify recurring failure patterns across fleets, reduce engineering effort and downtime, and support data-driven decisions related to system design, operations, and reliability improvement.
The technology has been initially validated in unmanned aerial and underwater vehicles (UAVs and ROVs). ANOX is now expanding the approach to additional industries, including the space sector, where increasing system complexity and growing fleet sizes create a need for more scalable diagnostic and reliability capabilities.

entityName: NTT DATA Europe & Latam Green Engineering SLU
entityDescription:
Green Deal & Sustainable Engineering - Innovating for a sustainable future
We provide technology solutions and consulting services to support the transition toward a resilient, efficient, and environmentally responsible model.
Our future depends on the health of the planet. For the first time in history, governments, businesses, the financial sector, and civil society are aligned around a shared objective: achieving low-carbon, resilient, and inclusive development.
The Paris Agreement and the 2030 Agenda set the global framework for action on sustainability, climate change, and environmental protection. These initiatives define ambitious goals that enable organizations and citizens to benefit from a green transition.
At NTT DATA, we support our clients throughout their ecological transition, contributing to a fair, prosperous society and a modern, competitive economy.
Our Service Lines
- Climate Change & Corporate Sustainability
We help clients adapt their operations to a more sustainable and low-carbon model through carbon footprint calculation and reporting, risk and vulnerability analysis, and the design of reduction, offsetting, and carbon market strategies.

- Sustainable Construction
We promote energy-efficient buildings developed under sustainable criteria, contributing to energy savings of up to 50–70%, and supporting certifications such as LEED, BREEAM, and WELL, as well as nearly zero-energy buildings (NZEB).

- Circular Economy
We integrate circularity across the value chain by analyzing life cycles (LCA), identifying key factors, and designing strategies and action plans that ensure sustainable and efficient business models.

- Environment, Biodiversity & Natural Capital
We assess environmental impacts on biodiversity, evaluate natural capital, and define strategies and action plans focused on preserving ecosystems and managing environmental and social risks.

- Energy Efficiency & Energy Transition
We conduct energy audits, develop renewable energy plans, support consumption reduction initiatives, and monitor performance through innovative management dashboards.

- Water
We deliver water engineering and aquatic ecology services, analyzing water cycle infrastructures and applying technology to support the protection and preservation of water resources.

- Sustainable Mobility
We provide solutions for public transport systems, low-emission zone management, and road safety, addressing the environmental impact of mobility in high-demand areas.

- Green IT
We support organizations in adopting green technologies through a Green Computing approach that enhances efficiency while reducing environmental impact.

- Primary Sector
We offer consulting and digitalization services for aquaculture, fisheries, and agribusiness, promoting a more innovative, efficient, and competitive primary sector.

- Smart Cities
We design and implement sustainable and digital transformation plans for cities, covering areas such as energy, pollution, biodiversity, and resource efficiency, while supporting access to funding.

entityDescription:
We are an innovative biotechnology manufacturer specializing in advanced biomaterials and emergency wound care solutions. Our core expertise lies in developing multi-functional, chitosan-based hydrogels designed to operate effectively in high-stress, resource-limited, and austere environments.
Our flagship technology, NovaHemo, is a biocompatible medical dressing that actively promotes platelet aggregation for rapid hemostasis, provides broad-spectrum antimicrobial action (including efficacy against S. aureus and E. coli), and accelerates the healing of acute trauma, surgical wounds, and thermal burns.
In the context of aerospace medicine and long-duration spaceflight, our research and development focus is aligned with optimizing Mass, Volume, and Power (MVP) constraints for onboard medical kits. Our hydrogel addresses critical spaceflight challenges by offering passive bioadhesion—eliminating the need for sustained manual compression—and operating as a zero-particulate material, thereby mitigating contamination risks to spacecraft Environmental Control and Life Support Systems (ECLSS).
Our primary objective within the space sector is to collaborate with the European Space Agency and academic partners to validate our technology's fluid dynamics and adhesion capabilities in microgravity. By advancing our Technology Readiness Level (TRL) through parabolic flight testing and ground-based facilities, we aim to provide next-generation, autonomous trauma care solutions for orbital, lunar, and deep-space exploration architectures.

description:
UniVirtua offers dashAlpha 
dashAlpha is an advanced software-defined networking platform with a focus on intelligent, seamless, resilient and secure network access across a multitude of bearer technologies – whilst being simple and easy to use. Our ‘zero touch’ philosophy with regard to user interaction has resulted in a platform with a simple user interface and a high level of automation to deliver a secure, high-bandwidth network access connection with minimal effort. dashAlpha enables a user to gain network access by simultaneously using different technologies – such as 5G, LTE, WiFi and satellite – to create a single high-bandwidth and secure connection which is resilient to drop-outs and other network failures. In achieving this, dashAlpha is able to not only deliver high bandwidth for streaming services such as Netflix and YouTube but to also deliver seamless network connectivity for communications applications such as WhatsApp, Skype, Teams and Zoom. Additionally, the software-defined nature of dashAlpha enables it to run on a variety of COTS (Commercial-off-the-Shelf) hardware, enabling flexible deployment options.

entityDescription:
Questa is building a new category of enterprise technology: a Decision Intelligence and Agentic AI ecosystem that enables organizations to build and scale AI safely, responsibly, and effectively. 

The company's philosophy is simple: before AI can make decisions, automate workflows, or act autonomously, the underlying data must first be made safe.
The journey starts with privacy-by-design. Through Questa's own proprietary Blackbox technology, sensitive information is automatically identified, anonymized, and protected before being exposed to large language models or AI agents. Names, financial details, personal identifiers, confidential business information, and regulated data can be redacted and replaced with secure placeholders, ensuring organizations maintain control of their information while still benefiting from modern AI capabilities. This approach is particularly valuable for financial institutions, healthcare providers, legal firms, government agencies, and other highly regulated sectors.
Once data is protected, organizations can move beyond experimentation and begin building enterprise-scale AI systems. Questa Solutions helps clients create agentic workflows, decision support systems, AI copilots, and autonomous business processes that integrate directly with existing applications, knowledge repositories, and operational systems. The result is a platform that transforms fragmented data into trusted intelligence and actionable outcomes.
Practical examples include privacy-protected investment research for fund managers, secure M&A due diligence workflows, intelligent document analysis for legal teams, healthcare knowledge assistants that preserve patient confidentiality, and enterprise agents that automate compliance, reporting, and operational decision-making. These solutions enable organizations to accelerate productivity while maintaining GDPR compliance, governance, and auditability.
By combining data protection, decision science, workflow automation, and agentic AI, Questa Solutions provides a scalable foundation for the next generation of intelligent enterprises. Rather than asking organizations to choose between innovation and compliance, the platform makes privacy, security, and governance the starting point for AI-driven transformation.

entityDescription:
Flexible Power Systems (FPS) is a UK-based technology and services company dedicated to accelerating the transition to electric vehicle (EV) fleets through data-driven solutions. The company combines advanced software with deep operational expertise to help organisations confidently plan, deploy and scale electrification strategies while managing cost, risk and performance.
At the core of FPS’s offering is a suite of intelligent tools and services that support every stage of the EV journey. From early-stage transition planning through to large-scale fleet operation, FPS provides strategic consulting, detailed data analysis and practical engineering insight to ensure informed decision-making. Its approach helps businesses assess EV suitability, design optimal rollout plans and maximise the return on investment from electrification initiatives. 
FPS’s proprietary platform, Operate, enables real-time visibility of electric fleets, integrating vehicle tracking, smart charging optimisation and charger management alongside advanced operational analytics. This scalable system is designed to grow with fleets, supporting everything from initial pilots to full-scale deployments, while unlocking efficiencies through automation, energy optimisation and charger sharing. 
In addition, FPS offers targeted solutions such as TRU Fuel Saver, which helps reduce emissions and operating costs from transport refrigeration units by switching from diesel to electric power. This innovation reflects the company’s broader mission to improve sustainability while delivering measurable commercial benefits. 
Since pioneering new approaches to fleet electrification in 2018, FPS has worked with leading organisations to deliver real-world results. With a team experienced in both energy systems and commercial transport, the company bridges the gap between strategy and execution—empowering clients to transition to cleaner, smarter and more efficient transport operations with confidence.

entityDescription:
Silicon Microgravity Ltd. (SMG) is a UK based SME spin-out of Cambridge University that leads in high-precision MEMS inertial and gravity sensors, delivering unmatched accuracy, compact design, and low power consumption. Our resonant MEMS technology surpasses conventional solutions, driving advancements in autonomous navigation, space, aerospace, and subsurface exploration. Backed by over a decade of research and a growing patent portfolio, SMG is redefining motion and gravity sensing for the future.

For inertial navigation, SMG Motion develops high-performance, next generation MEMS sensors for inertial navigation, tilt sensing, and seismology. SMG offers low drift, low noise, high accuracy and sensitivity accelerometers and gyroscopes manufactured in silicon utilising our resonant MEMS technology. These take MEMS technology into the navigation grade arena with the potential to displace larger and more costly FOGs. Focus market segments for applications include Space and Aerospace.

For gravity sensing, SMG Gravity has developed as prototype gravity sensor for surface applications which has a sensitivity of 10 nano-g. The sensor has a form factor and power consumption which makes it suitable for deployment in space and the company has provided quotes for lunar missions.

entityDescription:
Since 1980, Veiligheidstechniek Nederland B.V. (VTN) has been supplying and maintaining high-quality personal protective equipment that enhances the safety of people in hazardous work situations and environments. We can rightfully call ourselves a leading total supplier for industry, defense, fire departments and police, in the Netherlands, Belgium, and Germany, among others.

VTN offers a wide range of personal protective equipment for several markets. Our range includes portable gas detection from BW Honeywell and Blackline Safety, fixed gas detection from Honeywell Analytics, Bacharach, and Oldham Teledyne, and breathing apparatus from Scott 3M. Also, we supply protective clothing and gloves from Ansell, thermal imaging cameras from Bullard and Seek, and high-pressure compressed air compressors from L&W. We are also a certified service partner for these products.
We also represent renowned brands such as JSP Safety, Gumotex (emergency tents), Besto (life jackets), Viking Diving, Miele Professional, Toptrock, and Harstra (cleaning and drying equipment).

In addition to our representations, we produce and develop custom-made breathing air units and air trolleys in-house for the EMEA region. These products bear the CE mark and are approved by SIR and TÜV Nord. With a focus on innovation and product development, we strive to realize solutions together with our customers that fully meet their needs.

In addition to the production and supply of high-quality personal protective equipment, we place great value on the quality of our service within our organization. VTN has its own mobile service team for the Netherlands and Flanders, as well as several well-equipped, manufacturer-certified service workshops for the repair and maintenance of, among other things, portable gas detection equipment, breathing apparatus, diving suits, gastight suits, and compressed air units. Furthermore, our technicians perform preventive maintenance and repairs on-site at the end user's location on items including compressors, compressed air systems, portable and fixed gas detection equipment, and compressed air units and trolleys.

Our team of over 50 specialists is ready to provide you with personalized, tailored advice and service!
