entityDescription:
Polymat Composites is an innovative Italian startup founded in 2022 and headquartered in Tione di Trento, Italy. The company specializes in the design, development, and manufacturing of advanced composite materials, utilizing high-performance technical fibers such as carbon, aramid, and basalt. Innovation, quality, and technological excellence are at the core of its business philosophy.
One of Polymat’s key strengths is represented by the Basax® brand, which identifies environmentally sustainable composite materials manufactured using 100% natural basalt fibers and bio-based resin systems derived from renewable sources, with approximately 87% plant-based content. These materials provide a sustainable alternative to traditional fiberglass composites while ensuring excellent mechanical performance, lightweight properties, durability, and long-term reliability.
Polymat Composites operates across several strategic industries, including automotive, aerospace, light aviation and unmanned aerial systems (UAS/UAVs), industrial robotics, defense, sports equipment, design and furniture, as well as the production and supply of semi-finished composite components. Thanks to its integrated approach, the company independently manages the entire production chain in-house, from concept development to final manufacturing, through a wide range of specialized departments. These include research and development, engineering and technical design, rapid prototyping, resin infusion, hand lay-up lamination, autoclave processing, and additive manufacturing technologies for specific applications.
Polymat’s manufacturing processes are distinguished by a strong commitment to sustainability and environmental responsibility. The company implements advanced production methodologies aimed at minimizing material waste and promoting the internal reuse of residual materials whenever possible. Furthermore, Polymat continuously invests in innovative technologies and advanced systems to improve operational efficiency and optimize energy consumption throughout its facilities.
Driven by an ethical business approach that places environmental stewardship and local value creation at its core, Polymat Composites is committed to delivering solutions that meet the highest standards of quality, performance, and reliability. The company addresses the growing demand for high-performance products that combine technological excellence with environmental responsibility. Its mission is to become a recognized reference point in the advanced composites industry by integrating performance, aesthetics, and sustainability within a business model fully aligned with the principles of the circular economy.

Principia Techne is a deep-tech R&D company focused on space systems, autonomous robotics, and environmental intelligence. We design and build mission-driven solutions that apply first-principles science and precision craftsmanship to critical challenges on Earth and beyond.

entityDescription:
Founded in 2005, METRICA S.A. is a rapidly growing Greek technology company specializing in advanced measurement systems, geospatial technologies, environmental monitoring, and digital transformation solutions. With more than two decades of experience, the company has established itself as a leading provider of high-precision measurement, positioning, and monitoring technologies, serving both public and private sector organizations across infrastructure, environmental, marine, industrial, and research domains. Through continuous investment in innovation, advanced technologies, and highly qualified personnel, METRICA actively supports the development and deployment of cutting-edge solutions that transform geospatial and environmental data into actionable intelligence and operational services. METRICA possesses extensive expertise in GNSS technologies, geodetic monitoring, environmental observation, hydrographic and bathymetric surveying, digital reconstruction of critical infrastructures, structural health monitoring, water quality assessment, meteorological monitoring, oceanographic observations, and smart sensing systems. The company is also actively involved in the design and deployment of autonomous and unmanned platforms for environmental and infrastructure applications.
A key strategic asset of the company is the operation and management of one of the largest GNSS correction service infrastructures in Greece, the HxGN SmartNet network, comprising more than 100 continuously operating reference stations. This infrastructure provides nationwide high-accuracy positioning services and constitutes a valuable platform for geospatial, environmental, and Earth observation applications requiring precise georeferencing and positioning capabilities.
METRICA has established strong partnerships with leading international technology providers, and several other global manufacturers of advanced monitoring and measurement technologies. These collaborations provide direct access to state-of-the-art instrumentation, emerging technologies, and specialized technical expertise.
The company employs more than 50 highly qualified professionals, with approximately 72% holding engineering degrees and an additional 15% originating from scientific disciplines. This multidisciplinary team combines expertise in geospatial sciences, engineering, environmental monitoring, software development, data analytics, and systems integration, enabling METRICA to successfully deliver complex technological projects and innovation-driven initiatives.

entityDescription:
Meneltir is a single entity company incorporated in Malta. It is a wholly independent entity and is not part of a group or other corporate structure. Its shareholders are private individuals, not ordinarily resident in Malta. Regardless, the Company's management is centred on Malta and its Board meetings take place in Malta. Any dividends distributed to shareholders in the future will be paid in Malta subject to the Maltese tax code and due approval of the Company's Board of Directors acting under Maltese company law. 

Meneltir Labs is building an end-to-end atmospheric intelligence system, coupling orbital sensing, AI-native modelling, and operational delivery into a single integrated architecture. Operating from Malta, our mission is to build an AI-native orbital platform; deliver high-cadence atmospheric observations from a constellation designed for on-orbit inference; enable AI-native atmospheric modelling on a neural architecture trained on decades of reanalysis data; produce probabilistic forecast fields with calibrated uncertainty rather than point predictions or ensemble means; and provide sector-specific risk quantification through a unified API.
Building on this atmospheric intelligence stack, Meneltir is developing a parametric insurance and climate-risk platform. Calibrated probabilistic forecasts and event-level hazard quantification are translated into structured risk signals for the insurance, reinsurance, and financial sectors — supporting parametric triggers, automated loss-event detection, and portfolio-level exposure analytics. This connects Meneltir's orbital and modelling layers directly to the decisions and capital flows of risk carriers, closing the loop from observation to underwriting.

description:
solva: Unlocking Agrivoltaic Potential With economical sustainable Innovation
solva supports companies, farmers, and industry stakeholders in Europe to deploy photovoltaics in an economically and operationally efficient manner.
Planning cost is reduced by up to 80% and field management, AI paired with advanced satellite and spatial data to unlock new synergies between traditional landuse, industry and solar energy. The platform supports farmers, project developers, and investors in designing, monitoring, and operating systems produce energy. Metrics of cost, efficiency, energy, CO2 and produced material increase resilience against energy crisis.
In densely populated urban and suburban environments, this creates a clear advantage: biodiversity, agricultural use, and renewable electricity generation can be meaningfully combined on the same parcel of land.
As one of the ESA BIC incubatee we got accepted November 2025 and have so access to a big partner network.
solva addresses three core challenges in the sustainable transition:
Enabling high-quality, data-driven agrivoltaic project planning that reduces risk in early stage and so accelerates permitting and financing.
Optimizing ongoing operations through continuous monitoring, yield and shading analytics, and targeted interventions on the field.
Creating a digital backbone that connects agricultural data, energy performance, and carbon/climate metrics to support new business models such as carbon farming and ecosystem services.

entityDescription:
Photon-IV Inc. is a Canadian deep-tech defence and telecommunications company headquartered in Cambridge, Ontario. The company develops AI-driven predictive orchestration software for satellite-terrestrial (TN-NTN) network integration, addressing operational challenges in handover continuity, multi-orbit coordination, and resilient connectivity in contested or remote environments.
Photon-IV's technical focus sits at the intersection of O-RAN, non-terrestrial networks, and applied machine learning. The company has developed a proprietary AI orchestration platform built on a Temporal Fusion Transformer architecture. Current model performance: RSRP prediction Mean Absolute Error of 2.34 dBm and P50 inference latency of 20.9 milliseconds, both validated against third-party benchmarks.
The company's product portfolio includes four lines:
- Stellarlink, an O-RAN xApp for AI-driven TN-NTN handover orchestration (TRL 6)
- Predict, an rApp for IoT-NTN battery and connectivity optimization (TRL 5)
- SwarmNet, a resilient AI-orchestrated mesh communications layer for autonomous and unmanned platforms (TRL 4)
- Spectra, an extensible AI xApp and rApp framework for future 6G architectures (TRL 3)
Photon-IV holds multiple US provisional patents filed in March 2026, covering O-RAN broadband handover, IoT-NTN battery optimization, and defence uncrewed systems handover. 
The company participated in the O-RAN Alliance international plugfest at Virginia Tech, where its xApp underwent third-party validation in partnership with Keysight Technologies. Photon-IV is the only Canadian company on the published participant list for this round.
Active programmes include a Canadian Department of National Defence IDEaS contract (CW2428540), with Milestone 1 delivered and advancement to Milestone 2 confirmed. The company holds an active partnership and sandbox arrangement with Calian Group, is engaged with TerreStar Solutions on a joint Memorandum of Understanding for defence-validated orchestration on the Canadian sovereign MSS network, and has signed a Memorandum of Understanding with Arctic Space Technologies (Sweden). Photon-IV is also co-developing a counter-UAS drone swarm defence solution with Telecard (Ukraine) under the NATO BRAVE programme.
Photon-IV holds Controlled Goods Program registration and Reliability Status clearance for defence work in Canada. The company is a Creative Destruction Lab alumnus and a Velocity (University of Waterloo) partner. Technical leadership includes the Chief Wireless Architect, Chief AI Architect, and Lead AI Engineer, supported by an applied engineering team and co-op researchers from leading Canadian universities.
The company's strategic priority for ESA engagement is the integration of its AI orchestration platform into European NTN and 6G research and commercial trials, with active applications submitted to the ESA-GSMA Foundry 2026 challenges on AI for NTN (Project ORION) and 6G Innovation (Project NOVA).

SKYA Oy | Binabik.ai is a deep-tech start-up focusing on embedded and agentic AI for physical robot manipulation with multi-robot systems. The platform enables real-world autonomy, proactive memory, and adaptive behaviors across heterogeneous robot fleets—including UAVs, UGVs, and humanoid agents—for tasks like logistics, inspection, and collaborative manipulation also in space and in-orbit assembly, maintenance, and repair works.​
Leveraging Binabik.ai's opinionated toolkit, SKYA delivers low-latency runtime, fleet orchestration, and human-in-the-loop operations compatible with custom sensors and ROS 2 environments. This supports precise physical interactions, such as payload handovers for aerial robots for scalable aerial data collection contributing the the Earth Observation ecosystem and services with high-precision and on-demand data. Moreover, the solutions enable dynamic robots mission planning in industrial, civil protection, and defence scenarios.​
Key capabilities include:
- Agentic physical AI: Robots that observe, remember context (e.g., object locations), and execute parallel tasks like patrolling, scanning, and conversing while adapting to changes.​

- Multi-robot collaboration: UWB-secured communication for swarms, enabling humanoid integration alongside aerial and ground units for safe human-aware operations.​

- Embedded edge processing: Groq inference with async tool calls for real-time docking, virtual landing zones, and secure DLT integration in multi-agent systems.​

Originating from academic roots in UWB, secure embedded and agentic AI systems, and urban informatics, SKYA | Binabik.ai scales affordable, resilient solutions for 24/7 autonomous services

Novation Tech Hu has its registered office in Sárréti Ipari Park 041/12 hrsz Szeghalom. Novation Tech Hu was incorporated in 2011 and is exclusively involved in manufacturing activities.The Company is specialized in producing componentry for the automotive sector. The company counts about 490 employees and is focused on mass production, it operates as a toll manufacturer for Novation Tech S.p.A.
The main activity of Novation Tech Hu is the production of carbon fibre composite components for Novation Tech S.p.A.Novation Tech is specialized in moulding components in carbon and composite materials. Its drive for continuous improvement and innovation, typical of the competitive sports world, combined with the industrial know-how of the area in which it is located, are the pillars of Novation Tech's business model. Today, in fact, it is one of the leading companies in Europe specializing in high-tech carbon composites and employs more than 1.400 people.Group ProductsNovation Tech Group was originally established as a manufacturer of metal parts, over the years Novation Tech expanded its scope to include plastic injection and the processing of special alloys and today is a leader throughout Europe in the processing and manufacturing of carbon fiber reinforced plastic (CFRP) and composite materials for automotive, aerospace, sports and eyewear parts. Today the core business of the Group is divided into three main sectors, by end-market:•Automotive: automotive is largely the most significant business unit in terms of turnover. From seats to interior parts, structural components and body parts: Novation Tech has developed a number of innovative technologies for the automobile sector to meet both aesthetic and functional needs. Thanks to such technologies, since 2007 it supplies some of the leading car manufacturers.•Sport & Leisure: this is the second segment in term of turnover for the Group, thanks to its patents, which combine plastic and composite materials, Novation Tech is an active part of the constant evolution of the sport lightweight equipment with the aim of maximizing performance, creating products which meet all technical and aesthetic needs: frames, wheels and saddles for bicycles; eyewear; mountaineering equipment.•Aerospace: this is the newest business segment, thanks to its know-how in composite materials, Novation Tech has created and patented a new technology for manufacturing parts for the aerospace industry. The focus of the company is on interiors, leveraging its expertise in seat production with the new patented technology and expanding its customer base.Investments in research as developing processes and innovative production technologies combined with a lean approach to manufacturing, make Novation Tech a leader in the global automobile industry, responding promptly to market demands and delivering finished products of the highest standard. Thanks to its technological knowledge and skills, the company is able to help the clients identify its needs, working together to choose the most suitable materials and technologies that will give the desired outcome, in terms of mechanics, aesthetics, time and costs.

IANUS Technologies is a Cyprus-based research and technology company specializing in cybersecurity, crisis management, civil protection, and digital innovation. The company develops advanced software solutions and platforms that support public authorities, law enforcement agencies, first responders, municipalities, and critical infrastructure operators in addressing complex security and resilience challenges.
IANUS Technologies has extensive experience in European-funded research and innovation projects, particularly under Horizon Europe, EDF and other security-related programmes. Its expertise spans areas such as cyber threat intelligence, vulnerability assessment, situational awareness, decision-support systems, geospatial analytics, and secure information sharing.

Among its key innovations is SERVE, an advanced platform and methodology designed to assess vulnerabilities and security risks in public spaces, critical infrastructures, and large-scale events. SERVE combines geospatial analysis, threat attractiveness modelling, environmental parameters, and operational risk indicators to support evidence-based decision-making and improve preparedness and resilience. The solution enables authorities and security planners to identify weaknesses, evaluate potential impacts, and strengthen preventive and response measures through a structured and adaptable assessment framework.
IANUS is also the developer of MAESTRO, an integrated crisis management and situational awareness platform designed to support emergency response coordination and operational collaboration. MAESTRO provides real-time information sharing, incident monitoring, communication, and decision-support capabilities for first responders, law enforcement agencies, civil protection authorities, and crisis managers. The platform incorporates advanced technologies such as geospatial intelligence, secure communications, and mobile support tools to enhance coordination and response efficiency during emergencies and security incidents.

Our portfolio includes:

• Position sensors (LVDT, potentiometric, magnetostrictive and laser sensors)
• Rotary encoders and angular position measurement systems
• Pressure, temperature, humidity and environmental sensors
• Inclinometers and inertial measurement devices (IMU)
• Force, load and torque measurement systems
• Data acquisition and signal conditioning equipment
• Industrial communication interfaces and monitoring systems
• Structural health monitoring instrumentation
• Calibration and measurement solutions

GUEMISA collaborates with leading European manufacturers and technology partners, providing customized solutions from prototype development to industrial deployment.

The company supports customers in Spain, Portugal and international markets through technical consultancy, engineering support, system integration and after-sales service.

We are interested in participating in ESA-related projects as:

• Supplier of sensors and instrumentation
• Technical partner for measurement and monitoring systems
• Consortium member for industrial and R&D projects
• Technology provider for data acquisition and sensing applications

Core competencies include precision measurement, industrial sensing technologies, environmental monitoring, signal processing and instrumentation engineering.

entityDescription:
Montr develops innovative IoT-based safety solutions designed to protect employees and lone workers in situations where immediate assistance may be required. The Montr IoT Emergency Button enables users to trigger an alarm with a single press, providing rapid notification and location information to designated responders, monitoring centres, or integrated third-party platforms.
The solution combines advanced communication technologies such as LTE-M, NB-IoT, GNSS positioning, and Wi-Fi-based indoor localisation with a secure cloud platform to ensure reliable and timely alarm delivery. Montr serves organisations across healthcare, local government, housing associations, facility management, security services, and other sectors where employee safety is a critical concern.
Based in the Netherlands, Montr develops both the hardware and software components of its solutions in-house, allowing for rapid innovation and close alignment with customer requirements. Recent developments include indoor positioning using Wi-Fi fingerprinting and the integration of Non-Terrestrial Network (NTN) capabilities to provide satellite-based connectivity in areas where terrestrial mobile coverage is unavailable. Through these innovations, Montr is building the next generation of resilient personal safety solutions that remain connected whenever and wherever help is needed.

OpenGeoHub is a research foundation with headquarters in Wageningen, the Netherlands (Stichting OpenGeoHub, KvK 71844570). The main goal of the OpenGeoHub is to promote publishing and sharing of Open Geographical and Geoscientific Data and using and developing Open Source Software. 
OpenGeoHub foundation provides three types of services:
- Data production: We promote and actively support the production, sharing and use of Open GeoData (based on the Open Knowledge Foundation licenses). We provide platforms, tools, standards and training to encourage and support Open Geodata and reproducible research shared using open web services and open standards.
- Training and workshops: We help researchers grow by connecting them with peer networks, helping them improve their programming skills, and helping them to make their research more open and reproducible. We aim especially to encourage and empower under-represented researchers (e.g. those from ODA recipient countries and female researchers). We are a certified higher education organization registered under the Dutch Centraal Register Kort Beroeps Onderwijs (CRKBO).

- Serving decision makers: We aim to provide all users (governmental and non-governmental organizations, private sector companies and the general public) with easily accessible and trustworthy Open Geographical Environmental Data, fully documented, peer reviewed and reproducible.

entityDescription:
FireSafe is a wildfire intelligence company that combines real-time AI detection, geospatial risk analysis, and predictive modelling into a single integrated platform. FireSafe gives municipalities, utilities, insurers, and emergency-management agencies the intelligence to act before a wildfire becomes a disaster — identifying ignitions at the earliest stage, mapping exposure to the asset level, and forecasting fire behaviour to deliver hours of decision-making lead time rather than minutes.
Capabilities
FireSafe operates across three integrated layers. AI-powered detection monitors up to 2,800 sq km per unit, 24/7 and in all weather conditions, flagging ignitions before a 911 call is placed. Risk analysis maps vulnerabilities across an entire jurisdiction — infrastructure, residential zones, and critical assets — to support resource allocation and resilience planning. Predictive modelling simulates fire spread based on terrain, fuel load, weather, and historical data, supporting evacuation planning and operational response.
Earth Observation & Space Technology
FireSafe integrates geospatial satellite data and hyperspectral imagery to strengthen its modelling pipeline. Hyperspectral analysis is used to characterise vegetation and fuel load for vegetation-management programmes, while multi-source satellite Earth Observation data feeds the platform's risk, hazard, and predictive layers. This fusion of ground-based AI sensing with spaceborne imagery enables continuous, high-resolution monitoring of wildfire risk across large and remote landscapes.
Markets & Applications
FireSafe serves government, utility, insurance, and critical-infrastructure operators seeking quantified, defensible wildfire risk intelligence. The platform deploys in weeks and is engineered for demanding terrain and environmental conditions, supporting detection, mitigation, and emergency-response use cases at municipal, regional, and national scale.

entityDescription:
TorqueFuture s.r.o. is a Slovak deep-tech research and development company focused on a patented high-efficiency electromagnetic motor architecture. The technology uses permanent magnets in both the stator and the rotor, while windings are used primarily for electromagnetic flux commutation and control.
The current laboratory prototype has been independently tested by Slovak academic partners and has demonstrated measured efficiency of approximately 89–94% at around 100–150 W, including power electronics, depending on the operating point and measurement conditions.
TorqueFuture is interested in cooperation with ESA, industrial and research partners for further technology optimisation, prototype validation and adaptation to space-relevant applications such as actuators, robotic mechanisms, positioning systems and long-duty drive subsystems where energy efficiency, thermal stability and reliability are critical.

description:
Are you looking for an innovative technology for aluminum welding or bimaterial assemblies? Is the economic competitiveness of welding an important criteria for you? Because innovation is at the heart of business concerns, StirWeld is democratizing Friction Stir Welding (FSW).

Stirweld team has developed a technology allowing the use of friction stir welding (FSW) on all types of CNC machine. We support you in the optimisation of your machine park and the integration of a new know-how to offer to your customers. Our FSW head for CNC offers identical performances as a special FSW machine (effort control, quality recording,...). Its other advantages:
-	Low investment cost compared to special machines or FSW robotic stations.
-	Adaptability: despite the absence of standard machining centres, the FSW head of Stirweld can be adapted to all CNC machines.
-	Easy to use and to install: after the first installation, the user can mount and dismount the FSW head in a few minutes, easily switching from machining to welding and vice versa. 
Our customers are in the automotive, space, aerospace and metal working industries.

Our products: welding heads, standardised FSW tools and tool holders, industrial study, training FSW.

Friction Stir Welding Head for CNC Machine
Our FSW head can weld from existing CNC machine tools, whether it is a 3, 4 or 5-axis machine. The Stirweld FSW head brings the FSW welding functions to the machining center: force control and recording, cooling, protection of the spindle against loads and vibrations. The offer of this equipment highly reduces the investment cost of an FSW machine while offering the same performance as a special FSW machine.

Friction Stir Welding tools
Striweld offer you 3 types of FSW tools:
-	FSW tools high strength aluminium,
-	FSW tools standard aluminium,
-	FSW tools Al/Fe, - FSW tools Al/Si.
Stirweld experts are here to advise you in the appropriate choice for your specific applications. FSW Stirweld tools are robust & powerful for a controlled cost.
Friction Stir Welding Tool Holders
Stirweld tool holders are compatible with all FSW machines: Stirweld FSW Head for NC machines, FSW special machines, FSW robots. Tool holders are available in two versions: 
-	Classic tool holder,
-	Smart tool holder with temperature measurement.
Our tool holders handle your tools for your milling or drilling operations or your friction stir welding operations.

FSW industrial study
Stirweld support you throughout all your project(s) to succeed your first FSW part:
-	Co-design of your parts,
-	Design & manufacturing of clamping jig,
-	Welding parameters & quality control,
-	Support & optimization.

FSW 3-day training
Stirweld experts offer you a training about Friction Stir Welding: 
-	Discovery of the FSW process, - How to weld from a CNC machine, 
-	The FSW process adjustment, 
-	Implementation of learnings on FSW machine,
-	Impact of FSW parameters on welding quality,
-	Production of typical FSW defect.

Friction Stir Welding Expertise
With a skilled and fully committed team, Stirweld aspires to conquer a new market: FSW at low cost.
Since 1995, FSW remains a technology reserved for high added value applications involving expensive equipment. Our expertise, which is the result of 15 years of experience, enables Stirweld team to develop a technology for FSW for all types of CNC.

AEROSTACKS s. r. o. is a Slovak technology company developing an advanced snow monitoring and management solution for ski resorts and mountain infrastructure operators. Its product combines a snowcat-mounted, radar-based sensor with a centralised software platform to collect, process and visualise data on snow depth, snow quality, density and the thickness of individual snow and ice layers.

The solution supports data-driven management of ski slopes by helping operators assess slope conditions, optimise snow grooming and snowmaking strategies, improve slope quality and safety, and reduce unnecessary resource consumption. It can also support the monitoring of snow and glacier conditions underneath ski slopes.

Aerostacks focuses on radar sensing, field data acquisition, data visualisation and software-based decision support for more efficient and sustainable snow management in mountain environments.

The Milan Fire Brigade Command is one of the largest operational commands of the Italian National Fire and Rescue Service (Corpo Nazionale dei Vigili del Fuoco), the national authority responsible for fire prevention, firefighting, technical rescue, civil protection support and emergency response throughout Italy.
Serving the Metropolitan City of Milan and its surrounding area, the Command manages tens of thousands of emergency incidents every year, ranging from urban and industrial fires to natural hazards, major accidents, technological emergencies and civil protection operations. In addition to its operational duties, the Command actively contributes to innovation, training, emergency planning and European cooperation initiatives.
The Milan Fire Brigade Command has developed significant expertise in command-and-control systems, situational awareness, emergency coordination and CBRN response, including participation in European programmes such as rescEU. Through its operational experience and direct engagement with emergency management stakeholders, the Command provides valuable end-user knowledge and validation capabilities for the development of innovative emergency response services.

QoolNet was founded to address a fundamental gap in the adoption of quantum-safe cryptography: the challenge of operating it reliably at scale. While advances in QKD and post-quantum algorithms are essential, real-world deployments demand architectures that can manage variability, complexity, and operational constraints.
Our team brings deep experience in quantum technologies, networking, and large-scale systems. This background shapes an approach that prioritizes operability, interoperability, and long-term sustainability over isolated technical achievements. We design solutions that treat cryptography as infrastructure—something that must remain predictable, governable, and auditable in production environments.
By combining systems-level thinking with active contributions to standards and applied research, QoolNet enables organizations to move beyond pilots and demonstrations, turning quantum-safe technologies into dependable components of real-world communication networks.

entityDescription:
The Microsystems Laboratory - as the part of the HUN-REN Centre for Energy Research is intended to research and develop integrated sensors and sensor systems, MEMS and BioMEMS devices fabricated by silicon or polymer micro- and nanomachining technology. The activity covers the characterisation of novel functional materials, development of sensing principles, technology solutions and application-specific microsystems. The utilisation of micro- and nanomachining technology enables the miniaturisation of sensing and analytical systems and integration of various functions of sample preparation, sensing, readout, actuation or communication. The laboratory is focusing on the development of mechanical, physical, chemical (and biochemical) sensors, functional micro- and nanofluidic devices, implantable microsystems and infrared LED.

The Laboratory operates a unique infrastructure in Hungary, which is open for academic and industrial partners to fabricate (and to characterise) complex, purpose-designed microsystems, nanocircuits, as well as Lab-on-a-Chip devices and to develop their technology solutions. The Laboratory is a dedicated infrastructure of the HCHiP Chips Competence Centre, and the European network of Chips Competence Centers.
The high-tech microtechnology related fabrication and characterisation systems work in a class 10 cleanroom facility. The laboratory is dedicated for 3D processing of 4” Si / glass / polymer substrates with maximal resolution of 1µm, together with lithographic mask manufacturing. Electron beam lithography and focused ion beam (FIB) milling are also available with resolution of 20nm. Multi-domain Finite-Element Modelling (FEM), and process simulation also support the structural design and development. Wide spectra of characterisation techniques are also available: optical (fluorescent) and electron microscopy (SEM and EDS), atomic force microscopy (AFM), profilometry, optical and electrical measurements, electrochemical impedance spectroscopy, microfluidic characterisation, mechanical vibration and climate test chambers, UV-Vis / IR / FTIR / FLUORESCENT / RAMAN spectroscopy, etc.

entityDescription: eXplorAI is a technology-oriented startup originating from Sapienza University of Rome, focused on the design, implementation, and validation of advanced software and robotic solutions for autonomous systems operating in complex, unstructured, and GNSS-denied environments. The company primarily targets applications in the space sector, while adopting a dual-use approach that enables the transfer of aerospace-grade autonomy, sensing, and robotic technologies to terrestrial contexts where human access is limited, hazardous, or operationally constrained.The core business ofeXplorAIis the development and integration of autonomous functionalities for robotic systems, addressing the full chain from system analysis and algorithm design to validation in representative operational scenarios. The company focuses on software solutions for GNC of autonomous robotic platforms, combining model-based engineering approaches with artificial intelligence and machine learning techniques when these provide significant improvements in robustness, adaptability, and operational performance. In support of these capabilities,eXplorAIdevelops advanced software solutions for the analysis and processing of data acquired by scientific and engineering payloads onboard satellites and mobile platforms, including wheeled vehicles and aerial systems. Drawing on consolidated expertise in the interpretation of measurements from heterogeneous systems, such as optical imaging systems, LiDAR sensors, ground-penetrating radar, and radio- or laser-based communication links for cooperative robotic operations, the company enables enhanced perception, situational awareness, and decision-making capabilities for autonomous systems.To support technology maturation and ensure reliable performance assessment,eXplorAIdeploys its software solutions on COTS computing hardware, enabling hardware-in-the-loop testing under representative operational conditions. The company develops high-fidelity digital twins of extraterrestrial environments, integrating realistic visual appearance with accurate dynamical modeling of vehicles, sensors, and system interactions. These digital twins enable the definition of mission-relevant scenarios, support software-in-the-loop testing, and provide a controlled and repeatable framework for the quantitative evaluation of autonomous navigation, perception, and decision-making pipelines.Prototyping activities encompass wheeled platforms as well as alternative mobility concepts, including hopping and legged robotic systems, designed to operate in terrains and environments characterized by stringent operational constraints. eXplorAI develops robotic systems for interaction with the environment, enabling grasping, manipulation, and relative pose estimation of non-cooperative targets. These activities include the design and prototyping of robotic arms and end-effectors for applications ranging from in-orbit servicing to terrestrial operations, supporting tasks such as inspection, manipulations, sample handling, and tool deployment. Building on validated academic research, mission-oriented experience, and system-level integration capabilities, eXplorAI bridges scientific innovation and industrial deployment through a portfolio of high-value software solutions, robotic prototypes, and advanced testing infrastructures.

The system has been experimentally validated on a real ROS 2 rover platform, with applications in autonomous robotics, critical inspection, remote operations, space-analogue environments and long-duration embedded autonomy.

Our business model combines chip sales (direct and via distributors such as Rutronik, Avnet, and Arrow) with IP licensing to semiconductor and fabless companies, especially in segments we do not directly address (e.g., consumer electronics). Licensing can generate earlier revenue because it requires less maturity than shipping full chips. We already partner with AMD and Siemens. AMD provides tools, reduced-price hardware for demonstrators, and distribution visibility for an FPGA IP prototype via its partners’ IP catalog. Siemens also provide free tools, as well as marketing and business connections with potential customers.
Durance AI’s long-term goal is to lead AI chips for autonomous systems, starting with computer vision and expanding to other AI workloads. In the current phase, we are commercializing demonstrators (sold to four early adopters, including one major European and one major Japanese company), refining the platform to reduce per-deployment engineering, and finalizing product specifications and a technology roadmap by May 2026. We closed a �1.021M pre-seed in January 2026 (�581k equity, �440k non-dilutive from Bpifrance) and hired four engineers. Next, we target �5M in early 2027 to fund hiring, outsourced design, and silicon fabrication/packaging to deliver a silicon demonstrator close to the final product, with an additional round planned for late 2028 to support mass production.
We are already active in Europe and Japan and plan to enter the US soon. As a fabless company, we can scale strongly, as Nvidia, Qualcomm or AMD did with the same fabless business model. Our core technology is protected by an international patent (Europe, China, USA) owned by Université Côte d’Azur and CNRS, licensed to Durance AI on a fully exclusive basis, and we plan two additional patents in 2026.

Our team consists of different specialists, such as engineers, programmers, foresters, and analysts. We have developed an innovative tool for detecting wildfires.

We started developing the algorithms and AI dedicated to detecting smoke in 2010. After a couple of years, we managed to create a powerful tool that can infallibly detect wildfires within minutes after the outbreak, with only a small percentage of false alarms caused by clouds, fog, or smog – and thanks to the constant progress of the IT industry, we are able to keep on perfecting our system. We trust that we have created an essential tool that is unique on a global scale.

The system is based on AI, machine learning, and deep learning. It detects wildfires within minutes after the outbreak from a distance of 15 km (~10 miles) and sends an alert immediately after. We hope that SmokeD will play a major role in fighting and preventing fires, as well as in protecting the environment, people, and their property.

As of now, we are surveilling over 3 million hectares of land globally with 190 intelligent cameras. Our detectors can detect fires within minutes, enabling earlier extinguishing efforts and significantly reducing potential risks to people, property, and the environment.

description:
Geospatial intelligence for drone mission planning

Stratomaps has developed a geospatial intelligence platform for drone mission planning and dynamic in-flight re-routing. Our solution computes optimal 3D flight paths by accounting for both regulatory and operational constraints: ground risk (population density), air risk (civil aviation restriction zones), terrain topography, and aircraft-specific characteristics. As conditions change, it recomputes the optimal path in real time. The technology operates over areas pre-processed through our proprietary map and satellite data pipeline. It supports use cases including long-distance delivery (logistics, as well as medical and emergency payloads such as defibrillators), civil safety (improving situational awareness for firefighters), and manufacturers' regulatory compliance (geo-caging and geo-awareness).

entityDescription:
Real Again Srl is an Italian deep-tech innovative startup founded in Turin in 2024, with operations in São Paulo, Brazil, operating at the intersection of Semantic AI, Digital Twin technology, Quantum-Ready computing, and immersive spatial intelligence. The company develops proprietary AI platforms and algorithmic infrastructure for complex system modelling, Earth Observation analytics, and real-time decision support, with active applications in space-enabled services, environmental monitoring, urban intelligence, and critical infrastructure management.
Real Again's core technological differentiator is a proprietary semantic graph inference engine that enables multi-source data fusion, knowledge representation, and context-aware reasoning across heterogeneous data environments. This architecture functions as an intelligent semantic layer capable of integrating satellite EO streams, in-situ sensor networks, aerial telemetry, and ground-based data sources into unified, interpretable operational models, providing the analytical backbone for space-derived service applications requiring high explainability and real-time responsiveness.
Building on this foundation, Real Again develops advanced propagation algorithms that translate complex physical dynamics, including fire spread, atmospheric dispersion, environmental risk cascades, and structural stress diffusion, into real-time, fully navigable 3D simulation environments. These algorithms incorporate multi-layer geospatial inputs, terrain morphology, meteorological modelling, and satellite-derived vegetation and thermal indices to generate high-fidelity predictive scenarios. Simulation outputs are deployed as interactive Digital Twin instances, enabling operators and decision-makers to run forward projections, stress-test intervention strategies, and monitor evolving conditions in immersive XR environments before and during real-world operations.
Real Again's Digital Twin platforms are engineered for bidirectional, live data exchange with physical systems, supporting configurable temporal prediction horizons and photorealistic XR rendering pipelines that preserve physical accuracy while enabling intuitive spatial interaction for emergency coordinators, civil protection agencies, and scientific operators.
The company's computer vision and multimodal AI capabilities include semantic segmentation, multi-temporal change detection, anomaly identification in thermal and multispectral imagery, and AI-driven scene understanding from both aerial and satellite data sources, with operational deployments spanning burn scar mapping, land cover analysis, and satellite-derived risk assessment.
Real Again's Quantum-Ready infrastructure layer embeds quantum-classical hybrid inference pipelines and variational quantum circuit interfaces within its core graph models, ensuring forward compatibility with post-classical computing environments and long-term scalability of deployed analytical platforms.
The company holds active institutional roles within the European Innovation Council and the AI Ethics Board of the City of Turin, and maintains established partnerships with research institutions, urban regeneration agencies, and aerospace organisations across Europe and South America.

entityDescription:
SAFINA, a.s. is a Czech specialty metals producer headquartered in Vestec near Prague, with a heritage in precious and non-ferrous metals processing reaching back to the mid-19th century. The company has a long tradition in the complex processing and manufacture of products from precious and non-ferrous metals such as thermocouple wires, PGM wires, plates and tubing, sputtering targets, labware, chemicals, powders and others. Building on this metallurgical know-how, SAFINA has become one of Europe's established suppliers of gas-atomized metal powders for advanced manufacturing technologies. Metal Additive Manufacturing
Focus on Additive Manufacturing
SAFINA entered the additive manufacturing (AM) materials market in the early 2010s and has since developed a dedicated business line — SAFINA 3D Printing — supplying powders engineered for industrial AM processes. The company's powders are used in Powder Bed Fusion (PBF) and Cold Gas Spray (CGS) technologies, with a well-tuned production process that allows SAFINA to deliver powders with customer-specific grain size and chemical composition. Quality control includes sieve analysis, laser diffraction, dynamic image particle analysis, SEM, chemical analysis (ICP-OES, EDX), gas content measurement, and tap and apparent density/flow testing, ensuring consistent batch-to-batch performance for demanding AM applications. AI Verse is a French DeepTech company originating from INRIA, specializing in synthetic data generation for computer vision AI. The company develops GAIA, a procedural 3D simulation platform that generates large-scale, realistic, and automatically annotated image datasets for training, testing, and validating AI models.
 
AI Verse addresses the data bottleneck faced by organizations developing AI vision systems, especially where real-world data is scarce, expensive, sensitive, or difficult to collect. Its technology enables the generation of diverse scenarios across environments, lighting, weather, sensor viewpoints, object configurations, and edge cases.
 
The company serves defense, security, aerospace, and industrial applications, including object detection, target recognition, autonomous systems, ISR, surveillance, drone and satellite imagery, maritime monitoring, and AI model validation. AI Verse has experience working with European defense primes, armed forces, and technology partners, providing synthetic datasets and simulation capabilities to improve model robustness, reduce false positives, and accelerate AI deployment.

Crosshill designs, tests, and manufactures highly secure electronic systems for defense, aerospace, telecom, and space applications. Developed systems are protected against modern attack and tampering methods, to guarantee security and operational capabilities in all circumstances. Crosshill also offers advanced security testing services to evaluate the overall security level of electronic systems and devices. State-of-the-art passive and active testing methods are applied for both semiconductor and board level security assessments. 

Crosshill has extensive experience in advanced microelectronics, such as FPGAs, System-on-Chips, and cryptoprocessors, that lay the foundation for highly secure communication systems, cryptographic equipment, and space electronics. Anti-tamper services focus on silicon, sensor, and mechanical level protection mechanisms to safeguard classified information and sensitive IPs. 

Crosshill has a certified quality management system (ISO 9001:2015 and AQAP 2110 ed. D), valid facility security clearance (FSC) certificate up to SECRET and personnel security clearances (PSC) up to SECRET for cross national projects.

At Spectricon, our purpose is to innovate towards advancing mainstream technologies of hyperspectral imaging, while at the same time making them simple, portable and smart.
By pushing the limits of spectral imaging, the company has created and globally distributes next-generation hyperspectral camera platforms that provide the industry’s highest spatial resolution and widest spectral range. Our proprietary full-frame snapscan and handheld snapshot technologies can be trained to detect micro-structures and compositions of complex materials, making these tools more accessible, smart, and easy to deploy. 
Spectricon’s advanced spectral camera technologies have earned international awards and recognition and are sold across North America, Europe, and Asia, serving a variety of sectors, such as research institutions, remote sensing, microscopy, machine vision, online sorting, food processing, forensics, and artwork analysis.

entityDescription:
M3S Italia is an Italian technology company headquartered in Rome, Italy, specialising in the development, production and commercialisation of innovative, high-technology products and services for civil and defence markets, both nationally and internationally.
The company provides full system engineering services in the aeronautical, space, airport and transportation sectors, covering the entire lifecycle from concept definition and research through design, prototyping, testing, validation and operational deployment. M3S Italia develops hardware/software integrated, turnkey solutions for public and private customers.
Core technical competencies include GNSS signal quality monitoring and analysis (GPS, Galileo, GLONASS, BeiDou), satellite communication (SATCOM) link assessment for GEO, MEO and LEO constellations, RF interference detection and geolocation, and advanced positioning system engineering. The company also develops UAS/drone-based solutions, including BLOS/VLOS communication architectures integrating SATCOM and GNSS technologies, autonomous UAV platforms, drone-based remote sensing and spectrum monitoring payloads.
M3S Italia has strong expertise in software engineering and artificial intelligence, developing dedicated algorithms, AI/ML-based data processing platforms, Big Data analytics, IoT and robotics systems, and digital platforms for real-time telemetry and quality reporting.

entityDescription: NordSpace is a Canadian space company delivering end-to-end mission solutions, including launch vehicles, spaceport infrastructure, and in-space hardware. Headquartered near Toronto, Canada, NordSpace brings together a highly experienced engineering and program delivery team with proven track records from successful space launch companies and across major space agency and defence programs. Its flagship Tundra launch vehicle is a fully ITAR-free, two-stage liquid bipropellant rocket on track for responsive light-lift launches to LEO/SSO by 2028, with a roadmap toward reusable medium-lift in the early 2030s, making NordSpace a competitive launch partner for European institutional and commercial payloads. NordSpace also develops a growing catalogue of in-space hardware for small satellite missions, including the Zephyr electric propulsion thruster, the Chronos edge-AI camera, and VLEO non-terrestrial networking payloads for resilient, secure communications. NordSpace operates its own Atlantic Spaceport Complex (ASX) in Newfoundland, ideally positioned to support responsive, resilient cross-Atlantic allied launches, including under initiatives such as NATO STARLIFT. With an ITAR-free product line, established collaborations with European industry and research institutions, and rigorous in-house advanced manufacturing and testing capabilities, NordSpace is well positioned to support ESA missions and joint Canada–Europe space initiatives.

entityDescription:
Or3it develops a no-code Earth Observation (EO) analytics platform that consolidates satellite imagery sourcing, AI-driven analysis, and enterprise integration into a single unified workflow environment. It is built on the LexaTexer AI analytics platform and extends proven industrial AI architecture into geospatial applications.
 
The core problem Or3it solves is structural fragmentation in satellite analytics. Organizations face difficult access to multi-provider imagery, inconsistent formats and APIs, high technical barriers to building analytics pipelines, non-repeatable manual workflows, and weak integration into operational systems. As a result, Earth Observation often remains experimental instead of becoming embedded operational infrastructure.
 
Or3it removes these barriers by providing unified access to optical and SAR satellite data, including high-resolution SAR for all-weather and day-night monitoring. The platform automatically harmonizes formats, preprocesses imagery, and applies AI-driven models such as vegetation forecasting, anomaly detection, change detection, and object classification.
 
A central component is the no-code workflow builder. Users can visually design, customize, and deploy repeatable geospatial analytics workflows without programming skills. Pre-built solution templates accelerate deployment across sectors. Results are delivered in integration-ready formats and can be pushed directly into GIS systems, ERP platforms, and decision-support environments.
 
Primary markets include agriculture and forestry, infrastructure and transportation, energy and utilities, defense and security, disaster management, finance and insurance, and maritime monitoring. Typical use cases include crop health monitoring, palm oil compliance auditing, vegetation encroachment detection along power lines, road condition monitoring, wildfire risk forecasting, and area-of-interest surveillance.
 
Or3it differentiates itself through full no-code usability, multi-provider satellite consolidation, scalable repeatable workflows instead of one-off analytics, and enterprise-grade system integration. Unlike traditional EO ecosystems where imagery vendors, analytics providers, and integration teams are fragmented, Or3it connects the full value chain from data acquisition to actionable decision output.

entityName: UNITN - Nanoscience Laboratory, Department of Physics
entityDescription:
The Nanoscience Laboratory(NL) at the Department of Physics, University of Trento,focuses on cutting-edge research in areas such as neuromorphic photonics, integrated quantum photonics, non-hermitian photonics, linear and nonlinear silicon photonics,and nanobiotechnologies. NL is dedicated to advancing our understanding of the fundamental physical phenomena involving photons and their interaction with matter—particularly when structured at the nanoscale.
NL explores a broad range of optical systems, including waveguides, microresonators, and complex dielectric structures, striving to bridge basic science with innovative applications.
NL's research spans the full spectrum from theoretical studies to practical device development,with a strong emphasis on photonic technologiesthat integrate seamlessly with modern silicon-based microelectronics. While silicon photonics is a key focus, the lab also investigates alternative materials such as cellulose for atomic-level nanostructuring. Additionally, NL explores the interface between photonics and biology,including studies on living neuron cultures, pushing the boundaries of what is possible in nanobiotechnology.

entityDescription:
BEIA Consult International is a R&D performing SME, founded in 1991, and it is one of the leading providers of ICT solutions and services in Romania for cloud communications and IoT telemetry. The company’s references include over 5,000 turn-key projects for advanced IT and communications solutions. BEIA is certified ISO 9001, 14001, 18001 and 27001.
We are active in the following domains: service innovation, hardware, sensors, actuators, information technologies, data storage and processing (back end), interfaces, software (front end), integration, communication technologies / tele-systems, learning & training, standardization, communication / dissemination / marketing, business development, project management. Geographically, BEIA covers the whole country of Romania, and as fields of activities, BEIA is able to offer professional solutions, mainly for: (i) communications for companies and organizations (integrating IT&C hardware, software and networks), local telephone and data networks, (ii) communications for small office and homes (PBX, phones, etc), Contact and Call Center (iii) PCM and XDSL transmission systems, (iv) telemonitoring and radio-telemetry (IP / Wireless SCADA), (v) consultancy and implementing of applications – solutions for ICT problems in the following domains: local and central administration, industry and agriculture, power generation, environmental protection, public health, education and culture, national defense and intelligence.
Also, BEIA has experience in coordinating and participating in more than 40 R&D and Innovation projects (FP6, FP7, Structural Funds, H2020, ECSEL/Artemis, Eureka, Eurostars, Celtic, ITEA, COST, AAL, ERA-Net, Interreg, LIFE+, Erasmus+, MSCA, EaP Twinning, JTIs, etc.). http://www.beia.eu
Moreover, BEIA has implemented and integrated IoT telemetry applications in the field of smart buildings (monitoring HVAC, light, smart power plugs), smart city (noise, air quality, mobility), e-health (tele-diagnosis of diabetes, emergency communication systems for patients, nurses and doctors), environment (monitoring of water, soil and air quality), hydro energy (tele-monitoring of level and flow), solar energy (measurement of solar radiation in photo-voltaic parks, forecasting of energy production according to meteorology sensors, monitoring inverters), agriculture (frost warnings, disease alert for plants, evapo-transpiration calculations, measurement of cumulated degree days), accurate water data (water sensors for hydrographical purposes, from precipitation to water level monitoring of lakes, rivers, wells), efficient water management (leak and burst detection, pressure, flow, level and well monitoring), irrigation management (including sensors for measuring soil moisture, monitor water uptake), heliports (measurement of meteorological parameters), underground (monitoring oil/gas exploration sites, mining tunnels).

entityDescription: Orbital Boost Aerospace S.L. (OBA) is a Spanish New Space startup incorporated in July 2024, currently incubated at ESA BIC Andalusia. Our mission is to transform orbital logistics and sustainability by addressing two critical bottlenecks: LEO congestion and the high cost of inter-orbital transportation. OBA develops a disruptive infrastructure based on Electromagnetic Orbital Spaceports (Gauss-launchers) that provide external impulse to standardized, reusable autonomous spacecraft (pods). By externalizing the primary DeltaV, we reduce spacecraft mass by 50% and significantly lower mission costs for Active Debris Removal (ADR) and 'last-mile' delivery. Our technology is currently at TRL 3, supported by a robust IP portfolio (including a granted Utility Model and a PCT application). We are actively preparing the OBA Faraday mission - a 16U CubeSat orbital demonstrator selected for flight by PLD Space's MIURA 5 SPARK program. OBA operates within a high-level research consortium involving CIEMAT and the Universities of Seville and Malaga.

entityDescription:
Hill International (Global Overview)
Hill International is a global leader in program, project, and construction management, supporting clients in delivering complex capital projects across sectors including infrastructure, real estate, energy, healthcare, and transportation. With nearly 50 years of experience and a presence in over 40 countries, Hill has contributed to more than 90,000 project assignments worldwide, with a combined construction value exceeding $1 trillion. Hill provides independent, client-focused services spanning the full project lifecycle—from early-stage advisory and planning through execution and close-out—ensuring projects are delivered with strong governance, cost and risk control, and operational readiness. 
Hill Corporate Real Estate Hub (Netherlands / CoRE Hub)
The Hill Corporate Real Estate (CoRE) Hub, based in Amsterdam, acts as a central strategic delivery unit for global corporate real estate portfolios. The CoRE Hub integrates portfolio strategy, program governance, and project execution into a single operating model, enabling consistent delivery across regions while adapting to local requirements. Through its 70/30 delivery approach—standardizing core processes while allowing for contextual flexibility—the Hub supports multinational clients in translating portfolio-level objectives into coordinated, multi-country execution. Its focus on governance, data-driven decision-making, and integrated stakeholder management enables faster, more predictable outcomes across complex, distributed programs. 
Integrated Delivery Network (GISI + Partners)
Hill International operates within a broader integrated delivery ecosystem, including affiliated advisory, consulting, engineering, and construction partners under the Global Infrastructure Solutions Inc. (GISI) platform. This network enables the formation of tailored, multidisciplinary teams aligned to project-specific requirements—combining strategic advisory, technical expertise, and delivery capability. Through this model, Hill can act as a single point of accountability while drawing on a flexible partner network to support large-scale, complex programs, including those requiring specialized technical, regulatory, or regional expertise.

Quantum Leap is a hard-tech and deep-tech company based in Portugal, specialized in the development of next-generation technological solutions and the provision of strategic innovation services. The company operates as a vertically integrated entity, maintaining the capabilities to manage projects from initial discovery and research through to industrial production within its own facilities.
The core of the organization is built on a multidisciplinary approach to engineering and technology. This includes dedicated expertise in artificial intelligence, data science, IoT, and Industry 5.0 systems, as well as immersive technologies involving VR, AR, and Web3 environments. By maintaining this broad technical foundation, Quantum Leap is able to address complex challenges across various sectors, ranging from resource sustainability and water management to safety and digital privacy.
As an institutional partner, the company supports brands and organizations in navigating digital transformation and product prototyping. This is achieved through a proprietary end-to-end turnkey system that emphasizes research-driven strategy and rigorous testing before moving into final production.
Quantum Leap remains an independent company with a focus on long-term resilience and impact. entityDescription: This text introduces the Parallel CFD and Optimization Unit, of School of Mechanical Engineering from National Technical University of Athens. The research group has a long experience on CFD-based analysis & gradient-based optimization methods supported by gradient-based (adjoint method) and gradient-free methods. A non-extensive list of our various applications includes shape and topology optimization, flow control, aeroacoustics, conjugate heat transfer, aeroelasticity and robust design. The corresponding methods and software are dealing with Single- and Multi-Disciplinary analysis and Optimization (MDAO). among others, PCOpt develops CFD solvers for the prediction of flows at all speeds: the in-house GPU-enabled PUMA s/w) & the open-source environment OpenFOAM. The parameterization of examined geometries to be optimized is being done by in-house developed tools such as GMTurbo (turbomachinery applications oriented s/w). Moreover, EASY, a generic-purpose fully-parallelized optimization platform based on Evolutionary Algorithms and Artificial Intelligence has been developed and brought to market by PCOpt. EASY is capable to detect global optimal solutions with minimum computational cost, for large scale multi-objective problems. The activities of PCopt’s 15 members as well as the purchase of high tech equipment for the computational infrastructure is funded by European research programmes, but also directly by the industry and s/w developing companies.

entityDescription:
Topologic Consulting was established in 2016 in Warsaw, Poland. The entity’s mission is connected with provision of expertise and solutions oriented on EO satellite monitoring and applications of spatial information for the needs of fulfilling needs of various sectors both private and public. Using the expertise in the field of data harmonisation, data processing, data fusion, capabilities of work with customers towards defining their needs allow for definition, design and development of solutions fulfilling customers’ needs in the most optimised way. The company provides consulting and advisory services. It also assists in R&D projects planning, coordination and conducting.
Topologic is involved in Geo4IRBM (Geospatial Information Support for Integrated River Basins Management) financed in course of the Polish Industrial Incentive Scheme Programme. Project results main beneficent is the Asian Development Bank team, located in Jakarta, Indonesia, which dealing with planning a multiannual water resources management-oriented loan project. During the Geo4IRBM Topologic designed and developed tools supporting assessment of water resources, water retention and consumption in agriculture. The tools are based on continuous satellite monitoring, mainly conducted with use of Sentinel-1 satellites. Topologic provided also land cover maps, cropping intensity maps, maps of potential erosion and sediment yield. Total area covered by monitoring tools and spatial products is 22,000sqkm.
Besides physical geography-oriented works, Topologic conducts also human geography and geomarketing oriented activities. Long term cooperation with the Institute of Geography and Spatial Management of Polish Academy of Sciences in Warsaw required adaptation and development of transport modelling techniques as well as methods of fusion of spatial and statistical data aiming at research of small towns societies and economic factors.
Topologic is an Agent of Analytical Graphics Inc., and is responsible for promotion and sales support of software oriented at modelling of complex inter-related land, sea, air and space systems. The software tools are applicable in design of systems integration, mission planning, mission support and post mission analysis.

entityDescription:
Synaptyx Communication Networks S.L. is a highly innovative Spanish deep-tech company focused on Defence, Space and Critical Communications. The company develops commercial-grade, software-defined 5G and emerging 6G communication network solutions, including radio access network software, 5G Core components and AI-enabled orchestration platforms for terrestrial, hybrid and non-terrestrial networks.
Synaptyx specialises in cloud-native, multi-RAT 4G, 5G and NB-IoT software, evolving towards 6G, with a particular focus on 3GPP Non-Terrestrial Networks (NTN), satellite payload software and space-terrestrial network integration. Its technology is designed to enable satellites, ground stations and edge nodes to operate as intelligent, reconfigurable and secure network elements, supporting mission-critical, sovereign and resilient communications.
The company’s platform combines AI-assisted orchestration, zero-touch onboarding, self-configuration, self-optimisation, self-healing, secure lifecycle management and mission-aware resource allocation. This allows Synaptyx to scale and orchestrate networks ranging from very small private, tactical or industrial radio networks to large Low LEO satellite constellations, using self-organising network algorithms and autonomous operation to reduce ground dependency, improve resilience and optimise network performance.
Synaptyx also develops cyber-resilient software architectures, secure software upgrade capabilities, zero-trust security concepts and advanced orchestration mechanisms for critical communication infrastructures. Its strategic objective is to provide European, software-defined, AI-native and secure connectivity technologies for satellite operators, payload manufacturers, defence agencies, telecom operators and critical infrastructure users.

entityDescription: SIA ZTF “AERKOM” was founded in 1992. On June 12, 2018, Ervīns Blumbergs became the Chairman of the Board. On January 18, 2019, the company was registered in the Scientific Organization Register and values its scientific organization status. The company continues research in subsonic, supersonic, and hypersonic aerodynamics, as well as applied studies for turbojet engine development using magnetohydrodynamic effects. Research also focuses on efficient and environmentally friendly electronic waste sorting and processing. The scientific team actively participates in conferences, and Chairman Ervīns Blumbergs is currently pursuing doctoral studies at RTU. SIA ZTF “AERKOM” collaborates with leading Latvian universities, including the University of Latvia and Riga Technical University, conducting both scientific and applied research. To secure research funding, the company participates in ERAF, LZP, and other competitions, with project proposals prepared by a volunteer group of scientists. Since June 1, 2021, the company has been participating in ERAF Project No. 1.1.1.1/20/A/139 “Sustainable technology development for electronic scrap recycling to recover precious and non‑ferrous metals.”

EcoVerum B.V. is a Dutch software and decision-intelligence company based in Amsterdam, the Netherlands. The company develops digital solutions for the agriculture, food and environmental sectors, combining satellite data, field sensor data, weather data, agronomic context and AI-supported knowledge retrieval into actionable insights.
EcoVerum’s platform supports farmers, agribusinesses, cooperatives and value-chain partners in making better operational decisions, improving resource efficiency, monitoring environmental impact and generating verifiable evidence for sustainability and compliance reporting.
The company’s activities include custom software development, data integration, AI-enabled analytics, geospatial intelligence, sensor-data processing and decision-support tooling. EcoVerum focuses on practical applications such as regenerative agriculture, crop and soil monitoring, water-use optimisation, risk detection and evidence-based ESG reporting.

entityDescription:
AI Build Limited (t/a Aibuild) is a London-based software company specialising in computer-aided manufacturing and AI automation for industrial additive manufacturing. Founded in 2015, we develop software used at over 100 industrial customers worldwide for process planning, simulation, and autonomous toolpath generation across directed energy deposition (DED), wire arc additive manufacturing (WAAM), and other AM processes.
Our core product, Aibuild CAM, is a machine-agnostic platform that programs, simulates, optimizes, and generates machine instruction files for robotic and gantry AM systems. It includes Aibuild FETS, a GPU-accelerated finite element thermal solver built specifically for metal AM, and an AI Agent that autonomously generates toolpaths, runs quality checks, and iterates without user intervention. In March 2026, we extended this with Aibuild OS: a multi-agent AI platform that connects CAD, FEA, and CAM tools into autonomous engineering workflows driven by natural language prompts.
We maintain an active physical R&D programme at our London lab, which houses six robotic systems including a Fronius WAAM cell. This facility provides continuous process validation and training data for our software. AI Build Limited is ISO 27001 certified and supports ITAR-compatible local deployment for regulated environments.

entityDescription:
Aerobase Innovations AB is a Swedish deep-tech SME developing material models and process simulations for advanced manufacturing. The company works on hot and cold forming, welding, additive manufacturing, and joining — manufacturing routes used extensively in spacecraft structures, launcher components, and propulsion hardware.
Two product lines anchor the offering. SafeLight is a library of material failure models that capture post-buckling response and element-size and thickness dependencies for crash and structural-impact simulation. Phases predict microstructure evolution (grain size, precipitation, phase composition, plastic strain, and damage) during thermomechanical processing.
Aerobase also operates copilot.aerobase.se, an AI assistant for engineering and simulation workflows. The company is based in Luleå with a presence in Trollhättan and participates in several Horizon Europe projects.

He has been associated with the military industry since 1988.
Mr. Artur SZCZEPANSKI is the Plenipotentiary of the Board for Special Trade. He graduated from the University of Economics at the Faculty of Business Management. He has completed the necessary vocational training courses. He has been associated with the military industry since 2000.

entityDescription:
PODIS Ltd is a technology company developing advanced safety and emergency-response solutions that integrate space-based services with terrestrial communication systems. The company is the developer of an Automatic Crash Notification (ACN) system patented by the United States Patent and Trademark Office (US Patent No. 9,758,120), which uses Global Navigation Satellite System (GNSS) positioning together with mobile device sensors to automatically detect serious road accidents and notify emergency services.
The PODIS technology has been internationally recognised, including distinctions associated with the European Satellite Navigation Competition (Galileo Masters). The company is currently advancing its system toward AI-enhanced Advanced Automatic Crash Notification (AACN) capabilities and exploring integration with emerging satellite-based communications and 5G Non-Terrestrial Networks (NTN) to support emergency connectivity in remote and rural regions.
Through these activities, PODIS contributes to downstream space applications that use GNSS and satellite connectivity to improve public safety and emergency response services.

The company focuses on developing space-enabled safety applications that integrate GNSS positioning, satellite communications, and intelligent cloud-edge systems.

entityDescription:
We provide a full range of advanced, highly engineered products from Commercial off-the-shelf (COTS) systems to fully customized electronic subsystems. Our products are specifically designed to operate reliably in the harsh and climatically demanding environments of the aerospace and defense industries. OnTime Networks' products are found in Airborne, Ground, and Naval Defense applications. Our rugged systems are at the forefront of technology providing innovative solutions that address complexity, enable modularity, and provide growth, all while delivering optimal performance for SWaP-C (Space/Weight/Power/Cost) constrained applications.
We have significant technical expertise when it comes to rugged, time-synchronized Ethernet switching, routing, and timing solutions. We utilize Precision Time Protocol (PTP) IEEE1588 as the core technology to provide clock accuracy in the sub-microsecond range, making our products suitable for communication, and measurement and control systems. For example, PTP can provide synchronization to sensors, measuring equipment, data acquisition units, network equipment and recorders. We support a variety of market segments, such as the aerospace, defense, energy, and remote sensing markets. Our highly reliable and rugged Gigabit Ethernet switches are RTCA DO160G, MIL-STD 461D, -704E and 810G compliant and are hardened for thermal, shock and vibration extremes.

description:
Fantana is an Austrian engineering company specializing in opto-mechatronic systems and system integration for the space and defence sectors. 
We bring together optics, mechatronics, electronics, and intelligent software, pair with a deep understanding of customer's problem, to deliver solutions to challenges that no single discipline can solve alone. 

Flagship projects include: 
- Earth observation payload for a three-satellite constellation for the Dutch and Austrian Armed Forces (system design, FPA, precision actuators, electronics and software)
- Coherent Doppler lidar for remote wind sensing (system design, optical system, optical amplifier, software)
- Free-space optical communication subsystem with self-localisation for UAVs in GNSS-denied environments (transmitter, receiver, optical amplifier, localisation and synchronisation software)
- Multispectral hard-kill counter-drone system fusing lidar, electro-optical, and radar sensing (system design, sensor integration, full control algorithm, demonstration and testing)

As a focused SME with a team of specialists, we combine the agility of a small company with the engineering depth that mission-critical applications demand.

entityDescription: EOG GmbH develops robust AI-based models for the analysis of Earth Observation. We offer on demand services for smart agriculture based on satellite Earth Observation data and artificial intelligence algorithms to predict crop yields, monitor soil and phenological parameters and provide advices on how to adapt agronomical practices to climate change risks. Our solution, integrates in-situ measurements, if available, to detect plant water stress, optmise the use of water resources in agriculture, identify optimal location for cultivation and provide land cover classification. We provides estimates of the integrated water vapor in the atmosphere using GNSS and Interferometric SAR data in a format ready to be assimilated into numerical weather prediction models to improve the forecast of extreme weather events. We integrate spaceborne and ground-based radar data to provide a comprehensive view of the infrastructure health. Our solution provides displacement measurements, with millimeter to sub- millimeter precision, and vibration frequency measurements. This enables customers to predict potential failures, mitigate geological hazards and reduce maintenance costs effectively. Our services contribute to the monitoring of railways and roads, power and telecommunication infrastructures, dams, bridges, urban areas, cultural and historical sites, open-pit mines.
