entityName: Museo Galileo - Istituto e Museo di Storia della Scienza
entityDescription:
The Museo Galileo–Institute and Museum for the History of Science—born in 1925—is home to a world renowned collection of scientific instruments. Among the most exceptional are instruments that belonged to Galileo Galilei, including the only two surviving telescopes of the many that he built.
Museo Galileo is an institute for advanced research and documentation in the history of science and technology, offering scholars from across the world the great resources of its library and its website.
Museo Galileo routinely partners with such prestigious Italian and international institutions as the CNR-Italian Council for Research, Uffizi Galleries, Accademia Nazionale dei Lincei, Museo Archeologico Nazionale of Naples, Parco Archeologico del Colosseo, Biblioteca Nazionale Marciana in Venice, Laboratorio Europeo per la Spettroscopia Non Lineare (LENS), Royal Library at Windsor Castle, Max-Planck Society’s institutes, Harvard University, Dresden Staatliche Kunstsammlungen, and takes part in innovative research projects.
Deeply engaged in the dissemination of scientific culture, Museo Galileo organizes temporary exhibitions on the history of science and the interactions of science and technology with the arts, which are displayed in important venues both in Italy and abroad.
All Museo Galileo’s temporary exhibitions are the outcome of in-depth research carried out by scholars of great renown who are members or collaborators of the Florentine institution. Leonardo da Vinci’s work, Galileo’s astronomical discoveries, Medici and Lorrain collections, early modern cartography are among the subjects to whom Museo Galileo devoted its exhibitions. In addition, thanks to partnership with major archaeological museums, Museo Galileo’s produced a series of exhibitions dealing with scientific and technical knowledge in the Antiquity.

description:
Zetarium is a Netherlands-based insurtech and agri-risk analytics company developing advanced probabilistic models for crop productivity, climate risk, and parametric insurance. Our platform integrates satellite Earth Observation, weather data, and statistical/AI-based uncertainty quantification to support insurers, governments, and financial institutions in designing transparent, scalable agricultural risk solutions.

We collaborate internationally across Europe and Central Asia to enable climate-resilient agriculture, improve access to insurance for farmers, and support evidence-based policy design. Zetarium’s work focuses on transforming EO data into operational decision-support tools, feasibility studies, and pilot implementations with public-benefit impact.
entityDescription:
Zetarium- Satellite‑enabled parametric insurance, financers and traders for resilient agriculture
Combining satellite imagery, meteorological feeds, and actuarial/risk models to automate loss detection and risk assessment and to provide actionable data for all players in the farming sector.

Overview
Zetarium delivers satellite‑enabled parametric insurance and market services that support financers and traders while strengthening agricultural resilience. The platform combines satellite imagery, meteorological feeds, and actuarial/risk models to automate loss detection and risk assessment and to supply data across the farming value chain.
System function 
The system replaces manual loss adjustment and traditional risk management with automated, auditable decisioning. Inputs from Earth observation and weather feeds are processed through actuarial and risk models to generate objective triggers and risk metrics that can be consumed by insurers, financiers, traders, and farm operators.
Outputs and stakeholders
Zetarium produces standardized, auditable data products for claims triggers, portfolio risk assessment, and market decision support. These outputs are intended to inform underwriting, financing, trading, and on‑farm risk management across both smallholder and commercial contexts.

description:
About Us
Ateleris GmbH is a privately owned Swiss engineering company headquartered in Brugg, Switzerland, specializing in software and data engineering for the space sector. Our space practice operates as SPACE by Ateleris (https://ateleris.space). Founded in 2016 as a spin-off from the FHNW Institute for Data Science, we build on more than a decade of applied R&D work for European space missions, with TRL 9 flight software operational in orbit on ESA's Solar Orbiter since 2020.
What we do
We engineer software end-to-end along the flow of data, from onboard instruments through ground pipelines to user-facing platforms:
Flight Software. Instrument and payload software, onboard AI and machine learning, custom file systems, TM/TC handling, EGSE test automation, commissioning, and long-duration operations support.
AI and Data Engineering. Science data pipelines from raw telemetry (L0) to science-ready products (L2+), archival systems, calibration workflows, HPC and cloud-native processing, and applied machine learning on ground and in orbit.
Platforms and Integration. Web platforms, dashboards, operator tools, and backend APIs that connect space systems, data, and users. User-centred design with stakeholder workshops and in-house security review.
Flight heritage
Ateleris is co-developer of the flight and ground software for STIX (Spectrometer/Telescope for Imaging X-rays) on ESA's Solar Orbiter, operational since February 2020. The automated STIX science pipeline has been running continuously since end of 2021. Team experience also spans RHESSI, Euclid, ARRAKIHS, SKA, SDO, and e-CALLISTO.
How we work
We cover the full software lifecycle (SRR, PDR, CDR, QR/AR) and work either fully ECSS-compliant when mission criticality demands it, or ECSS-informed for leaner research-driven projects. Our practice combines CCSDS and PUS-C heritage, formal verification with Stainless (Scala) and Viper (Python), CI/CD with digital twins, and applied machine learning on resource-constrained hardware.
Partners and memberships
Partners and clients include ESA, FHNW, armasuisse Science and Technology, the University of Bern, EPFL, and Paul Scherrer Institute, alongside prime contractors across Europe. Ateleris is a member of the Swiss Space Industries Group (SSIG) of Swissmem.

description:
Founded in 1986, A.U.G. Signals Ltd. (AUG) has been dedicated to excellence in signal, image and data processing for over three decades. A leader in its field, AUG is at the forefront of research and development in registration, detection, recognition, classification and identification, tracking, data mining techniques, intelligent systems and online distributed processing, situation assessment for decision support, and multi-sensor information fusion.

AUG has an extensive track record of successful projects, collaborating with government, academic and industry partners. AUG develops customized technologies and products for its clients. The company has the capabilities to deliver end-to-end solutions (data acquisition, processing, map production and online distribution) that effectively meet clients’ specifications and unique requirements. A shortlist of activities include airborne hyperspectral surveys; the custom implementation of Constant False Alarm Rate (CFAR) systems for Automatic Target Detection (ATD), Automatic Target Recognition (ATR) and situation assessment and decision support; the custom implementation of Image Change Detection and Automatic Multi-sensor Image Registration and Fusion systems; and online signal processing. AUG is also active in processing a wide range of space-based, airborne, and ground-based applications.

entityDescription:
Büttner Ltd. is a Hungarian contract manufacturer with 30+ years of CNC machining expertise, now actively expanding into space and defence. Based in Nagyatád, we operate 80+ machining centres capable of 5-axis simultaneous milling to ±0.005 mm tolerances, handling parts up to 25 tonnes and 8,500 mm in length.
Our additive manufacturing portfolio now covers two complementary wire-based Directed Energy Deposition (DED) processes. Wire Arc Additive Manufacturing (WAAM) delivers large-scale, near-net-shape metal structures up to 1,500 × 1,500 × 1,500 mm and ~3 tonnes in virtually any alloy. Alongside it, we operate a multi-laser Wire-Laser Metal Deposition (W-LMD) system — feeding standard metallic welding wire coaxially through a multi-laser head to produce fully dense parts (99.998%) with exceptional microstructure, minimal waste, and multi-material capability across stainless steel, titanium, Inconel, copper, and aluminium. Both technologies integrate seamlessly with our CNC machining lines for true hybrid manufacturing. Rounded out by in-house CVD coating, heat treatment, and Zeiss-certified metrology, we offer a genuinely end-to-end metallic manufacturing service.

Jiří Vele is an architect and researcher specialising in large-scale additive manufacturing, robotics, and design for additive manufacturing (DfAM). He is co-founder of Scoolpt, a studio focused on 3D concrete printing and experimental construction methods.
He completed his PhD in Architecture (2025) at the Czech Technical University in Prague, where his research focused on non-planar 3D printing techniques and their application to structural performance and material efficiency.
He contributed as Technical Lead to Prvok, the first 3D-printed building in the Czech Republic, and has experience in developing robotic fabrication workflows, slicing algorithms, and construction-scale AM processes.
His current work focuses on circular construction and in-situ resource utilisation (ISRU), with the aim of applying additive manufacturing technologies in resource-constrained and extreme environments.

Deutsche InfraSoft GmbH (DIS) is a Berlin-based group of companies focused on the digitalization of transport infrastructure. With approximately 160 employees across five subsidiaries, DIS provides consulting, services, and software solutions for the planning, construction, operation, and maintenance of road and rail infrastructure in Germany and internationally.
Core competencies include geodetic surveying (terrestrial, mobile, and aerial), mobile mapping and laser scanning, GIS-based data management and web services, Building Information Modeling (BIM), 3D modelling and photogrammetry, and road condition assessment and evaluation. DIS operates proprietary software platforms for road data capture, visualization, and analysis, and maintains Straßeninformationsbank (SIB) databases for public road authorities in compliance with ASB and OKSTRA standards.
DIS serves a broad client base including Deutsche Bahn, federal and state road agencies (Landesbetriebe für Straßenbau und Verkehr), county road authorities (Landkreise), municipalities, and engineering consultancies. The group has completed over 1,000 infrastructure projects. DIS is headquartered at EUREF-Campus 21 in Berlin, with operational offices in Leipzig and across Germany.

Cyberlope GmbH is an emerging cybersecurity company redefining how complex, connected products are secured in high-assurance industries. The company develops a next-generation software platform for Product Cybersecurity, designed to transform security from a fragmented, document-driven task into a structured, scalable engineering discipline.
Starting with Cybersecurity Risk Assessments, Cyberlope’s solution integrates product modelling, risk analysis, mitigation tracking and evidence generation into a unified workflow. By embedding domain expertise and best practices directly into the platform, it enables organisations to execute security processes more efficiently, consistently and with full traceability—reducing effort while significantly improving quality and audit readiness.
Beyond risk assessment, Cyberlope is building a broader product portfolio to support lifecycle-oriented product security, including vulnerability management and supply chain transparency. This positions the company at the forefront of a rapidly growing market driven by increasing regulatory requirements and the need for secure-by-design products.
In the space sector, where systems are mission-critical, lifecycles are long and post-deployment fixes are often limited, Cyberlope enables suppliers to provide structured, review-ready cybersecurity evidence to primes and agencies. This reduces programme risks, improves review efficiency and strengthens trust across complex supply chains—contributing to more resilient and secure space systems.

Pear Power sp. z o.o. is a deep-tech R&D company specializing in advanced power electronics and control systems. Founded in 2026 and headquartered in Białystok, Poland, the company develops novel control algorithms and FPGA-native implementations for power conversion systems, with applications spanning grid-forming inverters, space power processing units, motor drive controllers, and high-reliability power management for defense and aerospace platforms.
The founding team combines over a decade of experience in linear synchronous motor control, sensorless drive algorithms, dual-inverter topologies, and maglev propulsion systems — including the design and commissioning of Europe's first passive magnetic levitation test track. entityDescription:
SoftWater develops innovative methodologies and tailored software solutions to support environmental policies and foster smart and sustainable natural resources management.

Climate change risk impact analysis
We deal with climate change-related challenges, assessing the economic, social, and environmental impacts and risks (physical and transitional). We cover a wide range of case studies in terms of scale, scope, and complexity, from territorial analyses focusing on people’s safety to the risks associated with agricultural and/or industrial activities. Main competencies include handling different datasets (satellite, reanalysis, observations), statistical downscaling of regional climate data, computation of climate indicators, and exposure assessment.
Modeling complex water and environmental systems
Our modeling expertise lies in the development and application of mathematical, hydrological, and data-driven models to support decision-making, as well as in exploring solutions to multi-objective problems through evolutionary-based optimization techniques. We integrate artificial intelligence and machine learning techniques to improve forecasts and predictions in the environmental fields of water, food, energy, and land. Our modeling activities leverage reliable computational libraries and include data preprocessing and harmonization, satellite image classification, statistical analyses, and data mining techniques.

Smart platforms for environmental big data
We develop lightweight, interactive web platforms that integrate spatial data, time series, and visual analytics interfaces to provide customized solutions for effective data visualization and decision support. Based on a mature, fully open-source stack, our platforms can also include integrated models, engines for computing a wide range of indicators, and AI-based procedures that run in real time to provide meaningful insights.

description:
Stellar Discoveries P.C. is redefining the future of human space exploration with a ground-breaking combination of planetary science, biochemistry, astrobiology, and advanced engineering. We pioneered the study of cosmic radiation and micrometeorite impact-induced soil/dust oxidants, as well as the monitoring and mitigation of their negative effects on astronaut health, instrumental payloads and space missions, while also leveraging some of them positively.

Our ultimate aims are:
•	Continuously prolong the presence of humans and of instruments in the space environment, and of the space missions by significantly reducing their risk, failures and costs.
•	Develop technologies that enable resilient space habitability, planetary terraforming and commercial exploitation.
•	Make use of these technologies to benefit our planet Earth: space requires high optimization in exploration which can lead to better use of terrestrial resources!

Products and Services:
? Sensors
a)	Sensors for the main space oxidants Reactive Oxygen (examples at TRL4 , ) and Perchlorate (mainly on Mars) Species for monitoring their negative effects (oxidative, explosive, biotoxic), and for countering them by specific intervention services: on astronaut health, spacesuits, extraterrestrial life biosignatures, base space stations, spacecraft, rovers, space habitats/greenhouses, dust filtration systems, water/food supplies, equipment, and also on Earth's space and microsatellite ecosystem (for Public Health and Civil Protection from atmospheric pollution by dusts from African winds, mines, wildfires, space debris, volcanoes, exposure to UV, nuclear, and radioactive radiation, monitoring biotoxic inefficiency of air/dust filtering systems in aircraft, mining, buildings, hospitals, industries etc).
b)	Medical/clinical sensors for continuous monitoring the health of astronauts against exposure to space oxidants, and for their protection by diet and spacesuit specific intervention services.
c)	Sensor for extraterrestrial life biosignatures (on Mars, Europa, Enceladus).
d)	Protection of the natural oxidants in planetary samples handled or collected during return missions from the Moon and Mars.
e)	Sensors for monitoring earthquakes

? Systems and methods for ISRU and habitation/terraforming, i.e., oxygen, water, and energy materials resources, e.g., from the Lunar and Martian dusts
a)	Periodic or on demand “harvesting” of oxygen (see oxygen farming) from Lunar and Martian dusts for astronaut use or as an energy resource, i.e., tubes tethered to astronauts for extended EVA, or large installations for oxygen farming.
b)	Extending the “oxygen harvesting” technology for parallel Helium-3 collection from Lunar dusts
c)	Electrokinetics applications for subsurface and permafrost water mobilisation and collection (e.g., on Mars), watering Space/Earth Greenhouses 

? Cosmic dust and exosphere/atmosphere simulant single-process production or modification to simulate planetary environments of all kinds and with ultra-high fidelity (one-to-one replicas in texture, size distribution, physical chemistry, oxidant activation, electrostatic charge capacity and particle levitation, in cryogenic, vacuum, and mixed-gas conditions)
a)	to model the negative effects of oxidants on space missions and astronaut health, i.e., during EVA on the near-surface Lunar environment or on Mars
b)	to perform ultra-high-fidelity testing of space payload equipment, e.g., mechanical, thermal, electrical, chemical tests, optical, and investigate mitigation technologies
The European Space Agency (ESA) has begun the process of filing an international patent for the simulant production method, and Stellar Discoveries P.C. will be granted a license to use and exploit the innovation.

? Antioxidant strategies, as:
a)	Dietary supplements for astronauts, to extend EVA activities and astronaut/crew presence in any space environment
b)	Services to mitigate the negative effects of space oxidants in water, foods, equipment, soils and dusts (e.g., for greenhouse use)
c)	Study of cosmic radiation effects during space missions for astronaut health.

The innovation of our products and services is based on our own unique space research discoveries that have revealed a significant knowledge gap in space sciences and space exploration. Oxidative effects are now increasingly recognized by international space agencies and institutions; underestimating the risks will result to the failure of space missions and related research investigations.

description:
Twin Photonics GmbH is a deep-tech SME developing scalable, chip-integrated sources of entangled photon pairs for quantum communication and networking. The company focuses on fully integrated, turnkey photonic modules that combine on-chip lasers, nonlinear generation elements, and spectral filtering to enable narrowband photon emission with precise frequency control. Our core technology is based on integrated photonic circuits (PICs) and hybrid integration.

We have demonstrated high-rate, telecom-compatible entangled photon sources with generation bandwidths exceeding 5000 GHz and pair rates above 200 kHz, while maintaining compatibility with standard optical communication infrastructure. The architecture supports frequency multiplexing via cavity-enhanced designs, enabling multiple discrete spectral channels and improved key rates for quantum networks. Twin Photonics is advancing both C-band sources for fiber-based quantum communication and other wavelengths to enable broadband interconnectability with next-gen quantum hardware. Our activities include design, and experimental validation of integrated quantum light sources, as well as system-level development for deployment in real-world quantum network environments. 

The company collaborates with leading academic and industrial partners across Europe and is actively engaged in developing next-generation quantum hardware for applications including QKD, quantum interconnects, and quantum internet.

description:
MConnected Ltd: An Asset Intelligence company with its core skills firmly on AI, IoT technologies & data backhaul. This “Predictive IoT” process has been very successful, leading to significant projects within the critical infrastructure, predictive maintenance, space and defence verticals.
Artificial Intelligence (AI) and the Internet of Things (IoT) are two of today’s most impactful technology developments. Inevitably, an increasing range of both enterprise and consumer applications and solutions leverage both technologies, so that they are enabled by both AI and IoT.
entityDescription:
MCONNECTED EXECUTIVE SUMMARY
 
MConnected Ltd is an Asset Intelligence company with its core skills firmly on AI and IoT principals and technologies. This “Predictive IoT” process has been very successful, leading to significant projects within the freight logistics, predictive maintenance, maritime and defence verticals. We focus on developing technologies for collecting data, whether numeric or textual, at scale, and in an automated manner that require minimal human interaction.
 
MConnected’s Technologies
MConnected’s IoT solutions operate on LoRaWAN Low Power Wide Area Networks (LPWAN) that are optimised for battery life, range, indoor-outdoor coverage, bi-directionality and cost. They utilise a variety of field-based sensors, designed to send small amounts of data over long distances. Each of the sensors send their short packets of data to a gateway. The gateway forwards the data to a cloud-based network server via backhaul (satellite, Ethernet, cellular, Wi-Fi).
MConnected’s network servers manage the data intelligence and network complexity, filtering redundant data, performing security checks and adaptive data rate management. If a sensor is mobile, no handover is required from gateway to gateway, a critical feature to enable asset-monitoring applications. The integrated platform provides an end-to-end solution that delivers insights and supports decision-making, creating value for the end-customer.
The business accommodates the full spectrum of technology requires for a complete IoT ecosystem to be delivered to our clients. The ecosystem can be simplified into discrete but well-connected silos:
 
THINGS>EDGE>GATEWAY>IoT PLATFORM>DATA ANALYTICS

description: AMC Robotics Ltd is a deep-tech company developing intelligent robotics platforms that combine advanced AI, sensing and edge computing to automate inspection, security and operations in high-risk and infrastructure environments across maritime and industrial sectors. In maritime, our quadruped and mobile systems support port and terminal patrols, quay and yard inspection, container and cargo monitoring, and safety checks around vessels and critical waterside infrastructure, reducing human exposure while improving continuity of operations. Building on nearly 100 years of cumulative shipping expertise and 25 years of autonomous robotics and AI integration in the maritime industry, the team focuses on solutions that enhance safety, reduce operational risk and unlock new data-driven services for ports, terminals, shipping and offshore assets. AMC Robotics holds ESA-STAR Valid Full status, enabling it to participate in ESA procurements and be awarded contracts within the Agency’s electronic tendering and registration framework
entityDescription:
AMC Robotics Ltd is a UK-based early-stage company developing autonomous robotics and drone technologies to support safer, more efficient monitoring and inspection of maritime vessels, with a view to integrating satellite connectivity from the European Space Agency (ESA) for data relay, positioning, and situational awareness. The company’s core focus is on smart robotics solutions, drawing on advances in autonomous navigation, sensing, and AI to automate inspection and monitoring tasks that are difficult, dangerous, or costly for human crews. AMC Robotics aims to deploy robotic systems (surface, climbing, or aerial platforms) to inspect hulls, deck structures, cargo areas, and hard-to-access sections of vessels, reducing the need for manual rope access or dry-docking. Drone and robot payloads are designed around multi-sensor data acquisition: high‑resolution imaging, thermal and corrosion mapping, structural anomaly detection, and environmental monitoring (e.g., emissions, hull fouling, leaks). By automating routine inspection, the company targets higher inspection frequency, improved data quality, and lower operational risk for shipowners, ports, classification societies, and offshore operators.
AMC Robotics Ltd is a downstream user and integrator of space-enabled services in the maritime domain: Satellite positioning: ESA/GNSS services (e.g., Galileo) provide precise, resilient positioning and timing for autonomous robots and drones operating around large vessels, in ports, anchorages, or coastal waters, enabling accurate navigation and repeatable inspection paths. Satellite communications: ESA-enabled satellite links support near real‑time data uplink and downlink between robots/drones and shore-based systems, ensuring continuous command, control, and data streaming even beyond coastal radio coverage. Earth observation integration: AMC’s systems can be positioned to complement EO-derived insights (e.g., vessel detection, route monitoring, environmental anomalies) by providing close‑range, high‑fidelity inspection data that can validate or refine satellite observations.
The robots and drones generate structured inspection datasets that can be time‑stamped and geo‑referenced using satellite positioning, then shared via ESA satellite communication services to cloud-based platforms for analysis, reporting, and regulatory compliance. Target customers include vessel owners, charterers, ports, insurers, and maritime authorities who need evidence-based documentation for safety, maintenance planning, and environmental reporting; the ESA-enabled connectivity turns AMC’s robotic systems into a continuous, remotely accessible inspection service. In the context of ESA’s “Commercial Applications of Space-Enabled Robotics: Maritime and Port Operations” type initiatives, AMC Robotics fits as an SME delivering operational robotics and drone solutions that depend on satellite positioning and communications to unlock new data products and business models in maritime inspection and monitoring

description:
TerraViso is a geospatial technology company developing satellite-enabled environmental intelligence solutions to support land-use planning, environmental assessment, and nature risk analysis.

The company’s platform integrates Earth Observation data, machine learning, and spatial modelling techniques to generate scalable, repeatable insights on habitat classification, biodiversity condition, and land-use change. By combining satellite imagery with advanced geospatial processing, TerraViso enables consistent assessment of environmental characteristics across sites, regions, and time periods.

A key capability of the platform is the ability to support forward-looking scenario modelling, allowing users to evaluate the potential impact of land-use changes on biodiversity outcomes. This enables decision-makers to move beyond static assessments and consider future environmental scenarios in a structured and quantitative way.

TerraViso is designed to address the limitations of traditional ecological assessment approaches, which are typically manual, time-consuming, and difficult to scale. By leveraging Earth Observation data, the platform reduces reliance on field-based surveys and enables standardised, data-driven analysis that can be applied consistently across large geographies.

The technology has been developed with a focus on real-world deployment and commercial application, targeting users such as developers, environmental consultancies, local authorities, and infrastructure providers. The platform is capable of generating outputs aligned with regulatory requirements, including biodiversity assessment frameworks used in the UK planning system.

TerraViso has developed an operational platform with existing capabilities in habitat classification, biodiversity modelling, and reporting workflows, with ongoing development focused on enhancing scenario modelling, improving model accuracy, and enabling portfolio-level environmental intelligence.

The company is positioned to deliver scalable environmental intelligence services that support more efficient, consistent, and informed decision-making, with Earth Observation data forming a core component of the technology stack.

description: Vanderkooij Consult Inc. (VDK) is a 100% Canadian-owned SME specializing in Synthetic Aperture Radar (SAR), InSAR, and advanced Earth Observation (EO) technologies. Founded by an aerospace engineer with 35 years of pioneering industry experience, VDK provides highly specialized R&D and consulting services focused on long-term environmental monitoring and ecological change detection . Our core activities center on engineering advanced data pipelines that unlock deep historical SAR archives (e.g., RADARSAT-1/2 dating back to 1995) alongside current multi-mission data streams (e.g., Sentinel-1, SAOCOM) . We develop innovative, AI/ML-integrated methodologies and Application Ready Data (ARD) to automate the extraction of environmental change metrics across vegetation, wetlands, permafrost, and coastal ecosystems . VDK actively collaborates with major stakeholders, including Environment and Climate Change Canada (ECCC), Natural Resources Canada (NRCan), academia, and Indigenous communities, to translate complex SAR time-series data into actionable intelligence for biodiversity conservation and climate change adaptation

entityDescription:
D’Alesio&Santoro Srl is a Milan-based independent design-and-engineering company specialised in the use of light as both a cultural medium and a technical tool. Founded in 2010 by Carlo D’Alesio and Piero Santoro, the company has developed a multidisciplinary practice spanning architectural lighting, custom luminaire design, integrated lighting systems, optical problem-solving, human-centric lighting, and technology-oriented prototyping. Its portfolio includes transportation infrastructure, hospitality, luxury retail, exhibition design, branded environments, bespoke product development and site-specific lighting systems delivered across multiple countries and technical contexts.

Beyond its public profile as an international lighting design practice, D’Alesio&Santoro also operates as a research-driven organisation with strong capabilities in physical prototyping, light-guides and luminous interfaces, custom fixtures, performance-oriented engineering and development of special light-based devices. The company’s human-centric lighting capability includes visual-comfort-oriented lighting strategies, daylight/artificial-light integration, dynamic light modulation, scene-setting logic and user-oriented control approaches for environments where well-being, perception and behavioural support are relevant design parameters.

Since 2026, these capabilities have been significantly expanded through the incorporation of MEG as D’Alesio&Santoro’s internal skunk works for applied photobiology, precision non-human lighting and advanced hardware/software R&D. This integrated capability brings expertise in programmable light platforms, controlled-environment systems, experimental chambers, radiometric assessment, microalgae- and plant-related systems, UV devices and custom payload-scale solutions for constrained research setups.

As a result, D’Alesio&Santoro can be positioned not only as a lighting design firm, but as a light-centred design, prototyping and engineering partner for projects where performance, experimentation, human-centric lighting quality and custom system development are essential.

description:
The University of Essex presents a highly credible, technically aligned partner to European Space Agency, combining deep expertise in AI, embedded systems, robotics, and advanced communications with a strong track record in real-world deployment and cross-sector collaboration. Its capabilities are particularly relevant to ESA’s evolving roadmap around autonomous systems, resilient infrastructure, and data-driven mission architectures. The university’s strengths in intelligent systems, secure data environments, and high-performance computing position it to support both spaceborne and ground-segment innovation, while its commercialisation and funding expertise enables effective translation from research into deployable solutions.

This translates into a set of clearly defined contribution areas:

* AI, autonomy and onboard intelligence: development of edge AI, multi-agent systems, and explainable models enabling real-time, autonomous decision-making in satellites and mission systems
* Robotics and physical AI: autonomous robotics for in-orbit servicing, inspection, and planetary exploration, alongside simulation and validation environments
* Advanced communications and navigation: 6G-enabled satellite-terrestrial integration, resilient communication architectures, and GNSS-denied positioning systems
* Data systems and Earth observation analytics: AI-driven processing of EO data, large-scale data fusion, and predictive analytics for climate and operational insights
* Cybersecurity and secure infrastructure: end-to-end encryption, cyber-resilience frameworks, and secure AI model deployment for mission-critical systems
* Embedded systems and space-grade integration: low-power, fault-tolerant embedded architectures and hardware–software co-design for constrained environments
* Simulation, modelling and digital twins: high-fidelity simulation environments and digital twins for mission planning, optimisation, and lifecycle management
* Commercialisation and ecosystem enablement: structuring ESA-aligned funding pathways, building consortia, and scaling dual-use technologies into space markets
* Sustainability and space environment monitoring: space debris tracking, energy-efficient systems, and EO-enabled environmental monitoring
* Human-centric systems and decision support: AI-assisted tools for mission control, human–machine teaming, and advanced operator interfaces

Overall, Essex can be positioned as a full-stack innovation partner, capable of supporting ESA from early-stage research through to deployment and commercial scale, bridging technical depth with execution capability in a rapidly evolving space ecosystem.

entityDescription:
Data driven support to sugarcane producers​
At SmartCane, we are dedicated to making positive impact on your sugarcane business. We provide data driven support to all sugarcane producers, because we know that every decision matters. It is the consistent everyday operations that make a cane field produce better, day-in-day-out. ​
The small-scale out-growers are responsible of more than half of the worldwide raw cane production whilst not having equal access to support compared to full time cane producers. SmartCane fills a crucial gap in the sugarcane value chain, by focussing on the small-scale producers. ​
For millers, cane supply from the out-growers is essential to maintain quality sugar production. Examples show that with consistent efforts, the value chain benefits, reliable cane supply increased sugar content. Digital technology makes personal attention attainable. ​
For producers, getting more out of the cane fields significantly impacts the household economies. Considering SugarCane is not the sole activity, the multiple activities and priorities often contradict. Yield optimisation is rarely the strategy. SmartCane fits, focussing attention to what is important, reducing the days spend on scouting. Freeing up time for other activities.

Sprouting from Dutch innovation attitude, we operate in the tropical zones of the world. SmartCane, a spinoff of the Resilience Network, combines 15 years of

entityDescription:
NanoMAR AS is a newly established Norwegian enterprise focused on revolutionizing water treatment through the application of advanced nanotechnology. Founded in 2023 by recognized researchers in biology and water quality, the company develops a patented, chemical-free nanobubble system designed to efficiently remove ultra-fine particles, dissolved substances, bacteria, and viruses from water. The innovative technology offers over 30% higher cleaning efficiency and lower energy consumption compared to current Best Available Technology (BAT). 

By integrating our advanced nanobubble technology with European space assets, NanoMAR transforms reactive water treatment into a proactive, automated defense system for marine aquaculture. Utilizing Satellite Earth Observation (SatEO) data to monitor sea surface temperatures and predict the trajectory of Harmful Algae Blooms (HABs) like Pseudochattonella, alongside SatCom for real-time remote activation, our solution establishes a preemptive protective barrier around offshore fish farms. Because the system uses no chemicals and low cost energy, it can be safely triggered via satellite API at the first sign of an algal anomaly without financial or environmental risk, directly supporting the ESA's mission to ensure resilient, sustainable, and responsible fishing practices.

entityDescription: Missionware is a technology company specialising in the design and development of advanced software platforms for real-time systems, geospatial applications, and mission-critical operational environments. The company focuses on building digital platforms that collect, integrate, and visualise operational data in real time in order to support monitoring, coordination, and decision-making in complex environments. Missionware develops software solutions across several domains including intelligent mobility systems, situational awareness platforms, infrastructure monitoring, and geospatial data processing solutions. A key area of expertise of the company is the development of platforms that combine real-time data ingestion, geospatial information, and operational visualisation into unified applications that allow operators to monitor vehicles, assets, and infrastructure in real time. These systems are typically used in operational environments where accurate situational awareness and timely decision-making are essential. Missionware has developed the Cognibase real-time platform, a high-performance software platform designed for building applications that require continuous data synchronisation, event processing, and real-time operational monitoring. Cognibase enables the rapid development of distributed systems that synchronise operational data between backend services and user interfaces, allowing multiple users to observe and interact with the same operational data in real time. The platform is particularly suitable for applications involving vehicle fleets, sensors, and geospatial information. Building on this technological foundation, Missionware has also developed software components such as TwinCore, a digital twin modelling engine used to represent and monitor physical assets and systems in real time, and DisplayCommander, a platform for managing operational displays and information panels in operations centre environments. These technologies support the development of systems that provide operators with a shared operational picture of dynamic environments and allow the monitoring of vehicles, assets, and events through interactive geospatial interfaces. Missionware’s engineering team has strong expertise in software architecture, real-time data systems, geospatial software development, and mobile application development. The company develops cross-platform location-based mobile applications and backend services that integrate location data from mobile devices, vehicles, and sensor, operational events, and other data streams into unified platforms that support monitoring and coordination tasks.

CONROO GmbH is a German logistics technology company specializing in digital solutions for ports, terminals, and container depots. The company develops the CONROO Connect platform, a comprehensive truck visit management system that digitally connects truck drivers with terminals and depots through intelligent mobile and web-based applications.
CONROO's product suite addresses critical inefficiencies in container logistics through four integrated modules:
- Gate Connect: Automated gate entry system that eliminates physical trucker cards and outdated gate infrastructure, enabling seamless, paperless terminal access with enhanced security protocols
- Gate Pass: Self-check-in mobile application providing secure digital access credentials for truck drivers, replacing physical ID cards and reducing terminal entry time by up to 20 minutes per visit
- Yard Connect: Real-time yard navigation system that guides trucks efficiently through terminal facilities, reducing turnaround times and optimizing yard operations
- Pre Connect (Slot Connect): AI-powered slot management and capacity planning system that optimizes terminal scheduling based on predicted truck arrival times and available capacity

ACRI-IN is an engineering firm specializing in coastal, hydraulic, and environmental engineering. Its approach combines research and development with numerical simulation, physical modeling, civil and port engineering, coastal development, and inland water management. Our team of multidisciplinary engineers has the expertise to design, manage, and optimize construction or renovation projects, as well as upgrade and compliance operations for any port, river, or offshore infrastructure. We perform fluid dynamics modeling, environmental studies—including on-site surveys—and prepare regulatory documentation. We have our own wave and current flume for 2D physical testing.
ACRI-IN is part of the ACRI Group, founded in Sophia-Antipolis in 1989; it has become a subsidiary of ACRI-ST, which leads a group of eight independent SMEs based in eight different countries. The ACRI Group is independent of any industrial, commercial, or banking group.
ACRI-IN is based in Sophia-Antipolis (06), the historic headquarters of the ACRI Group; it has a branch in Brest (29) and, since late 2024, a new subsidiary, GALATEA, based near Marseille (13). 
This strategic partnership with GALATEA demonstrates ACRI-IN’s commitment to strengthening its market position by integrating complementary expertise in the marine environment (environmental monitoring of construction projects, mapping of biocoenoses, regulatory filings, impact studies, etc.), thereby opening up new opportunities in the field of maritime and environmental engineering.

Net Service S.p.A. is an Italian ICT company founded in Bologna in 1997, specialized in the design, development, and integration of secure and interoperable digital systems for Public Administrations and enterprises. With over 20 years of experience in complex national and international projects, the company combines the agility of an SME with the organizational strength of a structured enterprise, delivering long-term organizational, economic, and sustainable value.
Net Service S.p.A. is the parent company of a group of complementary companies operating under a unified strategic and operational framework. These include:
- Realvalue Consulting(Italy, Poland, Switzerland) – Specialized in low-code CRM and CMS platforms.
- GT50– Focused on enterprise software and digital transformation consulting.
- Flosslab– A center of excellence in blockchain and open-source technologies.
- OIKOS Area– Provides consulting, auditing, and training in ISO-certified management systems, risk assessment, compliance, change management, HR, and organizational design.
As the lead company, Net Service S.p.A. offers end-to-end ICT services, including strategic IT consulting, process reengineering, system integration, software development, and operational management. It is a market leader in system integration and adopts a DevOps and Business-as-a-Service approach, managing complex projects entirely in-house to ensure efficiency and cost control. The company operates across Italy and internationally, with branches in London and Luxembourg.
Cybersecurity and Artificial Intelligence are strategic pillars of Net Service’s offering. The company designs and operates cybersecurity infrastructures for public and private organizations, implementing internationally recognized standards and advanced technologies such as federated learning, edge computing, and blockchain-based data protection. It also provides solutions for log monitoring, threat intelligence, vulnerability assessment, penetration testing, and secure digital identity management.
Net Service invests significantly in research and development and operates dedicated competence centers focused on Artificial Intelligence, Machine Learning, Blockchain, Big Data, and Quantum Computing. It collaborates with leading academic institutions and participates in national and European research programs. These initiatives demonstrate Net Service’s ability to deliver cutting-edge, secure, and scalable solutions aligned with the technological and operational needs of high-level institutional stakeholders.

entityName: atlas: carbon neutral solution S.r.l Benefit
entityDescription:
Atlas – Carbon Neutral Solution S.r.l. Benefit is a climate-tech startup developing digital infrastructures for the measurement, certification, and traceability of environmental data and CO₂ emissions, with applications across energy, agriculture, mobility, and industrial sectors.
The company has designed a proprietary framework based on MRV (Monitoring, Reporting, Verification) principles, integrating:
multi-source data acquisition (IoT sensors, satellite data, and enterprise inputs) 
ESG and carbon footprint analytical algorithms 
digital certification systems 
blockchain-based registration to ensure transparency, immutability, and auditability 
At the core of the platform is the B.R.A.I.N. Engine (Blockchain, Reduction, Aerospace, internazional, Network), which enables the transformation of environmental data into verifiable and auditable outputs, supporting ESG reporting, environmental certifications, and carbon credit generation.
Atlas positions itself as a neutral digital infrastructure layer, connecting companies, environmental projects, and certification bodies without replacing them, while enabling a new standard based on objective, data-driven sustainability.
The platform integrates advanced technologies such as satellite data, digital twin modeling, and blockchain, allowing scalable monitoring, validation, and optimization of environmental performance.
Key applications include:
automated sustainability reporting (CSRD, GRI compliant) 
monitoring and certification of environmental projects (e.g., regenerative agriculture, agrivoltaics) 
generation and management of verifiable carbon credits 
ESG software solutions for SMEs and large enterprises 
Atlas operates at the intersection of ESG software, climate-tech, and carbon markets, with the ambition to become a European digital infrastructure for trusted environmental data management and certification.

Tettosano (Edilprogress S.r.l.), established in 1982 in Cremona, represents over four decades of specialized expertise in industrial and commercial roofing solutions across Northern Italy. With 20 professionals including 8 technical managers and fully company-owned equipment, we have successfully completed over 4,200 projects, managing 72 industrial contracts annually. Our core competencies span asbestos removal and disposal—critical given Italy's mandatory remediation law (R. 14/12 of 2012)—industrial roofing systems, and photovoltaic integration, with 6 MW of solar capacity installed yearly. Since 2011, we have facilitated over �14 million in photovoltaic installations, combining structural renovation with renewable energy infrastructure to address both immediate safety needs and long-term sustainability goals.
Operating through specialized business units, we provide integrated solutions from initial design through execution, leveraging our internal technical office to optimize thermal efficiency and guide clients through government incentive programs, including 65% tax deductions for energy improvements and INAIL ISI grants up to 65% non-refundable funding. Our client portfolio encompasses major Italian corporations like Sorini Italia, La Cimbali, and Fedegari Autoclavi, alongside public entities including the Municipality of Cremona. Recent projects demonstrate our technical capabilities: a �740,000 specialized curved panel installation in Piacenza and a �685,000 comprehensive renovation in Trescore Cremasco, both incorporating advanced insulation systems and photovoltaic readiness.

Our experience in emergency response for extreme weather events, certified asbestos remediation processes meeting European environmental standards, and integration of energy efficiency with structural improvements directly support climate adaptation and infrastructure resilience objectives. With comprehensive insurance coverage, proven project management capabilities, and deep knowledge of European funding mechanisms, we provide the stability and reliability essential for long-term public infrastructure projects while helping organizations achieve their environmental targets and operational cost reductions.

Hystore Tech Ltd is a privately own, Cyprus registered company (since 2014) located in the Ergates Industrial Area in Nicosia-Cyprus. The Hystore’s factory of 1080m2 is built in a 3000m2 plot. It exhibits 240m2 of office facilities, 480m2 R&D laboratories and 360m2 production spaces. The company collaborates/employs/ highly qualified technical and scientific personnel, with Ph.D in Engineering, Physics, Chemistry and other disciplines, who have international experience on Renewables and Hydrogen Technologies, including hydrogen production, hydrogen storage in the form of metal Hydrides and Compressed Gas (Metal Hydride Compressor). The major activities of Hystore Tech Ltd is the production and characterization of Metal Hydride Storage Materials/Units/Systems from 5 NlitersH2 to 500000 NlitersH2 or more. Hystore activities cover the whole spectrum of H2 (Electrolysis, HHO Generators) production, purification, storage and the use of Hydrogen in applications such as the “green” electricity production with H2/Fuel Cells. Special emphasis is given in the “green” hydrogen production with the use of RES and Recycle Materials such as Aluminum scrap metals. Hystore Tech produces high gravimetric/volumetric Hydrogen density systems suitable for Drones, Underwater Vehicles and Stationary Energy Storage. Hystore Tech is the first company to install four (4) Photovoltaic Parks of 600kW installed capacity in Cyprus. Hystore is a leading European Company, which successfully participated in more than 6 National and 5 EU projects on H2 Technologies.

entityDescription:
Netwerk Media Kft. is a Hungary-based software engineering and applied AI/ML company with 15+ years of hands-on experience delivering production-grade digital systems. We design, build and operate end-to-end solutions spanning cloud infrastructure, data-intensive web platforms, geospatial processing pipelines, and machine learning systems, with a strong focus on reproducibility, traceability, security-by-design and measurable performance.
We have an established track record of scientific and technology collaborations with Hungarian academic and research institutions, including Eötvös Loránd University (ELTE) and the Hungarian Research Network (HUN-REN). We are currently contributing to an ESA-supported Venus-related project focused on the automated processing and classification of geological formations in radar imagery using machine learning methods, including robust data preparation, annotation workflows, model training and validation, and cloud-based MLOps practices.
The company’s technical leadership holds AWS professional-level certifications, including AWS Certified Solutions Architect – Professional and AWS Certified Machine Learning – Specialty, supporting reliable delivery of cloud-native architectures and ML pipelines.
Netwerk Media Kft. is also developing ArcusGeo Resilience OS, a browser-based, evidence-driven geospatial intelligence platform that transforms Copernicus/ESA-related Earth observation data into actionable, auditable risk insights. ArcusGeo integrates three layers in a single workflow: (1) multi-sensor change detection and classification (Vycterra), (2) contextual operational intelligence with traceable evidence links (Systerra), and (3) probabilistic forecasting and scenario analysis (Dynterra). The platform is designed for decision-makers who require transparent evidence chains, explicit uncertainty handling, and exportable outputs for reporting and compliance use cases.
Netwerk Media Kft. is registering in ESA STAR to support ESA-related business development and proposal activities, to strengthen collaboration with ESA and ESA-affiliated programmes, and to enable structured engagement around ArcusGeo and associated technology development initiatives.

This motto has guided us since 2011, when our company began operating in the IT market in Poland. From the very beginning, we had one clear goal – to support our clients in activities that streamline the functioning of complex IT environments.
Today, after more than 10 years in the Polish IT market, we are confident that thanks to our knowledge and commitment, many companies and institutions from the banking and financial, industrial, energy, transport, medical, and public administration sectors can benefit from comprehensive IT solutions, optimally tailored to their needs.
This would not be possible without the people working in our company – professionals in their respective fields. They are the ones behind our success. Their extensive experience, knowledge, and dedication allow us to carry out complex projects. That is why it is so important for us that they feel supported and appreciated.
We recognize that the values guiding a company directly influence the quality of work performed. That is why at ApexIT, we particularly value teamwork. We know that only through collaboration can productivity increase, problems be solved, and strong relationships between employees be built, which in turn creates a positive workplace atmosphere. Respect, integrity, quality, commitment, creativity, becoming an expert in one’s field, innovation, work-life balance, and ethical behavior in all aspects of our operations are values that matter deeply to us.
We prioritize the needs and satisfaction of our clients. We believe that our business success is measured by our clients’ success. We adhere to the highest management standards, as confirmed by international certifications: Quality Management System compliant with ISO 9001, Environmental Management System ISO 14001, and Information Security Policies compliant with ISO 27001.
We offer products from the world’s leading technology companies. We take pride in holding top partnership statuses with the manufacturers we work with, including Hewlett Packard Enterprise, Commvault, Trend Micro, Veritas, AWS and many others.
We hold the EcoVadis certificate, which is an excellent confirmation that ApexIT follows the main principles of sustainable development and implements environmentally friendly standards. We also possess an industrial security certificate issued by the Internal Security Agency, confirming ApexIT’s ability to protect classified information from unauthorized disclosure in connection with contract execution.
Working with us, you can be confident that your infrastructure and applications are in good hands, because client satisfaction is our greatest reward and motivation to improve every day in what we do.

entityDescription:
NUVUS is a technology-driven company focused on virtualizing electronic hardware for software development, validation, and testing.
The team brings over a decade of experience in complex system validation and integration, particularly in safety-critical environments. This includes large-scale testing setups, automation frameworks, and end-to-end system validation for advanced software systems.
In parallel, NUVUS is actively executing software development, validation, and digitalization projects across multiple industries, ensuring continuous real-world feedback and practical applicability of its solutions.
NUVUS is developing the Virtual Hardware Generator (VHG), a platform that enables high-fidelity virtual models of electronic control units. This allows software to be developed and validated independently of physical hardware, reducing time, cost, and risk.
The technology is being transferred into the space sector, where hardware constraints and extreme conditions require new validation approaches. VHG enables the simulation of hardware behavior under conditions such as radiation effects and thermal stress, supporting earlier validation and more robust system design.
NUVUS aims to establish virtual hardware as a core infrastructure for next-generation engineering across space and terrestrial industries.

Factual Consulting is an international boutique consulting firm focused on mobility, helping public and private sector clients navigate the transition toward safer, smarter, and more sustainable transport systems. The firm combines strategic consulting, market insight, technology assessment, and project management to support work across areas such as mobility research, market expansion, transport planning, road safety, corporate mobility, mobility data spaces, and innovation management. Its mission is to help clients understand emerging trends, seize new opportunities, and respond effectively to the fast changing mobility landscape. 
What sets Factual apart is its integrated model, which brings together foresight, collaborative research and development, knowledge creation, and entrepreneurial execution. The company does not only advise on the future of mobility, it also helps shape it through participation in international research and innovation projects and through the development of its own technology driven ventures and in house solutions. This includes a growing track record at the intersection of space and mobility. Factual coordinates the Horizon Europe JULIA project, which applies Galileo services and Copernicus data to improve the reliability, safety, and sustainability of public transport, and it has also contributed to several EUSPA related initiatives, including MOLIERE and ARIADNA, focused on bringing EU space services into urban mobility and public transport applications.

entityDescription:
LYNKX is a French deep-tech start-up developing satellite-connected safety alert solutions for people operating beyond GSM mobile network coverage. The company designs the LYNKX+ STAR, a LoRa-to-satellite relay beacon enabling emergency alerts to be transmitted from environments where neither GSM nor LoRaWAN networks are available. LYNKX builds on two existing products: the BIVOUAK mobile application, a community hiking platform, and the LYNKX+ beacon, which uses LoRa radio technology for peer-to-peer and cloud-based alert transmission. 
The LYNKX+ STAR extends this ecosystem by adding satellite connectivity through a relay module, ensuring reliable emergency communication in remote outdoor areas and isolated professional environments. The company has pivoted its commercial strategy toward the B2B lone worker safety market, targeting sectors such as forestry, energy maintenance, and industrial operations where GSM coverage is unreliable. A functional prototype has been developed and validated through field testing, with alerts successfully transmitted in GSM-free environments. LYNKX is currently integrating NTN (Non-Terrestrial Network), a 3GPP-standardised satellite radio technology, in partnership with Nordic Semiconductor, to ensure long-term technical stability and ecosystem compatibility. The company was incubated at ESA BIC Nord France, which supported the development of its satellite communication capabilities and commercial strategy. LYNKX is headquartered in Les Adrets, Isère, France, and operates at the intersection of IoT hardware, satellite communication, and personal safety applications. The company's mission is to ensure that no worker or outdoor practitioner is left without a means of calling for help, regardless of their location.

entityDescription:
ZeptoNova is an advanced R&D company specializing in complete, end-to-end solutions for MEMS, microsystems, and advanced electronics. We provide custom device design, low-volume prototyping, and co-pilot fabrication, all the way to mass production through our established network of world-class manufacturing partners. Our mission is to transform breakthrough concepts into manufacturable, scalable products through cutting-edge microfabrication and packaging technologies.

Our Core Competences
MEMS Design & Engineering
- Custom MEMS design and multi-physics simulation
- Feasibility studies and concept validation
- CMOS-MEMS integration (3D packaging, monolithic processing)
Microfabrication Capabilities
- Access to all major academic cleanrooms in Belgium, enabling highly flexible low-volume prototyping
- Single-step microfabrication processes, including:
- Thin-film deposition (CVD, PVD, PLD, ALD)
- Piezoelectric thin films (PZT, AlN, ScAlN)
- Lithography mask production
- Dry etching & deep reactive ion etching (DRIE)
- Other custom micro-processing steps on demand
Fast-Track Production Lines
Ready-to-manufacture product lines for rapid development:
- MEMS Micromirrors
- Inertial Measurement Units (IMU)
- RF MEMS (BAW, SAW)
- PMUT fabrication line
- MEMS Microphone platforms
Advanced Packaging Solutions
We provide industry-grade packaging to bring concepts into robust, product-ready form:
- Wire bonding, flip-chip bonding
- Wafer bonding & vacuum packaging
- Wafer-level packaging
- Post-CMOS chip modification (e.g., ENIG deposition)
- CPC packaging
- Interposer design & fabrication (Silicon or Glass substrates)
Characterization & Testing
Comprehensive lab-grade testing and metrology:
- SEM imaging & surface profilometry
- Laser Doppler Vibrometry
- Electrical & thermal characterization of MEMS devices
- Holographic microscopy
- Thin-film characterization: stress analysis, XRD, reliability testing
- Piezoelectric thin-film characterization (coefficients, stress, permittivity, lifetime)
Ultrasound & Acoustic Solutions
End-to-end ultrasound technology support:
- Interface electronics design
- Transducer packaging
- Underwater acoustic characterization
- Medical imaging consultancy
- Electrical testing & validation
Advanced Electronics
Analog and digital advanced electronics services
- Circuit and printed circuit board (PCB) design
- Embedded software and firmware development
- FPGA programming
- Control systems and communications, Advanced signal processing and AI implementations

entityDescription:
Solutions Connektica France, founded in 2022 and based in Toulouse, France, develops a specialized AIT (Assembly, Integration and Test) execution platform dedicated to the production of critical space hardware subsystems and components.
The platform integrates Manufacturing Execution System (MES) functionalities with workflow orchestration, real-time data acquisition from test equipment, and process automation into a unified environment. It supports both assembly and testing activities, enabling full digitalization of AIT operations.
Connektica addresses the needs of satellite manufacturers, both legacy and NewSpace players as well as their subcontractors (SMEs), who are facing increasing pressure to scale production while reducing costs and maintaining stringent quality, traceability, and compliance standards (EN9100)
By transforming traditionally engineer-driven AIT processes into operator-executable workflows through digital work instructions and automated procedures, the platform significantly reduces reliance on highly specialized engineering resources. At the same time, automation of test execution and data capture reduces cycle times, minimizes manual intervention, and limits errors and rework.
This approach enables industrialization of space manufacturing by improving production efficiency, ensuring end-to-end traceability, and supporting high-quality standards required for space-grade hardware.

entityName: Universität Wien - Soft Matter Experiments Laboratory (SoMeX)
entityDescription:
The Soft Matter Experiments (SoMeX) Lab investigates the physical principles governing the behavior of soft and biological systems, with an emphasis on both equilibrium and non-equilibrium phenomena. By combining innovative experimental techniques with theoretical insights, the SoMeX Lab addresses challenges ranging from the microscopic dynamics of colloids and foams to the collective behavior of living tissues.

The activities are broadly organized into four main research themes:
1.
Development of novel methods to investigate soft and biological materials
2.
Dynamics of soft matter systems3. Biophysical studies of living matter
4. Non-equilibrium fluctuations and microgravity experiments

entityDescription: The University of Las Palmas de Gran Canaria as such was created in the 1989-1990 academic year, because of a major movement in society in Gran Canaria, which culminated when the Canary Islands Parliament passed the University Reorganisation Law on April 26th, 1989. entityDescription:
Rescomp Engineering is an engineering consultancy specialized in the design, analysis, testing and monitoring of advanced composite structures. The company supports industrial partners throughout the entire development cycle, from early-stage feasibility studies and performance optimisation to detailed structural design and validation.
Rescomp combines strong expertise in simulation and modelling with advanced experimental capabilities, including the design and execution of static and fatigue test campaigns. Experimental results are interpreted through physics-based and data-driven approaches, enabling the development of reliable and efficient design strategies. In parallel, the company provides tailored training and knowledge transfer activities, supporting R&D teams and engineers in areas such as composite design, fatigue assessment and structural health monitoring.
In addition to consultancy and testing services, Rescomp develops proprietary technologies for composite analysis and monitoring. These include advanced tools for fatigue life assessment (FLA), capable of predicting damage initiation, propagation and failure under cyclic loading, and innovative sensorless structural health monitoring (SHM) solutions, which exploit the intrinsic electrical properties of composite materials to detect damage in real time without embedded sensors.
These technologies can be used independently or combined to enable an integrated approach to design and monitoring, supporting the development of safer, lighter and more reliable composite structures, as well as improved prediction of residual strength and service life.
Rescomp is also actively developing new modelling tools targeting emerging applications such as bonded joints and inserts, injection-moulded short-fibre composites, recycled carbon fibre components and additive manufacturing of continuous fibre-reinforced polymers.

IONA Logistics Limited is an Irish-registered company (CRO 771910) developing an autonomous drone logistics network designed to transform last-mile and middle-mile delivery in rural and hard-to-reach regions. The company provides a white-label drone delivery system for logistics operators, enabling them to operate cost-effective and scalable services that complement traditional van or ferry-based transport.
IONA’s technology stack includes proprietary hybrid tilt-rotor UAVs capable of beyond visual line of sight (BVLOS) operations and autonomous handling hubs. The system integrates satellite data, Earth observation, and AI-driven route optimization to ensure reliable delivery even in complex terrain and adverse weather conditions.
The company operates from Ireland, with R&D and flight testing in Europe and the UK. It is currently conducting feasibility and demonstration projects under ESA ARTES 4.0, validating its service model with early customers including Streamline Shipping Group and Eagle Couriers.
IONA’s vision is to decarbonize and automate regional logistics by building an aerial network that extends the reach of sustainable transport to communities underserved by conventional infrastructure.

entityDescription:
Neoforge is an AI-driven advanced metal manufacturing company headquartered in Berlin, Germany. The company operates a proprietary physics-AI simulation platform combined with a vertically integrated production facility, enabling the rapid development and delivery of complex, mission-ready metal components — from CAD to qualified part under one roof.
Neoforge's end-to-end capabilities span component identification and design optimisation, AI-driven build preparation with first-time-right printing via Laser Powder Bed Fusion (LPBF), post-processing (5-axis CNC machining, heat treatment, surface finishing), full materials testing, and metrology. The company's thermal homogenisation technology ensures consistent mechanical properties across different geometries, machines, and production sites, significantly accelerating qualification and transferability.
Neoforge supports a wide range of metals including nickel alloys, titanium alloys, aluminium alloys, copper alloys, and stainless steel. By simulating more and prototyping less, Neoforge reduces time-to-product by up to 90% compared to traditional iterative manufacturing approaches.
The company specialises in supplying critical complex metal components for European sovereignty applications, including space, defence, and high-performance industrial sectors. Customers retain full ownership of the developed production recipe, enabling flexible insourcing or third-party production at a later stage.

entityDescription: Quantumz.io is a private software and R&D company (a Polish limited liability company) active in quantum technologies, scientific computing, and optimization software. It develops hybrid classical-quantum and physics-inspired methods for combinatorial optimization, especially problems formulated as QUBO and Ising models. Its main technologies include VeloxQ, a QUBO/HUBO solver with a Python SDK for deployment on standard CPU/GPU infrastructure and future hybrid workflows; XaosQ/AIRS, a solver-based disruption-management platform for airline operations built around Time-Space Networks and mixed-integer linear programming; and QOS, a platform for heterogeneous quantum-classical workflows. The company’s technical work also covers physics-inspired optimization based on nonlinear Hamiltonian dynamics and simulated-bifurcation-type methods, rigorous benchmarking of quantum and classical runtime claims, and methods for certification of quantum operations. Overall, Quantumz.io operates at the intersection of software engineering, applied optimization, and quantum computing R&D, with application areas including logistics, aviation, scheduling, energy, and other industrial decision-support domains.

entityDescription:
Space It Up SCARL is a strategic consortium that aims to boost Italian space technology for the exploration and exploitation of space, generating concrete benefits for the planet and humanity. The company is based on collaboration between 33 entities among universities, research centers and industry. Space It Up SCARL was originally established to manage and coordinate the homonymous project funded by the Italian Space Agency. While this remains its core operational mandate, the long-term objective is to expand its portfolio of research and development initiatives and to consolidate its role as a stable coordination platform for the national space ecosystem.

The mission of Space It Up SCARL is to coordinate its partners, foster structured collaboration among universities, research centres and industry, and support the submission of proposals to national and international funding programmes. By operating as a unified operational hub, the consortium strengthens the competitiveness of the Italian space ecosystem and ensures that the country’s scientific and technological capabilities are effectively represented in major strategic opportunities.
Space It Up SCARL also aims to serve as a national platform capable of aligning and managing future initiatives across multiple technological domains. Through this integrated structure, the organisation intends to provide Italy with a cohesive response to the growing global demand for innovation in areas such as space exploration, autonomous and collaborative robotics, extraterrestrial habitats, Earth observation and human spaceflight.

entityDescription:
NaviGate develops, produces and commercializes innovative high-technology products and services for the space sector. The company focuses on onboard software solutions for autonomous orbit determination and satellite navigation designed to operate directly on spacecraft with minimal dependence on ground infrastructure.
Its core product is a modular and flexible navigation software capable of integrating multiple sources of navigation data, including GNSS signals, inter-satellite measurements and optical sensors, automatically adapting to the sensors available onboard the spacecraft. This approach increases satellite operational autonomy, reduces ground-segment operational costs and improves the accuracy and robustness of navigation solutions, even for complex missions such as lunar or deep-space operations.
The software is based on advanced orbit determination algorithms, high-fidelity orbital propagation models and multi-sensor data fusion techniques. It is designed for embedded and real-time environments and optimized to run efficiently on resource-constrained onboard computers.

entityDescription:
Four Dot Infinity (FDI) is a Greek SME specialized in the development of intelligent services and AI-driven solutions for Beyond-5G and 6G communication systems. entityName: von Karman Institute for Fluid Dynamics - ML4F — Machine Learning for Fluid Systems
entityDescription:
The ML4F group develops mathematical frameworks for combining multi-fidelity data streams in fluid-dynamic systems. The core activity focuses on hybrid surrogate models that integrate sparse high-fidelity CFD with lower-fidelity simulations and experimental measurements.
Expertise in adjoint-based gradient evaluation and physics-constrained regression enables the construction of models that remain consistent with fluid-dynamic principles, providing a reliable basis for the analysis and optimization of complex engineering components.
With a focus on system identification and state estimation (e.g. Kalman filtering and Bayesian inference), ML4F develops integrated modelling frameworks that continuously reconcile model predictions with observational data. These approaches support efficient design exploration and contribute to the development of physics-informed digital representations of engineering systems for performance monitoring and prediction.

entityDescription: DIET (Department of Information Engineering, Electronics and Telecommunications,http://www.diet.uniroma1.it) is a department of Sapienza University of Rome, recently established after the fusion of the former Department of Electronic Engineering (DIE) and Department of Science and Technique of Information (INFOCOM). It is a governmental organization under the directives of the Italian Ministry of University and Scientific Research. The permanent staff is of about 65 researchers and professors, plus administrative and technical personnel, temporary researchers, contractors, and PhD students. Turnover of staff personnel is related to people retiring and consequent replacing. As for PhD students the turnover is three years whereas for temporary researchers and contractors it is 3-6 years. DIET carries out research and teaching activities covering many aspects of Information and Communication Technology. DIET has an extensive scientific experience in active and passive remote sensing. It has performed activities for analysing and interpreting data (electromagnetic models, inversion techniques), designing radar and radiometric sensors, modelling environment phenomena. Remote sensing of the atmosphere by microwave radiometers (both ground-based and satellite measurements) and radar remote sensing researches for land applications have been developed in the framework of international experiments and projects funded by Italian Ministry of Research, ASI, ESA and Italian Civil Protection. Past experience on inversion schemes include standard regression techniques, as well as Bayesian technique and neural networks.
