CGT is a leading Italian industrial solutions provider and the official Caterpillar dealer in Italy since 1934, offering a comprehensive range of products and services across multiple strategic sectors. 
The company delivers integrated solutions including sales, rental, and technical assistance for earthmoving machinery, construction equipment, infrastructure projects, extractive industries, power generation, oil & gas operations, and marine applications. 
Its nationwide presence includes numerous branches, workshops, and a highly specialized technical team capable of providing rapid support and spare parts anywhere customers operate.

CGT plays a significant role in the marine sector, offering a wide portfolio of marine engines, propulsion systems, and technical services designed for shipyards, commercial vessels, industrial maritime applications, and naval operations.
CGT provides complete propulsion systems, integrating engines, generators, auxiliary systems, and control solutions to support ship-building yards and industrial maritime installations.
Furthermore, CGT offers specialized technical assistance, programmed maintenance, and remote diagnostic services, allowing fleets and shipyards to monitor the health and performance of their equipment 24/7. This service capability ensures minimized downtime, rapid repairs, and long‑term fleet optimization

As part of the international TESYA Group, CGT benefits from a broad European footprint spanning Italy, Spain, Portugal, and the Balkans.
TESYA Group is composed of 28 companies with strong local roots across 15 countries. entityDescription:
Dynas+ Group is an engineering company specialized in numerical simulation. Thanks to our long-standing partnerships with the major software publishers Ansys (https://www.ansys.com/) and DEP USA (https://depusa.com/), we distribute internationally recognized engineering software solutions such as LS-DYNA, Ansys Discovery, Ansys Mechanical, Fluent, HFSS, Maxwell and DEP MeshWorks. We support our industrial clients in Europe in optimizing their development cycles by providing tailored expertise services: technical support, training, subcontracting, consulting, methodology development, and R&D.
Our historical core expertise (over 30 years of experience) lies in the modeling and analysis of fast dynamics phenomena as well as the simulation of complex multi-physics phenomena using the LS-DYNA software. Over the years, this expertise has been strengthened by integrating complementary software, enabling our engineering office to expand its scope and address increasingly complex technical challenges in a wide range of industries such as aerospace, automotive, defense, marine, nuclear, and industrial goods.
Dynas+ places research and innovation at the heart of its strategy and actively participates in several collaborative innovation projects in the space, aeronautics and defense sectors. Every day, Dynas+ strives to create more efficient, faster, and more innovative solutions thanks to its committed collaborators and continuously enriched expertise.

Dynas+ has developed strong expertise in the simulation of hypervelocity impacts of orbital debris on space structures using LS-DYNA, supporting the analysis and design of resilient spacecraft components. This work has led to the filing of a patent related to an innovative structural concept specifically designed to improve resistance to debris impacts. In addition, Dynas+ has significant experience in the simulation of shock wave propagation resulting from pyrotechnic events within launcher and satellite structures.
In 2025, we are strengthening our European presence with the creation of Dynas+ Iberia, based in Madrid, to better support our new partners and clients in Spain and Portugal.

entityDescription: Suplac Rafinarie SRL este o societate cu răspundere limitată românească (CUI 46663303), înregistrată în România, stat membru ESA. Directorul companiei, Prof. Sergiu Vasili Lazarev (ORCID: 0009-0005-3749-9735), este cercetătorul principal și unicul coordonator științific al acestei propuneri.Prof. Lazarev desfășoară cercetări independente în fizica teoretică și computațională din 2010, cu aplicații directe în dinamica fluidelor, modelarea turbulenței și aerotermodinică. Peste 15 ani de cercetare au produs peste 50 de publicații evaluate de colegi și dezvoltarea cadrului New Subquantum Informational Mechanics (NMSI), din care a fost derivat solverul Navier-Stokes augmentat NSE-NMSI (NMSIFoam).Competența principală în dinamica fluidelor include: regularizarea analitică a ecuațiilor Navier-Stokes prin intermediul unor operatori matematici noi (DZO, gamma_diss, scalarea timpului fractal T_F); implementarea NMSIFoam ca modul de rezolvare OpenFOAM v2312; și validarea numerică a predicției turbulenței hipersonice la Mach 8-20 în raport cu datele de referință open-source NASA, atingând reduceri medii ale erorilor de 68% în comparație cu RANS k-omega SST standard (TRL-4 confirmat, 5 cazuri de referință).

entityDescription:
Spaceneedle helps high-value crop growers who struggle with weather-driven losses turn uncertainty into clear, profitable field action. In Poland and across the EU, droughts, frosts, and heatwaves are increasing while most operational decisions still rely on generic forecasts and delayed signals. Growers need plot-level clarity early enough to prevent damage, not just report it.
Our platform combines Copernicus satellite data (Sentinel-1 and Sentinel-2) with Galileo-synchronized ground sensors to produce real-time microclimate intelligence and actionable recommendations. The result is a practical decision system for irrigation, fertigation, and frost response that can also automate selected workflows. We focus on both outcomes and usability: protect yield per hectare, reduce water waste, and simplify daily decision-making for farm teams.

entityName: Baltic Space Systems Sp. z o.o.
entityDescription:
Baltic Space Systems Sp. z o.o. is a polish startup focused on the development of compact inertial navigation systems (INS) for unmanned platforms. Our devices are engineered to function in environments where satellite navigation signals are degraded or unavailable. They facilitate autonomous orientation and positioning without reliance on external information, thereby significantly enhancing resilience against GNSS jamming, spoofing, and interference during missions.
We originally developed the technology for rocket applications; however, due to its modular architecture, we have broadened our offerings to include two additional variants: satellite and drone.
A fundamental aspect of our approach is a unified device "core" the computational and algorithmic architecture, which we customize during production by selecting the type and quantity of sensors utilized in the system. This enables us to meticulously align the product with the customer's priorities, enhancing accuracy or optimizing cost.
In practice, this means we can provide various levels of precision without the need to redesign the entire system, merely by adjusting the sensor configuration within the same architecture.

Sea Green Engineering S.r.l. (SGE) is an innovative Italian ship design and engineering company based in Trieste, specializing in the development and integration of advanced onboard technologies for sustainable maritime operations. Founded in 2020 by a team of experienced naval architects and marine engineers, the company provides high-value engineering services covering the entire lifecycle of vessel design, from feasibility studies and concept development to basic and detailed design, retrofit solutions, and construction support. 
SGE focuses strongly on the energy transition of the maritime sector, developing and integrating alternative propulsion and energy systems such as hybrid, full-electric, and other low-emission solutions aimed at improving vessel efficiency and reducing environmental impact. The company also develops specialized maritime software tools to support ship energy system design and optimization, enabling shipowners and designers to evaluate and implement advanced power configurations for next-generation vessels. 
Through its multidisciplinary team and network of collaborators, Sea Green Engineering combines expertise in naval architecture, offshore engineering, and advanced simulation methods, including structural analysis and energy system modelling, to deliver innovative and reliable solutions for maritime, offshore, and inland waterway vessels. The company is also actively engaged in research and development projects and international collaborations aimed at decarbonizing shipping, exploring technologies such as alternative fuels, fuel-cell-based power systems, and wind-assisted propulsion. 
With a strong commitment to sustainability, innovation, and engineering excellence, Sea Green Engineering supports shipowners, shipyards, and technology providers in designing the next generation of greener, safer, and more efficient ships.

entityDescription:
What is 'PwC'?
PwC is the brand under which the member firms of PricewaterhouseCoopers International Limited (PwCIL) operate and provide professional services. Together, these firms form the PwC network. ‘PwC’ is often used to refer either to individual firms within the PwC network or to several or all of them collectively.
In many parts of the world, accounting firms are required by law to be locally owned and independent. Although regulatory attitudes on this issue are changing, PwC member firms do not and cannot currently operate as a corporate multinational. The PwC network is not a global partnership, a single firm, or a multinational corporation.
For these reasons, the PwC network consists of firms which are separate legal entities. The firms that make up the network are committed to working together to provide quality service offerings for clients throughout the world. Firms in the PwC network are members in, or have other connections to, PricewaterhouseCoopers International Limited (PwCIL), an English private company limited by guarantee. PwCIL does not practise accountancy or provide services to clients. Rather its purpose is tofacilitate coordination betweenmember firms in the PwC network. Focusing on key areas such as strategy, brand, and risk and quality, the Network Leadership Team and Board of PwCIL develop and implement policies and initiatives to achieve a common and coordinated approach among individual firms where appropriate. Member firms of PwCIL can use the PwC name and the resources and methodologies of the PwC network are made available to them. In addition, member firms may request the resources of other member firms and/or secure the provision of professional services by other member firms and/or other entities. In return, member firms agree to abide by certain common policies and to maintain the standards of the PwC network as put forward by PwCIL.
The PwC network is not one international partnership and PwC member firms are not otherwise legal partners with each other. Many of the member firms have legally registered names which contain “PricewaterhouseCoopers”, however there is no ownership by PwCIL. A member firm cannot act as agent of PwCIL or any other member firm, cannot obligate PwCIL or any other member firm, and is liable only for its own acts or omissions and not those of PwCIL or any other member firm. Similarly, PwCIL cannot act as an agent of any member firm, cannot obligate any member firm, and is liable only for its own acts or omissions.

entityDescription:
MatAlytics Ltd is a UK based deep technology company developing advanced AI solutions for real time structural integrity and asset life assessment in heavy industry.
Founded as a spin out from the University of Nottingham, MatAlytics combines high fidelity finite element engineering models with physics informed artificial intelligence to create its core platform, CITRUS Component Integrity Technology Reliability Utilisation System. The technology enables near instantaneous prediction of stresses, fatigue, creep damage, and remaining useful life of critical components such as pressure vessels, steam drums, piping systems, and high temperature structures.
Unlike conventional methods that rely on periodic offline simulations or conservative rule based approaches, MatAlytics bridges design and operation by translating live plant data into physically interpretable engineering metrics in real time. This allows operators to make safer, faster, and more economically optimised decisions, particularly for assets operating under flexible duty cycles or beyond original design life.
The company serves power generation, nuclear, oil and gas, and other safety critical industrial sectors, working closely with major utilities and industrial partners to deploy physics based AI within existing analytics environments.
MatAlytics’ mission is to redefine how engineering decisions are made, moving from static assessment to continuous physics grounded intelligence.

entityDescription:
Addyx is an innovative Italian startup founded in 2021, specializing in the development of proprietary technologies for advanced composite manufacturing. The company focuses on enabling the efficient production of high-performance hollow structures with complex geometries, addressing key limitations of traditional manufacturing systems.
Addyx operates primarily in the aerospace, automotive, marine, and high-performance sports industries — sectors where lightweight design, structural efficiency, and manufacturing repeatability are essential competitive drivers.
The company’s core strength lies in its patented technologies designed to improve the production of hollow composite components.
WSM-170 is an expandable, water-soluble mandrel engineered for manufacturing hollow tubular composite parts. It simplifies the layup process, improves internal surface quality, reduces waste, and allows easier removal after curing, increasing overall process efficiency.
Carbon Exoskeleton is a system of topologically optimized structural reinforcements integrated into composite components. It enhances stiffness and mechanical performance while minimizing weight, enabling more efficient structural designs.
RM-X is a next-generation reinforced sacrificial mandrel technology developed for producing hollow composite structures with complex geometries, including undercuts, nodes, and variable cross-sections. The system consists of a thin external shell made from water-soluble polymer combined with an internal structural reinforcement core, also fully water-soluble. This configuration ensures mechanical stability during curing while allowing complete dissolution in water after processing. The result is reduced material usage, lower production times, improved repeatability, and cost efficiency.
Addyx integrates advanced CAD design, structural simulation, additive manufacturing, rotomolding, and hybrid manufacturing techniques. The company develops functional prototypes, industrial demonstrators, and proof-of-concept projects in collaboration with industrial partners, supporting OEMs and Tier 1 suppliers in optimizing their composite manufacturing processes.
Its business model combines direct supply of devices and engineered solutions with a scalable approach that includes technology licensing. By leveraging strong intellectual property protection and process know-how, Addyx positions itself as a technology partner for companies seeking to manufacture lighter, stronger, and more sustainable composite structures.
The company’s vision is to become a reference player in advanced composite manufacturing technologies, transforming geometric complexity into a competitive advantage and enabling new structural architectures that can be reliably industrialized at scale.

entityDescription: The Ljubljana University Incubator (LUI), established in 2004 at the initiative of the University of Ljubljana, is the leading center for the support and development of innovative startups in Slovenia. entityDescription:
Vecify is a Spanish deep-tech company developing an engineering platform that enables space and other regulated-critical industries to design, test, iterate, and certify complex systems within a single continuously traceable environment aligned with the V-model and ECSS standards.
Space programs operate under highly rigorous verification and certification frameworks, yet traceability, verification matrices, and compliance evidence are still largely managed through fragmented tools and document-driven processes. As spacecraft, launchers and avionics systems grow in complexity, this approach introduces schedule risk, costly rework during Phase C/D, and audit friction at major review milestones.
Vecify unifies system architecture, requirements, verification and validation (V&V), risks, configuration baselines, and certification evidence into a structured engineering model. Compliance is not treated as a downstream documentation task, but as an integrated and continuously managed property of the system.
At its core, Vecify integrates explainable AI to assist with regulatory interpretation, automated traceability, and real-time change-impact analysis across ECSS workflows. Engineers remain fully in control, while certification readiness becomes continuous. All AI-supported outputs are auditable, transparent, and compatible with certification authority expectations. Vecify combines domain expertise with advanced AI capabilities supported by the Barcelona Supercomputing Center AI Factory.
Vecify’s objective is to strengthen Europe’s digital mission assurance capabilities and enable faster, safer certification of critical space systems.

Confagricoltura Campania is the regional branch of the Confederazione Generale dell’Agricoltura Italiana, one of the oldest and most prominent organisations representing the agricultural sector in Italy. The organisation represents approximately 8,000 agricultural enterprises in the Campania region and plays a key role in supporting agricultural employers and promoting the development of the agri-food sector.
Operating in a region characterised by rich biodiversity and high-value agri-food supply chains, Confagricoltura Campania works to strengthen the competitiveness, sustainability and innovation capacity of agricultural enterprises. The organisation acts as a key interlocutor with regional, national and European institutions, fostering dialogue between farmers, public authorities and other stakeholders.
Confagricoltura Campania provides a wide range of services to support agricultural businesses, including labour relations management, legal and administrative assistance, CAP consultancy, rural development support, fiscal and accounting advisory services, training and professional development programmes, as well as support for internationalisation and market access.
The Federation coordinates five provincial unions (Naples, Caserta, Salerno, Avellino and Benevento), ensuring territorial representation and direct support to local agricultural enterprises. In addition, it works closely with several specialised organisations such as Agriturist, ANGA, ANPA, Confagricoltura Donna, Confagri BIO Campania, CAA Confagricoltura and Gestioni Assicurazioni Agricole, which contribute to strengthening services and representation across the agricultural sector.
Through its structured governance and extensive network of enterprises and stakeholders, Confagricoltura Campania plays an important role in promoting innovation, knowledge transfer and sustainable development within the regional agri-food ecosystem.

entityDescription:
RumenAI – Measure. Analyse. Optimise.
Carbon is the currency of life. Where it flows, biology adapts. Where it accumulates, systems destabilise.
RumenAI was founded on a simple conviction: to optimise living systems, we must first measure them at their biochemical core.
At the heart of the company’s innovation is a patented, miniaturised spectroscopic platform embedded within a biocompatible ruminal bolus. Once deployed inside the rumen — one of nature’s most complex anaerobic bioreactors — the device autonomously and continuously quantifying dissolved CO₂ and other critical fermentation intermediates.
Measure: RumenAI captures real-time carbon speciation and gas–liquid mass-transfer dynamics directly within a dense, multiphase biological reactor — a domain previously inaccessible to continuous monitoring.
Analyse: Embedded edge processing and AI-driven spectral modelling transform raw signals into dynamic carbon-flux intelligence, revealing metabolic stability, fermentation efficiency, and early stress signatures.
Optimise: The resulting insights guide farmers to generate precise feeding strategies, prevent metabolic disorders, improve nutrient utilisation, increase productivity, and reduce methane emissions.
By shifting farm management from reactive intervention (detection) to predictive control (Prevention), RumenAI enables more efficient, resilient, and climate-conscious livestock systems.
By making carbon visible, RumenAI transforms biological complexity into measurable performance, enabling smarter food systems today and informing controlled life-support systems of tomorrow.

entityDescription:
Azolla Projects is a Barcelona-based, purpose-driven company dedicated to enabling and financing the transition to regenerative agriculture, transforming it into a scalable farming model.

Azolla Projects is specialised in the design and implementation of projects related to carbon farming and natural capital, regenerative agriculture and ecosystem services in agricultural and land-use systems. The company works on projects that translate environmental performance into decision-relevant outcomes for public and private stakeholders.
Azolla Projects has experience in structuring complex, multi-actor initiatives in the agri-food sector, including EU-funded R&D projects, policy-oriented activities and collaborations involving research institutions, farmers, value-chain actors and public authorities. A core area of expertise of the company lies in the deployment of monitoring, reporting and verification (MRV) approaches, as well as in the alignment of project outcomes with evolving European regulatory and certification frameworks related to climate mitigation, adaptation and sustainability.
Building on this foundation, Azolla Projects has also worked closely with financial institutions and public bodies on topics related to sustainable finance, including participation in advisory processes linked to government-led initiatives. Through this work, the company has developed a solid understanding of financial risk analysis methodologies, sustainability-related regulatory and reporting obligations affecting the financial sector, and the implications of financing decisions, including fiscal and regulatory considerations associated with green and non-green investments.
Azolla Projects brings specific experience in ESG-related reporting frameworks and in the interpretation of portfolio and value-chain-level impacts financed by financial institutions, including Scope 3–type considerations beyond carbon, such as water, land-use and broader environmental externalities. This perspective is directly relevant to financial institutions obligations to assess, manage and mitigate the impacts associated with the activities they finance.
Azolla Projects contributes its capability to translate Earth Observation–based drought resilience indicators into economically interpretable signals aligned with financial risk assessment, project viability analysis and sustainability-aligned decision contexts. This combination of technical, regulatory and financial interpretative expertise complements the Earth Observation and modelling capabilities of Future Water and directly supports the objectives of the proposed research.

The Jopp Group (stylized as JOPP Group) is an independent family-owned company headquartered in Bad Neustadt an der Saale in the Rhön-Grabfeld district of Bavaria, Germany. It develops and manufactures automotive components. With 12 production facilities in 7 countries across 3 continents, the Jopp Group employs over 1,700 people.
Jopp develops, manufactures, and supplies solutions for the automotive industry worldwide. These include mechatronic components such as shift-by-wire systems and actuators, as well as proprietary sensor and electronics concepts. The portfolio also encompasses complete circuit systems, lubrication and cooling systems, and interior components. The production of high-precision turned and sintered components and injection-molded plastic parts rounds out the product range.
The company analyzes the field of electromobility and generates product ideas, such as thermal management for battery and power electronics in electric vehicles. In addition, it is working on highly integrated coolant control units and concepts for the direct cooling of electric motors. The value creation of the group of companies is primarily based on precision machining and sintering technology, plastic injection molding and electronics manufacturing.

entityDescription:
SiPearl is an European fabless designer of high-performance energy-efficient processors for HPC, AI and data centres. These processors will help address strategic dual-use challenges in the fields of security, defence, medical research, energy, climate and engineering with a reduced environmental footprint.
SiPearl is thus contributing to Europe’s technological sovereignty.

Created by Philippe Notton in June 2019, SiPearl is the company bringing to life the European Processor Initiative(EPI) project. The aim of EPI is to foster the deployment in Europe of high-performance and energy-efficient processor technologies. Privately held, SiPearl is supported by the European Union and France.
SiPearl designs European processors that help Europe’s supercomputers to achieve exascale power. It works through close collaboration with its 30 partners from the EPI consortium – scientific community, supercomputing centres and leading names from the IT, electronics and automotive sectors – which are its stakeholders, clients and end-users.
Since its operational launch in January 2020, SiPearl has been financially supported by the European Commission under the Horizon Europeprogram.
The company also benefits from support from the European Innovation Council(EIC) as part of its EIC Accelerator programme, from the French government via France 2030, and from corporate and financial investors including Arm, Eviden and Cathay Venture Inc (Taiwan).

description:
We are an SME specialized in Computational Fluid Dynamics simulations for complex geometries. We have a large experience in the CFD simulations of hypersonic flows, and participated in projects like ARD, IXV, Space Rider. We also performed CFD simulations of re-usable launchers in the H2020 project RETALT, and in the ESA FLPP project CFD4SALTO. 
We use and develop our own CFD code, called NSMB, which has all the functionalities of a modern CFD code. For hypersonic flows NSMB includes chemical, thermo-chemical and electronic non-equilibrium models. NSMB has been coupled to the OpenSource code Mutation++ developed by VKI, and was used to study Gas-Surface interaction in an ESA funded project.

description:
Onetreck is building the next generation of autonomous medical systems for missions on Earth and in space, ensuring that no human is left without care when support collapses.

Born in the French Alps and accelerated from the national AI excellence cluster (MIAI, UGA, CNRS), we are fully industry-driven and design sovereign, resilient clinical intelligence capable of operating in the world’s most degraded environments.

Our flagship system, Manta Voyager, is a TRL 5–6 ultra-compact edge-AI medical module that delivers real-time, clinician-level guidance without connectivity. 
Entirely on-device. No cloud. No tracking. No dependency.

Onetreck is supported by leading scientific, defense, space, and hardware institutions including CNES, DGA, AID, and NVIDIA. The company is laureate of BPI France (BFTE), MedInTechs, the French Tech HIIT Program, the CLARA R2B Prize, and is accelerated by ESA BIC in Aerospace Valley.

Tested with university hospitals such as AP-HP Paris and already deployed in demanding field evaluations, our system is engineered for extreme robustness. Onetreck is also preparing for orbital mission integration, supporting next-generation space-medical autonomy.
entityDescription:
OneTreck® is a pioneering healthtech company committed to delivering precision medicine to underserved populations worldwide. Our primary focus is addressing the critical needs of medical deserts — regions where healthcare access is limited due to geographic, economic, or infrastructural challenges.
Our solution, Manta Voyager by OneTreck®, combines lightweight hardware and advanced software to offer a frugal, autonomous telemedicine platform. Designed for environments with unreliable connectivity, Manta Voyager operates on portable devices without the need for cloud computing, ensuring resilience in remote locations, conflict zones, offshore platforms, and even space exploration.
At the core of our innovation is the use of digital twin technology, causal analysis, and a wide range of biomedical data input — enabling deeper insights into patient health and supporting truly personalized treatments.
Trusted by multiple biotech and pharma clients, our technology is deeply integrated into preclinical and clinical R&D processes. Our certified health data hosting servers ensure secure and compliant data management, reinforcing the trust of our partners and clients.
At OneTreck, we believe in bringing precision medicine everywhere, for everyone.

DEIMOS has remarkable expertise in Space activities, being Space one of the core business activities of the company since the creation in year 2001. Our expertise encompasses mission analysis and design, Guidance navigation and control, Ground Segment Systems, development of critical on-board software systems, Satellite Navigation Systems, Space Situational Awareness, etc. In our areas of expertise, we are involved in the majority of the ESA missions such as: Earth Observation, Satellite Navigation, Launchers, Robotic Exploration, Science, Space Situational Awareness, etc. Furthermore DEIMOS has the ability to carry out space missions, such as leading our own missions: DEIMOS 1 flying since 2009, and DEIMOS-2, which is a programme to be launched in 2013. For our own programmes, DEIMOS is the prime of the mission development, as well as responsible for the mission analysis and design, system engineering, complete development of the Ground Segment, integration of the Space Segment, based on platforms and payload provided by third party, overall integration and validation of the system, launch and commissioning. Furthermore DEIMOS has the responsibility for the operations of our own missions, as well as the commercial exploitation of the data, applications, products and services, based mainly in our own data.

Development of software systems is a key line of activity of DEIMOS. We have large expertise in the development of software systems involving complex algorithms, as we combine both capabilities. Hereafter it is just an example of our software development capabilities: Ground Segment Systems for Earth Observation: DEIMOS has been involved in all the ESA EO missions, in the development of Ground Segment Systems, such as Mission Planning, Calibration and Validation, Performance Monitoring, Instrument Data Processing, Archive, Catalogues, etc. For many of these elements, DEIMOS has already multi-mission software products that can be easily adapted from one mission to another Galileo critical components for the Ground Mission Segment: DEIMOS is developing critical components such as the MGF (Message Generation Facility), MSF (Mission Support Facility), RDG (Raw Data Generation), etc.

entityDescription: A.N.E.V. CONSULTING Services Ltd is a forward-thinking, for-profit organization dedicated to advancing research and innovation in cognition and E2STEAM (Entrepreneurship, Environment, Science, Technology, Engineering, Arts, and Mathematics). With a strong emphasis on fostering innovation and STEAM capacity, the company collaborates with various stakeholders and external funding sources, including the EU, to support its endeavors. Under the umbrella of A.N.E.V. CONSULTING Services Ltd, three distinct entities operate with regal names: STEMFREAK, Institute for STEAM Education, and ROBO Each of these entities plays a vital role in promoting excellence and innovation in STEAM education and related fields. The Institute for STEAM Education spearheads several noteworthy projects, including the development of a Certification Scheme for STEAM students, schools, and educators in collaboration with the Cyprus Certification Company. Additionally, the Institute has undertaken extensive research and development efforts to create an Interactive Educational STEAM Program, which integrates multiple disciplines seamlessly. This program, piloted and validated over several years, is designed to cater to students aged 5 to 18, offering comprehensive interdisciplinary learning experiences. STEMFREAK, another integral arm of the organization, offers STEAM Educational Programs both conventionally and through an innovative E-Learning Platform. The program is designed to cater to students of all ages, with a focus on providing flexible, high-quality STEAM education. Through franchise packages, STEMFREAK extends its reach to other educational organizations, enabling them to deliver blended STEAM education effectively. ROBO, the third component of A.N.E.V. CONSULTING Services Ltd, is deeply involved in robotics education and innovation. From distributing basic robotics components to designing and producing educational STEAM kits tailored to STEMFREAK's program, ROBO plays a crucial role in empowering the maker community and advancing robotics education in Cyprus and the EU. One of the notable aspects of the Institute for STEAM Education's projects is its focus on astronomy-related education. Dr. Andri Vrioni, the driving force behind the Institute's initiatives, has authored books that integrate astronomy into STEAM education, providing interdisciplinary activities for learners of all levels. Furthermore, research papers presented by Dr. Vrioni and her team delve into the learning outcomes of VR/AR-STEAM blended learning environments, emphasizing the importance of incorporating modern technology into educational practices. In summary, A.N.E.V. CONSULTING Services Ltd and its affiliated entities are at the forefront of promoting innovation and excellence in STEAM education, with a particular emphasis on interdisciplinary learning and leveraging modern technologies. Through their diverse projects and collaborations, they are actively shaping the future of education in Cyprus and beyond.

description:
Tess Space is a deep-tech robotics company and spin-out from Space Robotics research, developing AI-based autonomy software for unmanned ground vehicles (UGVs) operating in complex outdoor environments.
The company’s core technology is an AI-driven Guidance, Navigation, and Control (GNC) system that enables autonomous navigation, sensor fusion, and mission execution in rugged and unstructured terrain.
Core application area:
Security and surveillance: Autonomous UGV navigation for patrolling, situational awareness, and monitoring of large outdoor areas such as critical infrastructure, borders, and industrial sites. Industrial inspection and resource operations: Autonomous ground robots for inspection, data collection, and monitoring in sectors such as energy, infrastructure, and mineral extraction in remote or hazardous environments and Arctic. Environmental and biodiversity monitoring: Autonomous robotic systems for long-term monitoring of ecosystems, forests, and wildlife, enabling large-scale data collection with minimal environmental disturbance.
Tess Space builds on more than 20 years of experience in robotics and artificial intelligence research, originating from Aalborg University’s Space Robotics activities, combining academic research with real-world robotic system development and deployment.

entityDescription:
Planetek Hellas, a member of the D-Orbit Group, is a leading Greek company active in Earth Observation, geospatial intelligence, and software development for both satellites in orbit and their ground systems.
Founded in Athens in 2006, the company combines deep expertise in satellite data exploitation, geoinformation systems, and participation in major ESA and European Commission programmes.
The company’s expertise covers a wide spectrum of activities, including:
- Ground Segment systems for mission control and satellite operations
- Mission planning, control, and AI-powered payload data ground systems
- In-orbit software and AI-based onboard processing (AI-eXpress)
- Spatial Data Infrastructures (SDI) and Copernicus-based applications
- Advanced Earth Observation services for environmental monitoring, civil protection, defence, and security

The company operates its own Satellite Command and Control Centre (C2) in Kifisia, Athens – a modern infrastructure serving as a national hub for satellite mission operations that supports both civilian and defence applications.
Through continuous innovation, research, and talent development, Planetek Hellas has become one of the most dynamic players in Greece’s and Europe’s space ecosystem, committed to turning satellite technology into operational value for society, government, and strategic autonomy. Planetek Hellas provides solution oriented services in the field of Geomatics, involving the use of EO data and systems for environmental & critical infrastructure monitoring, urban planning, civil protection and security.

description:
The mission of the Faculty of Agrobiotechnical Sciences Osijek is aimed at sustainable development obtained via high-quality and effective education based on the modern learning outcomes and the concept of lifelong learning, as well as on the training of highly qualified experts. Scientific activity is founded on the development and dissemination of basic, applied, and developmental research in order to obtain new knowledge and ideas through critical thinking and creativity. The Faculty enables the students to acquire competencies based on modern scientific knowledge by virtue of knowledge and technology transfer and by an active cooperation with the economic entities and community-based developmental partners. The Faculty promotes the development of the economy and of a wider social community by involving them in the European Research Area (ERA) and the European Area of ??Higher Education (EAHE). 
As one of the leading research and higher educational institutions in the field of biotechnical sciences in the region, the Faculty of Agrobiotechnical Sciences Osijek will develop a research and educational profile recognized on the international level. By 2025, the Faculty will become recognizable in the biotechnical and interdisciplinary scientific fields of research, in which it will achieve excellence on the international level, actively participate in the European Research Area (ERA), and profile itself as a biotechnical center of excellence for the transfer of knowledge and technologies to the economy.
entityDescription: Faculty of Agrobiotechnical Sciences Osijek is part of the Josip Juraj Strossmayer University of Osijek and is one of its oldest members. 18 October 2015 marked exactly 55 years of its foundation. Besides teaching students at undergraduate, graduate and postgraduate studies, the major activity of the Faculty is scientific research, primarily in the field of Agriculture and Biotechnology. Scientific and teaching faculty have the task of educating students, gradually introducing them into the world of basic knowledge about plants, animals and farming technologies so that they could independently manage processes of agricultural production, whose ultimate goal is production of food for human community. In this complex process of education, teachers use their own knowledge of scientific and professional work, and thereby enhance and modernize the education of students. Alongside with the education of students, research assistants together with professors and professional staff are engaged in research in the fields of biology, chemistry, nutrition and protection, genetics of plants and animals, engineering and economics in crop and livestock production, all with the aim of qualitatively and quantitatively improving food production and at the same time reducing production costs and conserving nature, environment and human health.

description:
EmTDLab is a deep-tech materials company using proprietary AI to develop next-generation radiation shielding for satellites, space assets, and critical infrastructure, creating advanced materials that enhance protection and performance: 
- We are powered by SYMADE.AI, an AI-driven systematic material discovery engine that serves both as our internal innovation core and as a service enabling partners to expand their materials knowledge and accelerate innovation.
- We design, synthesize, and manufacture novel materials that are lighter, more cost-effective, and highly efficient for radiation shielding applications.
- The European Space Agency has officially verified and validated our proprietary software and materials platform, confirming its technical maturity and unlocking commercial pathways and strategic growth opportunities.
entityDescription:
EMTDLAB stands for “Emerging Technologies Development Laboratory”
Core business of the company
Discover, develop and manufacture materials for high-performance space radiation shielding combined with high structural performance. Market the materials to aerospace companies, space agencies, space electronics manufacturers, aerospace engineers and system integrators. Create leadership in this niche market based on novel, proprietary Materials Informatics methods and high-throughput manufacturing.
EmTDLab technology value proposition is the use of Materials Informatics (M.I.) to perform systematic search for materials composition with optimal radiation shielding and mechanical properties. 

Target Market Segments
Early Stage: (1) Commercial-of-the-shelf electronics component manufacturers willing to access the New Space market using EmTDLab technology to smart shield component at chip- and board-level; (2) Substitute radiation-hardened, radiation tolerant and fault-tolerant / fault-detection systems with external radiation shields; (3) Contract Research Services for radiation simulation and spacecraft optimisation;
Later Stage: (1) Larger surfaces of new materials types will be manufactured for entire spacecraft’s: satellite walls, spaceship pressure hull, spaceship debris and radiation shield; (2) Aerospace engineering services outsourcing;

Application Range – Commercial Use Cases
Both structural materials for living organism’s on-board spacecraft / space vehicles & shielding materials for space electronics: satellites, robotic probes, launch vehicles, crew exploration vehicles, landers & ascent vehicles, rovers, mining robots, astronauts suits, planetary power systems; building materials for planter system.

Physical & Chemical Properties Optimisation
· Radiation Shielding
o High Energy Protons
o High Energy Electrons
o Galactic Cosmic Rays (Heavy Ions)
o Secondary neutrons
o Optional : Gamma Rays and EMI
· Thermal Management
o Heat Dissipation / Heat Sink
· ATOX – Atomic Oxygen Corrosion
 
Mechanical Properties Optimisation
· Specific Strength
· Specific Modulus
· Fracture Toughness
· Fatigue Crack
 
Application Range – Commercial Use Cases
Both structural materials for living organism’s on-board spacecraft / space vehicles & shielding materials for space electronics:
· Satellites
· Robotic probes
· Launch vehicles
· Crew Exploration Vehicles
· Landers & ascent vehicles: planetary & asteroids
· Planetary rovers: manned and automated
· EVA suits
· Photovoltaic panels (planetary power systems)

entityDescription:
Satellite communication has essentially contributed to today’s most advanced society through data transmission, mobile telephony and television. An alternative and addition to all terrestrial communication systems, therefore providing a lot of potential for future trends. For example, ideas such as Industry 4.0, the Internet of Things (IoT) or autonomous driving require powerful communication networks, which are capable of reaching every location worldwide.

To demonstrate and to bring these capabilities into focus, the German Center for Satellite-Communications r.S. (DeSK) was founded in 2008, unifying enterprises, scientific institutions and universities, operating in the field of satellite communication.

DeSK’s objective is to promote the expansion of business relations among the members to create a powerful network, capable of initiatingsynergies.

In addition, the institution organizes workshops to find qualified and trained professionals. The association also initiates a dialog with relevant stakeholders from political sectors and the industry with the goal to incorporate the versatile possibilities communication satellites provide, into political infrastructure plans and other economic sectors.

Further, DeSK operates an interactive showroom to demonstrate the relevance of satellite communication technology in our daily lives. With the slogan “Touch and Feel Satellite Communication" the showroom informs the general public as well as young talents about new trends and topics in this field.

entityDescription:
HUN-REN Centre for Energy Research (HUN-REN EK) is an organisational unit of a newly established Hungarian Research Network, operating as a distinct legal entity with its own legal personality. As of 28 October 2025, the budgetary-institution status of the HUN-REN Centre for Energy Research (EU VAT No.: HU15327040) ceased, and from 29 October 2025, the Centre continues to operate as an organisational unit of HUN-REN Hungarian Research Network. The newly established HUN-REN Centre for Energy Research (EU VAT No.: HU19426196 ) is the general legal successor of the former budgetary institution regarding rights and obligations.
HUN-REN EK comprises three research institutes: the Institute for Atomic Energy Research, the Institute for Energy Security and Environmental Safety, and the Institute for Technical Physics and Materials Science. The mission of the research centre is to perform research and development in the field of nuclear science and technology for facilitating the adoption and the safe use of nuclear technology in Hungary, to participate in international research efforts aiming at the establishing a new generation of nuclear power plants and closing the fuel cycle, to study the interaction of radiation (including neutrons, gamma-rays and electrons) with matter, and to do isotope and nuclear chemistry, chemical analysis by nuclear methods, radiography, radiation chemistry, radiation protection and nuclear security, surface chemistry and renewable energy research. In the field of technical physics and materials science, research efforts are concentrated in the following topics: the interdisciplinary research on complex functional materials and nanometer-scale structures, exploration of physical, chemical, and biological principles, their exploitation in integrated micro- and nanosystems, and in the development of characterization techniques. HUN-REN EK provides technical support for the Nuclear Power Plant Paks as well as the Hungarian authorities. The Institute operates the 10 MW Budapest Research Reactor (BRR), providing the scientific community of Europe (Budapest Neutron Centre) with research possibility for neutron physics and its applications, and supplying Hungary with radioactive isotopes, mainly used by medical applications. HUN-REN EK, as developer of several space radiation and space dosimetry systems, is one of the founding members of the Hungarian Aerospace Technology Platform (HATP).

description:
Vesper AS (Norway) – Patented Engineering Concepts for High-Speed & Space Systems 
Vesper AS is a technology transfer and IP venture company. We originate high-impact engineering concepts, protect them through patent filings, and commercialise via licensing, joint development programmes, and JV/SPV structures with capable industrial partners. 
Opportunity: FALAK – Adaptive Hypersonic Heat-Management System FALAK is a lightweight, adaptive thermal-management concept for vehicles exposed to extreme aerodynamic heating, including high-Mach atmospheric flight and re-entry. Traditional thermal protection is typically sized for worst-case peak heating, adding mass, cost, and refurbishment burden. FALAK is designed to manage heat flux in real time where and when it matters most—reducing reliance on conservative overdesign. 
What it addresses :
- Highly non-uniform, time-varying thermal loads 
- Migrating hotspots driven by trajectory, dynamic pressure and surface conditions 
- Thermal bottlenecks that constrain vehicle architecture and performance 
Target benefits:
- Reduced thermal protection and structural mass through lower peak design margins 
- Improved component lifetime and system reliability under transient heating 
- Better reusability potential and shorter refurbishment/turnaround cycles 
- Increased design flexibility for next-generation high-speed and re-entry platforms 
Status & IP:
- Early development stage (approx. TRL 2–3) 
- IP being protected through patent applications filed by Vesper AS 
- Technical specifics, integration interfaces and performance targets are shared under NDA 
Partner we want (co-financing & execution capability): 
We are seeking industrial partners and research organisations able and willing to co-finance and execute a staged validation pathway, such as: 
- Thermal analysis and modelling capability (CFD/FEA/heat transfer) 
- High-enthalpy / high-temperature test capability (e.g., wind tunnel, arc-jet or equivalent) 
- Materials, TPS, high-temperature structures and integration competence 
- Access to relevant programmes and funding channels for demonstrator work 
Collaboration formats: 
Funded feasibility studies, joint demonstrators, licensing, or structured joint ventures—depending on partner needs and programme constraints. 
If you work on reusable launch systems, re-entry vehicles, or high-speed flight demonstrators where thermal margins drive mass and cost, we welcome a confidential dialogue to assess fit and define a validation plan.
entityDescription:
Vesper is an early-stage startup focusing on thermal management for hypersonic vehicles. 
By developing concepts that reduce heat-loads at extreme velocities, we aim to enable safer, more efficient platforms for the space industry.

Falak is our first development project. 
Falak brings real-time, adaptive thermal control to hypersonic flight and re-entry—actively targeting localized hotspots as thermal profiles shift. 
By reducing peak heat loads where they matter most, Falak cuts thermal-protection mass to improve speed and reduce weight, while strengthening survivability under extreme aerodynamic loads. 
The result is a pathway to higher reusability of aerospace components and faster, more repeatable mission cycles.

description:
Gorilla IT develops high-quality applications with measurable impact. As a high-tech innovation company, operating at the intersection of model-driven development and semantic interoperability, we provide organizations with an integrated approach to managing the complexity of modern digital ecosystems and effectively using their information assets.
Gorilla IT is a European leader in Model-Driven Development (MDD), with expertise in transforming conceptual models into secure, compliant, maintainable, and future-proof IT solutions. Our methodology is grounded in Fact-Based Modelling, and we have decades of experience converting conceptual models into operational software artifacts, including databases, web services, and full-stack applications.
We maintain a strong global network within the Fact-Based Modelling community, working closely with tool vendors and academic institutions. Gorilla IT has actively contributed to the European Space Agency’s (ESA) vision of semantic interoperability. Based on our expertise in the ORM language and tools such as NORMA Pro, ESA selected us to develop the first version of the Space System Ontology (SSO), in collaboration with Airbus Space & Defence, OHB Systems, Thales Alenia Space, and ArianeGroup. Our contributions continue through multiple initiatives. We have supported the formalization of the ORM metamodel (FAMOUS-2) and assisted ESA in transforming academic research on ORM into practical, globally accepted formats, including hierarchical structures, class diagrams, and other conceptual representations. We also worked with large system integrators to extend the SSO to additional domains. 
Currently, Gorilla IT is extending its expertise to the field of artificial intelligence by linking semantic models with AI and reasoning capabilities. Our track record includes the delivery of high-quality solutions for organizations in sectors such as finance (e.g., ABN Amro, Achmea, Centraal Beheer) and energy (e.g., Shell). These projects illustrate our capacity to deliver solutions that remain relevant and effective over time.

entityDescription:
The Desertification Research Centre (CIDE) is a public scientific research centre. Due to our nature as a mixed centre, three institutions are involved in our management: Spanish Research Council (CSIC), theUniversity of Valenciaand theAutonomous Government of Valenciathrough theConselleria de Agricultura, Desarrollo Rural, Emergencia Climática y Transición Ecológicaand theConselleria de Innovación, Universidades, Ciencia y Sociedad Digital.
At CIDE we work, since its origin, to provide knowledge based on scientific evidence, and to communicate to society the importance of environmental issues, and in particular, about the risk and potential impact of desertification and climate change on ecosystems and human beings, and thus contribute to the protection of our environment. In this sense, we are one of the pioneer centers in Europe in the study of desertification and one of the few institutes devoted to this topic, with a solid base and extensive experience in the study of soil, water and ecosystem degradation processes, mainly in the Mediterranean. In constant evolution, our strategic objectives, included in our Action Plans, are aligned with the Sustainable Development Goals (SDGs).
To carry out our work, we have a multidisciplinary team with 17 researchers on staff whose lines of work are framed in the Departments of Environmental Quality and Soils, and Ecology and Global Change; and we have a total of 88 workers including administrative and service staff, technicians and researchers and pre and postdoctoral researchers.
From a more applied point of view, many of the studies we carry out have implications for the management of nutrients and water in agricultural systems, and in a more general framework for land management, biodiversity conservation and ecological restoration.
CIDE has participated and participates in multiple research and environmental advisory committees at regional, national and international levels. The Centre participated in the elaboration, development and monitoring of the United Nations Convention to Combat Desertification, including Annex IV of the Regional Implementation for the Mediterranean; and in regional and national desertification control plans, such as the National Action Program to Combat Desertification (PAND). It also participates in European Union committees and initiatives, including the elaboration of the European Strategy for Soil Protection. It also advises the Valencian Parliament, Generalitat Valenciana (Advisory and Participation Council for the Environment (CAPMA), Forestry Board, Threatened Flora Committee, etc.), European Parliament, OECD, the Joint Research Centre (JRC), UICN, etc.
This centre also contributes to academic and professional training through its participation in different masters and doctorate programs of different universities (Univ. Valencia, Univ. Politécnica de Valencia, Univ. de Alcalá de Henares, etc.), as well as collaborating in the training of university personnel through the supervised internship programs of the different universities.

Company description: The Desertification Research Centre (CIDE) is a public scientific research centre. Due to our nature as a mixed centre, three institutions are involved in our management: Spanish Research Council (CSIC), theUniversity of Valenciaand theAutonomous Government of Valenciathrough theConselleria de Agricultura, Desarrollo Rural, Emergencia Climática y Transición Ecológicaand theConselleria de Innovación, Universidades, Ciencia y Sociedad Digital.
At CIDE we work, since its origin, to provide knowledge based on scientific evidence, and to communicate to society the importance of environmental issues, and in particular, about the risk and potential impact of desertification and climate change on ecosystems and human beings, and thus contribute to the protection of our environment. In this sense, we are one of the pioneer centers in Europe in the study of desertification and one of the few institutes devoted to this topic, with a solid base and extensive experience in the study of soil, water and ecosystem degradation processes, mainly in the Mediterranean. In constant evolution, our strategic objectives, included in our Action Plans, are aligned with the Sustainable Development Goals (SDGs).
To carry out our work, we have a multidisciplinary team with 17 researchers on staff whose lines of work are framed in the Departments of Environmental Quality and Soils, and Ecology and Global Change; and we have a total of 88 workers including administrative and service staff, technicians and researchers and pre and postdoctoral researchers.
From a more applied point of view, many of the studies we carry out have implications for the management of nutrients and water in agricultural systems, and in a more general framework for land management, biodiversity conservation and ecological restoration.
CIDE has participated and participates in multiple research and environmental advisory committees at regional, national and international levels. The Centre participated in the elaboration, development and monitoring of the United Nations Convention to Combat Desertification, including Annex IV of the Regional Implementation for the Mediterranean; and in regional and national desertification control plans, such as the National Action Program to Combat Desertification (PAND). It also participates in European Union committees and initiatives, including the elaboration of the European Strategy for Soil Protection. It also advises the Valencian Parliament, Generalitat Valenciana (Advisory and Participation Council for the Environment (CAPMA), Forestry Board, Threatened Flora Committee, etc.), European Parliament, OECD, the Joint Research Centre (JRC), UICN, etc.
This centre also contributes to academic and professional training through its participation in different masters and doctorate programs of different universities (Univ. Valencia, Univ. Politécnica de Valencia, Univ. de Alcalá de Henares, etc.), as well as collaborating in the training of university personnel through the supervised internship programs of the different universities.

entityDescription:
Datafuchs Oy is a Finnish AI company building geospatial intelligence software for organisations that depend on spatial data to make decisions. 
 
The company's flagship platform, Geofuchs, replaces manual GIS analysis workflows with AI agents that understand natural language. Where a GIS analyst might spend days processing satellite imagery, correlating layers, and producing a report, Geofuchs completes the same analysis in minutes — querying hundreds of authoritative data sources, reasoning over spatial relationships, and returning interactive map visualisations directly from plain-language requests.
 
The platform is built for the European public sector and regulated industries: municipalities, national mapping agencies, infrastructure operators, and forestry and agriculture enterprises. These are environments where data sovereignty, auditability, and integration with official EU/national data standards are non-negotiable. Geofuchs is designed from the ground up for that context — natively compliant with EU INSPIRE mandates and sourcing data from authoritative national providers.

Datafuchs was founded by a team combining enterprise software delivery experience across Fortune 500 clients with deep Nordic market knowledge. The company is headquartered in Finland.

entityDescription:
- INSTITUT MAUPERTUIS - 
Institut Maupertuis is a research and technology transfer organization based in France. It focuses on advanced manufacturing technologies, working closely with industry partners to develop and implement innovative solutions. Here are some key points about the institute.
Overview
Location: Based in Rennes, Brittany, France.
Founded: Established in 2003.
Mission: To facilitate the transfer of innovative technologies from research to industry, focusing on enhancing manufacturing processes.
Core Activities
Research and Development: The institute conducts applied research in collaboration with universities, research centers, and industrial partners.Technology 
Transfer: It helps industries adopt cutting-edge technologies, improving efficiency and productivity.
Training and Education: The institute provides training programs and workshops to equip professionals with the latest technological skills.
Areas of Expertise
Additive Manufacturing: Working on 3D printing technologies and materials to create complex and high-performance parts, as: 
 - Wire Arc Additive Manufacturing (WAAM), controlled atmosphere;
 - Wire Laser Additive Manufacturing (WLAM), controlled atmosphere;
Materials: Titanium (TA6V, Ti40), Inconel (718 & 625), Stainless steel, Steel, Aluminium, Copper, Bronze and all wire from D0.5mm to D3.2mm.
Laser welding: Laser welding, Arc Welding, Hybrid welding (Laser + Arc).
Friction Stir Welding: Assembly without melting pool (All aluminium series, Copper, Bronze).
Metrology and Quality Control: Implementing advanced techniques for precise measurement and quality assurance in manufacturing processes.
Digital Manufacturing: Leveraging digital technologies, including simulation and digital twins, to optimize manufacturing operations. 
Software: Path planning software, monitoring software. 
Robotics: Developing and integrating robotic systems for various industrial applications.
Collaborations
Institut Maupertuis collaborates with numerous academic and industrial partners, including:
Universities: Engaging in joint research projects with academic institutions.
Industries: Partnering with companies from various sectors, such as aerospace, automotive, and healthcare, to address specific technological challenges.
Impact
The institute plays a crucial role in advancing manufacturing technologies in France and Europe, contributing to the competitiveness of the industrial sector. It is recognized for its expertise in bridging the gap between research and practical industrial applications.

The company is based in Trondheim (Norway) and is specialized in submersible buoys that are autonomous and can operate both subsea and on the ocean surface.

entityDescription:
The NTT Group, operating globally under the unified brand NTT, Inc. since July 1, 2025, is one of the world’s leading technology and telecommunications groups. In 2025, NTT implemented a global corporate identity renewal to consolidate its diverse technology, telecommunications and infrastructure businesses under one unified global brand. The Group maintains extensive global operations across telecommunications, digital infrastructure, cloud platforms, cybersecurity and advanced technology research.

NTT DATA serves as the global technology, digital infrastructure and innovation powerhouse of the NTT Group. It is the only company worldwide that owns and operates the full digital value chain from subsea cables to satellites. This includes more than 150,000 kilometers of subsea fiber cables supported by its own marine vessels, a global data center platform with more than 155 data centers in over 20 countries and more than six million square feet of capacity, one of the world’s largest IP backbones, the fourth largest private 5G provider, and satellite-based IoT infrastructure. NTT DATA’s infrastructure is designed to support global digitalization at scale.

The company manages 300 billion USD in assets with zero debt, employs more than 190,000 people in over 70 countries and invests 3.6 billion USD annually in research and development. It has more than 17,000 data and AI practitioners and over 100,000 employees certified in generative AI. NTT DATA is ranked number two globally in application and infrastructure services by Gartner, recognized as an emerging leader in generative AI consulting and implementation and ranked number three globally in managed services by IDC. Its global partnerships include NVIDIA, Cisco, HPE and Dell.

NTT Germany AG & Co. KG is one of the German entities within the NTT ecosystem and an integral part of NTT DATA’s European presence. The company is headquartered in Bad Homburg and delivers advanced IT and digital transformation services to private and public-sector clients in Germany. Its services include enterprise connectivity solutions such as internet, fiber and wireless networking, cloud and data center services, managed IT and cybersecurity operations, data and AI-driven digital transformation and consulting and integration services for numerous technology solutions and vendors.

NTT Germany employs approximately 1,100 professionals and is fully integrated into NTT DATA’s global workforce of more than 190,000 employees. By leveraging NTT DATA’s global infrastructure, research capabilities and technical expertise, NTT Germany provides secure, scalable and future-ready technology solutions across Germany’s enterprise and public‑sector landscape.

entityDescription:
SUEZ Air & Climate team is compound by more than 100 professionals around the world who have collaborated for more than 30 years with customers and public organizations, helping to improve air quality and providing innovative solutions against climate change.

Our monitoring systems are adaptable and can be tailored to your needs. We can provide real-time monitoring and predictive models, combining emissions, orography, air quality and meteorological modelling to develop studies of dispersion and air quality plans and strategies. We also work to optimize traffic flows to reduce emissions in cities, helping smart city governments to predict areas of poor air quality and reduce air pollution.
A comprehensive assessment allows us to identify the most relevant sources and to design a bespoke action plan to minimize the impact. A comprehensive approach by using different strategies is typically needed for an accurate diagnosis of the problem: Olfatometric studies (based on UNE-EN-13725 and UNE-EN-16841 standards), VOCs (Volatile Organic Compounds) monitoring by means of active and passive sampling, on-line monitoring with nano sensors, greenhouse gases studies, as well as fugitive emissions detection through infrared detectors among others

entityName: AGRI SOLUTIONS SPÓŁKA Z OGRANICZONĄ ODPOWIEDZIALNOŚCIĄ
entityDescription:
Agri Solutions is a European AgriTech company specializing in advanced R&D and commercialization of digital agriculture technologies that integrate farms, agribusiness, and the agri-food supply chain into a unified data ecosystem. The company develops proprietary platforms including FarmCloud (Agri IoT middleware and data integration layer), FarmPortal (FMS with precision agriculture, ISO-XML, VRA and machine integration), and FoodPass (traceability and ESG/MRV reporting), designed to support Agriculture 4.0 and 5.0 transformation across primary production and processing.
Agri Solutions has extensive experience in research and innovation projects focused on AI, Earth Observation, IoT sensing, and predictive analytics for agriculture. Current R&D activities include satellite-based in-season profitability forecasting (ProfitCast), computer vision models for livestock assessment, digital twins of farms, and AI-driven decision support for crop production, risk monitoring, and resource optimization. The company integrates heterogeneous data sources such as Sentinel satellite imagery, IoT sensors, machinery telemetry (ISOBUS/CAN), weather data, and ERP systems (e.g., SAP, MS Dynamics) into scalable cloud architectures (SaaS, on-premise, and white-label deployments).
The platforms developed by Agri Solutions are already used within a growing international ecosystem of farms, food processors, input suppliers, and technology providers across Europe, supporting thousands of agricultural operations and multiple agri-food stakeholders. The solutions enable end-to-end traceability, compliance with EU regulations (e.g., EUDR, CSRD, ESG reporting), and data-driven farm management with real-time monitoring and advanced analytics.
Agri Solutions collaborates with research institutions, technology partners, and industry stakeholders on applied R&D, pilot deployments, and technology validation in real production environments. The company’s core competencies include AI for agriculture, Earth Observation analytics, Agri IoT integration, supply-chain digitalization, and scalable digital infrastructure for sustainable and resilient agri-food systems aligned with EU Green Deal and space-enabled innovation objectives.

entityDescription:
CMB Cleanroom è una società di ingegneria italiana specializzata nella progettazione, costruzione e fornitura chiavi in ​​mano di camere bianche e ambienti controllati per applicazioni ad alta affidabilità nei settori spaziale, aerospaziale, microelettronica e tecnologie avanzate. Con una vasta esperienza nel controllo della contaminazione, CMB supporta aziende leader, PMI e centri di ricerca nello sviluppo di strutture per l'assemblaggio, l'integrazione e il collaudo di satelliti (AIT), sistemi avionici, optoelettronici ed elettronica avanzata, garantendo la piena conformità alla norma ISO 14644 e ai requisiti aerospaziali specifici della missione.
CMB fornisce un portafoglio integrato di servizi, tra cui studi di fattibilità, progettazione concettuale, ingegneria di dettaglio, costruzione di involucri per camere bianche, sistemi HVAC e di filtrazione, monitoraggio ambientale, messa in servizio, qualificazione e riqualificazione periodica.
L'azienda fornisce soluzioni modulari e completamente personalizzate, dalle aree compatte ISO 8 alle grandi camere bianche ISO 5-7 per l'integrazione di carichi utili, gruppi ottici ed elettronica di precisione. I sistemi sono progettati per il controllo della contaminazione particellare e molecolare, la stabilità termoigrometrica e la protezione ESD, garantendo condizioni di processo robuste e ripetibili.
Settore Spaziale 
Per l'industria spaziale, CMB progetta e costruisce camere bianche dedicate all'integrazione di sottosistemi satellitari, alla preparazione del carico utile e al supporto per i test ambientali. Le strutture includono aree di vestizione e logistica, stoccaggio pulito, officine in ambiente controllato e baie di integrazione interfacciate con strutture per test di vibrazione, vuoto termico ed EMC, consentendo flussi di lavoro AIT senza interruzioni.
Elettronica e microelettronica 
Per l'elettronica e la microelettronica, CMB sviluppa ambienti controllati per l'assemblaggio di PCB, circuiti ibridi, sensori ed elettronica di potenza, combinando elevata pulizia con funzionamento efficiente dal punto di vista energetico e prestazioni ambientali stabili.
Un partner ingegneristico a lungo termine: 
CMB opera come partner a lungo termine, supportando i clienti dalla progettazione iniziale fino alla manutenzione del ciclo di vita, agli aggiornamenti e all'allineamento normativo. Sfruttando competenze ingegneristiche, esperienza in loco e una rete di fornitori qualificati, CMB offre soluzioni per camere bianche affidabili, conformi e convenienti, su misura per le esigenze dell'ecosistema spaziale e high-tech europeo.

entityDescription:
Part of theBMT Group, BMT Aerospace is a designer and manufacturer of gears and mechanical components for the aerospace industry. We employ a total of 560 workers and have a consolidated annual turnover of 100 million dollars. 
BMT Aerospace is active in five key market segments: high lift actuation gears, turbine engine gearboxes, shafts & couplings, high-precision detail gears, and bevel, helical and ring gears.
Our high lift actuation gear products, such as sector gears and pinions are produced to meet customer specifications and stringent quality standards, always pursuing the aerospace industry’s target of weight reduction. Our state-of-the-art equipment and specialist in-house knowledge spans accurate design, high-strength steels, super-efficient heat treatments, surface treatments and surface enhancement
We also produce turbine engine gearboxes, shafts & couplings, high-precision detail gears, and bevel, helical and ring gears are manufactured at our facilities in the United States and Romania.
BMT Aerospace is active in almost every major aerospace platform, including Airbus’s A320, A330, A350 and A380, Boeing’s 787, Bombardier’s C- series and CRJ, Embraer’s ERJ 170/190, Irkut’s MC-21 and the Sukhoi Superjet. description:
Adaptronics is a deep-tech italian startup founded in 2022 as a spin-off of the university, designing, manufacturing and commercializing electro-adhesive robotic gripping devices based on advanced thin-film technology produced via flexible printed electronics. 
The company develops conformable electro-adhesive grippers with embedded sensing and control capabilities (including proximity detection, contact monitoring and force exchange analysis) to enable versatile manipulation of objects. 
Adaptronics operates in two main markets: 
- Industrial automation: providing electro-adhesive gripping solutions for handling delicate or hard-to-grip items, with deployments in sectors such as packaging, e-commerce and labeling. 
- Space robotics: developing a space-qualified version of its electro-adhesive technology (SpaEAAL) to support in-orbit servicing, in-orbit manufacturing and active debris removal, including planned on-orbit demonstration activities. 
The company is headquartered in Italy, with operations in Bologna and Turin, and has been incubated within ESA BIC Turin, supported by ESA Spark.

entityDescription:
World from Space is a company focusing on the creation of downstream applications based on Earth Observation (EO) and other data, especially from the Copernicus program. WFS has experience with EO data processing (multispectral, SAR), spatial and temporal data analysis, visualizations, machine learning, and integrations into software platforms or GIS.
WFS performs analysis in the areas of agriculture, cities, air quality, and the environment. The main product - DynaCrop API provides powerful crop monitoring for agricultural software platforms anywhere in the world.
In the urban domain, WFS focuses on measuring specific key performance indicators (KPIs) for climate change adaptation, drought, and vegetation monitoring. It provides urban adaptation consulting, including initial analysis, action plans, and monitoring results.
WFS participates in ESA contracts, H2020 research projects, and consultations on the use of Copernicus data and services.
World from Space is incubated in ESA BIC Brno and is the winner of the Copernicus Masters 2018 competition. We will be happy to discuss possible cooperation on commercial contracts, research projects, and non-profit activities.
Competencies & Capabilities:
Automated cloud-based EO data analysis (AWS, SentinelHub, CreoDIAS, etc.)

Global field-level crop monitoring based on Sentinel 1 and Sentinel 2 fusion

Machine learning with EO data (eo-learn, pytorch, etc. )

Soil moisture and drought assessment based on Sentinel 1, Sentinel 2, and SMOS

Copernicus data analysis and consulting (CDS, ADS, EFFIS, GDO, CLMS, CEMS etc.)

Urban EO monitoring - vegetation, temperature, air quality, sustainability indicators

Interactive web-based map applications, dashboards, and stories

Python, JS, QGIS, SNAP,
