Hispansion is a startup dedicated to advancing space exploration by developing a range of lunar regolith simulants and related services. 
Our mission is to provide the space sector with high-quality, reliable, and cost-effective solutions for research, technology development, and testing under lunar-like conditions. Our activities focus on the design, production, and supply of lunar simulants tailored to specific mission needs, ensuring accurate representation of key lunar regions such as mare and highlands. We collaborate with leading research institutions and industry partners to continuously improve our products and develop innovative solutions that support in-situ resource utilization (ISRU) and lunar infrastructure projects. 
In addition to simulant production, Hispansion will soon offer testing services that allow companies and institutions to validate their technologies in controlled lunar-like environments.

entityDescription:
Surrey AI Imaging Limited (SAIIL) is a pioneering technology start-up nestled in the heart of Surrey, UK. SAIIL’s core specialisation lies in the realm of image processing, AI and software engineering, with a pronounced focus on planetary remote sensing and Earth observation. The technical team at SAIIL, led by Dr. Yu Tao as the Technical Director, is a melting pot of talent, innovation, and experience. With a rich tapestry of knowledge in computer vision, remote sensing, geospatial data analytics, VR, GIS, machine learning, and deep learning, SAIIL’s team is adept at devising and implementing image processing algorithms, deep learning models, and their applications to address intricate challenges in planetary and Earth remote sensing. SAIIL’s suite of expertise includes:
· Satellite Imaging: From super-resolution restoration of various resolutions and bands to shadow detection and re-shading using deep learning.
· 3D Reconstruction: Leveraging techniques like photogrammetry, photoclinometry, and structure from motion for topographic mapping and subpixel-scale 3D reconstructions.
· Image Analysis: This encompasses satellite image matching, multi-resolution image co-registration, optical flow-based tracking, and object detection on both Earth and planetary surfaces.

entityDescription:
UJP PRAHA a.s. historically continues the activities of the former Institute of Nuclear Fuels, gradually incorporating activities from many other fields into its portfolio. Among the most important are our extensive and long-standing experience in processing uranium and other materials for shielding protection, the production of transport and storage containers for sources of ionizing radiation, and a broad portfolio of products and services.
The engineering production at the company is based on the results of its own research and development across many sectors, such as aviation, the energy industry, the chemical industry, petrochemicals, and mechanical engineering. The advanced technology for processing metallic uranium through melting, alloying, machining, surface protection of uranium, uranium parts, and products made from metallic depleted uranium has been and continues to be further developed here. UJP PRAHA a.s., as the only facility in the Czech Republic, offers a wide range of transport and storage containers for radioactive sources utilizing the shielding properties of metallic uranium, lead, and tungsten, as well as shielding parts made of metallic uranium, small uranium products, and uranium compounds for both domestic and international markets.
In the field of medical devices, UJP PRAHA a.s. specializes in products utilizing ionizing radiation. The main products are radiotherapy cobalt unit and related devices and software for radiotherapy.

AVICON Advanced Vision Control is a Warsaw-based company in Poland, specializing in the design and implementation of advanced vision systems for industry, science, and dual-use technologies. As an SME with over 15 years of market presence, AVICON not only integrates solutions from leading global manufacturers but also conducts intensive R&D, developing proprietary technologies for 2D and 3D image acquisition and processing, including systems based on ToF and triangulation cameras, as well as computation acceleration using FPGA and GPGPU technologies.
The company is distinguished by its expertise in hyperspectral image analysis, leveraging proprietary machine learning algorithms for material classification and defect detection, with applications in both industrial and security sectors. AVICON’s dual-use technologies also encompass the development of calibration algorithms, point cloud analysis, and advanced methods for image data processing, enabling the creation of precise and high-speed inspection and monitoring systems. Moreover, AVICON is an active member of CapTech Optronics, contributing its knowledge and innovations to the European defence and security research community.

entityDescription:
Van Halteren Technologies Boxtel B.V. is a high-tech engineering and manufacturing company based in Boxtel, the Netherlands. It is part of the broader Van Halteren Technologies group, a Dutch family-owned enterprise known for delivering advanced technological solutions across defense, energy, maritime, simulation, and increasingly, the space industry.
The Boxtel branch specializes in the design, development, and production of fluid power systems, motion control technologies, and precision mechanical components like large hydraulic cylinders and electromechanical actuators. These capabilities are critical for a wide range of applications, including military land systems, training simulators, and environmental control systems.
In recent years, Van Halteren Technologies Boxtel has expanded its portfolio to serve space-related customers, providing high-reliability components and subsystems that meet the stringent demands of the aerospace sector. These include custom hydraulic and electromechanical systems, and precision actuators used in launch infrastructure. The company’s expertise in motion simulation and control also supports testing and validation platforms for eg. space applications.
With a strong foundation in engineering excellence, the Boxtel facility is equipped with modern manufacturing and testing infrastructure, enabling it to deliver turnkey solutions and custom-built systems for both commercial and governmental space programs. The company works closely with OEMs and space agencies to ensure compliance with international standards and mission-critical performance requirements.
Van Halteren Technologies Boxtel B.V. is committed to innovation, quality, and sustainability, continuously investing in R&D and workforce development. Its multidisciplinary teams collaborate across the Van Halteren group to deliver integrated solutions that push the boundaries of technology—on land, at sea, and now, in space.

efendable employs a team of approximately 90 specialists in cybersecurity, with members drawn from backgrounds in major Norwegian private companies, consulting firms, and national intelligence and security services. entityDescription:
The Prague Innovation Institute (Pii) is an organization dedicated to fostering innovation in various sectors, including business, education, and city development, and is powered by the City of Prague. Established in January 2020, Pii operates as a public benefit organization focusing on supporting the development of education, the city's infrastructure, and the environment.
Key aspects of Pii's mission include:
- Support for Entrepreneurs and Startups: Pii offers crucial support to early-stage entrepreneurs and startups, helping them turn their innovative ideas into successful ventures. This includes providing guidance, tailored solutions, and a network of opportunities.

- Educational Advancement: Unique in Czechia, Pii is the only innovation center focused on advancing education. It collaborates with schools at all levels of the education system, striving to improve education for all and address individual children's needs.

- City Development Initiatives: Pii aims to improve Prague's environment through the promotion of modern technologies in energy, sustainable development, and waste management, including the use of renewable energy sources.

- Collaboration with Academia and Business: Pii works closely with academic institutions like the Czech Technical University in Prague (CTU), focusing on applied research and the promotion of new scientific knowledge. This collaboration extends to supporting platforms that aid in the creation and development of spin-off and startup companies.

- Innovation Strategy: Pii aligns its goals with the Innovation Strategy set by the Czech Republic until 2030 and other strategic initiatives like the Smart Prague Concept. It works on connecting various innovation actors, including researchers, entrepreneurs, and the public sector.

- Funding and Management: Initially funded by the Prague City Hall, Pii operates independently without additional funding for its operations from the city. It is involved in specific projects, such as the Business Innovation Center, and since July 2020, it has been managed by Bohumil Kartous, an expert in education development.

entityDescription:
Waldfreunde gGmbH – Entity Description
Waldfreunde gGmbH is a non-profit organization based in Dreieich, Germany, focused on reforestation and the protection of native forests. The organization unites communities, companies, and individuals in hands-on environmental efforts by planting trees and fostering a deeper connection with nature.
Mission
The mission of Waldfreunde is to bring people together to plant trees and to create more than just carbon offsetting. Their goal is to enable shared, meaningful experiences that promote environmental awareness and inspire action.
Core Purpose
Waldfreunde aims to combat climate change through regional reforestation, strengthen biodiversity, promote sustainability, and build emotional connections to nature. The organization emphasizes personal responsibility, education, and corporate engagement.
Team and Structure
The organization is led by co-CEOs Jürgen Graf (CEO & Sales) and Jennifer Graf (CEO & Marketing). They are supported by a focused team including Sandra Luschtinetz (Operations & Security), Anton Strecker (Operations & Events), Michael Köpﬂer (Project Manager) and Christine Rumpf (Finance & Budget). The team combines operational expertise with a shared commitment to environmental action.
Key Offerings
Waldfreunde offers corporate tree-planting events as teambuilding activities, community planting days, environmental education programs, and strategic partnerships for companies seeking to improve their sustainability performance. 
Now we are planning a new product, a digital platform aimed at revolutionizing reforestation. Their goal is to connect technology and nature to make reforestation more efficient, data-driven, and better controllable. Summary of the planned product:• A central interface for forest owners, municipalities, companies, and employees• AI-supported area analysis and real-time forecasts for better planting planning• Integration of various data sources (e.g., satellite data such as Sentinel, SMOS, FLEX, etc.)• Reforestation with people, drones, and robots – hybrid, scalable, future-orientedWith this, Waldfreunde aims to create a connecting system that offers transparency, overview, and effective management for reforestation projects – especially in times of climate crisis, extreme weather, and forest loss. A scalable technology product for digital, networked reforestation that combines ecological impact with modern infrastructure.
Partners and Supporters
The organization collaborates with local authorities, foundations, schools, and companies. They actively involve volunteers and foster long-term relationships to scale environmental impact.

entityDescription: Openscapes is intentional social infrastructure in the open source science ecosystem. We have developed a mechanism that identifies needs and rapidly brings people together to address them, building momentum like a flywheel. This approach is working at many different scales, including within government, across governments, within academic groups, and as individuals not identifying as part of a team. Openscapes offers training, community building, and mentorship programs that build open source technical and collaborative leadership skills within and across teams and organizations. All our lessons, curriculum, writing (blog posts, peer reviewed publications, slides, etc) are all open source and shared publicly online – using the same tools we teach for data analysis and reproducible reports (examples: GitHub, Quarto/RMarkdown, R, Python, Jupyter, Google Drive). We believe role-modeling open practices is critical to helping teams shift towards open science. (Lowndes et al, 2027, Nature Ecology & Evolution, https://doi.org/10.1038/s41559-017-0160; Lowndes et al. 2024, Ecology and Evolution, https://doi.org/10.1002/ece3.11341)

description:
LEON Systems is a post-proof-of-concept modular spacecraft infrastructure built from the ground up by a self-taught UK innovator using nothing but a smartphone and sheer will. Designed for deep space missions, LEON merges nuclear thermal propulsion, plasma systems, and cryogenic-integrated thermal architecture with a smart AI control stack to deliver an adaptable spacecraft backbone — capable of autonomous mission management, modular expansion, and real-time failure recovery. Unlike traditional systems, LEON isn’t a siloed vehicle — it’s a scalable space infrastructure platform built to evolve with advancing propulsion tech, AI, and mission design. From Mars freight drops to lunar satellite relays, LEON’s architecture supports multiple roles with low-cost reconfiguration and AI-managed operations. Best of all, its the ECOboost of the rocket world with a mars transit turn aroud calculated to just 4 months. thats 1 mission, from earth, to mars and back again!
About the Founder — Jay Pratt I’m Jay Pratt, an independent builder from the UK. I left school at 15. No formal training, no backing, no credentials. Told I’d never amount to anything. So I built LEON. Not to prove them wrong — but to prove the future right. With no labs or funding, I mapped, designed, documented, and simulated a full spacecraft architecture using only a mobile phone. Now I’m connecting with ESA, NFX, STFC, and accelerators — not to pitch a fantasy, but to bring a real, technical, ground-tested space system to life. 
Tech Highlights Hybrid Propulsion Stack:
Nuclear Thermal + Plasma + Cryo-fed logic Modular Architecture: Built for quick upgrades, part replacement, and mission pivots AI Stack: Handles autonomous mission control, fault recovery, and optimization Thermal Control: Smart cryogenic flow systems integrated with propulsion logic Self-diagnostic & Sim-tested: Documented recovery logic for major system failures

entityDescription:

Through innovative data management and AI analysis, data generated along the AM process chain is automatically processed and stored in the digital twin. Digital Twin: First comprehensive digital component twin that captures all relevant quality data along the AM process chain, enabled by innovative data wrangling module.

entityDescription:
ASPACE COMPANY SRL develops high-value software that integrates advanced proprietary ensemble machine learning models with remote sensing (multispectral and hyperspectral) data from Earth observation satellites, such as Sentinel, to develop an innovative software product that provides predictive soil information. By combining soil sample data with multispectral satellite imagery, the resulting high-value technology generates precise, high-resolution soil profiles to optimise agricultural decisions like soil fertility, nutrient management, and fertiliser requirements.
Multispectral and hyperspectral satellite image captures critical data across multiple electromagnetic wavelengths, enabling a detailed analysis of soil properties. The proprietary ensemble machine learning framework, a cornerstone of this innovative technology, combines algorithms in a generalised model to ensure superior accuracy and scalability.
This high-value innovation addresses traditional challenges in soil analysis by introducing a scalable and quantitative approach using Earth observation data. It not only enhances fertiliser recommendations but also mitigates global supply issues affected by geopolitical tensions, offering a high-value solution for precision agriculture.
With this innovative product, farmers no longer need hardware or physical soil sampling. Using only GPS coordinates, the system delivers fast, affordable, and accurate soil analysis, paired with tailored fertiliser recommendations and digital management tools. By leveraging artificial intelligence and satellite data, this high-value innovation operates on a continental or global scale, empowering agricultural productivity through cutting-edge solutions.

entityDescription:
Foundation Space Resources (FSR) is a for-profit company specializing in advanced modelling and simulation technologies for the space industry. Established on October 14, 2020, in Alberta, Canada, FSR has rapidly positioned itself as a leader in Lunar mission planning, environmental simulation, and system modelling, catering to space agencies, research institutions, and private aerospace firms.
With a lean but highly specialized team, FSR has successfully developed innovative Digital Twin technology to address critical gaps in Lunar exploration. The company has actively engaged in industry partnerships and secured interest from key stakeholders and customers such as Canadensys, Starpath Robotics (Starpath), Space Copy, Orbit Share, and the North American Space Institute (NASI).

FSR's Lunar Digital Twin is the only commercially available tool which can provide high temporal and spatial fidelity illumination maps of the entire Lunar surface, including the 3-dimensional structure of shadows above the surface. Customers are currently using it to quantify (and thereby optimize) hardware design constraints and develop flexible mission plans. Currently TRL 4, it simulates the components of and the interactions between the different aspects of the cislunar (i.e. between the Earth and the Moon) environment. FSR's near-term goal is to develop our Lunar Digital Twin into a flexible tool for Lunar hardware design constraint and mission planning optimization. Our long-term vision is to develop our Digital Twin into a comprehensive dynamic simulation of the Lunar environment, capable of supporting automated virtual testing, economic assessments, demand analysis for Lunar services, and mission planning as well as be deployed on Lunar assets to aid in navigation. FSR is enhancing this tool with recent advances in AI, including explainability and evolutionary algorithms to optimize hardware design, mission planning, and decision-making processes.

FSR aims to meet the growing demand for high-fidelity Lunar modelling and simulation capabilities arising from the developing awareness of the commercial Lunar industry that current design and testing methodologies do not sufficiently de-risk hardware designs and mission plans to meet desired mission timelines and profitability. High-fidelity Lunar modelling and simulation capabilities are not only critical for mission planning and system design but are also vital for the verification, validation, and stress testing of space systems.

Customers are currently using it to quantify (and thereby optimize) hardware design constraints and develop flexible mission plans. Currently TRL 4, it simulates the components of and the interactions between the different aspects of the cislunar (i.e. between the Earth and the Moon) environment. FSR's near-term goal is to develop our Lunar Digital Twin into a flexible tool for Lunar hardware design constraint and mission planning optimization. Our long-term vision is to develop our Digital Twin into a comprehensive dynamic simulation of the Lunar environment, capable of supporting automated virtual testing, economic assessments, demand analysis for Lunar services, and mission planning as well as be deployed on Lunar assets to aid in navigation. FSR is enhancing this tool with recent advances in AI, including explainability and evolutionary algorithms to optimize hardware design, mission planning, and decision-making processes.

FSR aims to meet the growing demand for high-fidelity Lunar modelling and simulation capabilities arising from the developing awareness of the commercial Lunar industry that current design and testing methodologies do not sufficiently de-risk hardware designs and mission plans to meet desired mission timelines and profitability. High-fidelity Lunar modelling and simulation capabilities are not only critical for mission planning and system design but are also vital for the verification, validation, and stress testing of space systems.

Taighde Éireann – Research Ireland is a new, competitive research and innovation funding agency in Ireland. 
The establishment of the agency was a key action of Impact 2030: Ireland’s Research and Innovation Strategy.

Research Ireland was established on 1st August 2024, following an amalgamation of Science Foundation Ireland (SFI) and the Irish Research Council (IRC).
Research Ireland is an agency of the Department of Further and Higher Education, Research Innovation and Science working in collaboration with higher education institutions and other state agencies such as the Higher Education Authority (HEA), IDA Ireland and Enterprise Ireland.

Objectives of Research Ireland
As set out in the Research and Innovation Bill 2024:

Promote the attainment and maintenance of excellence in the standard and quality of research and innovation.

Support the undertaking of research and innovation in all fields of activity and disciplines by researchers with different levels of knowledge, experience and specialist skills in such fields or disciplines.

Promote and support the contribution made by research and innovation to economic, social, cultural and environmental development and sustainability in the State.

Strengthen the engagement of the research and innovation system with:

>the Government, Ministers of the Government and bodies (whether statutory or otherwise) which are funded wholly or partly by public moneys, and

>enterprise, non-governmental organisations, cultural institutions and society generally; to promote and develop the reputation of the State internationally as a location that is favourable for undertaking research and innovation; to advance the principles of equality, diversity and inclusion with regard to opportunities to undertake research and innovation and in the undertaking of that research and innovation.

LaGrand GmbH is a Swiss company specializing in the integration of satellite data and artificial intelligence (AI) to generate actionable insights for industrial and infrastructure applications. Our core expertise lies in the analysis of thermal and optical satellite imagery to monitor physical assets and detect activity patterns and anomalies.
To date, we have delivered significant value to the steel industry by using satellite-derived thermal signatures to estimate production activity at steel plants. These insights are used to forecast market trends and support procurement and financial planning across the downstream value chain.
Building on this foundation, we are expanding our technology to enable proactive monitoring of critical infrastructure—such as district heating networks—by detecting thermal anomalies and other early indicators of system degradation or leakage.

Our mission is to make satellite-based monitoring accessible and impactful for a wide range of industries.

RMT is an Italian engineering and software development company specializing in advanced machine vision systems and artificial intelligence (AI) for industrial automation, railways application, quality control, and process optimization.
Leveraging years of experience in applied research and development, RMT designs and implements custom-made solutions that integrate cutting-edge 2D and 3D vision sensors, intelligent illumination, robotics, and proprietary AI algorithms.
RMT's core expertise lies in developing highly precise and reliable systems for:
- Automated defect detection and classification: Identifying even subtle imperfections on complex surfaces and materials (e.g., metals, wood panels, composite materials, tunnel walls, crack detection, water leakege, missing part...).

- Dimensional control and precise measurement: Utilizing 3D scanning technologies for accurate thickness, shape, and profile verification.

Process optimization: Enabling efficient material utilization and decision-making through intelligent data analysis (e.g., automatic defect mapping for optimized material cutting).

RMT's methodology involves a structured approach, often starting with paid feasibility studies and proof-of-concept (PoC) phases to validate the technical solution and define project requirements, ensuring a low-risk investment for clients before proceeding to full implementation.
With a strong focus on delivering tangible value and return on investment (ROI) for its clients, RMT is committed to pushing the boundaries of industrial automation through innovative vision and AI solutions. entityDescription:
Skyline Drones SRL has stood out since 2019 in the Romanian UAV market as a leading provider of customized services for 3D scanning and aerial inspection through drones across various industries such as precision agriculture, telecommunications, electrical networks, wind farms and photovoltaic parks, construction (civil and industrial), utility infrastructure (water and sewage), as well as the oil and gas industry (refineries, pipelines, oil tanks), environmental monitoring, surveillance and safety. 
Starting in 2021, the company began the commercialization of professional drones, offering end customers training in drone usage, as well as support for drone registration and authorization acquisition. Over the years, the portfolio has been enhanced with the use and/or commercialization of new drones and technologies, following certifications from UAV and related system manufacturers such as Quantum Systems, Micasense, YellowScan, Pix4D, UgCS, Accecore Technologies, Sitemark, Emlid, DJI, Deltaquad, Hexadrone, Diodon, PhaseOne, Sentera, Sniffer, Agremo, Agisoft, Elistair, CHC Nav. In 2022, Skyline Drones launched the Skyline Academy. 
In 2024, implementation of the research and development project “AI Drones for Sustainable Wheat Farming” (AgriDrone) in collaboration with partner Agrivi from Croatia, funded through Eurostars 2023, aimed at the development and commercialization of a farm management software platform based on artificial intelligence and high-resolution imagery provided by drones (https://skylinedrones.ro/ai-drones-for-sustainable-wheat-farming/).
The 7 teams offer nationwide and regional coverage in Eastern Europe, with completed projects in Hungary, Bulgaria, Serbia, and Kosovo. Certified pilots can proudly claim the scanning of 400 MWh of photovoltaic parks, over 100,000 hectares of agricultural crops, and approximately 100 industrial facilities/buildings inspected in various regions of Romania, as well as in Eastern European countries, totaling around 150 customized projects tailored to client needs that demonstrate the high added value of Skyline Drones SRL’s innovative aerial inspection services in multiple key economic sectors at the national level.

entityDescription:
ABOUT US
Founded in 1997, Tesera Systems Inc. (Tesera) is an employee–owned technology company. Tesera is 100% exclusively focused on delivering High Resolution Inventory Solutions (HRIS).

In business for over 26 years, our interdisciplinary team reflects a unique combination of forestry and data IT skills and experience. We pride ourselves on providing clients with responsive, exceptional services, high-quality, fully managed and transparent forest and natural resource inventory solutions.

Across Canada, the USA, Brazil and South Africa (in both natural and plantation forests), our team have now successfully completed 17 HRIS Enhanced Forest Inventories (EFI) projects on different forested landscapes covering almost 650,000 hectares, and Individual Tree Inventories (ITI) on a subset of 141,632 hectares.

OUR SOLUTIONS

HRIS integrates AI-based, machine learning and advanced analytics with Enhanced Forest Inventory (EFI) and Individual Tree Inventory (ITI) capabilities.

Tesera has designed HRIS to use fixed radius ground plots and a range of remote sensing data, including LiDAR, 4-band color infrared imagery, and multispectral satellite imagery. HRIS can accommodate terrain and soils, climate and other ancillary data.

HRIS uses advanced data science, AI-based machine learning (ML) and automation using Amazon Web Services to process forest inventory data. HRIS generates over 1,300 features for use in developing models to predict accurate and reliable forest attributes including tree species, heights, diameters, volumes, forest stand structure, site productivity and many others.

Our unique and transparent approach to data aggregation and analytics empowers our clients to discover hidden and sustainable opportunities, and realize new value from their forestry and natural resource assets. HRIS solutions are accurate, flexible and fully scalable… from small woodlands to extensive forest and natural resource landscapes covering millions of acres and hectares.

Over multiple projects and diverse forest conditions, HRIS is more accurate, with an increase in predictive accuracy of 66% (or three times more accurate). This means that in order to achieve the same accuracy with a conventional ground plot-based approach, one would need to establish at least 9 times the number of ground plots.

Our AI-based machine learning inventory solutions are extremely versatile and continue to support multiple data sources and applications. For example, HRIS is serving as the basis for determining forest carbon stocks, carbon offsets (sequestration and abatement) and will be used to model forest changes over time. HRIS is also providing an accurate and reliable approach to support several carbon and forest harvesting projects, ensuring independent data verification and adherence to established standards and regulations. Additional insights on some of these projects can be found at: www.tesera.com/projects.

Our team is also advancing the automation of multivariate forest change detection using advanced algorithms and analytics to rapidly and accurately identify changes in forest environments. This approach requires analyzing multiple variables and large datasets (time series satellite imagery, climate data and other environmental indicators) to detect and monitor changes in forest cover, health and composition over time.

entityName: The European Marine Energy Centre Limited
entityDescription:
EMEC is a not-for-profit innovation catalyst pioneering the transition to a clean energy future.
Established in 2003, EMEC is the world’s leading centre for demonstrating wave and tidal energy converters in the sea.
As a plug-and-play facility EMEC helps reduce the time, cost and risk of testing innovative sustainable technologies.
EMEC is the world’s only accredited ocean energy test laboratory (ISO/IEC 17025) and inspection body (ISO/IEC 17020): the centre provides pre-consented grid-connected test sites in harsh wave and tidal regimes as well as scale test sites in gentler conditions for testing smaller scale technologies, subsystems and components. To date, EMEC has hosted more ocean energy devices than at any other site, providing operational, technical and business support to help clients commercialise.
Attracting developers from around the globe, EMEC’s facilities help to prove what is achievable in some of the harshest marine environments while in close proximity to sheltered waters and harbours.
Building on our experience in developing the ocean energy sector, EMEC is exploring options for developing a national floating offshore wind test site to the west of Orkney. The site aims to offer floating wind developers representative metocean conditions to those in ScotWind, Celtic Seas and future leasing rounds. EMEC also runs the Offshore Wind R&I Programme searching for novel solutions to help deliver offshore wind faster, cheaper and at lower risk.
EMEC is also leading innovation projects exploring the integration of renewables with green hydrogen, storage and e-fuels. The centre has established an R&D hydrogen ecosystem, featuring electrolysers, fuel cells, storage and refuelling, for first-of-a-kind and pilot scale projects aiming to decarbonise power, heat and transport applications.
EMEC’s infrastructure and experience are increasingly being used in wider energy systems and decarbonisation innovation. For example, Microsoft demonstrated a subsea data centre at EMEC’s offshore test site and EMEC is leading the Islands Centre for Net Zero to support Orkney, Shetland and the Outer Hebrides on their path to net zero emissions.
EMEC was set up in 2003 to kick start an ocean energy sector in the UK and boost economic development in the Highlands and Islands. Over the years EMEC has grown and diversified, and unprecedented activity that has taken place in Orkney due to the presence of EMEC has been a catalyst for economic development, creating jobs and a world-leading supply chain now exporting skills and knowledge around the globe. An economic impact assessment calculated EMEC added £370 million GVA to the UK economy between 2003 and 2023.

EMEC is also leading innovation projects exploring the integration of renewables with green hydrogen, storage and e-fuels. The centre has established an R&D hydrogen ecosystem, featuring electrolysers, fuel cells, storage and refuelling, for first-of-a-kind and pilot scale projects aiming to decarbonise power, heat and transport applications.
EMEC’s infrastructure and experience are increasingly being used in wider energy systems and decarbonisation innovation. For example, Microsoft demonstrated a subsea data centre at EMEC’s offshore test site and EMEC is leading the Islands Centre for Net Zero to support Orkney, Shetland and the Outer Hebrides on their path to net zero emissions.
EMEC was set up in 2003 to kick start an ocean energy sector in the UK and boost economic development in the Highlands and Islands. Over the years EMEC has grown and diversified, and unprecedented activity that has taken place in Orkney due to the presence of EMEC has been a catalyst for economic development, creating jobs and a world-leading supply chain now exporting skills and knowledge around the globe. An economic impact assessment calculated EMEC added £370 million GVA to the UK economy between 2003 and 2023.

entityDescription:
ASTRAEA MARINE presents the USV STOÏC 10MH, an autonomous high-seas patrol vessel designed with a patented stabilized platform that enables extended and silent maritime surveillance missions. This unique vessel uses space-connected technologies such as satellite communication and navigation (GNSS), enabling reliable real-time data transfer and precise autonomous positioning. The project addresses growing global needs for persistent maritime surveillance, border security, and environmental monitoring with minimal ecological footprint.
The USV STOÏC is equipped with a large airborne platform elevated above the water using submerged twin hulls with foils and hydrodynamic masts. This design ensures exceptional stability, making it ideal for drone deployment and recovery (both aerial and underwater). Energy autonomy is achieved through solar panels, vertical wind turbines, and biogas-powered generators, enabling several weeks of fully autonomous operations.
Our initial market targets are European maritime security agencies, environmental monitoring institutions, and defence contractors. Competitive advantages include unmatched endurance, energy autonomy via renewables, minimal acoustic and electromagnetic signature, and a modular design adaptable to a wide variety of missions.
Our revenue model includes direct sales of vessels, long-term leasing contracts, and potential technology licensing. Strategic partnerships are being pursued with drone manufacturers, maritime defence integrators, and government agencies.
In the short term, we aim to finalize industrialization, strengthen IP protection, and secure pilot clients. Over the long term, ASTRAEA MARINE intends to scale internationally, expand the USV family (different sizes, specialized missions), and become a key player in autonomous maritime solutions with strong space integration.
The core team combines deep expertise in naval engineering, renewable energy systems, and embedded technologies. Intellectual property is protected through patented design elements.

entityDescription:
Swiss Space Mining AG is a pioneering Swiss technology company at the forefront of clean energy innovation for space and terrestrial applications. Founded on a vision of sustainability and scientific excellence, the company develops advanced systems that enable energy production, conversion, and transmission in the most challenging environments—whether in orbit, on the Moon, or in remote regions on Earth.
Swiss Space Mining AG’s broader technology portfolio includes LifeShield- and Singe Wire Electric Converters, built to ensure robust and secure energy transmission in space or under extreme terrestrial conditions. Final goal of our research is powerful and safe wireless energy transfer. We also work on a microwave reactor system designed for the selective conversion of methane into Hythane. We aim for highly energy-efficient conversion with no carbon monoxide or carbon dioxide emissions.
With a dedicated R&D team and facilities in Switzerland, Swiss Space Mining AG is uniquely positioned to support the growing demand for decentralized, clean, and high-efficiency energy solutions. Our technologies are scalable, patent-protected, and aligned with the future of space exploration and climate-conscious innovation.

entityDescription:
Created in 2001 to consolidate the international activities of school service centres and agencies in Quebec’s education network, Éducation internationale is a cooperative of exchange and development services in education and vocational training[1]. Éducation internationale is a non-profit cooperative comprised (and representing the majority) of Quebec’s French and English school service centres. One of the cooperative’s missions is to export Quebec’s expertise in vocational training and basic education internationally. Quebec is recognized around the world for vocational training that meets labour market needs thanks to the close ties between the labour market and vocational training centres, and the work-study opportunities available in Quebec’s vocational training system. 
 
Since its inception, Éducation internationale has led a number of international development projects in a number of African and South American countries funded by the World Bank, the African Development Bank, Global Affairs Canada, the Agence française de développement, GIZ, and the Global Partnership for Education in particular. 
 
Éducation internationale’s head office is located in Quebec City,Canada. It has legal status as a cooperative, as defined under the province of Quebec’s Cooperatives Act. Governance of the cooperative is provided by a board of directors consisting of 12directors selected by its member institutions.
[1] In Canada, provincial governments are responsible for education. As a Canadian province, Quebec has a department of education responsible for delivering educational services within its borders. In the Quebec public education system, elementary schools, secondary schools, and vocational training centres come under the authority of 72school service centres, decentralized bodies that manage and govern education and vocational training.

description: Lofith is on a mission to redefine performance materials for a sustainable future in SPACE and BEYOND. We develop and manufacture next-generation thermoplastic composites that are lightweight, recyclable, and tailored for extreme environments — from orbit to Earth. Our proprietary UD tapes and compounds are designed for automated processing (AFP, LFT, etc.), offering high performance with reduced environmental impact. Backed by ESA through the Spark Funding initiative, we're validating our materials in real space conditions, including a demo flight on a LEO satellite. We replace metals and traditional thermosets in structural parts, enabling cleaner re-entry, full recyclability, and lower emissions. Our solutions are already gaining traction in aerospace, automotive, and energy sectors, with strategic collaborations underway and active clients.
entityDescription:
Lofith Composites is an advanced materials company specializing in sustainable long-fiber-reinforced thermoplastic composites. The company was founded following over five years of R&D led by AIMPLAS and is now focused on scaling up and commercializing innovative composite technologies for structural applications.
Lofith's core mission is to offer lightweight, recyclable, and high-performance alternatives to traditional metallic components, particularly targeting aerospace, mobility, and industrial markets. As a viable substitute for aluminum, Lofith materials contribute to reducing the environmental impact of space missions, especially during atmospheric re-entry, where metallic components pose sustainability and safety challenges.

Technical Expertise
Thermoplastic Composite Design & Manufacturing:Expertise in the design and production of long-fiber-reinforced thermoplastic composites using sustainable and scalable processes (e.g., compression molding, thermoforming).

Material Development & Optimization:In-depth know-how in tailoring mechanical performance, recyclability, and thermal behavior to meet the demanding requirements of aerospace and space-grade materials.

Lightweighting Solutions:Proven ability to reduce structural component weight by up to 50% compared to metal counterparts, leading to improved fuel efficiency and payload capacity in space applications.

Environmental Performance & Sustainability:Focused on end-of-life recyclability, reduced CO₂ footprint, and minimizing debris and environmental harm during atmospheric re-entry by replacing metallic materials.

Application Areas:Structural parts for satellites, launch vehicle components, thermal protection systems, and other mass-sensitive subsystems in both LEO and GEO missions.

entityDescription:
PENGUINBIO GmbH, found in 2024 by Dr. Peter Rappl, is developing ZONUINBIO, the first molecular diagnostic test compatible with EU regulation (IVDR) directly measuring the marker Zonulin, a key regulator of gut barrier integrity. ZONUINBIO is crucial for both, precision medicine on Earth and health in space for detection and prevention of acute reactions, but also diseases associated with gut inflammation, including inflammatory bowel disease, such as Crohn’s disease.
Under space conditions (e.g. micro-gravity, radiation, stress), astronauts suffer from gut barrier disorders that trigger inflammation and immunodeficiency. ZONUINBIO offers a much-needed precise diagnostic option in Orbit, but also pre and post missions. Space medicine serves also as a catalyst for innovations in terrestrial diagnostics.

Applications at CSG include:

90green solution GmbH ("90green") is a Frankfurt-based startup developing innovative solutions to improve air quality in urban and industrial environments. 90green’s mission is to raise awareness of air quality issues and enable data-driven action through intelligent sensor technology and advanced analytics.
At the core of the business is a modular sensor system that can be flexibly deployed both indoors and outdoors. The collected data is processed via a cloud-based platform, where it is analyzed, visualized and translated into tailored recommendations for municipalities, businesses and industries.
Space technology plays a crucial role: 90green integrates satellite-based Earth observation data to enhance its local measurements with broader environmental insights, such as pollutant distribution, fine dust levels, and urban heat islands. This unique combination of high-resolution, on-the-ground sensing and large-scale satellite data offers significant added value, enabling more precise analyses, targeted interventions and long-term strategies for healthier living environments.

entityDescription:
I-conomy designs and manufactures state-of-the-art DC/DC converters for space applications using either qualified components or commercial components (ITAR-FREE) tested under vacuum and radiation. The team specializes in solving electro/mechanical reliability and performance issues of high voltage power supplies for space use.
I-conomy produces HV power supplies and HV custom systems guaranteed to operate in any vacuum condition so that there is no risk that outgassing of materials in space could cause dangerous discharges or corona effects.
Utilize space-use HV cables, shielded or unshielded, to distribute the high voltage to simplify assembly operations for the customer. The standard modules are contained in aluminum boxes that have 4 holes for easy and reliable fastening by screws.

For maximum vibration and shock resistance, do not use pins soldered to the PCB for control signals and power but flexible cables for effective stress release.
I-conomy also makes:
- custom high voltage systems to customer specifications to optimize weight and size, complete with mechanics, control board and HV cables
- four quadrant fast and very low noise HV modules ranging from -700V to +700V for high precision piezoelectric actuators (Fabry–Pérot interferometer applications)

entityDescription:
Aperio Space Technologies GmbH develops key technologies and software for resilient, secure, and scalable satellite networks with a platform-independent approach. With a patent-pending method for dynamically determining network topology and operating multi-orbit and multi-platform satellite networks, Aperio enables operators to access their satellites in real time to retrieve data and perform continuous operations. After joining the Aperio network, satellites will be able to downlink more data faster, thereby increasing mission returns. This is particularly crucial in earth observation, where the instant availability of large amounts of data is critical for applications such as disaster response, environmental monitoring, infrastructure monitoring, cargo monitoring, and surveillance.
Through intelligent dynamic routing, the data traffic in future telecommunication networks that (even partly) rely on satellites will be optimized and secured with advanced cryptographic mechanisms that Aperio integrates into their protocols. At the same time, space will become safer through Aperio’s work. Not only does the dynamic topology eliminate single points of failure and make telecommunication and earth observation constellations much more resilient, but it also enables instant manoeuvring for collision avoidance and autonomous operations, which will become mandatory given the exponential rise of active satellites in orbit.

description: The University of Huelva (UHU) is a young, public university, striving for excellence and fully implicated in the academic and professional future of its more than 12.000 students. University of Huelva has 9 faculties (Social Work, Education, Humanities, Labour Science, Schools of Nursing and Medicine, Business, Experimental Science, Law, and Engineering). Students can choose from a wide range of undergraduate and postgraduate degrees. UHU currently offers 29 master's degrees and 9 doctoral programs, covering all areas of expertise: Humanities, Social Sciences, Education, Science and Technology and Health Sciences. Doctoral studies are also logically embedded in the structures of research and technology transfer. The UHU is formed by 92 research groups devoted to different fields of knowledge. It has boosted the integration of research groups in centres of research, which will allow to increase the scientific output, as well as creating new lines of research according to present and future needs throughout outer investigations. As a Public Service of Higher Education, the University of Huelva works towards training its students, with a strongly devoted teaching staff and with a large researching career. It also has a highly committed administration staff. In addition, the facilities of this University and its offer of services makes this institution a unique place to receive an excellent higher formation. This institution is part of the Campuses of International Excellence in agrifood industry (ceiA3), sea (CEIMAR) and environment, biodiversity and global change (CEI CamBio). In 2022, the University of Huelva joined the European University Alliance PIONEER with the strategic goal of creating a European University within the framework of the Erasmus+ call launched by the European Commission.

entityDescription:
Finapp has designed and patented the next generation of CRNS probes that use cosmic rays to measure water into the soil and snow non-invasively, on a large-scale, in depth and real time. This is the Finapp revolution: particle physics at the service of environmental and social sustainability.

Cosmic rays come from space and in contact with the Earth’s atmosphere generate a cascade of particles, including fast neutrons. The latter have the peculiarity of interacting mainly with water molecules. When they come into contact with water in the ground or snow, part of the fast neutrons is absorbed and part is reflected back into the air, losing part of the initial energy: thus slow neutrons are born. A large difference between the number of fast and slow neutrons implies a large amount of water and vice versa. Since fast neutrons have enough energy to penetrate inside the ground for many cm (meters in snow), the given figure is representative in depth. Since slow neutrons are distributed over large distances, it is possible to monitor the water content over vast areas, about 5 hectares at sea level.

GeoCodis Gran Canaria SLU is the Canary Islands branch of GeoCodis Ltd., established to extend the company’s innovative geo-technological solutions to new markets. As part of the GeoCodis group, this branch specializes in consulting, software development, and the deployment of geospatial services tailored to local and international needs.
Leveraging the expertise and tools developed by the parent company, GeoCodis Gran Canaria focuses on delivering advanced geo-location, geo-visualization, and geo-analytical solutions with a strong emphasis on cost-efficiency and usability. The branch is also committed to fostering local collaborations and contributing to sustainable development through smart digital tools for environmental monitoring, infrastructure management, and service optimization.

GeoCodis Ltd. is a SME company specialized in consulting, application software development and services to provide cost efficient solutions to all kind of business. Our geo-location, geo-visualization and geo-analytical solutions and services provides great added value to our customers.

One of our products is GeoQoS portal, a tool in a mobile phone industry that controls performance, reliability, and usability of a telecommunications service. This portal was developed for visualization of KPI’s that controls quality of services.

Internationally we are present in Uganda where develop UPMIS software solution for maintenance and monitoring water schemes in rural settlements.
Recently we published WhereIsWater.at portal on a base of Sentinel 1 radar imagery that provides online access to a last water body measurement or to an overview of a historical archive. Users can be also informed when the newest images will appear on the system. The most frequently used services are cumulative coverage for a requested period of time, and reports of water presence inside a requested area.

entityDescription: NexWafe commercializes an innovative epitaxial silicon wafer production technology for advanced photovoltaic applications on Earth and in Space. Following a successful pilot, NexWafe is scaling toward commercial production at its 50 MW facility in Bitterfeld, Germany, focused on space wafers. Our proprietary EpiNex process grows ultra-thin, high-efficiency wafers directly on reusable seed wafers through high-throughput gas-to-wafer epitaxy. The newly produced wafer is detached while the seed wafer is recycled, replacing multiple conventional Czochralski steps and reducing energy use and CO₂ emissions by up to 60%, while cutting costs by 50%. As the only fully Western alternative to a market dominated (>99%) by China, NexWafe offers a secure, scalable, and cost-competitive solution to reshore photovoltaic supply chains to Europe. This supports localized production of advanced PV materials and aligns with EU goals under the Net-Zero Industry Act (2024), EU Solar Energy Strategy (2022), and the EU Space Strategy for Security and Defence (2023).Our technology enhances Europe’s energy sovereignty by ensuring a stable domestic supply of high-performance wafers for space solar power applications for dual use, through satellites in Low Earth Orbit (LEO) and High-Altitude Platforms (HAPS) thereby securing future space solar infrastructure critical to the emerging space economy. NexWafe’s staged scaling, from pilot to megawatt and gigawatt capacity, de-risks expansion to fulfill secured offtakes exceeding 9 GW, with initial production facility already oversubscribed. All offtakes are secured for the 1st commercial facility in Bitterfeld, including for the Space segment which brings >87% gross margin, making the facility profitable within the first year of operations. International scaling beyond Bitterfeld will be done in a capital-light licensing model, for which we already have a Strategic Partnership with Reliance Industries in India for at least a 6GW production. Our vision is to build a network of localized, economically sustainable wafer manufacturing across Europe and beyond, reinforcing Europe’s leadership in space value-chain manufacturing and supporting our energy independence through space.

entityDescription:
HydroStar Europe (HydroStar) is a Green Hydrogen Technology Development Company. HydroStar designs and manufactures hardware that spans that the entire Hydrogen Value Chain including production, purification, compression, storage, and integration. HydroStar currently have 7 active hydrogen-related innovation projects as outlined below, (as of January 2025):

1x OFGEM Strategic Innovation Funding Beta Phase Project: Partnered with Wales and West Utilities, Welsh Water and Yeo Valley.
1x Clean Maritime Demonstration Competition 4: Partnered with Babcock International and London South Bank University
1x OFGEM NIA - Optimising Anaerobic Digestor Plants utilising Green Hydrogen: Partnered with Wales and West Utilities and Ixora Energy.
1x Hydrogen storage and distribution supply chain Collaborative R&D: Partnered with London South Bank University
1x Launchpad: net zero industry, South West Wales – R1 CR&D: Partnered with Cardiff University
1x UK-Australia Renewable Hydrogen Innovation Partnership Programme: Partnered with Northumbria University, UNSW, and Umax Ltd.
1x Smart Shipping - Renewable Hydrogen Mapping and Prospective Production: HydroStar only

HydroStar builds TRL9 Alkaline Electrolysers that are sized between 125kW and 1MW, but are also pioneering the design of membraneless electrolysers. These electrolysers are significantly cheaper than established PEM/Alkaline technology owing to the fact that there is no membrane and HydroStar only use stainless steel electrodes, as opposed to nafion and rare earth metals that are commonly. The lack of membrane also means that HydroStar are able to utilise impure water sources such as rainwater, grey water, final effluent and, seawater as an electrolyser feedstock unlike conventional technology that requires the use of water that has gone through the reverse osmosis (RO) process. This means that HydroStar produces hydrogen in line with stoichiometric values (9Litres of water per kg of H2 produced) whereas the RO process consumes anywhere from 9-15 Litres of potable water per Litre of Ultra Pure water produced.

HydroStar are also developing solid-state hydrogen storage technology (metal-hydrides) that are capable of storing hydrogen interstitially, but also can purify and compression hydrogen up to Grade D (99.97%) and 700bar respectively.This technology is considered the safest way to store hydrogen as it is chemically bonded to the metal alloy with no chance of escape unless the correct temperature and pressure conditions are met.

HydroStar is at the forefront of UK-based Green Hydrogen innovation and is striving for continued participation in sector-defining projects.

entityDescription:
Novac wants to enter the electric mobility market (both terrestrial and spatial), improving its efficiency and quality by means of supercapacitors, thus imposing a new quality standard for the best electric vehicles on the planet. The technology developed by Novac revolutionizes the supercapacitors market with two main characteristics: solid state and mouldability.

Supercapacitors are storage devices characterized by high specific power compared to traditional batteries; coupled to the normal batteries supplied, they would be used in situations where more power is needed, both in charge and discharge, guaranteeing better performance and life-cycle enhancement, having orders of magnitude longer life compared to batteries, and coupling them with batteries can improve the latter life as well, since a drastic stress reduction is achieved. This characteristic of supercaps assumes a very high value for aerospace applications, where long life-cycle and reliability are key factors.
Although the advantages of supercapacitors are clear and evident, at present there is little use of them due to the characteristics of the ones currently on the market. In fact, unlike Novac’s product, they are in a liquid state, containing flammable materials inside them, making them dangerous. Furthermore, these are supercapacitors of bulky and non-customizable dimensions, which makes it difficult to allow their application inside cars or space objects, and impossible inside scooters and bicycles. It is precisely these properties of the currently available supercapacitors that represent a great market opportunity for Novac, which with its own technology aims to revolutionize electric mobility by coupling batteries with safe, shape-customizable and high power density systems. By creating a much safer and liquid-free device, Novac’s product finds a perfect match with spatial applications, where the harsh working conditions impose limitations on the use of classic liquid state devices, making Novac unique on the market, also in terms of volume saving.

The customer base includes small aerospace companies as well as industrial aerospace giants, governmental institutions, tech journals, and venture capital investors. Analysis, consulting, and project management services in the fields of spaceflight, rocketry, and high technology.

entityDescription:
Henddu is a France-based startup that develops smart air quality and climate observatories tailored for developing countries starting in Africa. By leveraging a digital platform powered by proprietary algorithms, Henddu offers a cost-effective solution—up to 6 times cheaper in capital expenditure and 10 times in operating costs than traditional systems. The platform integrates diverse data sources including satellite Earth observation, ground sensors, meteorology, and health indicators to provide real-time environmental intelligence. Its space-based data fusion, using services like Sentinel and CAMS, enables hyperlocal pollution forecasting (HOQA), hotspot detection (Henddu-Spot), and vulnerability mapping (Henddu-Cluster). This multidimensional approach strengthens public policy, institutional capacity, and community engagement through actionable, data-driven insights. Henddu empowers governments and industries to shift from passive monitoring to predictive and strategic environmental governance—driven by both space and ground intelligence.
Henddu is supported by Inria Startup Studio, ESA BIC Nord France, Euratechnologies and the French Public Investment Bank (Bpifrance), and collaborates closely with academic partners such as Inria, the University of Lille, and CNES.

Lynx Educate is a France-based education startup and strategic consultancy dedicated to advancing sustainability, innovation, and inclusive development through transformative learning. With operations in France and Algeria, and partnerships across Africa, Europe, and Latin America, Lynx combines digital education delivery with strategic advisory in global education, environmental science and NewSpace.Our approach, built around Impact Learning, fosters curiosity, agency, and engagement with real-world challenges. We empower learners to become drivers of change through interdisciplinary, action-oriented pedagogy.
Lynx Educate has a strong axis of expertise in NewSpace and sustainability, spanning both upstream and downstream space activities. We support educational and innovation programs focused on Earth Observation, satellite applications, and space-sector entrepreneurship. Our global network of space experts, particularly in Europe and Africa, enables us to deliver cutting-edge content and foster collaborative innovation.
We have launched digital universities, conducted sustainability training for large organizations, and advised academic institutions on international expansion. Our network includes a wide range of academic and professional partners in global education, sustainability and Space, enabling tailored responses to diverse learning and development needs.
A core mission of Lynx is capacity building and knowledge transfer to Africa. We are committed to strengthening Africa’s space ecosystem by delivering training, mentoring, and institutional support, with a focus on empowering local talent and promoting equitable access to space opportunities.

As a participant in the AfricaSpace initiative, Lynx Educate, along with its Algerian partners, aims to contribute meaningfully to the joint goals of ESA and AfSA by supporting digitalisation, climate resilience, and the growth of a robust, inclusive African space sector through education and strategic collaboration.

Koole is a trusted provider of industrial and maritime services, specializing in wreck removal, industrial demolition, hazardous material remediation, and emergency response.

Koole started 40 years ago as a family business in demolition and has grown to over 250 employees while maintaining a hands-on approach and focus on quality. Our success comes from empowering people and our flexible, adaptable team. What sets us apart is our integration of onshore and offshore operations and the ability to quickly scale up in emergencies with our own equipment.

Koole originally started as a demolition company within the industrial sector but has since grown into an international company working onshore and offshore.
Onshore Division specializes in demolition and industrial cleaning for industries like food, pharmaceutical, petrochemical and power plants. Services include hazardous material removal, dry ice cleaning, and 24/7 emergency response/support.
Offshore Division handles complex maritime challenges worldwide. With specialized equipment and skilled personnel, koole manage salvage operations, wreck removal, maritime construction and emergency response efficiently. 

Our fleet of tug vessels and barges is equipped to handle a wide range of maritime challenges. From navigating complex waterways, transporting heavy cargo, or supporting offshore operations. Besides the offshore equipment Koole has also a various and specialized range of demolition equipment, excavators (UHD), wheelloaders, trucks, lowbed trailers, truck mounted cranes, forklift and supporting tools like working containers, storage containers, AWP, generators for power supply, industrial cleaning trucks, sweepers, etc.
In addition to our own projects, we also work with third parties, providing flexible solutions to meet various needs.

entityDescription:
The SWE research group has strong expertise in space weather. More than 50 peer reviewed papers related to the Sun-Earth interaction guarantee the experience acquired in the framework of both national and international projects. Not only improving scientific knowledge on the Solar-Terrestrial interaction is the main goal for SWE, but also the development of space weather products, where the research group has proven experience in leading the Spanish Space Weather Service (http://www.senmes.es/) and providing products to the ESA SSA SWE Network (http://swe.ssa.esa.int/) through the Geomagnetism-Expert Centre. We also operate and maintain the Space Weather Station at the University of Alcala.
Regarding ESA activities, the SWE-UAH group has led two ESA contracts:
P3-SWE-XXXVII, SWE Products for Southern Europe - Phase 1, and
P3-SWE-XXIII, Space Weather User Needs for the Mediterranean Region. Now we are part of the consortium led by the Royal Belgian Institute for Space Aeronomy in the contract S2P - S1-SW-02.2, S1-SW-05, S1-SW-06 - Space Weather Service Network Development and Pre-Operation Part. All the previous contracts demonstrate the experience of the team in validating space weather products and implementing them in the ESA Portal through the SSO system. Users’ campaign to get feedback of our products were also developed in the framework of these contracts.
The SWE group has also participated in the ESA contract Synergetic use of SMOS L1 Data in Sun Flare detection and analysis, which allow us to propose the SMOS Mission for Space Weather Operations, considering the potential of near real-time solar observation at 1.4 GHz from MIRAS instrument.

entityDescription:
Company Overview
LAM Technologies is an Italian company headquartered in Florence (Sesto Fiorentino), specializing in the design and manufacturing of motion control systems. Founded in1991, the company has earned a reputation for delivering high-quality, innovative, and cost-effective automation solutions to customers worldwide.

Core Competencies
LAM Technologies provides a complete and integrated product portfolio for stepper motor motion control, suitable for a wide range of industrial applications:
- Advanced Stepper Drives
- High-performance Stepper Motors (also called Stepping Motors)
- Customizable Power Supplies
- Supporting Software Tools and accessories

Main Product Portfolio
LAM Technologies offers a wide variety of stepper motors and drives, from basic models to advanced, programmable and network-enabled systems.
- High-performance Stepper Motors in standard NEMA 17, NEMA 23, NEMA 24, NEMA 34 and NEMA 42, torque up to 29 Nm. Integrated Encoder and M12 industrial connector version available.
- Stepper Drives (Step Motor Controllers) DIN-rail mountable, compact design
- Integrated Stepper Motors with integrated Controller, Drive and Encoder
- Microstepping and step-less technologies, also in closed loop for servo-like performance
- Advanced fieldbus support:EtherCAT, PROFINET IO IRT, CANopen, Modbus TCP, Modbus RTU
- Hadrware, Firmware and Software customization possibile

Key Advantages
- In-House R&D, all electronics, firmware, mechanical components, and software are developed internally. This allows LAM to respond quickly to customer requirements and continuously innovate.
- Customization Services, LAM Technologies is capable of providing tailored solutions — including mechanics, firmware, I/O, and protocol support — to meet unique space, cost, or technical needs.
- High Product Reliability, each unit undergoes complete functional testing, including automated and traceable processes (serial number, batch, operator, temperature, etc.). Data is archived to ensure traceability and post-sales service quality.
- Fast Delivery and Stock Availability, usually products are available from stock
- Global Presence, with thousands of systems shipped annually, LAM Technologies supports a global network of distributors and OEM partners. Technical support is available in English and Italian language.

entityName: Sapienza University of Rome - Dipartimento di Ingegneria Chimica Materiali e Ambiente (DICMA)
entityDescription:
Il Dipartimento di Ingegneria Chimica Materiali Ambiente (DICMA) ha assunto il nome attuale nel 2006.
La sua storia inizia con l'istituzione del Gabinetto di Chimica Docimastica, dedicato all'insegnamento della Chimica Organica ed Inorganica (1873) e della Chimica Applicata dei Materiali da Costruzione (1876). Questa organizzazione, originariamente destinata alle discipline della Chimica Applicata, si è evoluta nel corso degli anni in seguito agli sviluppi della Chimica Industriale e ha trovato la sua struttura moderna nella fondazione dell'Istituto di Chimica Applicata e Industriale nel 1932. Nel corso degli anni, le responsabilità originarie inerenti all'industria chimica si sono ampliate fino a includere tutte le aree dell'ingegneria chimica, della scienza dei materiali e della metallurgia. Nel 1983, quando sono stati istituiti i dipartimenti universitari, questo Istituto è stato riorganizzato insieme all'Istituto delle Arti Minerarie nel Dipartimento di Ingegneria Chimica, Materiali Materie Prime e Metallurgia, nome che ha mantenuto fino al 2006.
Dal 1895 l'Istituto e poi il Dipartimento hanno la loro sede nell'adiacente palazzo in stile classico di via delle Sette Sale nel complesso di San Pietro in Vincoli.

Robert Bosch GmbH is a German multinational engineering and technology company headquartered in Gerlingen, Baden-Württemberg, Germany. The company was founded by Robert Bosch in Stuttgart in 1886.
Bosch's core operating areas are spread across four business sectors: mobility (hardware and software), consumer goods (including household appliances and power tools), industrial technology (including drive and control) and energy and building technology. In terms of revenue, Bosch is the largest automotive supplier.
Bosch has been working on NV-based quantum sensors since 2017 within its central research
division, combining expertise in quantum optics, sensor electronics, and system miniaturisation. This work led to the recent formation of Bosch Quantum Sensing GmbH, a dedicated venture co-founded with Element Six, a leading supplier of synthetic diamond. KWAN-TEK develops and commercializes high-precision measurement solutions using diamond quantum sensors. The company offers products and services for various demanding applications, with the mission of ensuring the resilience of critical systems through quantum measurements deployed in industrial environments.
Technology
The company utilizes diamond quantum sensor technology. It leverages the quantum manipulation of the Nitrogen-Vacancy (NV) defect present in the diamond's crystalline structure, which has remarkable properties for measuring various physical quantities, particularly magnetic fields. It has the unique advantage of combining the precision provided by quantum measurements with the robustness and ease of integration provided by diamond.

roboloon develops autonomous airship drones to automate the inspection and digitization of long-range infrastructure such as powerlines, pipelines, railways, and roads. Utilizing helium for aerostatic lift, these airship drones achieve significantly longer flight durations and are suitable for operations over populated areas due to their inherent safety. With its patented propulsion system, roboloon's airship drones have, in contrast to conventional airship drones, the same maneuverability as a rotorcraft while offering many times the flight time of conventional multicopter drones. The combination of these features has the potential to disruptively change multiple applications.

Our solution addresses key challenges in infrastructure inspection, which is still predominantly conducted on foot or by helicopter - methods that are time-consuming, costly, and environmentally unsustainable. By providing a cost-effective and environmentally friendly alternative, roboloon delivers inspections that not only reduce costs but also integrate data aggregation and analysis to enable preventive maintenance.

Ericsson is the world leader in communications technologies and services. Ericsson's core business is equipping mobile networks, and the company is one of the most important providers in this field: 40 percent of the world's mobile traffic is handled by Ericsson network technology. One particularly important business area at the moment is the introduction and continuous advancement of the mobile communications standard 5G.
In Germany, Ericsson has been active for more than 60 years and employs 2,400 staff at 12 locations. Approximately 1,000 of these employees are working in the area of research and development (R&D). With the help of its technology, Ericsson is also making a significant contribution to implementing the Gigabit Strategy in Germany.
The Eurolab in Herzogenrath, close to the city of Aachen, is one of Ericsson’s largest research and development centers in Europe. Founded in 1991, we have 600 research and development engineers today, working on the latest 5G and soon 6G releases of mobile network technologies – always with the benefit for consumers and industries in mind.

Design and prototyping of custom magnetic coils for university research, particularly in the biotechnology sector.

WEIGHT - EFFICIENCY – CHARGING CYCLES - SAFETY

OUR SOLUTION
Nordic Nano specialises in next-generation renewable energy solutions, leveraging advanced nanotechnology and screen-printing techniques to enhance solar energy harvesting and storage.
Designed for both terrestrial and extra-terrestrial applications, our technology is engineered to withstand the extreme conditions of space, ensuring reliable energy solutions for satellites and harsh planetary environments.

Our solutions deliver a significant leap in energy efficiency—more than doubling performance— and replace the reliance on rare earth metals and toxic materials: The sustainable energy harvesting and storage applications enhance system longevity, reduce environmental impact, and optimise power generation for satellites and planetary habitats. Besides space missions, our key customers include e.g., solar parks, roof and wall manufactures and electric mobility solution providers.

COMPETITIVE ADVANTAGE
Our thin-film solar energy harvesters, solar panels, and solid-state energy storage solutions are exceptionally lightweight, non-explosive, and highly efficient in energy harvesting.
The solar film is mouldable, while the batteries can be printed into any shape. These features are of critical importance when designing equipment for various space missions, where extreme environmental conditions demand superior durability, adaptability, and reliability.

established early 2024 with a jump start of securing first a robust clientele while ensuring technology development and commercial scaling capabilities. entityDescription:
BetterSea Power (BSP) is a startup founded to deliver measurable benefits for the planet and society by generating renewable energy, reducing water pollution, collecting environmental data, and protecting vital ecosystems. Its cutting-edge technologies lower operational costs and attract eco-conscious stakeholders, positioning harbours as catalysts for sustainable economic growth.
BSP offers a modular, universal solution for harbours, featuring walkable photovoltaic planks, airless fenders equipped with skimmers and a filtering system, as well as fast-charging columns equipped with sensors for water quality monitoring. Compatible with wind turbines and weather systems, BSP seamlessly integrates renewable energy generation, water purification, and environmental monitoring, without requiring new infrastructure and setting a new benchmark for sustainable port technology.
The walkable photovoltaic planks can generate up to 58W of power each. They are customizable in size and colour to blend with the characteristics of each harbour, eliminating the spatial and visual pollution associated with traditional photovoltaic panels. The use of airless fenders with integrated skimmers, combined with a filtering system, enables the cleaning of harbour waters from multiple pollutants.
Additionally, BSP has developed Sentinel, an advanced early warning system that protects freshwater ecosystems and ensures water safety and food security. Sentinel is a modular floating station that integrates sensors to collect and transmit real-time water quality data, a filtering system to purify water bodies of multiple pollutants, a clean water dispenser to ensure a continuous supply of drinking and irrigation water, and solar panels that sustainably power the station and can provide clean energy to rural and Indigenous communities.
BSP’s initial target audience includes the growing number of private marinas committed to sustainability and environmental responsibility. Unlike existing solutions, BSP offers an innovative, integrated, and modular technology that meets both energy demands and the increasing need to reduce and monitor environmental impact.
