The tool has been updated with a circular assessment inspired by Cradle to Cradle to support companies to understand and identify their degree of circularity as well as circularity strategies that the company can implement to improve the sustainability of their business.
Moebeus promotes business activities related to Blockchain, which is used by companies to certify the social and environmental commitment of the business and value chain, ensuring transparency and traceability.
Moebeus has designed a digital educating ecosystem for the empowering of young people's skills in order to consolidate their expertise in the sustainability field. It has designed educational paths for young people in some schools of Tuscany, and workshops for awareness-raising activities for local and national stakeholders. Moebeus has promoted activities for university students on circularity and technology. entityDescription:
Corporate financing is a decisive factor for the success of a company, regardless of whether it is a young start-up or an established company. Solid financing is the basis for implementing future-oriented business goals and realising targeted growth plans. We understand that every company is unique and therefore requires customised solutions.

Venture capital investments are generally divided into several financing rounds, in which various co-investors usually contribute equity to the company as part of a capital increase in return for the subscription of new shares. The target companies of a venture capital investment are young and innovative companies in the start-up or growth phase.

The participation of a private equity company often takes place as part of a single transaction in which existing shares of a selling shareholder are acquired by the private equity investor. In contrast to venture capital investments, private equity investments start later and require stable cash flows.

In the first step, our experts at EurA Ventures GmbH will support you in your search for a suitable investor from our exclusive investor network as well as in finding the right investment opportunity for you. Afterwards, we support you throughout the entire transaction process right up to closing. For us, long-term, trusting and successful cooperation is important and we ensure that your individual transaction process is structured and implemented in line with your objectives.

Robotics and AI Innovation

Samudra develops modular robots designed to automate critical tasks in seaweed farming. Our current focus includes:

	•	NIRA: A compact monitoring robot that autonomously collects data on seaweed growth and environmental conditions. This includes monitoring water quality parameters like temperature and salinity, essential for optimising farm productivity.
	•	NAYAN: An AI-powered camera module that captures underwater images and videos. It analyses data to predict optimal harvest times, detect early signs of pathogens, and monitor seaweed health.

Smart Farm Technology

We integrate these technologies into ‘smart’ seaweed farms capable of minimal human intervention throughout the growth cycle. Our digital platform analyses data from our robots, providing farmers with actionable insights and predictions. This supports informed decision-making and maximises yield while minimising environmental impact.

Off-Aquaculture Farm Services

Beyond seaweed farms, Samudra offers specialised off-aquaculture farm surveys using our NIRA robots. These surveys include comprehensive data collection on environmental parameters and ecosystem health. We tailor our services to meet specific client needs, promoting sustainable practices and regulatory compliance.

Our Commitment

At Samudra Oceans Limited, we are committed to advancing sustainable marine agriculture. By harnessing robotics, AI, and data-driven insights, we aim to transform seaweed farming into a scalable solution for global food security and climate resilience.

Join us on our journey to harness the power of the ocean sustainably, for a brighter and more resilient future.

entityDescription: We are a Slovakia based startup founded by 3 researchers who are exploring a new way of debris manipulation at orbit. Our concept should allow to handle even large objects with bigger mass, yet have the ability to be launched by lighter launching systems or as secondary payloads. Once in place, any multipurpose vehicle can be focused on its highest added value – servicing instead of catching and removal. Our aim is to utilize all known advantages of cooperating multi-agent systems (substitutability of agents, smaller development price, distributed activities, etc.) for catching and debris manipulation including changing their orbits and delivery to the target place for their storage, burning in atmosphere or in-orbit servicing. This should enable the price of these space activities to decrease substantially in the future.

The company Zéphir Alsace (ZA) is a SME, specialized in the synthesis and marketing of zeolite materials, especially hydrophobic materials for applications in air pollution control (trapping of Volatile Organic Compounds (VOCs), odors, ....) and water pollution control (trapping of dissolved organic molecules). 
The company is also involved in molecular decontamination in the space field, and in the laser field to avoid Laser-Induced Contamination (LIC). Main results include the supply of zeolite pellets for the Curiosity and Perseverance rovers, which are exploring the planet Mars since 2011 and 2022, respectively.

ZA is developing close relationships with academic research institutions and with organisations such as the french space agency (CNES) and the french army (DGA). Recently, in collaboration with CNES, zeolite paintings with high zeolite content have been elaborated for molecular decontamination.

In 2025/26 60,000 corporations in the EU will have to disclose how their direct operations and supply chains are impacting biodiversity, for the very first time. Failure to comply can lead to fines equating to 5% of total revenue.
 
For large agricultural corporations, the regulation requires gathering biodiversity data on over 10,000 suppliers (typically farms) across 30 countries.
 
Using a combination of SAR, Multispectral and Hyperspectral imagery Biota can determine the ecosystem condition and health of priority supplier sites. This is achieved by assessing metrics such as plant photogenic activity, senescene content, and moisture readings for trees, hedges, crops and even certain plants.
 
Biota’s data analysis is provided through a SAAS model, sold directly to EU headquartered agricultural corporations.

entityDescription: Sports Impact Technologies is developing a sports wearable that detects all head impacts, as they happen. The wearable is both sports and player agnostic meaning that it can be used for any sport and by any player. User impact data is also recorded including the number and severity of impacts that a player has experienced over their playing career. The wearable uses GNSS data to determine a players speed at the time of impact.

entityDescription:
As an innovative engineering and consulting company, we combine classic hydrographic with limnologic and systemic services. 
 
 
We merge hydrographic, sedimetologic as well as ecological understanding towards an improved water body management. 
 
 
We take the consequences of erosion, siltation of reservoirs and eutrophication of water bodies very serious. Especially the siltation of reservoirs as a global phenomenon, with increasing follow-up costs and ecological consequences is of high importance. 
 
We are dedicated to the objective to investigate siltation processes as precise as possible, to deliver the best possible data basis to reservoir operators for their decision making. This includes not only the survey of sediment masses but also their physical and chemical characteristics. 
 
A contribution to the best possible environment protection and water body operation is a matter of concern to us. 
 
Based on our experience from many years in research and the combination of often separately used measurement techniques (echosounder/sonar – penetrometer – sediment coring – ROV surveys) we are able to produce highly precise and innovative results. 
 
Our services include hydrography, creation of versatile hydro-acoustic data sets and maps up to detailed investigation of sediments and life time assessments of reservoirs.

entityName: University of Augsburg - Organic Computing Group
entityDescription:
The Organic Computing Group at the University of Augsburg, Germany, has been founded in 2012, and continuing work which started at the Leibniz University Hannover in 2006.
This work investigates concepts and methods in the area of Organic Computing with a focus on self-organising networked systems. This includes software architectures for self-organising systems, distributed algorithms implementing self-x properties in such systems, for example building technical trust, sensor/actuator systems for interfacing ICT systems with their surroundings, and embedded machine learning and optimization in technical applications. Concrete application domains that serve as a basis for experimental evaluations include networked Smart Camera systems, communication networks, and vehicular traffic control. In the area of architectures, the basic observer/controller architecture and the multi-layer observer/controller architecture have been designed and evaluated extensively. The work on distributed algorithms for self-organising systems includes data management in mobile ad-hoc networks, e.g. consistency models and data distribution, as well as algorithms for sensor alignment/configuration at runtime. Embedded machine learning has been advanced, for example, when optimising applications at runtime based on context information using improved learning classifier systems or artificial neural networks.

entityDescription:
Stars Edge introduces the first Airbreathing Propulsion for Very Low Earth Orbits (150 - 250 km) enabling for a new generation of satellites capable of 3x Earth Observation Resolution and 5x the Telecommunications data transfer. The engine designed is the only in the market designed for Airbreathing and not retrofit from a previously existent and less efficient engines. Demonstrated in lab and using grant to push it to space testing within the next year/year and a half.
Engine doubles up as a clean and throttleable engine for existing satellites when retrofit with a propellant tank and system. The engine is capable of providing high power manoeuvers on demand and an economic manoeuverability mode with high efficiency and little fuel usage. The throttleable electrical engine is a first in the space market. To further set it apart from the competition other unique selling points of the product is its reduced emissions, cost and higher overall satellite security. This version of the propulsion system uses non-pollutant and readily available gas like Nitrogen.
The fuel used is 6% of the emissions and 5% of the cost as compared to current on the market alternatives like Hydrazine. It does not have a thermal signature or use pressure, magnetism or moving parts. Lower risk associated to the system allows overall less total satellite risk mitigation. The lower need for mitigation strategies (like redundant valves and sensors) allows the satellite to be lighter and reducing overall system costs. The power capacity of our product allows for the satellite to perform close proximity operations, collision avoidance and deorbiting manoeuvres.
The technology has been proved to be relevant for other global market applications of heat exchanging/thermal management specifically the synergy with the new electrical aircraft coming into service in 2035.
Stars Edge plans to tackle the space, the sky and everything in between.

entityDescription:
ABB Ltd. is a UK part of ABB Group and is headquartered in Warrington, Cheshire and employs 1750 people operating from 22 locations. ABB is a technology leader in electrification and automation, enabling a more sustainable and resource-efficient future. The company’s solutions connect engineering know-how and software to optimize how things are manufactured, moved, powered and operated. ABB was founded more than 140 years ago and has globally ~105 000 employees. ABB Ltd. has business lead of ABB Marine & Ports port operations and voyage optimization activities in UK.

January 2024 ABB signed the order with Portsmouth International Port to supply a shore connection solution for visiting ferries and cruise ships. The order is part of the UK port’s Sea Change project to design, build and operate a shore power system across its three busiest berths, the installation will serve two ferry berths – each with five connection points – and an additional berth shared by ferries and cruise ships. The system is due for installation in the fourth quarter of 2024 and expected to be operational by the second quarter of 2025. ABB’s shore connection allows vessels to turn off their engines while at berth, avoiding annual carbon dioxide emissions for the vessels calling at the Portsmouth International Port by an estimated 20,000 metric tons from 2027. This will significantly improve air quality in the harbor area while helping the port to realize its long-term environmental ambitions. To support this positive climate impact, ABB will continue to develop “Oversea – Fleet Support Center as a Service” as part of DECARDIS project to reduce emissions and congestion in busy waterways and ports further by optimization of voyage and port calls and reducing waiting times at ports.

entityDescription:
Unpredictability is usually perceived with a sense of uneasiness and discomfort. However, when it comes to secure our data, information, posts, pictures and whatever flows to (or from) the internet about us, protection relies on unpredictability. The impossibility for an eavesdropper or a hacker to break the walls protecting our digital life depends on secret keys, protocols and cyphering algorithms, namely the art & science of cryptography. Keys, essential to lock&unlock the doors, must be randomly generated. And true randomness implies unpredictability.
Random Power harnesses the quantum properties of semiconductors to generate a virtually endless stream of random bits feeding cyber-security systems. The principle is embodied in a platform of Silicon devices and benefits from micro-electronics advances; the source of randomness is endogenous and this is a genuine paradigm shift with respect to existing devices, providing simplification and robustness of the system; quantum properties of matter make unpredictability irreducibly unbreakable.

Random Power, supported by the European Commission through a grant within the ATTRACT cascade grant project (https://attract-eu.com/) and in collaboration with European Entities, embodied the patented random generation principle into three devices, including a high performance computer-on-a-board and an Application Specific Integrated Circuit (ASIC), a proprietary chip FIPS-140-3 compliant delivering the bit stream AES-256 encrypted.

entityDescription:
Slovenian National Building and Civil Engineering Institute (ZAG) is the leading Slovenian Institute in the field of building and civil engineering.Through high-quality work it successfully promotes the progress-orientated Slovenian applied science and technical expertise on a global scale.
The organization is widely recognized both in Slovenia and in other countries by means of its experts, top-class equipment and multi-disciplinary work, including life cycle analyses of different construction materials.
ZAG is involved in the international co-operation in science and technology with institutions from the EU, the USA and other countries. Over the last 10 years ZAG has participated in more than 50 projects funded by the EU (4th - 7th FP).

Its research and testing sector is divided up into four departments: materials, building physics, structures, and geotechnics and infrastructure, it also has its own department for metrology. In the field of tasks deriving from the CPR (the Construction Products Regulation) it has two independent services: the Certification Service and the Service for Technical Assessments.
Its main activities include:
• fundamental and applied research in the fields of building materials and structures, 
• development of new methods of testing and measurement,
• certification and attestation of conformity of products, materials and executed works,
• training of research and technical staff in particular technical fields,
• participation in the preparation of technical codes and standards.

entityDescription:
PLOATECH specializes in advanced scientific and customized engineering services, with a primary focus on the underwater domain. Our expertise spans in the following key sectors: remote sensing, data processing, instrumentation R&D, and robotics.
Data services include organizing and conducting survey operations with manned and/or robotic vehicles; real-time and post-processing 3D spatial measurements of the seafloor and water column, including temporal and multi-parametric data. Instrumentation R&D includes automations, scientific sensors, and systems integration. In addition, development and improvements of human-occupied submersibles, remotely operated vehicles (ROVs) and autonomous underwater vehicles (AUVs).

PLOATECH works to provide scientists with tools for detection and measurements, for helping improve the environmental conditions of the seas and oceans. To this end and although PLOATECH is a relatively new company, it draws over 25 years of experience in the marine scientific sector, and our track record includes participation in oceanographic expeditions and research projects funded by organizations such as H2020, NSF, NASA, and NOPP.
Space programs can directly benefit from technologies used for sea surface and underwater environments, either for data validation (ground truth) or as testbed for exploration in other ocean worlds. PLOATECH’s R&D is relevant to ESA because it decreases the need for human intervention in complex or hazardous environments which have previously required human teleoperation of highly manoeuvrable vehicles and emphasizes minimalist hardware through increased reliance on autonomous analysis, navigation, and planning. This is directly transferable to planetary explorers which must operate under similar power, size, and telemetry constraints.
PLOATECH stands at the forefront of underwater engineering science. Our commitment to sustainability, cutting-edge technology, and cross-disciplinary collaboration drives our mission as we are contributing to the exploration of the depths of the oceans.

This is directly transferable to planetary explorers which must operate under similar power, size, and telemetry constraints.
PLOATECH stands at the forefront of underwater engineering science. Our commitment to sustainability, cutting-edge technology, and cross-disciplinary collaboration drives our mission as we are contributing to the exploration of the depths of the oceans.

Angloco Ltd is a manufacturer of all types of fire fighting vehicles for operation in all international and domestic market sectors. Our wide range of products provide fire services worldwide a solution to all their vehicle and equipment needs from small All Terrain Vehicles (golf buggy style) to high capacity water foam tenders for industrial or airport operation. Our client base therefore includes civilian, military, airport and industrial fire brigades and civil defence forces.

Since it''s original formation in 1965 the company commenced production of it's first fire fighting vehicle in 1974 from which time the company focused it's entire operation on the fire truck market. In order to support such a global customer base we have the largest After Sales Service operation dedicated to fire vehicles in the UK. Our service division provide a wide range of services to our clients such maintenance, supply of spare parts, training and commissioning.

In parallel with the new vehicle and support operation we also act as a Distributor of special fire vehicles and equipment on behalf of world-leading brand names from Europe and the USA. We also own a majority share in a company located in Poland who produces specialist 'misting' fire modules and equipment.

entityDescription:
KanopyMed was founded in 2018 by Grégoire Mercier, a physician, and Ulysse Rodts, an economist, as a spin-off from the Montpellier University Hospital's innovation center.
The company's ambition is to improve the quality, efficiency, and equity of healthcare systems through population (public health) and individual (digital medical devices) approaches. 
Kanopymed implements innovative methodologies (artificial intelligence, machine learning, dynamic mapping) to design decision support tools powered by health data (SNDS, registries, hospital data, open data).
Kanopymed places ethics at the heart of its values and is a founding member of EKITIA.
 
Key dates:
- In 2019, Kanopymed is a finalist in the AHRQ data challenge in the US.
- In 2020, the company signs several collaborations with major players in the pharmaceutical and medical device industries.
- In 2021, KanopyMed secures 250,000 euros in funding to develop PREDIC, a future digital medical device for cardiology.
- In April 2022, the company will partner with the Montpellier Metropolis and the Montpellier University Hospital to develop AIR-MAP, a digital twin of the metropolitan population to better understand the impact of air pollution on health.
- Coming soon: Medical CE marking for PREDIC and collaborations with companies.
 
The company is based in Montpellier and has four employees.

description:
SkyWatch, a Canadian SME, that specializes in Earth observation (EO) data and the support of analytics, both through its state-of-the-art cloud-based software Platform. SkyWatch delivers pioneering solutions for both downstream and upstream space markets, focusing on the strategic needs of end users and customers. The Platform streamlines access to a comprehensive aggregation of satellite and aerial imagery, enabling rapid, on-demand processing and analysis, supporting applications requiring timely and accurate EO data - supporting dual-use applications. 
For the downstream, SkyWatch offers unparalleled ease in accessing and integrating EO data, supported by a scalable infrastructure and a robust API for seamless system integration. Since 2018, the Platform has gained traction with over 5,000 commercial organizations globally, evidencing its reliability and efficiency with over 1 million API calls per month, while offering its users to over 90% of commercially available satellite-based EO data. Additionally, SkyWatch specializes in the streamlined ingestion and integration of geospatial data products into any Esri environment or application. 
For the upstream, SkyWatch provides a tailored solution for satellite operators, facilitating efficient data management and monetization through a framework for creating data pipelines, while automating the entire process of data ingestion, processing, and distribution. The Platform excels in high-volume data processing and supports the integration of machine learning and AI models, resulting in less waste and lower costs for operators. The Platform leverages market intelligence from the downstream, creating tactical and strategic benefits for operators to optimize collections, plan orbits, engage in speculative tasking, and increase fulfillment. 
Over the past 10 years of operation, we've developed have a strong set of competences around multi-sensor integration, orchestration, data management & storage, and delivery to workflows that benefits our private commercial customer base, while also engaging with the Canadian Space Agency (CSA) and the European Space Agency (ESA) on key strategic R&D projects.

entityName: ReLUIS - Rete dei Laboratori di Ingegneria Sismica e strutturale
entityDescription:
ReLUIS 
 
Competence Center of the Civil Protection Department - decree of the Department Chief n.3152 of 24 July 2013, published on the Gazzetta Ufficiale n. 220 of 19 September 2013
 
The Laboratories University Network of seismic engineering (Rete dei Laboratori Universitari di Ingegneria Sismica - ReLUIS), founded through a conventional act signed on the 17th of April of 2003, is a interuniversity consortium with the purpose to co-ordinate the activity of earthquake engineering University Laboratories, giving scientific, organizational, technical and financial supports to associated University while promoting their participation to scientific and technological-orientated activities in earthquake engineering field, in accordance with national and international research plans in this area.
Co-ordination action promotes the partnerships between Universities, Private Universities, and Inter-university Centres (henceforth indicated with the term “University”) and between them and other Research Institutes and Industries and also promotes the development of earthquake engineering Laboratories according to its statute, through conducting generation and dissemination of knowledge.
The consortium is a scientific interlocutor of different Governmental, Regional, Provincial and Council Agencies and of public and private Institutes to get tangible objectives concerning vulnerability and risk evaluation and reduction.
All the scholars belonging to the associated consortium structures, at the moment of acknowledgment to the consortium or belonging to the foundation for founder members, that take care of problems concerning seismic engineering, can associate and participate in Consortium activities by co-operating in an interdisciplinary way.
The consortium has the main office in Naples in the Department of Structures for Engineering and Architecture, University of Naples “Federico II”. The consortium is a nonprofit organization.
Founder and pertaining members are:
University of Basilicata (Dep. of Structures, Geotechnical and Engineering Geology)
University of Naples Federico II (Dep. of Civil Engineering and Architecture)
University of Pavia (Dep. of Civil, Environmental and Mechanical Engineering)
Successive members:
University of Trento (Dip. of Civil, Environmental and Mechanical Engineering)
In addition to partner universities, experts and professors belonging to further universities and research institutes, well widespread on the national territory, as shown in the figure below, participate to the research and support activities of the Consortium.

entityName: Université de Neuchâtel - Laboratoire d'Hydrogéologie Stochastique
entityDescription: The Stochastic Hydrogeology Lab is a research unit within the Faculty of Sciences of the University of Neuchâtel. It develops mathematical methods and software in the field of spatio-temporal statistics. These methods are used to interpolate properties based on observations and quantify uncertainty. This team is among the world leader in the field of multiple-point statisticis, which is a branch of spatial statistics that build models by learning from example. It is a category of machine learning method able to produce patterns in space or time that are similar to those observed in analog data. These methods can be used to reconstruct the spatial distribution of rock types in the undeground, fill missing data gaps in remote sensing observation, or model time series.

entityDescription:
YPlasma is an innovative enterprise that emerged from the prestigious Instituto Nacional de Técnica Aeroespacial (INTA), established as a spin-off in February 2024. YPlasma's core offering is its patented plasma actuator technology, originally developed for space propulsion, which it aims to adapt for a variety of earth-based uses.
Their business model is built on a licensing strategy that allows for broad utilization of their technology. This flexibility and customizability mean that YPlasma can form partnerships across different sectors, where its technology can be tailored to specific industrial needs. The company's strategy ensures quick technology dissemination and adaptation, which is key for the collaborative growth of both YPlasma and its partners.
The hallmark of YPlasma's technology is its space-derived legacy, which guarantees robustness and versatility—qualities that are vital in the extreme environment of space. Bringing this technology down to earth, YPlasma has chosen to focus initially on the wind energy sector. Their technology addresses major challenges in wind turbines, such as icing and aerodynamic inefficiency, promising to increase energy yield and reliability. Key pilot projects like the partnership with Sotavento wind park (owned by Enel and Iberdrola) serve as a proving ground for their technology's capabilities, demonstrating real-world benefits. Additional agreements with Enel Green Power, NextEra Energy, Total Energies and Plenium Partners are in place to test the technology.
YPlasma is led by CEO David Garcia, who has a 15-year background in leading hard tech and sustainability startups, Antonio Conesa, Head of Aerodynamics at INTA and Mario Sanchez, CTO and co-authors of the patent, bring a deep expertise in aerodynamics and plasma technology research, with a track record of significant breakthroughs.
The versatility of YPlasma's plasma actuators stretches well beyond the wind energy industry. For satellites, they offer a maintenance-free and efficient propulsion system alternative for low-orbits, protected against extreme space temperatures.
In the aviation sector, these actuators can dramatically improve aerodynamic efficiency, leading to significant fuel savings and emission reductions. We have been selected by Airbus as their prime choice following an extensive evaluation of over 80 technologies. Additionally, they can play a pivotal role in thermal management for high-stakes applications in data centers, automotive, and energy storage industries, enhancing safety, performance, and longevity. YPlasma also ventures into agriculture, where their technology promotes sustainable plant growth and offers a method for chemical-free environmental sanitization.
As YPlasma builds on its initial successes in the wind energy pilots and seeks opportunities in other sectors, it aims to serve as a model of innovation, utilizing the transformative capabilities of plasma actuator technology to push various industries towards a more efficient, sustainable future.

Their technology addresses major challenges in wind turbines, such as icing and aerodynamic inefficiency, promising to increase energy yield and reliability. Key pilot projects like the partnership with Sotavento wind park (owned by Enel and Iberdrola) serve as a proving ground for their technology's capabilities, demonstrating real-world benefits. Additional agreements with Enel Green Power, NextEra Energy, Total Energies and Plenium Partners are in place to test the technology.
YPlasma is led by CEO David Garcia, who has a 15-year background in leading hard tech and sustainability startups, Antonio Conesa, Head of Aerodynamics at INTA and Mario Sanchez, CTO and co-authors of the patent, bring a deep expertise in aerodynamics and plasma technology research, with a track record of significant breakthroughs.
The versatility of YPlasma's plasma actuators stretches well beyond the wind energy industry. For satellites, they offer a maintenance-free and efficient propulsion system alternative for low-orbits, protected against extreme space temperatures.
In the aviation sector, these actuators can dramatically improve aerodynamic efficiency, leading to significant fuel savings and emission reductions. We have been selected by Airbus as their prime choice following an extensive evaluation of over 80 technologies. Additionally, they can play a pivotal role in thermal management for high-stakes applications in data centers, automotive, and energy storage industries, enhancing safety, performance, and longevity. YPlasma also ventures into agriculture, where their technology promotes sustainable plant growth and offers a method for chemical-free environmental sanitization.
As YPlasma builds on its initial successes in the wind energy pilots and seeks opportunities in other sectors, it aims to serve as a model of innovation, utilizing the transformative capabilities of plasma actuator technology to push various industries towards a more efficient, sustainable future.

RUPHOS GmbH – Rugged Photonics Systems was established in 2023 as a spin-off from the Fraunhofer Institute for Laser Technology in Aachen, Germany. Our core business focuses on the development and manufacturing of mounted optical components, complete optical systems, and consulting services for clients in the space optics sector. 

Our product range includes mounted passive optics such as mirrors or lenses, advanced optical elements like Pockels Cells or Faraday Isolators, as well as comprehensive optical systems including telescopes, reference cavities, or lasers. Utilizing the soldering technology developed by Fraunhofer ILT, our optical mounts and systems offer unprecedented stability across a broad temperature range and high resistance to mechanical loads. Additionally, they are free from organic materials to prevent molecular contamination issues in space applications. 

Thanks to our strategic partnership with LAYERTEC, a leading German manufacturer of laser optics, RUPHOS is capable of providing high-quality, space-suitable optics for numerous satellite missions, customized to meet our clients' needs and available promptly.

entityDescription:
AquaCloud was established in 2017 and is a big data project anchored in the aquaculture industry’s need to solve common challenges in order to create sustainable growth.
The project is part of NCE Seafood Innovation and began together with cluster members Lerøy Seafood Group ASA, Grieg Seafood ASA, Mowi ASA, Bremnes Seashore AS, Lingalaks AS, Eide Fjordbruk, and Bolaks AS. The project has developed substantially since 2017, and today the project involve a even broader group of leading aquaculture companies.

In 2021, the project was spun out of the cluster and is now an limited company. 
The initial scope of this groundbreaking initiative was to establish a secure database for storing data and to use advanced analytics to identify where sea lice outbreaks were probable. This part of the project celebrated some success. However, data quality and dependability were insufficient to reach the ambitious goals at the time.
At the core of the project is still the Data Platform which receives continuous updates from participating companies and represents a unique repository of high-resolution data from their farming operations. While observing obvious legal and competitive limitations, selected datasets will be shared both between participants and even made generally available to third parties for innovation.
The project has evolved from being a pure sea lice forecasting asset to become a hub of industry activities including companies from multiple sectors in the industry. Based on the initial findings of lacking data quality, the project launched several workflows addressing standardization needs in the industry:
- Sensor Data – an open IoT-based standard allowing equal access to aquaculture sensors and systems
- Fish Health – common standards for areas such as mortality causes and fish group identification as well as digital information exchange between various health and welfare entities
- Environmental Data – reviewed the environmental section of NS9417 standard on unambiguous terminology and methods for documentation of production

entityDescription:
Leanspace is a leading provider of ground segment solutions. 
Satellites have become so critical that our societies can no longer function without them. Yet each satellite requires a complex and costly infrastructure on the ground, and even today it takes years to build them. Forecasts show that space will grow strongly, bringing new solutions to the problems we face on Earth. At Leanspace we believe that for this to happen, space programs need to be radically simpler to execute than they are today. Space is an antiquated industry in dire need of digital disruption.We founded Leanspace in 2020 with two value propositions in mind. The first is to reduce the costs, time and risks involved in setting up ground segments. The second, to increase the agility and resilience of space missions, through more flexible ground infrastructures. These are made possible by our unique technology, a modular, cloud-native software platform that we've been developing for 4 years now. 
Today, our technology has been proven in orbit (TRL9). With it, we offer products and solutions that cover every link in the operational value chain: control centers, antenna integration, cloud deployment, cybersecurity...Our platform is agnostic, so it can be used for any type of space vehicle: Earth observation, satellite communications, launchers, but also for life extension, refuelling or de-orbiting operations...

The offered services range from consultancy in the context of satellite data acquisition and application, and support in the acquisition of appropriate data, to the preparation, evaluation and interpretation of data following the specific information requirements of the customer.

Special educational products such as a school atlas produced for ESA and exhibitions provided to museums and science centers complete eoVision's product portfolio. Vodafone Greece is a member of the Vodafone Group, one of the largest telecommunications groups in the world, and acts as a catalyst in the Greek market. With unique know-how and talented human resources, Vodafone invests in the most modern and future-proof digital infrastructure, reliably supports the needs of individuals and businesses and actively contributes to economic and social development in the country. In its 26 years of activity in Greece, Vodafone leads the market forward and continues to contribute to innovation, implementing a strategic plan for investments of €500 million. by 2020. Earlier, from 2008 to 2015, Vodafone invested more than €1.5 billion. euro in Greece. Vodafone Greece has one of the largest private optical networks in Greece, covering more than 9,000 km. and serves more than 850,000 broadband connections. At the same time, it has more than 3,000 facilities providing high capacity lines (fiber to the building). Today, Vodafone proceeds with the first large-scale implementation of fiber-to-the-home (FTTH) networks in Greece. In this context, the company completed the development of a new generation network (also using fiber optics) in Freattida, Neos Kosmos, Pagrati, Nursing Home and Nea Ionia and continues in the coming months the implementation of new generation networks (FTTH or FTTC) in many areas of Athens, Thessaloniki, Volos, Kozani, Ioannina and Veria and in a total of 25 centers. At the same time, the company is constantly expanding its telecommunications network in mobile, with extensive 3G and 4G coverage and 5G services that offer high speeds, quality and reliability to its subscribers. Vodafone is recognized as an experienced partner that supports every modern need for communication with quality solutions and an excellent service experience. Vodafone provides the most reliable and quality Internet access, for corporate use, through its own digital leased circuits, using microwave links or fiber optics. The main feature of this service, which differentiates it from other providers, is the provision and support of Internet access and the relevant leased circuit from the same provider, which makes Vodafone a one-stop-shop. Vodafone's policy to manage risks and opportunities in a systematic manner and to aim at the continuous improvement and satisfaction of the needs of all stakeholders, led it to develop an integrated management system. At Vodafone we have been certified by Lloyd's Register Quality Assurance (LRQA): 
• Quality Management according to ISO 9001:2015 for activity related to the subject of the declaration, with scope in the design, development, implementation, operation, maintenance and monitoring of mobile and fixed communication networks, wireless technologies and data networks. 
• Environmental Management according to ISO 14001:2015 for an activity related to the subject of the declaration, with scope in design, development, implementation, Operation, maintenance and surveillance of mobile and fixed communication networks, wireless technologies and data networks. 
• Management of Occupational Health and Safety according to ISO 45001:2018 for an activity related to the subject of this Declaration, with scope in the design, development, implementation, operation, maintenance and monitoring of mobile and fixed communication networks, wireless technologies and data networks. 
Vodafone also has the following certifications: 
• Information Security Management according to ISO/IEC 27001:2013 
• Business Continuity Management according to ISO 22301:2012 
• Energy Management according to ISO 50001:2018

entityDescription:
Coolx offers data management software that collects and evaluates data for the European Union Deforestation Regulation.
Coolx is a software that combines forest monitoring technologies with artificial intelligence to enable trading, importing and exporting companies to convert their supply chains to deforestation-free. The software:
- Performs satellite analysis with Sentinel-2 imagery to assess the deforestation risk of suppliers' plots using AI, as well as the risks of being in environmental or indigenous protected areas.
- Conduct an assessment of the status of the importing and/or exporting company with respect to the EUDR.
- Conducts an initial supplier assessment of the suppliers of the suppliers of these companies
- Generates a guided action plan with specific tasks for the company to comply with the EUDR in a guided manner.
- It performs a socio-legal analysis of supply chains, contrasting and verifying the information provided by users and their suppliers using AI tools in relation to land use rights, third party rights, labor rights, environmental protection, human rights, the principle of free consent, and tax, anti-corruption and trade regulations. For this we use AI models that read the files and extract all the information automatically, allowing us to move from information hidden in the documents to structured information in our database that we use to verify that socio-legal requirements are being met.
- Stores the analysis information in a structured way to use this data for Due Diligence compliance (legal process defined by the European Commission to comply with the EUDR).
- Allows the visualization of the analyses performed in order to demonstrate the results obtained to the authorities.

Data collection and Map building : collecting data of the safest cycle routes and creating the maps on the back of it.

entityDescription: At Quaesta AI we deliver solutions based on the most advanced methodologies and algorithms from Deep Learning and Artificial Intelligence, for tasks where standard methods often fail. Thanks to more than a decade of experience in scientific research, our solutions are based on state-of-the-art algorithms for computer vision, with applications in remote sensing and quality control, addressing demanding standards of quality and performance. Our experience focuses on remote sensing applications based on satellite and drone images, with both visible and non-visible (multispectral and hyperspectral) bands. Among the others, we have developed solutions for the identification of specific vegetation species and undergroud large structure of possible archeological interest using satellite data, as well as for the detection of landslides using SAR and multispectral bands. Additionally, we develop software solutions for ensuring quality control, with a focus on manufacturing processes characterized by the need of high performance, both in terms of speed (minimal latency), robustness and of accuracy of the system. Our software allows tasks such as anomaly detection, barcode and QR codes decoding, OCR/OCV, and many other typical tasks in visual-based quality control automation. We are one of the few companies developing ad-hoc software for neuromorphic (Event-Based) cameras, a revolutionary family of cameras capable of capturing information from scenes at extremely high frequency and in low-light and high-contrast conditions. Our software is not bound to any specific camera brand or computer platform, allowing a straightforward adoption and integration in existing production environments.

entityDescription:
Our vision is a world of clean and cheap energy for everyone. Our mission is to develop energy converters for the transition to decentralized, low greenhouse gas and efficient energy production. We develop, manufacture, sell and service microturbines for Combined Heat and Power. We exploit any fuels from renewable sources through very low emissions flameless combustion.
We have developed an innovative combustion technology called flameless combustion which can be used to burn very efficiently and with low emissions (NOX and CO) any type of gas from natural or bio gas to mixtures of natural gas with hydrogen, ammonia, syngas (H2-CO), or pure H2. Our burners are integrated in our in-house microturbines to produce efficiently and cleanly electricity and heat. Our systems are sufficiently modular to be adapted to industrial processes which would require high-temperature heat, electricity and waste heat recuperation and subsequent conversion. We also develop our in-house heat pump connected to a microturbine to enhance the global efficiency and an ORC system for waste heat recovery. We therefore combine all the building blocks required to be efficient/hybrid solutions comaptible with renewables for the heating industry.

entityDescription:
LIDAX Electro Optical Systems (Hereafter LIDAX EOS) is a space technological company located in Paracuellos de Jarama Madrid (Spain) 
Its main objective is the development and commercialization of custom electro-optical systems for space to reduce time to market of functional products that can support a variety of space applications. 

An imaging scanning lidar for Space applications SMARTLID3 is currently one of its main projects references.
LIDAX EOS is a subsidiary of LIDAX GROUP, the parent organization has more than 22 years of expertise and 15 senior space engineers and technicians with advanced laboratories and equipment to develop complex Space Flight equipment used in Instruments for Earth Observation, Planetary Exploration and Telecom, Astrophysics Instrumentation for Satellites, On ground Science and Astronomical Instrumentation Projects.
The above-mentioned space family of products are:
• Opto-Mechanical Subsystems.
• Focal Plane Assemblies (FPAs) for Electro-Optical systems.
• High Performance Mechanism.
• Optical Ground Support Equipment.
Some relevant projects to which LIDAX has contributed are the James Webb Space Telescope, Meteosat Third Generation MTG, Earthcare ATLID, BepiColombo MIX-C & MIX-T, Exomars 2020. 

This extensive experience ensures their support on the success for a RDV/GNC Scanning LIDAR product development, where LIDAX EOS is the spearhead that will lead as product owner its development and commercialization.
LIDAX EOS carries out the following activities in a fully integrated center of 1,800 m2:

· System Engineering / Chief Engineering activities.
· Assembly and Integration areas for any opto-electronics device(In ISO 7/5 Cleanrooms).
· Testing laboratory for the complete functional validation for any opto-electronic device.
 
SMARTLID3 project is being developed together with a technological partner specialized on terrestrial LIDARs, based on a long term commitment between both companies.

entityName: Agenzia regionale per la prevenzione, l'ambiente e l'energia dell´Emilia-Romagna
entityDescription: The regional agency for prevention, environment and energy of Emilia-Romagna (Arpae) was established with regional law n.13/2015 and has been operational since 1 January 2016. It integrates the functions of Arpa (established with regional law n.44 of 1995) and the environmental services of the provinces. entityName: ARPAL - Agenzia Regionale per la Protezione dell'Ambiente Ligure
entityDescription:
RPAL is the public reference body in environmental matters, in charge of monitoring the regional environment and of controlling the potential pollution sources. It is operational since 1 January 1998 in support of the Region, Provinces, Municipalities for the protection of environment, biodiversity, water resources and soil, and for the prevention and promotion of collective health and safety.
ARPAL is part of the National System for Environmental protection, together with all other regional Agencies and ISPRA, the Italian Central Institute for Environmental Protection and Applied Research. ARPAL takes also part to the National Civil Protection System, including the Regional Meteorological and Hydrologic Center (RMHC) of Civil Protection, which carries out daily weather forecasts and rainfall measures as well as river level monitoring and discharge forecast with several products. It uses a meteo-hydrological forecasting chain the couples the meteorological models with the hydrological model, DRiFt, that allows to forecast river discharge over the main catchments of Liguria region, in a probabilistic context.

entityName: Glowny Urzad Geodezji i Kartografii (Head Office of Geodesy and Cartography)
entityDescription:
Head Office of Geodesy and Cartography of Poland (GUGiK) is a national mapping agency.
The role of Head Office of Geodesy and Cartography is to provide access to current geodetic and cartographic information andco-creating a modern spatial data infrastructure. The tasks carried out by Head Office of Geodesy and Cartography result mainly from two basic legal acts:
- Act of 17 May1989 on geodetic and cartographic law.

- Act of 4 March 2010 on spatial information infrastructure.
The most important tasks of GUGiK include:
- supervising realisation of the national policy in the scope of land surveying and cartography,
- maintaining theNational Geodetic and Cartographic Resources,
- maintaining records in the systems of information on lands with general state importance,
- granting professional qualifications in the area of land surveying and cartography,
- creating and maintaining the geoportal of spatial information, as the central access point for services (such as searching, reviewing, downloading and transforming) within a full thematic and territorial range of infrastructure,
- being responsible for contacts with the European Commission.The Surveyor General of Poland has been appointed as the National Contact Point on issues relating to the INSPIRE Directive.

entityDescription:
MediaTek is a fabless semiconductor company, which is another way of saying we design chips for electronic devices that our partners manufacture.
We design cutting-edge system-on-chip (SoC) solutions for cellular handsets and tablet devices; fixed and wireless connectivity; high-definition TV; optical storage and DVD and Blu-ray products.
MediaTek is headquartered in Taiwan and has sales and research subsidiaries in mainland China, Singapore, India, U.S., Japan, South Korea, Denmark, the UK, Sweden and Dubai. Our R&D centre in Cambourne (near Cambridge) develops smartphone SW and cellular system technology, and our R&D centre in Kent develops RF technology. MTK Wireless Ltd is the UK operation of MediaTek Inc. In the UK, we have two R&D centers – both working on technology for our future SoC wireless chipsets. Our R&D centre in Cambourne (near Cambridge) develops SW and system technology, and our R&D centre in Kent develops RF technology
MediaTek'sWirelessProducts
MediaTek has cumulatively shipped well over 2.5Bn cellular chipsets since entering the cellular market segment less than a decade ago. MediaTek’s “total solution” turnkey approach, and insatiable appetite for excellence in modem solutions, has enabled our customers to successfully deploy MediaTek powered handsets in over 150 countries worldwide. Most recently, our 3G chipsets have been at the forefront of enabling the democratization of smartphones for the mass market. In addition to cellular chipsets, MediaTek has developed leading edge wireless connectivity technology, including Wi-Fi, BT GPS and NFC.
MediaTek in Finland

MediaTek Finland focuses in 5G/6G modem chipset development, containing embedded system SW development, algorithm and HW design as well as modem integration and verification. MediaTek Finland has close co-operation with European network vendors and mobile network operators and participates also to 3GPP specification work.

description: Arceon develops ceramic matrix composite materials and structures.
entityDescription: Arceon B.V. is an engineering company located in the Netherlands, focussed on the research, development and application of ceramic matrix composite materials. The company consists of a strong team of engineers, and an in-house manufacturing capability. Ceramic matrix composite materials (CMCs) are a combination of ceramics and composites, utilizing the advantages of both. Like polymer composites, they use reinforcing fibres like carbon or silicon carbide to provide strength and stiffness. The matrix consists of a ceramic, usually silicon carbide, which provides high temperature performance and ablative resistance. Arceon uses carbon fibres in a silicon carbide matrix, which results in attractive material properties: low density (1.9-2.1 g/cm3 ), high temperature resistance (stable up to at least 1600 °C), low CTE (-1 – 2.5 10-6 K -1 ) and high strength (flexural strength up to 300 MPa). Also, by using different fibres and additives, many of the properties can be tailored to specific applications.

entityDescription: Foresting Tomorrow ApS was established in 2019 with the purpose of developing a new digital tool (Skovkortet.dk) for forest owners and managers. The tool can be used to optimize and manage the operation of planted areas and to document the occurrences and activities of forest areas with regard to areas, species, age, quantities, diameters, harvesting times, key biotopes, cultural values, and more. The idea for the tool and the current solution were developed by Jens Isbak and Rasmus Pedersen, and later Henrik Neergaard-Petersen joined as a partner. Since its launch in 2019, the development has been rapid, and today, 30% of the Danish forest area is registered in Skovkortet, corresponding to over 3,000 forests. Additionally, there are close customer relationships with companies like HedeDanmark, Danish Forestry Association, a number of municipalities and private forest owners In 2023, our current solution was updated to an international version called, Forsler.com, which enables global scaling and simplifies future product expansions. Our central vision is to promote the transition to a more sustainable future by offering a high-quality digital forest platform that provides forest owners, managers, and organizations with the necessary tools to manage their forests in an environmentally responsible and sustainable manner.

DBT-Energie BV is een toonaangevend bedrijf gespecialiseerd in de ontwikkeling, productie en levering van energieoplossingen voor een breed scala aan industrieën en toepassingen. Met een sterke focus op innovatie, kwaliteit en duurzaamheid willen wij onze klanten voorzien van een betrouwbare en efficiënte energievoorziening die aansluit bij hun specifieke behoeften. 

Onze expertise omvat verschillende gebieden binnen de energiesector, waaronder: 

1. Transformatorstations en schakelinstallaties: Wij ontwerpen, produceren en leveren hoogwaardige transformatorstations en schakelinstallaties die de veilige en betrouwbare distributie van elektrische energie garanderen. 
2. Oplossingen voor energieopslag: we bieden geavanceerde energieopslagsystemen die helpen bij het beheren van piekbelastingen, het beperken van schommelingen in het elektriciteitsnet en het optimaliseren van het gebruik van hernieuwbare energiebronnen. 
3. Slimme netwerken en automatisering: Onze slimme netwerkoplossingen en automatiseringstechnologieën dragen bij aan een efficiënter energiebeheer, het minimaliseren van verstoringen en het verbeteren van de algehele netwerkprestaties. 
4. Energie-efficiëntie en duurzaamheid: We streven ernaar energie-efficiëntie en duurzaamheid te bevorderen in alle aspecten van onze activiteiten, van productontwerp tot productie en distributie. 
Als vertrouwde partner streven wij ernaar langdurige relaties met onze klanten op te bouwen, waarbij we nauw samenwerken om op maat gemaakte oplossingen te leveren die voldoen aan de specifieke eisen van hun projecten. Onze focus op innovatie, kwaliteit en klanttevredenheid vormt de kern van alles wat we doen bij DBT-Energie BV

entityDescription:
Mycro3D ApS (Formerly known as ATTO 3D) is a spin-out from Technical University of Denmark, based on research conducted at DTU Health Tech. Mycro3D Has developed a unique, patented, microscale 3D printer capable of printing in commercial photopolymers at ultra-high resolution and large volume. Our technology approach allows us to print in 2-50 µm resolution in up to 4x4x4 cm volume and even with multiple materials for the same print. Despite this capability, the printer is very compact, smaller that 20x20x20 cm. 

Mycro3D has 4 co-founders, all stemming from DTU Health Tech. The co-founders are also the inventors and researchers that has engaged with the original work since 2018. The invention bases on research in micro devices for oral drug delivery conducted at the IDUN Centre of Excellence since 2018. The designs and components theorized required fabrication methods that enabled large arrays of microstructures to be fabricated. To realize this, a team was dedicated to develop a microscale 3D printer with the necessary capabilities. in 2021 the first prototype was capable of fulfilling the needs in the research department. With this milestone, a lot of traction showed commercial potential for this printer technology in other fields. This gave rise to the commercial journey that resulted in Mycro3D. With traction in R&D in medical devices, health and electronics, the Mycro3D company was created to bring this technology to fields and industries that can benefit from it. Our primary focus lies in R&D of medical microdevices, but we are also seeing traction in sound, electronics, aerospace and biology fields. Furthermore, we are working on new material formulations, such as carbon enhanced and compound materials. These are theorized to have specific use in Aerospace and Biology applications, where strong, light-weight materials and radioopaqueness are among the necessary features currently being explored.

TheLIST3N(Computer Science and Digital Society) laboratory develops efficient approaches (concepts, models, methods and tools) to deal with the entire data processing chain, from sensors to uses, through data analysis and optimization.

This research unit project is the result of a reconfiguration of four existing research teams: ERA, LOSI, M2S and Tech-CICO. The new structure includes76 permanent researchersfor a total staff of165 people.

The primary objective of this integrated approach is to promote the design of new methods and methodological advances in the disciplines by taking into account the specificities of the different links in the chain. entityDescription:
With the emerging possibilities of additive manufacturing, mmWave applications have gained an auspicious toolset to realize complex and high-performance systems especially in the field of antennas, e.g. radar-frontends for the next generation of autonomous driving or detection systems for drones.Especially with the use of plastic 3D-printers, hollow waveguide structures can be realized, which easily outperform PCB solutions in terms of attenuation and dimensional design freedom at frequencies above 30 GHz.Those plastic geometries however, still need to be metal coated in order to deliver a functional waveguide system.In this context, Golden Devices GmbH offers an enabling coating concept to realize electromagnetically hollow structures an therefore, combine the performance of waveguide systems with the manufacturing capabilities required for complex designs up to series manufacturing.
In addition, Golden Devices also offers the design and manufacturing of casted full-metal parts. The casting process from Golden Devices makes it possible to combine the advantages of 3D printing, such as design freedom, with the advantages of solid metal parts. This enables high mechanical reliability and increased resistance to environmental requirements, such as in aerospace applications.

entityDescription:
LOTRIČ Metrology is European family-owned company with 190 employees. We have been calibrating, testing and certifying with a love for metrology for three decades. We develop highly perfected but easy to use metrology products and services. We are proud to work with companies of all sizes, from the smallest ones to the largest global corporations.
 
Work in the company is organized into two key areas, namely:
1. performing metrology solutions and,
2. research and development based on metrology field.
 
Metrology solutions:
In the LOTRIČ Metrology group, we perform calibrations for the widest range of customer requirements. The certificate is the key and most important result of the service execution. This certificate ensures the traceability of the customer's measuring instruments, providing tabular and graphical accuracy and precision results with measuring uncertainty. The calibration certificate complies with the necessary international standards (ISO 17020 and ISO 17025), technical guidelines, and customer-specific needs.
With 512 methods, of which 249 are accredited, we are the leading provider of all-in-one metrology solutions. We cover more than 95% of all metrological needs for most clients. With certificates in 53 countries and a QNet network of international partners, we provide services in the EU and beyond. Our references include the names of more than 25,940 companies.
Every year, the LOTRIČ Metrology Group issues 100,000 certificates based on 5,000,000 measurements, which we evaluate with 4 billion measurement data collected and archived using our own EXACTUM system. 
 
Research and development:
In the scope of research and development, we focus on:
- advanced systems for measuring product dimensions that are fully tailored to the client’s needs.
- inline or Offline systems for complete quality control based on advanced algorithms
- advanced platforms for data processing that incorporate machine vision technology and predictive capabilities
- development of certification schemes for non-harmonized areas to verify device compliance before startup and during use (e.g., robotics), with monitoring of repeatability, accuracy, reliability, and other safety elements

entityDescription:
According to the Law of Greenland Parliament nr. 6 8th of June 1994 about the Greenland Institute of Natural Resources (GINR), the institute is obliged to:
- provide the scientific basis for an assessment of sustainable use of the living resources in and around Greenland as well as protecting the environment and securing the biological diversity
- advise the Greenlandic Government in the work of the Institute
- publish results of its research

On this basis the main goals of GINR are to:
- give advice based on high quality scientific research.
- foresee changes in the ecological equilibrium and the development of populations as a result of change in climate and human impact on nature.
- indicate quantitative and sustainable use of the living resources.
- advise on measures to protect the environment and ensure biological diversity.
- include local knowledge in scientific research.
- enter into open dialogue with Greenlandic communities and communicate knowledge about causal relationships in nature.
- provide suitable research facilities for the personnel and strengthen the connection between this internationally orientated workplace and theGreenlandic community.
- maintain a stable and secure working environment both physically and psychologically and establish an up-to-date physical working environment in the laboratories, field stations and boats.
- secure acquisition of necessary financial resources through the annual Finance Act as well as through external sources.
These goals are implemented by members of the staff, who:
- gather, process and assess data concerning exploitation and preservation of the living resources.
- conduct research in preparation for assessment on the living resources important for Greenland.
- contribute to studies of processes and ecological connections in nature .
- participate in surveys and innovative work in relation to the assessment ofmethods and tools used in exploiting natural resources in Greenland
- safeguard the international responsibilities that lie with Greenland within the field of research as mentioned above.
- safeguard the coordination and recording of survey and research results from related institutions which have significant influence on the living resources of Greenland and the securing of the environment and natural resources of Greenland.
The Greenland Institute of Natural Resources may undertake assignments with all or partial expenses covered by:
- other public organisations and companies
- private organisations and companies

entityDescription:
LIPOR -Municipalities Association for Sustainable Waste Management of Greater Porto - was founded in 1982 as Municipality Association and manages, recovers, and treats the municipal waste produced in eight municipalities of the Greater Porto Area: Espinho, Gondomar, Maia, Matosinhos, Porto, Póvoa de Varzim, Valongo, and Vila do Conde. At the same time, we continue to share good practices with the population, which are supported by awareness campaigns. 
Every year, we treat around 500,000 tons of municipal waste which is produced by about 1 million inhabitants. 
We are upheld by modern waste management concepts which promote the adoption of integrated systems and the minimization of waste disposal in landfill. That's why we've developed an integrated management strategy based on four key components: Multimaterial Recovery, Organic Recovery, and Energy Recovery, supported by a Landfill Site to receive the waste from processes and from previously prepared waste. 
This concept has grown naturally, and we continue to embrace new projects and services, thus strengthening its strategic path. The principles of a Circular Economy inspire us, hence, when managing the waste we receive daily, we add the three pillars of Sustainable Development: environmental, economic, and social.
Over the years, our work has been celebrated with different awards and recognitions, encouraging us to keep working towards a sustainable future.

entityDescription: Qascom (Quality and Secure Communications) is a software and systems technology provider of security applications in the satellite navigation and communications domain. Qascom operates in various sectors: Space, Transport and Government. In the space sector, Qascom offers technologies and competence in security for GNSS signals and receivers. Products range from GNSS (Global Navigation Satellite Systems) system security tools to GPS monitoring and remote tracking applications. Columbus is a suite of tools for GNSS security simulation. It can assist system designers and application developers, as well as assist in the facilitation of certification processes. Qastrack is a middleware for GNSS telematic applications, including real-time tracking and integrity monitoring. Research activities are mainly focused on GNSS signal and receiver security. Qascom has a number of publications in the field, pioneering the area of trusted location systems and location based access control. Research in GNSS receivers include the design and vulnerability assessment of tamper resistant hardware, software and cryptographic schemes. Qascom additionally performs research on anti-spoofing techniques through cryptographic integrity and authentication, both at the data and the signal level for both GNSS and augmentation systems. Services involve consulting in the area of satellite navigation systems and security analysis of critical applications. This includes vulnerability assessment, requirement analysis and risk mitigation for applications dependant on GPS. Design and integration of technologies for detection, localization and mitigation of intentional and non-intentional interference are additional services provided by Qascom for applications that rely on GNSS.

entityDescription:
Electric Vehicle Technologies
/ Hybrid Electric Aircraft Technologies
The AIT Austrian Institute of Technology actively supports the European aeronautic industry by providing technological solutions for the advancement of “More Electric Aircraft” and “Hybrid Electric Aircraft.”
As air travel continues to experience rapid growth, with one billion passengers flying within, into, or out of Europe in 2018, along with 11 million scheduled flights, we recognize the urgent need to address the environmental and sustainability challenges associated with this trend.
Our efforts encompass two key areas: the development of a electrothermal Ice Protection System for aircraft and rotorcraft, and the advancement of solid-state batteries for hybrid propulsion in regional and short to medium-range electric airliners.
In our pursuit of decarbonization, we specialize in delivering technological solutions for energy storage, electric propulsion, and electrical auxiliaries, lending our support to the European aeronautics industry. One significant area of focus is achieving energy efficiency through the implementation of innovative ice protection systems for aircraft. Within this domain, we offer comprehensive services ranging from simulating ice formation under certification-relevant environmental conditions to designing and validating performance.
Additionally, we dedicate our research efforts to the development of solid-state batteries specifically tailored for the propulsion of hybrid electric aircraft. Our services encompass modeling large-scale distributed battery systems, including the aircraft grid, as well as further advancing high-power and high-energy density battery cells, modules, and packs. These advancements are designed to handle high discharge rates while adhering to the stringent safety requirements of the aeronautics industry.
Through our commitment to technological innovation and sustainability, we aim to contribute to the transformation of the European aeronautic industry, paving the way for a greener and more efficient future in aviation.

description: Established in 2021, Astradyne is a startup at the forefront of deployable structure technology. Central to our mission is the development of lightweight, foldable photovoltaic solutions for both space and terrestrial applications, which leverage our proprietary FRET technology (Flexible Reinforced Electronics with Textile), a manufacturing process that reinforces electronic components with textile material. This breakthrough represents a significant leap in deployable systems, offering unparalleled efficiency, lightness, compactness, and versatility. Astradyne's initial focus is on the solar energy sector, where our goal is to establish a new standard in efficiency and adaptability. Our market entry is spearheaded by SolarCube, a product that embodies Astradyne's vision: a deployable solar panel that combines aesthetic sophistication with functional excellence for satellite applications. The launch of SolarCube, scheduled for 2025, directly responds to the growing and evolving needs of the space sector for more efficient and reliable energy generation solutions. On Earth, our technology finds various applications, from enhancing renewable energy sources in urban settings to powering remote and off-grid locations. Our foldable solar panels are adaptable for use in diverse environments, providing clean and sustainable energy wherever needed. Looking ahead, Astradyne is poised to expand its technological footprint. With FRET as our foundation, we are exploring new frontiers in advanced communication systems, biomedical devices, and more. Our vision is broad yet focused: to leverage our proprietary technology to meet market needs with practical and innovative solutions. Since its inception in May 2021, Astradyne has secured instrumental funding for accelerating the research and development. The team, which brings together seasoned experts from top firms and research institutions around the world, combines deep technical knowledge with a keen understanding of business strategy. This unique blend has propelled us towards significant achievements, including securing our first commercial contract and being selected as Italian Startup of the Year by a jury of investors and market experts in 2023. Currently, we are preparing to raise a seed investment by the end of 2024. This investment will be essential for the in-orbit testing and market entry of SolarCube, as well as for beginning to explore the potential of FRET technology in various products and applications.

entityDescription:
Medair is a Swiss-based international non-governmental organization (INGO) founded in 1989. Inspired by Christian faith, the mission of Medair is to alleviate human suffering in some of the world's most remote and devastated places. Medair operates with the core principle of helping people affected by natural disasters or conflict to recover with dignity. Medair adheres to the fundamental principles of the Red Cross Code of Conflict, and provides assistance based on need, regardless of race, religion, ethnicity, nationality, or political beliefs. 
Areas of Intervention:
Emergency Relief: Providing immediate assistance following disasters, such as food, shelter, and medical care.
Shelter Support: Helping families rebuild or repair their homes and communities.
Medical Care: Delivering essential healthcare services in crisis zones.
Nutrition Services: Addressing malnutrition and promoting healthy eating habits.
Water, Sanitation, and Hygiene (WASH): Ensuring access to clean water and sanitation facilities.
Cash Assistance: Empowering families to meet their basic needs quickly during crises.
Key Strengths:
Rapid Response:Medair prides itself on its ability to mobilize quickly and start delivering aid within 24 hours of a disaster.
Local Focus:They work closely with local communities and partner organizations to ensure their interventions are culturally appropriate and sustainable.
Expertise:Medair employs a team of highly skilled professionals in various fields,including health,nutrition,shelter,and water sanitation.
Commitment to Dignity:Their approach emphasizes treating people with respect and helping them rebuild their lives.

entityName: UNIVERSITY OF HEIDELBERG - Institute of Earth Sciences
entityDescription:
Goals and tasks
The overall objective of the geosciences is to understand the origin and development of the planet Earth from its formation about 4.5 billion years ago until today. The Earth's surface – and thus the human habitat – is constantly changed and reworked by complex interactions between the geosphere, the atmosphere, the hydrosphere and the biosphere. Geologic processes take place on extreme time scales – from picoseconds (as in chemical reactions on mineral surfaces) to billions of years (as in plate tectonics and biological evolution).
The geosciences have particular societal relevance not only for identification and forecasting of geohazards such as volcanic eruptions and earthquakes, but also for understanding the background of current environmental and climate change issues: the near and distant future of the earth can be predicted from the record of the geologic past. Geosciences play a central role in answering questions about the impact of humans on "system Earth", the resilience of ecosystems or the availability of natural resources. Geoscientists therefore do not only conduct basic research, but apply their research in practical manner, in particular on topics relating to sustainable environmental development and the supply of raw materials.
Research
The focus of research at the Heidelberg Institute of Earth Sciences is in the fields of solid Earth (including mineralogy, petrology, isotope geology ,and sedimentology), cosmochemistry, environmental geochemistry, paleoenvironment and paleoclimate research, paleontology, and archeometry. These research groups emphasize analyzing processes both qualitatively and quantitatively using state-of-the-art technology and instrumentation. The high analytical competence of geoscientific research in Heidelberg is demonstrated by the 2014 commissioning of the national laboratory for secondary ion mass spectrometry.

entityDescription: OKAPI:Orbits is a young, spin-off start up from the Institute of Space Systems of the Technische Universität Braunschweig. We provide access to state-of-the-art tools for: • Object propagation, including uncertainty propagation, • Pass prediction, • Initial Orbit Determination (Gibb’s, Herrick-Gibb’s, GTDS), • Statistical Orbit Determination (Weighted Least Squares, Extended Kalman Filter, Unscented Kalman Filter), • Conjunction analysis, • Manoeuvre suggestion (under development). All our routines have been developed under scientific standards at the Institute of Space Systems, TU Braunschweig, and will be available using a simple-to-implement Representational State Transfer (REST) interface. Especially the last point brings some distinct advantages to our users: • It’s easy to integrate into software written in any programming language. • You only subscribe for the services you need. If all you want is to predict satellite passes that is all you get, and all you pay for. • There is no long training needed: All interfaces and processes are lean and well designed, so you can focus on your work. • You don’t need expensive hardware to run your requests. Everything runs in the cloud, on safe and secure servers. If that is no option for you, of course the server can run anywhere you like. • Last-but-not-least: Everything can be fully customized. All this is possible thanks to the system running in the background: our data stream management system (DSMS), called Picard. Compared to conventional database management systems, DSMS continuously expect incoming data streams, just as they continuously provide outgoing data, while being optimized to control data flow and processing. This brings the great advantage that processes how to handle certain incoming data can be defined dynamically within the system. While in the current step of our development, the processes are already defined within the system, in future releases this will bring the possibility to define any process based on all components included in our software – which exceeds the list of tools named above. Alongside to providing our software, we provide expert knowledge in the area of space situational awareness, with a focus on Space Surveillance and Tracking, sensor network design and optimization, and Space Debris Mitigation Guideline and Standards compliance.
