Everything runs in the cloud, on safe and secure servers. If that is no option for you, of course the server can run anywhere you like. • Last-but-not-least: Everything can be fully customized. All this is possible thanks to the system running in the background: our data stream management system (DSMS), called Picard. Compared to conventional database management systems, DSMS continuously expect incoming data streams, just as they continuously provide outgoing data, while being optimized to control data flow and processing. This brings the great advantage that processes how to handle certain incoming data can be defined dynamically within the system. While in the current step of our development, the processes are already defined within the system, in future releases this will bring the possibility to define any process based on all components included in our software – which exceeds the list of tools named above. Alongside to providing our software, we provide expert knowledge in the area of space situational awareness, with a focus on Space Surveillance and Tracking, sensor network design and optimization, and Space Debris Mitigation Guideline and Standards compliance.

They are an enabler of high tech AI adoption and exploitation, leveraging extensive experience across diverse industries in both the Asian and European markets. Specializing in space and Earth Observation, Space Cybersecurity, Space Engineering, Robotics, Natural Language Processing, Prediction Analysis, Image Processing, Voice Cloning, and more, they bring cutting-edge solutions to the forefront.

One of DDE's key strengths lies in its ability to enhance and optimize deep learning algorithms, ensuring seamless operation on current edge devices, including satellites. Moreover, their commitment to developing fully data-driven, customized AI solutions and services sets them apart in terms of accuracy, speed, and cost-effectiveness without disrupting existing systems.
DDE leverages its AI deployment success in South Korea to enter the overseas market, offering tech transfer to similar industrial sectors. With a minimal R&D footprint, DDE's strategy capitalizes on its technical advantage, contrasting with competitors engaged in ongoing AI development efforts.

They are pioneers in technology diplomacy, fostering connections between Asia, EU and US markets. Backed by a global team of over 40 international professionals, DDE's mission is clear: leverage our cutting-edge assets in data sciences, encompassing ML/AI and Quantum technologies, to address the evolving demands of leading industries across Asia, EU and US.

entityDescription:
The business vision of Automaton is about “Improving productivity and asset performance 
with automation”. 
In other words, we automate the machines our customers use. We do this by retrofitting 
our equipment to our customers' machines and making them remotely operable. 
Our solution consists of hardware and software components. The guidance of the 
equipment will be handled via Galileo HAS satellite guidance and OSNMA authorization. 
Our business model is based on a service model. Instead of one time equipment sale we 
provide a full service to our customers, including installation and continuous user support. 
Our pricing model is based on a monthly invoiced contract.
Our customers will not be required to make a sizable investment to install our equipment. 
It will be relatively low entry / low risk to opt for our service. 
AT 1 product i.e. our first and currently only product will be meant for heavy duty rollers 
which are used in construction sites to level the site and make the ground compact enough 
to build on (roads, construction sites etc). 
Our co-founders, Aapo, Tuomo, and Sami, bring to the table a perfect blend of technical 
expertise, business acumen, and practical experience. Aapo, with over a decade in 
automation and robotics entrepreneurship, provides the technical backbone, while 
Tuomo's years of experience in high-tech sales and delivery ensure a customer-centric 
approach. Sami, with his hands-on experience with various machines, adds invaluable 
practical insights to onsite installation and delivery of the equipment.
We're not just automating machines; we're constructing the future of work, brick by brick, 
one automated machine at a time. Welcome to Automaton, where innovation meets 
application.

entityDescription: At Riverkin, we sell smart water management solutions. description: ISQ has a presence over the entire space supply chain, and actual working interaction with most of the leading European actors, either the industrial ones such as ArianeGroup, Arianespace, Avio or Thales Alenia Space, either the institutional ones such ESA or CNES. In the upstream side of the supply chain, we have a track record of R&D activities of Space hardware up to TRL6, namely through verification by testing and analysis, Quality Assurance support and testing of space segment equipment and subsystems, Life Cycle Assessments of materials, processes and propellants, and we are the single Portuguese entity with a permanent team at the European Space Center in Kourou for more than 15 years, working every day at the Ground Segment and Space Segment (Ariane 5, Vega, Soyuz) in Assembly, Integration, Quality Assurance, and Safety Assurance activities. In the Downstream, we are developing earth observation services to monitor infrastructures and assess mineral resources for our industrial clients.
entityDescription: The ISQ is a private Portuguese entity, established in 1965 ISQ has more than 50 years of history, having a multitude of technical capabilities, with employees all over the world, taking the technical expertise to the client all over the world. ISQ acts on both vertical and transversal areas, and thus is capable of providing a customized service in different engineering fields; “vertical” Technical Expertise: in the different fields of Mechanical, Civil and Electrical Engineering, Technical Inspections, Laboratories, Health and Safety, Environment, Energy, and Quality Systems. “transversal” Technical Expertise: Research and Development, Vocational Training,. ISQ main markets are the following ones:Energy; Process industries;Construction & Infrastructures;Automotive;Aeronautics;Space;Big Science (CERN, ESO,ITER). entityDescription:
L-TEK d.o.o. is a medium-sized company that has a long tradition in the field of design and manufacturing of electronic circuit. They have specific knowledge, gained through experience and customers feedbacks. All that enables the development of complex electronic circuits (PCBs) suitable for the most demanding applications. L-Tek is a competent provider of IoT solutions and developer of medical devices. The company has in recent years intensively invested in the development and automation of manufacturing processes, IT software technologies, robotics and the development of its own products. L-Tek specializes in prototyping for high-tech products of small and medium series. They have capability of covering all phases in the product life cycle - from PCB design, software development, manufacturing, assembly to testing and delivery - according to the needs of the electronics, Internet of Things, medicine, and manufacturing segments.
Based on extensive knowledge and rich experience, they can develop, design, and manufacture all types of electronic solutions and appropriate software - from conceptual design to implementation. Their clients are high-tech companies to which they offer consulting, design, development, and production of development boards, and provide products to software companies that do not have the necessary experience in hardware design. L-Tek also supports companies in their start-up phase and guide them from the production of the first prototypes to the implementation of larger production series. L-Tek partners receive complete solutions or just an individual service in all phases of the production and design process.
All processes are performed in a suitable ESD protected area in compliance to the highest standards of quality for our development and manufacturing processes. Therefore L-Tek is ISO 13485, ISO 9001,ISO 14001, RoHS 3 and REACH certified.
L-TEK is a stable and healthy Slovenian company, which is also reflected in its operating results, which were above average for the industry and size of companies in which it operates. The company has over 100 employees.

entityDescription:
Stiftelsen Seilskipet Statsraad Lehmkuhl is a nonprofit foundation primarily aims to preserve the sailing ship 'Statsraad Lehmkuhl' for future generations and provide it with a dignified purpose of use that aligns with the ship's tradition, including maritime vocational training. On 15th April 2023, the Norwegian tall ship, Statsraad Lehmkuhl, returned to Bergen from a 20- months circumnavigation of the globe during her “One Ocean Expedition 2021 – 2023”. The expedition is a recognized part of the UN´s Ocean Decade of Ocean Science for Sustainable Development.The main goal of the expedition was to “create attention and share knowledge about the crucial role of the Ocean for a sustainable development in a global perspective”, and therein a special focus on SDG 14 and SDG 13. The expedition was also a brilliant showcase of SDG17 with a strong and dedicated partnership with more the 40 partners from public sector, education, research, innovation and commerce.
Wherever the ship sailed it created massive attention around the main goal. In ports, the ship served for conferences, receptions, high- level meetings and diplomacy. At sea, the ship served as a floating university, bringing on board students and scientists from all over the world to discuss and study Ocean matters. On board, everyone works together to sail the ship and gather experience and knowledge about the ocean and each other.
As part of the preparations to the expedition, the ship was equipped with state of the art research instruments, and the ship has since served as a sail training – and research vessel. More advanced research instruments and a new laboratory will be installed in 2024

Wherever the ship sailed it created massive attention around the main goal. In ports, the ship served for conferences, receptions, high- level meetings and diplomacy. At sea, the ship served as a floating university, bringing on board students and scientists from all over the world to discuss and study Ocean matters. On board, everyone works together to sail the ship and gather experience and knowledge about the ocean and each other.
As part of the preparations to the expedition, the ship was equipped with state of the art research instruments, and the ship has since served as a sail training – and research vessel. More advanced research instruments and a new laboratory will be installed in 2024

Filiale à 100% du Groupe ADP depuis 2017, Hologarde a été créée pour répondre à un double enjeu : maîtriser le trafic des drones au sein des espaces aériens contrôlés et protéger les sites critiques de la menace des drones.

entityDescription:
HDES Service & Engineering is a small engineering company founded in February 2018 but with activities going back to 2011. It is active in advanced energy storage systems, both pneumatic and electrical. The company is currently located within the ESA Space Business Innovation Centre in Noordwijk. The main technology in the pneumatic field is the Cool Gas Generator (CGG) technology. With this, HDES builds on the work on CGG Technologies BV and CGG Safety & Systems BV that have been active in Cool Gas Generator Development since 2011.

HDES Service & Engineering has an experienced technical and management team with vast experience in technology development. The team is complemented with a pool of experts that are available for insourcing. The knowledge is documented in reports, tests results, drawings, design descriptions, plans and procedures. HDES considers its team’s specific skills and knowledge and its documentation as the core of its competencies.

HDES has built up a fully independent infrastructure to design, develop and test Cool Gas Generators. That includes the possibility to compute chemical reactions needed to design a propellant and pilot production facilities for grain production. Furthermore, it has analysis and CAD tools to design the CGG and the systems around it and a test facility with a high-speed data acquisition system to test CGGs.

HDES is currently engaged in developing two applications for the Cool Gas Generator: an oxygen generator for breathing applications and a CO2 generator for maritime safety applications.

The present experience of HDES includes:
(1) Complex technical product development, including testing verification and certification
(2) Prototype building and testing both in Cool Gas Generator
(3) Design and development of test structures, including instrumentation, control and data acquisition
(4) Energy storage systems, both electrical as well as chemical and pneumatic
(5) Electrical systems design, development and testing
(6) Development of ignition systems that work at very low temperatures
(7) Modelling and characterization of physical processes
(8) Corporate strategy and financial management
(9) Energy and marine market

Projects and activities where HDES personnel has been involved include:
(1) Product development of Oxygen Cool Gas Generators for breathing apparatus
(2) Product development of a CO2 generator for maritime safety applications
(3) Product development of CO2 and other CGGs for space applications
(4) Development of Cool Gas Generators for four space missions, which have operated successfully in space onboard the Proba-2, Delfi N3xT, InflateSail and RemoveDebris satellites

entityDescription:
Evenor-tech was created in 2009 as a spin-off from Spanish National Research Council. Today, Evenor is a consolidated technology-based company focused on Research, Development and Innovation consultancy for data management, land evaluation, agriculture, ecosystem services and global change, by using statistics techniques, GIS, Earth observations and other co-creative methodologies such as Community of Practice and Digital Marketing.

Evenor participates in European, national and regional strong networks on earth observation, soils, water, ecosystem services and geo-information. Some of them are Copernicus Relay, Global and European Soil Partnership, European Hydropedological Data Inventory from JRC, FORSYS COST Action and REDIAM which represents the Regional Focal point of Andalusia (south of Spain) for the European network of information and observation on the environment (EIONET) promoted and coordinated by the European Environment Agency. In addition, Evenor is always participating at the H2020 program, which increases our networking capacities with reference European centers such as WUR, BOKU and INRA.

The firm has specific experience on environmental and soil data management (database architecture, harmonizing and standardizing), modeling and simulation of land process and conducting scenario analysis, artificial intelligence, ecosystem services analysis, policy advice thanks to the broad experience and multidisciplinary nature of the team.

In the field of data management and processing, statistical techniques such as machine learning or artificial intelligence provide a better solution for huge environmental databases and facilitate the interoperability among different data sources. Evenor has experience on data management and the application of these techniques in several projects such as the European project RECARE, OPERA and CONSOLE. In these projects, we developed pilot’s studies in representative benchmark soil of the Mediterranean region, in order to model ecological processes (regulation of soil contamination, regulation of climate change, regulation of soil water retention, etc) and then up-scale at European results. In addition, close collaboration with academic centers and universities allows the firm to update the statistical techniques and methodologies and improve its capacities.

Regarding the involvement of key actors, Evenor provides experience on Community of Practice development and Digital Marketing applied in R+D+I projects. The CoP approach allows the identification of key players and promotes the exchange of knowledge. This approach is very useful to compile information or opinions from different perspectives. The combination of this approach with Digital Marketing facilitates the increase of numbers of participants through trends analysis and the improvement of communication strategy.

Company description: Irreo is an irrigation automation system with crop monitoring by satellite.
Irreo is a system that allows automatic and efficient management of irrigation on all sectors of a cultivated plot of land, combining an irrigation automation system and a satellite monitoring service for crops and their water requirements without the installation of probes or sensors.
Our algorithms analyse maps from various satellite constellations, both public and private, on a daily basis to estimate the actual evapotranspiration of the crops and provide water to the plants in the right amount and at the right time interval to meet their water needs.
To this end, we have designed and developed electronic control units that, connected to the irrigation system, autonomously manage the flow of water, respecting the constraints and programmes imposed by the farmer, so as to calibrate the irrigation process according to the water needs of each sector of the field.
With Irreo, users can:
- monitor the health, growth and water requirements of crops in the various plots;
- receive an optimal and realistic irrigation schedule for the crops on its field, taking into account the water requirements of the plants on the various sectors, the constraints of the irrigation system, and the user's preferences in terms of rotations and strategies;
- automatically start irrigation, distributing the right amount of water at the right time interval, leaving the user the possibility of managing the system remotely (motor pump, filters, solenoid valves...) through our simple app and thus being able to increase crop yields while reducing working hours, costs and consumption.
With Irreo, the farm can:
- Increase crop yields: produce more with the same amount of water used, also improving the quality of the harvest and reducing the risk of damage or loss;
- increase the work productivity of its employees;
- optimise water use, thereby reducing the energy costs associated with irrigation activities;
- keep crop health under control;
- remotely manage the irrigation system and monitor its proper functioning;
- save on the purchase and maintenance costs of soil moisture sensors.

entityDescription:
Ezentis was set up in 1959, initially dedicated to the operation of power installations in Spain. Ezentis was floated in the Stock Market in October 1988 and started its international expansion into the Latin American market. Initially it centred on Chile to fulfil a major contract with Telefonica. Afterwards, operated in Brazil, Peru, Argentina, Colombia, Mexico, Portugal and Germany. It focused its business mainly on the engineering, operation and maintenance of telecommunications and energy network infrastructures, as well as on providing technological solutions for the infrastructures.

After a restructuring plan that took place in 2023, Ezentis currently focuses its operations in Spain on three main areas:
· Communications engineering. This area covers activities such as engineering, design, planning and maintenance of communication systems.
· Security engineering: engineering, installation and maintenance of integrated security systems.
· Technology. This area covers activities such as engineering, design, architecture, consultancy and development of both Systems and Networks, IoT technological solutions for the monitoring of industrial environments, design and manufacturing of communication busters, manufacturing of GIS localization systems and others.

PROFILE
modostudio | cibinel laurenti martocchia architetti associati, located in Rome, is a multidisciplinary practice of architecture, urban planning and industrial design. Profiting from the diversified skills of the founding partners and the continual collaboration with experts from various fields, modostudio combines architectural theory, research, innovation and experimentation with high technical knowledge and professionalism. Established at the end of 2006 by three principal architects, Fabio Cibinel, Roberto Laurenti, and Giorgio Martocchia, after many years of collaborating with internationally acclaimed architects like Massimiliano Fuksas, Piero Sartogo, Erik Van Egeraat and Kas Oosterhuis, modostudio in a short time was awarded and shortlisted in many international architectural competitions. Modostudio partners have been teaching architecture at Cornell University, faculty of architecture in 2008, 2013, 2016, 2018 and 2024, sustainable design at Inarch postgraduate master between 2010 and 2016 and architectural design at IED - European Institute of Design in Rome between 2011 and 2015. Modostudio works have been published in a wide range of specialist literature and exhibited in the Italian Pavillion at 16th and 13th Architecture Biennale (2018, 2012) in Venice, at the 5th Biennale of Public Space in Rome in 2019 and in the Italian Pavillon at Shanghai Expo 2010. Modostudio works have been selected and awarded in several architecture awards including the Rigenera 2022 Awards, the International Prize for Sustainable Architecture 2015, the IQU Award 2015, the KlimaHaus Awards 2015 and 2016, the 27/37 Italian young architects award.DESIGN APPROACHModostudio works are characterized for using experimental and innovative construction materials, which has allowed the studio to acquire a deep experience in the field of construction.

The design approach starts from the analysis of the context, in order to develop innovative proposals, at the same time deeply linked to the territory features.
The studio specializes in buildings design with high technological complexity thanks to an integrated process that involves all the necessary professional skills from the earliest stages of design, pursuing the highest environmental and energy performance certifications.
The entire design process, from the concept phase to the construction design, is constantly monitored and controlled by the use of three-dimensional modeling softwares, with a workflow that is able to operate in BIM methodology, also providing the possibility of VR (virtual reality) enviroment settings.

A focus on the energy and functional building retrofitting led the office to be highly specialized in the design reuse of existing buildings.

Company description: Ukatemi Technologies is a focused, professional engineering company with expertise and demonstrated experience providing high quality and unique cybersecurity services to its Customers. We approach problems with an engineering attitude. We enjoy dissecting things to understand them better, we are excited by designing new solutions, we care about small details in implementation, and we always strive for quality. Our motto is„Driven by challenges”,that means we aim to apply our expertise in protecting applications, systems and services that require high quality of service, reliability and security, and in specific areas where there are no well-developed solutions yet.

Ukatemi was founded in 2012 as a spin-off company of the renowned CrySyS Lab (Laboratory of Cryptography and System Security) of the Budapest University of Technology and Economics. Ukatemi is an independent SME based in Budapest, Hungary.

Our capabilities include evaluating cybersecurity posture, penetration testing and vulnerability assessment, reverse engineering, security by design (systems and processes), incident response, computer forensics, malware analysis, fine-tuning SIEM/SOC solutions as well as designing and performing practice-oriented cybersecurity training and exercises both in IT and OT (ICS/SCADA) environment. We have strong experience in the field of malware analysis and cyber-physical systems security.

Each Ukatemi engineer is an established and skilled professional. Our staff has been involved in the detection and analysis of several publicized targeted malware attacks (including Duqu, Flame, MiniDuke, TeamSpy), custom-tested anti-APT tools, played key roles in large-scale incident management, security and vulnerability assessment and security evaluation of critical information infrastructures; we have provided support to many IT security experts worldwide. Our team of qualified experts has the professional skills and experience needed to deliver the high quality and efficient performance of the activities described in this proposal.

We have:

·deep and robust knowledge in malware analysis, de-obfuscation techniques, and reverse-engineering;
·widespread experience in cyber-physical systems, especially in industrial control systems (including oil and gas; electricity and nuclear power; utility; production; IoT; automotive and transportation);
·access to private malware and threat intelligence feeds and repositories, as well as our own malware repository with more than 600 million malware samples and a collection of 10 million public key certificates;
·custom sandbox environments and malware laboratory, including custom tools;
·experience with various cyber threats including targeted attacks (APTs);

entityDescription:
Founded in 2013, Iconem is currently active in around fifty countries to promote the conservation of cultural heritage threatened by looting, urbanization, mass tourism, armed conflicts, and climate change. Its team of approximately 20 people develops large-scale 3D scanning solutions for natural and cultural sites, enabling their recording at very high resolution. Since its inception, the company has been committed to heritage preservation in partnership with international organizations, governments and municipalities, or internationally renowned museums such as UNESCO, the Aga Khan Trust for Culture, the Sultanate of Oman, the City of Paris, or the Louvre Museum. Its 3D models of monuments, urban or rural heritage on a large scale, and its training programs dedicated to professionals facilitate the essential work of conservation and restoration experts.

Resulting from its partnership with Inria and Microsoft Research, Iconem's technology is based on AI and its computer vision algorithms, enabling us to become a leader in photorealistic 3D scanning of cultural heritage sites. The use of AI for the preservation and promotion of cultural heritage is a rapidly growing field, and collaboration between technology companies, cultural institutions, and researchers is essential to harness the potential of AI in real-time detection of heritage destruction. Real-time monitoring of the conservation status and dynamics of destruction of global cultural heritage is now made possible by the use of satellite imagery and automated change detection technologies.

Our methodological approach consists of a complete chain for the protection of endangered cultural heritage sites, including active monitoring through site observation, identifying risks, and their prevention, detection and characterization of damage, and potential preventive measures, as well as for conservation/restoration.

entityDescription: Specto Photonics is an Italian deep-tech start-up aiming to democratize access to Brillouin Spectroscopy by developing and commercializing high-rejection Rayleigh common-path optical filters and miniaturized spectrometers for Brillouin spectroscopy using Silicon Photonics and more. Brillouin Spectroscopy allows the optical measurement of a material's mechanical properties (e.g. stiffness and viscosity) in a non-destructive manner, at high optical resolution and without physical contact. Specto's flagship product, ALBA, will provide significant advantages over current technologies in terms of ease of use, portability, production costs, and performance. The Rayleigh high-rejection filter, BIPD, supports the existing Brillouin setups to eliminate the unwanted and overwhelming Rayleigh backscattering, significantly improving the signal-to-noise ratio, permitting the application of the technique to turbid media like milk and bones. This filter boasts impressive optical rejection capabilities exceeding 45dB. Its first demonstrator has already been fabricated in-house, and the first product prototype is under fabrication. This side product is being developed modularly, allowing it to be utilized independently of ALBA. These competitive advantages will provide unprecedented capabilities for the life sciences, chemistry, and material science sectors and, eventually, medical diagnostics.

entityDescription:
tec4U GmbH (tec4U) was founded in 1999. In 2003, the company was awarded the "Gründer Champions" prize at the German Founder and Entrepreneur Days. This was followed in 2010 by the "IT Innovation Award" in the "Saarland State Winner" category at CeBIT for the "CoChecker" software. The company's business activities are geared towards the international market. Quality management is certified in accordance with DIN EN ISO 9001. In October 2013, tec4U GmbH was split into two divisions: tec4U-Ingenieurgesellschaft mbH and tec4U-Solutions GmbH, with the former offering software solutions in the fields of freight forwarding management and automotive. One focus of tec4U is the development of telemetry and telematics systems based on their experience in the field of vehicle dynamics analysis and Car2x communication. 
The company operates based on many years of engineering know-how and the broadest possible database in combination with the possibilities of BIG Data Analytics. The main business goal is to provide customers with all necessary information about their driving units in such a way that they can determine the most cost-efficient combination of vehicle, route and driving specifications for the job on hand – in a comprehensible and reproducible manner. Based on the successful application of the in-house telemetry system "Entruck" for several logistics companies throughout Europe, tec4U has obtained a significant vehicle database that is unique in the field of transport logistics in terms of data resolution, quality and variety. "Entruck” enables manufacturer-independent, standardized, and permanent monitoring of safety and maintenance-relevant vehicle parameters. Using secure data transmission available throughout Europe, over fifty different vehicle parameters can be collected, processed, and reported back to the truck operator in real time, without loss and in high data resolution. tec4U’s consultancy services are based on this data set and provide support in the fields of driving efficiency assessment and emissions analysis. The project team consists of engineers, software developers and business associates with many years of experience in the field of transportation logistics, as well as in the administration of subsidized measures.

entityDescription:
The satellite market is booming, with projections of over 60,000 orbiting objects by 2030. However, strong sustainability challenges arise as satellites have a short lifespan, resulting in overcrowded orbits and $1 trillion worth of value loss due to inoperative assets. In-Orbit Services (IOS) like refueling, repairing, and life extension are proven to be the solution for the expanding satellite population. However, current IOS prototypes face hurdles due to limited autonomy and tailored mission focus, resulting in a lack of scalability and economic inefficiency. A shift towards multi-mission capabilities is crucial to forming a self-sustained space ecosystem, enabling cost reductions and wider market access.

SPAICE pioneered leveraging Generative AI and Deep Reinforcement Learning to develop the first fully autonomous solution to enable In-Orbit Services at scale. Our proprietary software tools enable autonomous navigation and multitasking robotic services and integrate with existing satellites to improve their capabilities. Our software is delivered through a plug-and-play servicing platform including sensors, robot arms, and a computing unit. As a modular payload, our platform is ready to be integrated into any existing satellite, transforming it into a functional in-orbit servicer. Spaice is the first universal AI-based solution for space services, agnostic to any target satellite and capable of performing several robotic operations.

Our primary clients are satellite manufacturers, as our focus involves integrating our robotic platform with their satellite buses to convert them into servicers. We sell them our robotic kit and software charged as a one-time license. These servicers will be used to provide services to constellation operators, for which we will charge a periodic fee. Providers of IOS missions represent an additional sales stream. These companies currently perform in-orbit rendezvous and docking demonstrations with individual targets and aim to scale their services to multiple missions. Our multitask kit is the perfect solution to enable their scalability.

entityName: European Center for Geodynamics and Seismology
entityDescription:
The ECGS was created in Luxembourg on June 13th, 1988 (as published in the Memorial “C” N.41- February 15, 1989, pp 1936-1938) in accord with the Accord Partiel Ouvert (APO) established by Governments from the States Member of the European Council.
This APO, concerning prevention, protection and assistance organization against technological and major natural risks (Agreement EUR-OPA on Major Risks) has passed the Resolution (87) 2 from the 2ndof March 1987, in which European Community Commission and the UNESCO, the Health World Organization and the Humanitary Affairs Department from the United Nations took part.
On May 17th, 1994, a Convention was signed in-between ECGS and the Grand Duchy of Luxembourg, defining the following tasks for which the ECGS will be supported:
- To promote programs in Geodynamics Research, related to the study of Tectonics Distortions in connection with Earthquakes,with a particular emphasize on Space Techniques.
- To improve the relationship between specialists from different scientific disciplines by supporting regular meetings as part of the Journées Luxembourgeoises de Géodynamique (JLG), and also by encouraging colloquia and workshops.
- To equip the Underground Geodynamics Laboratory in Walferdange with the necessary scientific and technical equipment for the study of deformation in a tectonically active zone, in order to test its performance in an aseismic site.
- To undertake these specific actions in a scientific interest.
The Grand Duchy of Luxembourgprovides annual support to:
- Cover the cost of the permanent staff
- Organize the Journées Luxembourgeoises de Geodynamique (JLG)
- Colloquia and workshops related to geodynamics and seismology
- Support will also be provided to cover the cost of publishing the “Cahiers de l’ECGS” and

One of Canada’s oldest and most prestigious universities, St. Francis Xavier is consistently ranked the best undergraduate university in Canada.
The first university in Canada to have a formal Service Learning program, StFX values community development, social justice and global awareness. They are home to the internationally-recognized Coady International Institute, and students find leadership development opportunities here that they can apply in all aspects of their lives. Students who are committed to and embody these values thrive at StFX.
Their close-knit residence environment is at the heart of the StFX experience. Students live and learn together in a thriving academic environment. They have a wide variety of fascinating programs to choose from in the faculties of Arts, Science and Education, and within the Gerald Schwartz School of Business.
Their 45,000 worldwide alumni are a strong and engaged community, and provide a valuable network for graduating students.
At StFX, they are excited about where they are, and where they're headed. Today StFX is one of Canada’s very best universities; known for their exceptional academic programs, focus on leadership development and commitment to social justice and community development.
Founded in 1853, St. Francis Xavier has a long and proud tradition as one of Canada’s oldest universities. For almost 165 years, they have cultivated our strong and resilient spirit, dedication to intellectual rigour, and commitment to engaging students who aspire to be community-minded citizens of the world. Piql Iberia was born in Barcelona in 2016 by a group of Information Management professionals to help organizations better manage their information, whether anological or digital, through a coherent and innovative use of information technologies, adapting them to the reality of each user. With a presence in Barcelona, Madrid and Lisbon itself, the adoption of digital technology has been promoted in various fields, both public and private and in sectors such as Public Administration, Culture, Energy, Engineering or Education, among others.

This vision led Piql Iberia to initiate several projects of development of its own tools, integration of open source software and representation of third-party technologies that allow to cover the entire life cycle of the information, from its creation to the moment that it has to be saved to ensure future accessibility. 

These tools include file management, advanced document management, publishing, digital preservation and digitization solutions. The development of tools based on artificial intelligence techniques for improving information gathering processes or for the most accurate exploitation of available information has been one of the lines of work since the company's inception and have already been used in real projects successfully.

Finally, as part of information management projects, digitization, information capture, archival description and consulting services have been designed to help the faster and easier adoption of digital technologies.

As an important part of this project, an agreement was reached with the Norwegian company Piql AS for the exclusive representation of its digital preservation solutions, an agreement that remains in force and through which projects have been carried out in various public and private institutions.

entityDescription:
ISPTech is a spin-off from the German Aerospace Center's (DLR's) Institute of Space Propulsion. We offer efficient, reliable and affordable thrusters and propulsion systems for spacecraft based on so-called green propellants.

As result of more than 10 years of research and development work at the German Aerospace Centre (DLR), ISPTech commercialises the developed propulsion technologies that operate with green (non-toxic) propellants. 
ISPTech’s spacecraft propulsion systems are characterized by a high efficiency, reliability and allow cost reductions up to a factor of 10 compared to conventional systems. The cost reductions are made possible by the use of green propellants, which offer significant advantages in terms of operationally simplicity, safety and handling. In addition, significantly shorter delivery times and cost benefits result from the production of the components using additive manufacturing, the simplified testing of the propulsion system and the use of standard components.

entityDescription:
The University of Toulouse is one of the oldest higher education institutions in Europe, dating back several centuries. Currently, it is recognized as one of the leading universities in France, with a strong reputation for academic excellence and contributions to scientific research. The university is spread across several campuses in the city of Toulouse and its surroundings. One notable characteristic of the University of Toulouse is its strong tradition of multidisciplinarity. It offers a wide range of study programs in various fields, from sciences and engineering to arts and humanities. This diversity allows students to explore different areas of interest and benefit from a rich and varied educational experience. The university also stands out for its international partnerships and collaborations with prestigious institutions worldwide. These alliances provide students and researchers with opportunities to engage in collaborative projects and exchange ideas with experts from diverse backgrounds.
Furthermore, the University of Toulouse is deeply committed to innovative research. It hosts numerous renowned research laboratories where researchers work on innovative projects in a multitude of fields, from medicine to aerospace to social sciences. The ANITI institute, dedicated to artificial intelligence, is one of the most important project coordinated by the University of Toulouse. Gathering about 200 reserachers, it covers research, innovation and education in trustworthy AI for several applications domains such as aeronautics, automobile, industry 4.0, environment, health.

entityDescription:
EnduroSat S.a.r.l (Luxembourg) was established as a specialized branch of EnduroSat Group to serve the Luxembourgish market and international clients by providing high expertise of mission management. It aims to develop and commercialize a streamlined mission management service for the future markets of earth observation (EO) and satellite communication (SatCom) as well as for satellite constellations in very low and low earth orbits (LEO/VLEO). 
EnduroSat S.a.r.l. services include project management for a satellite platform development, integration and testing, mission design and mission management, and operation of high-performance satellites and customized satellite missions. As part of the EnduroSat Group, Endurosat S.a.r.l. benefits from considerable flight heritage as currently there are more than 500 systems flying in orbit. The satellite platforms, which are developed by EnduroSat Group are software-defined and in-flight configurable – the parameters of the satellite can be updated in orbit according to the customer’s needs. The unique features of EnduroSat’s platforms include:
• Plug & play on hardware and software level
• In-orbit configurability and update capability
• Multiple hardware and software redundancies
EnduroSat S.a.r.l, as a newly established branch, leverages the existing expertise of the EnduroSat Group which has built a solid experience by providing solutions for many successful projects. It has designed and engineered class-leading satellite systems and platforms which have been featured by the Small Spacecraft Technology State of the Art report of NASA.Our products and services include: Satellite platforms (including ESAP class satellites), Communication modules, Antennas, Onboard Computers, Power modules, Solar panels, Structures, Ground support equipment, Custom modules, Flatsats, Constellation service, Satellites as a Service, SpaceDev, SpaceOps.

SmartEnds offers a range of products aimed at revolutionizing waste management and recycling processes. Some of SmartEnds' key products include:
- BrighterBins: A smart waste management solution that provides real-time fill level monitoring for waste bins. This helps optimize waste collection routes, reduce operational costs, and prevent overflowing bins.

- Track & Trace: A GPS tracking system for waste collection vehicles and bins, offering real-time data insights and transparency in waste management operations. It helps reduce CO2 emissions, improve efficiency, and ensure accountability.

- Vision AI: An AI-powered solution for automated waste sorting and recycling. Using advanced image recognition technology, Vision AI identifies and categorizes different types of waste materials, enabling more efficient recycling processes and waste diversion from landfills.

These products combine innovative IoT technology, data analytics, and AI algorithms to address the challenges faced in waste management and recycling, providing efficient, cost-effective, and sustainable solutions for businesses and municipalities.

entityDescription: ADAPTA Studio is a spinoff of Politecnico di Milano that has made 3D accessible to everyone through the development of algorithms for the optimization and management of models, spaces, and scans, patented and usable through a Cloud service. ADAPTA has designed a cloud service, "AMAZ3D," to democratize the use and distribution of 3D models, spaces, and scans (hereinafter referred to as 3D assets) to meet the growing demand for digital content. In fact, one of the main challenges in the field of 3D applications (Gaming, CAD, Digital Twin, Training, etc.) today is to have real-time interactions with the highest possible graphical performance. ADAPTA has developed innovative algorithms that significantly reduce the polygon count and weight of 3D assets while maintaining the quality and final graphical performance as much as possible, making it usable on any type of device (PC, smartphone, tablet, headsets, etc.) with a focus on digital multichannel for the end user (Web, Mobile, Augmented and Virtual Reality) with optimal performance. Furthermore, AMAZ3D not only optimizes the 3D model but also manages the entire document flow (storage, versioning, sharing, etc.) through a repository and a 3D viewer integrable into apps and third-party systems. The company is currently evolving AMAZ3D to also support next-generation 3D tools for the automatic reconstruction of three-dimensional assets based on artificial intelligence techniques such as NERF/Gaussian Splatting.

ADAPTA has developed innovative algorithms that significantly reduce the polygon count and weight of 3D assets while maintaining the quality and final graphical performance as much as possible, making it usable on any type of device (PC, smartphone, tablet, headsets, etc.) with a focus on digital multichannel for the end user (Web, Mobile, Augmented and Virtual Reality) with optimal performance. Furthermore, AMAZ3D not only optimizes the 3D model but also manages the entire document flow (storage, versioning, sharing, etc.) through a repository and a 3D viewer integrable into apps and third-party systems. entityDescription:
Pileus Scandinavia, further in the text called Pileus, is a newly started company that aims to bring new technology from Luleå University of Technology, regarding ice detection and forecast for ice formation on wind turbines, to the market.
The technology has been validated during two winter seasons together with Vattenfall and Statkraft and has proven to be superior to other technology available today. Pileus technology is able to detect 97% of cases, which can be compared to today's system that can handle 2%.
Being able to detect with very high accuracy and accuracy when ice begins to accumulate on wind turbines and being able to provide a forecast of what the risk looks like for the next 24 hours provides very great benefits for wind power producers. The advantages concern both electricity production, security and pricing linked to the common electricity market, Nord Pool. Energy losses due to ice and snow can amount to 10-15% of total production during a winter, i.e. large energy loss and reduced revenues for owners of wind farms.
By using Pileus technology, this figure can be greatly reduced and electricity production optimized by using our forecast for weather and icing.

entityDescription:
With the advent of large launchers, the price of cargo to low Earth orbit has plummeted to new lows. Soon, a future in which cargo prices from here to LEO are the same as from here to Shenzhen seems possible. This opens up the prospect of using space as a place for economic activity, not just for data, telecommunications or images, but also for physical goods and materials. Space is indeed a very attractive place to do this: the absence of gravity opens up drastically simpler synthesis routes for a range of chemical, physical and biological compounds, while the environment provides infinite free energy, heat, cold and quasi-perfect vacuum - commodities that would require drastic amounts of energy on Earth.
As attractive as this vision is, the current state of technology stands in the way of this future. In fact, with the exception of the launcher, the entire space technology stack in use today is still based on paradigms from over half a century ago, when space assets were essentially very expensive disposable items. As travel to and from space has become routine, this needs to change to make the entire industry sustainable and resource efficient.
Starflight Dynamics' mission is to provide the enabling technologies to bring industry to space and enable future production there. As such, the company is working to provide the full range of services required, from reusable transport platforms to reusable space cargo containers and, of course, large solar-powered production platforms that will be the production sites of the future. 
Starflight Dynamics will generate revenue from two main sources:
- Once established, the company will build and operate robotic in-orbit production facilities, where customers can run their processes in dedicated production cargo containers.
- Along the way, the company will commercialise the technologies developed for this, from agile and long-endurance platforms to re-entry technologies and the like. To this end, the company has partnered with established industrialists in the field to provide derived products for niche applications.

Our organization was established on the 14th of February 2008.
It was ascribed the name KITION PLANETARIUM & OBSERVATORY.

It is named after the ancient city of Kition which was found in the area where nowadays, the town of Larnaca, Cyprus, is located. For this reason is considered an honorary act on behalf of the local authorities to grant us the permission to utilize the name of this significant landmark as a prefix to the name of our organization.

Our vision is to encourage the awareness among the general public and attract and retain their interest, involvement and contribution into the world of discovery, exploration and wonder.

The mission of our organization is to promote the study, experimentation and information in the fields of astronomy, astrophysics, space science as well as in the fields of other physical and social applied sciences.

The above shall be substantiated in the following potential, practical ways

The construction and operation a digital planetarium with full dome projection with high definition video projection of stereoscopic movies, 3D animation, real time astronomy shows and real time projection of social and cultural events.

entityName: Instytut Geofizyki Polskiej Akademii Nauk (Institute of Geophysics of the Polish Academy of Sciences)
entityDescription:
Institute of Geophysics of the Polish Academy of Sciences - a scientific institute of the Polish Academy of Sciences based in Warsaw, dealing with research and monitoring of geophysical processes. He is a member of the Center for Earth and Planet Research - GeoPlanet. Since 2023, the director of the Institute is prof. Ph.D. Paweł M. Rowiński.
The Institute of Geophysics has been operating since 1953, initially (until 1970) as the Department of Geophysics. In the initial period, research conducted there was limited to selected issues in the field of seismology, physics of the Earth's interior and terrestrial magnetism; other fields of geophysics were gradually added: physics of the atmosphere, ionosphere and magnetosphere, oceanology, planetary geodesy, hydrology.
In the years 1973-1978, some departments separated from the Institute of Geophysics of the Polish Academy of Sciences, creating independent research institutions: the Institute of Oceanology of the Polish Academy of Sciences and the Space Research Center of the Polish Academy of Sciences.
The Institute is currently conducting research in the following areas:
• Seismology - analysis of earthquakes and tremors induced by mining activities, seismicity of the European Union area and more broadly,
• Seismic studies of the lithosphere - the structure and geodynamics of the Earth's crust and upper mantle obtained based on deep seismic soundings and natural seismicity. organization and interpretation of active and passive seismic experiments aimed at identifying the structure of the crust and upper mantle of the Earth,
• Geophysical imaging - development and application of innovative imaging techniques, especially those based on the full wave field, seismic processing, depth imaging and denoising of seismic data.
• Theoretical geophysics – analysis of the physical laws governing geophysical processes and development of mathematical and numerical methods for describing these phenomena,
• Magnetism - development of magnetotelluric research methods, numerical modeling of electromagnetic induction processes in the Earth's interior, regional research on the structure of the Earth's crust, paleomagnetic research and magnetic properties of intrusive and sedimentary rocks,
• Polar and marine research - analysis of geophysical and environmental data obtained at the Polish Polar Station on Spitsbergen and Hornsund, research on changes in abiotic features of the natural environment in the polar zones,
• Hydrology and hydrodynamics – transport and mixing of pollutants in surface waters, modeling of flood wave transformation using hydraulic and hydrological models, modeling of flood risk by implementing the latest achievements of the statistical theory of extreme phenomena, climate change,

The Institute of Geophysics has been operating since 1953, initially (until 1970) as the Department of Geophysics. In the initial period, research conducted there was limited to selected issues in the field of seismology, physics of the Earth's interior and terrestrial magnetism; other fields of geophysics were gradually added: physics of the atmosphere, ionosphere and magnetosphere, oceanology, planetary geodesy, hydrology.
In the years 1973-1978, some departments separated from the Institute of Geophysics of the Polish Academy of Sciences, creating independent research institutions: the Institute of Oceanology of the Polish Academy of Sciences and the Space Research Center of the Polish Academy of Sciences.
The Institute is currently conducting research in the following areas:

• Seismic studies of the lithosphere - the structure and geodynamics of the Earth's crust and upper mantle obtained based on deep seismic soundings and natural seismicity. organization and interpretation of active and passive seismic experiments aimed at identifying the structure of the crust and upper mantle of the Earth,
• Geophysical imaging - development and application of innovative imaging techniques, especially those based on the full wave field, seismic processing, depth imaging and denoising of seismic data.
• Theoretical geophysics – analysis of the physical laws governing geophysical processes and development of mathematical and numerical methods for describing these phenomena,
• Magnetism - development of magnetotelluric research methods, numerical modeling of electromagnetic induction processes in the Earth's interior, regional research on the structure of the Earth's crust, paleomagnetic research and magnetic properties of intrusive and sedimentary rocks,

description:
Swarm Logistics GmbH is a deep-tech company based in Stuttgart, Germany specializing in the development of "Fleet Control" systems, with vehicle based economic AI agents and a blockchain based coordination platform. The company was founded in 2018. 
We create the software technology to fully automate the dynamic coordination & orchestration of heterogeneous fleets with trucks, cars, buses, autonomous vehicles, AGVs & delivery robots in open environments. We are working on a self organizing network of vehicles with a server less infrastructure and edge computing, where vehicles of competing transportation companies can work together with flexible time and location trans-shipments. Vehicles coordinate themselves like swarms. 
We are an experienced team of logistics and IT experts with over 18 years of experience in logistics. Our interdisciplinary team has experience in operations research, artificial intelligence, industry-grade software development, algorithmic securities trading and game theory. 
We work with the world’s leading researchers and research institutions in the fields of artificial intelligence, multi-robot systems, tour planning, decentralized systems and swarm intelligence. The German automotive supplier ETO Group holds as a strategic investor shares in our company since 2021 and we are striving for cooperation in the development of automobiles and commercial vehicles. We are alumni of the Business Incubation Center of the European Space Agency (ESA) and were financed by grants from ESA and the German federal state of Baden-Württemberg. We belong to the start-up network of Europe’s largest research consortium in the field of artificial intelligence, Cyber Valley, an association of the Universities of Tübingen and Stuttgart, the Max Planck Society with the Max Planck Institute for Intelligent Systems and numerous industrial partners. We deal with the complex problems of optimization and decision-making in the areas of logistics, mobility, vehicles and their intersections.

entityDescription:
DISTech Disruptive Technologies GmbH is an Austrian-based company that was founded in 2017. The company specializes in professional competencies in component design and layout, structural mechanical optimization, and manufacturing. It offers professional training of future additive manufacturing (AM) specialists in the metal and plastics sector.
DISTech's primary focus is on the development of additive manufacturing technology and the education and training of companies regarding "Design for Additive Manufacturing (DfAM)." The company also designs and optimizes customer-specific components from various industrial sectors.
An in-house engineering department functions as an interface between the idea and the real product, using various software solutions such as CAD/CAM and simulation programs to develop new products. Customers are supported with know-how in design and engineering to achieve the required quality at the best price.
The company offers a wide range of AM systems and technologies for additive manufacturing, which ensures that the most efficient system can always be used for production for different quantities and component sizes. Different qualities, including surface, geometry, and dimensional accuracy, can also be produced using these AM systems. Additionally, fitting or sealing surfaces can be produced via internal mechanical processing.
DISTech produces prototypes and special components, ranging from simple illustrative models to series components. By utilizing cross-technology manufacturing, the company achieves high-quality standards, allowing its customers to advance their product development. It can realize components in a wide range of materials, from flexible to fiber-reinforced.
In summary, DISTech Disruptive Technologies GmbH is a professional partner that specializes in component design and layout, structural mechanical optimization, and manufacturing. Its engineering department uses various software solutions to develop new products and supports customers with design and engineering expertise. With its focus on the development of additive manufacturing technology and customer-specific component optimization, DISTech helps companies advance their product development in leaps and bounds.

entityDescription:
AlphaEO is a downstream Earth Observation start-up providing environmental dashboards which employs cutting-edge Earth Observation (EO) technology, The SaaS model exemplifies a sophisticated downstream application tailored for a broad spectrum of domains beyond its initial agricultural focus. This interactive platform harnesses the power of data fusion, combining optical and radar satellite imagery to deliver comprehensive, near-real-time insights. While AlphaFarm demonstrates its prowess in precision agriculture, the underlying technology of the AlphaEO dashboard extends its utility across various sectors including environmental monitoring, disaster response, and natural resource management.
For environmental monitoring, the dashboard can analyse deforestation rates, track biodiversity changes, or monitor water bodies' health, offering vital data for conservation efforts and policy-making. In disaster response, the ability to quickly interpret changes in the landscape becomes invaluable. The dashboard's rapid processing of EO data can aid in assessing damage, coordinating relief efforts, and planning recovery operations by providing accurate, timely information on affected areas. Natural resource management benefits from the ability to monitor changes in landscapes, such as the depletion of natural resources or the impact of mining activities, ensuring sustainable exploitation and conservation of these resources.
At its core, the AlphaEO dashboard embodies a modular and scalable solution, designed to adapt and integrate specific modules tailored to the needs of various domains. Its user-friendly interface ensures that complex satellite data is accessible and actionable, enabling decision-makers, researchers, and professionals across different sectors to leverage EO data effectively. Through continuous innovation and adaptation, the AlphaEO dashboard stands as a versatile tool, ready to meet the challenges and opportunities of a rapidly changing world.

entityDescription:
X – ENDER Space s.r.o. develops distributed ledgers for space applications. We want to enable satellite to satellite p2p trustless data exchange and decentralized control applications over Distributed Satellite System (DSS) missions and constellations. 

Our innovative project introduces a groundbreaking approach to satellite operations, leveraging the power of distributed ledger technology (DLT) to create a secure, efficient, and collaborative space environment. This technology, akin to blockchain, offers a decentralized platform where satellites can share and exchange data in a trusted manner, akin to a digital community in the sky.
Key Benefits:
- Cost Efficiency: By participating in this network, satellites gain access to a vast pool of data from others, significantly reducing the need for individual data collection missions. This shared approach leads to substantial cost savings in terms of time, resources, and operational expenses.

- Revenue Generation: Unique data collected by satellites becomes a valuable commodity. This system enables satellites to monetize their data by providing access to it for a fee, creating a new revenue stream and turning data collection capabilities into profitable assets.

- Data Integrity and Security: The DLT ensures that once data is recorded, it is immutable and tamper-proof. This guarantees the authenticity and reliability of the data shared within the network, fostering trust among all participants.

- Automated Transactions: The use of smart contracts automates data requests and transactions. This not only simplifies operations but also ensures fairness and transparency in data exchange, further enhancing the system's efficiency.

- Collaborative Space Environment: Our project promotes a cooperative approach to space operations, where satellites work together, sharing resources and information. This collaboration paves the way for more advanced and comprehensive space missions, benefiting all stakeholders involved.

In summary, our distributed ledger technology for space operations is not just a technological innovation; it's a strategic business move. It offers a dual advantage of cost savings and revenue generation while ensuring data security and fostering a collaborative space environment. This positions our technology as a game-changer in the space industry, offering immense value to satellite operators and stakeholders in the burgeoning space economy.

Company description: X – ENDER Space s.r.o. develops distributed ledgers for space applications. We want to enable satellite to satellite p2p trustless data exchange and decentralized control applications over Distributed Satellite System (DSS) missions and constellations. 

Our innovative project introduces a groundbreaking approach to satellite operations, leveraging the power of distributed ledger technology (DLT) to create a secure, efficient, and collaborative space environment. This technology, akin to blockchain, offers a decentralized platform where satellites can share and exchange data in a trusted manner, akin to a digital community in the sky.
Key Benefits:
- Cost Efficiency: By participating in this network, satellites gain access to a vast pool of data from others, significantly reducing the need for individual data collection missions. This shared approach leads to substantial cost savings in terms of time, resources, and operational expenses.

- Revenue Generation: Unique data collected by satellites becomes a valuable commodity. This system enables satellites to monetize their data by providing access to it for a fee, creating a new revenue stream and turning data collection capabilities into profitable assets.

- Data Integrity and Security: The DLT ensures that once data is recorded, it is immutable and tamper-proof. This guarantees the authenticity and reliability of the data shared within the network, fostering trust among all participants.

- Automated Transactions: The use of smart contracts automates data requests and transactions. This not only simplifies operations but also ensures fairness and transparency in data exchange, further enhancing the system's efficiency.

- Collaborative Space Environment: Our project promotes a cooperative approach to space operations, where satellites work together, sharing resources and information. This collaboration paves the way for more advanced and comprehensive space missions, benefiting all stakeholders involved.

In summary, our distributed ledger technology for space operations is not just a technological innovation; it's a strategic business move. It offers a dual advantage of cost savings and revenue generation while ensuring data security and fostering a collaborative space environment. This positions our technology as a game-changer in the space industry, offering immense value to satellite operators and stakeholders in the burgeoning space economy.

entityDescription:
Tartu Observatory is an institute of University of Tartu. Tartu Observatory was established as an independent research institute in 1947 and merged to University of Tartu
since 1st January 2018. Tartu Observatory is the leading center of space research and technology in Estonia.
The research areas of Tartu Observatory are space technology, earth observation (EO), cosmology, and stellar physics.

Tartu Observatory has modern, well equipped facilities for research work, an excellent visitor centre and new laboratory complex. In 2012, a new laboratory complex at the premises of Tartu Observatory has been established for development and testing of new technologies including stations for development, prototyping, and assembly; facilities for climatic, thermal-vacuum, vibration, and electromagnetic compatibility (EMC) testing; workshops for mechanical construction and repair works. The laboratories have independent and automatic control for temperature and humidity. Special conditions as electrostatic discharge protected environment (ESD), anechoic chamber, and cleanrooms equivalent to EN ISO 14644 Class 8 conditions have been established. Three rooms in cleanroom environment with total area of 100 m2 are available for optical measurements, where permanent setups for radiometric, photometric, spectral, and angular sensitivity calibrations are installed. Optical laboratory includes passive damping setup tables, one of them on separately built foundation for vibration-free measurements.
The laboratories of TO are accredited to ISO 17025:2017 and offer calibration and testing services to research institutions and industrial customers (https://kosmos.ut.ee/en/laboratory).

Satraka Ltd develops and markets an innovative and market-disruptive user terminal tracking antenna technology for LEO and MEO satellites, to provide broadband internet services.

The technology, trademarked as Satraka, in being patented internationally.

Satraka uses dual feed system and a shaped toroidal reflector surface to produce tracking and handover beams in one antenna. The tracking beam is created by the movement of the feed system which is a few kg mass, rather than the entire antenna which is hundreds kg mass. This reduces the complexity of the tracking system and the cost.

Satraka offers competitive advantages over all existing tracking antenna on the market or under development, in both technical performance and cost.

Satraka technology applies to terrestrial 5G/6G market too, providing multiple and identical high gain beams simultaneously.

description:
Successful with EurA - Achieve your goals faster - with EurA

EurA is your international consultancy for innovation and technology. The consultants support companies, research institutions and public clients of all sizes in making technical innovations possible. EurA supports tomorrow's market leaders in generating ideas for innovations, developing new products and services and marketing them nationally and internationally.

You benefit from the sector and industry experience as well as the technical knowledge of our highly qualified consultants. As an expert in funding and a leader in innovation networks, we are committed to high quality innovation consulting for companies, even beyond our own company.

We have also been very successful in cross-industry technology transfer for a number of years, including for the European Space Agency ESA as ESA Broker Germany and the Space Agency at DLR with the Space2Motion, Space2Agriculture and Space2Health networks. Since the beginning of 2022, EurA has been managing the ESA BIC (Business Incubator Center) NRW for ESA and MWIKE NRW to promote space-related start-ups.

In addition, EurA Aachen manages the "Copernicus Network Office Municipal" for the space agency at DLR and manages a specialist network of national players from administration, science and industry who deal with possible applications of satellite remote sensing for municipal tasks.

Protecting the environment and climate is a matter close to our hearts. The EurA sustainability team is a leader in sustainability consulting for companies and has proven its expertise in numerous projects. LCA (Life Cycle Assessment), ecological footprint, eco-design and life cycle assessment as well as "green" technologies, especially in the hydrogen sector, will be important building blocks in the future and are no foreign words for us. The topic of "Clean Space" is taken into account here.
entityDescription:
EurA is one of Germany's leading innovation consultancies. EurA AG was founded in 1999 as EurA Consult GmbH (2014 renamed in EurA Consult AG and 2016 renamed in EurA AG) and has made a name for itself as an innovation consultancy offering its services throughout Germany. Our clients, numbering over 1200 across the group as a whole, are mainly small and medium sized enterprises from a wide range of industries. In terms of industries our focus is on automotive, machine and plant manufacturing, aviation and aerospace, industrial automation, food and beverages, pharmaceuticals, information and communication technologies, nano and biotechnology, cleantech, new materials, medical and healthcare sectors, and sensor and testing technologies. With many years of experience in consultancy on practically all aspects of corporate development and technology transfer, we have in-depth knowledge of the specifics of a whole range of industries. Being an accredited company, we at EurA AG belong to the small circle of technology and innovation consultancies with authorisation from the German Federal Ministry of Economics and Technology. With the management support we provide for a wide range of cooperation clusters, we are one of leading innovation consultancies in Germany today. A cooperation cluster is a collaborative body of at least six small to medium sized enterprises which has the objective of developing innovative products, processes or services on a joint basis. The goal is synergetic collaboration in one or more technological fields, from research and development through to the marketing of the R&D results. EurA AG is a non-listed public limited company and has its registered headquarters in Ellwangen (Baden-Württemberg). The majority of the shares are held by the managing partners and members of the executive board. 

In addition, EurA has more than 25 years of experience in the development of network ideas and the formation, establishment and management of more than 100 competence and cooperation networks, making us one of the leading network management institutions in Germany and Europe today.

These activities also include the management of technologies, which includes the areas of technology consulting, transfer as well as evaluation. In the field of cross-industry technology and know-how exchange, EurA AG staff have been involved in national and international technology transfer activities of DLR, the state of North Rhine-Westphalia and ESA, among others, since 1993.

These activities have led to participation in more than 250 successful mediations of innovation projects for the creation of new products and services based on aerospace technology in various industrial sectors and markets (spin-off), as well as from various industrial sectors into aerospace (spin-in). 

EurA's Aachen office is currently part of the ESA Technology Broker Germany and acts as lead for SparkFunding. In addition, EurA in Aachen manages the ESA BIC North Rhine-Westphalia. It also manages the cross-sector networks Space2Motion, Space2Agriculture and Space2Health also the Copernicus Municipal project for the DLR Space Agency.

entityDescription:
IREPA LASER develops innovative laser manufacturing solutions for the industry and assists their operational implantation on site.​
The laser processes developed by IREPA LASER meet efficiently a great deal of the industrial needs in terms of quality, speed, flexibility and cost.

IREPA LASER is above all a research and development centre, where advances are continuous particularly through the scientific assistance of 550 researchers from the Carnot MICA Institute. What is more, the targeted and personalised support of IREPA LASER provides our industrial customers – small and medium companies and large corporations – with thorough and tailored expertise.
IREPA LASER particularly collaborates with the Carnot MICA institute, pooling 17 research and development organisations: Nine laboratories and eight technology resource centres, with a total of 550 researchers, engineers and technicians and 246 doctoral students, with a turnover of €28 million in industrial contracts. Thus, IREPA LASER offers industry a complete research and development chain for the functionalising of materials, surfaces and interfaces.
A laser training centre to promote laser technology skills
With 30 years’ expertise in the area of laser technology, IREPA LASER has trained over 6000 individuals in the field.
The training packages offered by IREPA LASER chiefly relate to laser treatment and manufacturing processes, quality control and laser safety.
Besides, along with INSA in Strasbourg, IREPA LASER offers a diploma training course in industrial laser techniques lasting over a year and a half. As laser technology experts, our specialists will help you train your employees in the particularities of that technology.
A leading-edge laser machine base
The IREPA LASER machine base includes high-tech laser equipment ranging from 10 W to up to 6 kW, combined with multiple-axis machines, robots and micro-machining centres of the latest generation. In particular, it has lasers, additive manufacturing machines (using the CLAD(r) process), micro-machining equipment, 3D texturing machines, welding machines and other specific equipment.
Further, IREPA LASER has accurate and optimised equipment for the characterisation and testing of materials.

Company description: IREPA LASER develops innovative laser manufacturing solutions for the industry and assists their operational implantation on site.​
The laser processes developed by IREPA LASER meet efficiently a great deal of the industrial needs in terms of quality, speed, flexibility and cost.

IREPA LASER is above all a research and development centre, where advances are continuous particularly through the scientific assistance of 550 researchers from the Carnot MICA Institute. What is more, the targeted and personalised support of IREPA LASER provides our industrial customers – small and medium companies and large corporations – with thorough and tailored expertise.
IREPA LASER particularly collaborates with the Carnot MICA institute, pooling 17 research and development organisations: Nine laboratories and eight technology resource centres, with a total of 550 researchers, engineers and technicians and 246 doctoral students, with a turnover of €28 million in industrial contracts. Thus, IREPA LASER offers industry a complete research and development chain for the functionalising of materials, surfaces and interfaces.
A laser training centre to promote laser technology skills
With 30 years’ expertise in the area of laser technology, IREPA LASER has trained over 6000 individuals in the field.
The training packages offered by IREPA LASER chiefly relate to laser treatment and manufacturing processes, quality control and laser safety.
Besides, along with INSA in Strasbourg, IREPA LASER offers a diploma training course in industrial laser techniques lasting over a year and a half. As laser technology experts, our specialists will help you train your employees in the particularities of that technology.
A leading-edge laser machine base
The IREPA LASER machine base includes high-tech laser equipment ranging from 10 W to up to 6 kW, combined with multiple-axis machines, robots and micro-machining centres of the latest generation. In particular, it has lasers, additive manufacturing machines (using the CLAD(r) process), micro-machining equipment, 3D texturing machines, welding machines and other specific equipment.
Further, IREPA LASER has accurate and optimised equipment for the characterisation and testing of materials.
