entityDescription: Atout Process was founded in 2010 to develop innovative products based on non-intrusive electomagnetic imaging and measurement techniques. Atout’s proprietary technologies include Electrical Capacitance Tomography (ECT), Magnetic Inductance Tomography (MIT), Electrical Velocity Tomography (EVT), and other novel methods. Atout develops solutions based on these technologies to solve some of the most difficult measurement problems in industry including food, energy, oil & gas, aerospace and defence. Atout’s offering allows customers to see inside pipes and vessels through opaque barriers and to weigh moving product without direct contact. Atout has developed the concept of Smart Tanks for Space which provide reliable measurement of propellant mass and distribution under all circumstances, including micro- or zero-gravity, in any orientation and during manoeuvres. Improved gauging in microgravity may allow optimisation of Satellite life span while prediction of propellant centre of mass can be a significant aid to spacecraft control.

entityDescription:
The company Lightigo Space s.r.o. (est. 2022, www.lightigo-space.com) is a subsidiary of Lightigo s.r.o. (est. 2019, www.lightigo.com) with a focus on technology transfer from academia to industry and its consequent commercialization. Moreover, Lightigo Space fosters further development of prototypes with expertise in optics, optomechanics, electronics and firmware, control and data processing software, spectroscopy, and machine learning. The company closely cooperates with the Laboratory of Laser Spectroscopy (CEITEC Brno University of Technology, www.libs.ceitec.cz). Thus, the major focus of the company is on analytical chemistry (e.g., prospecting of lunar regolith) by using namely the Laser-Induced Breakdown Spectroscopy (LIBS) and Raman spectroscopy.
The team of Lightigo Space has already been involved in several space-related projects. The first major project was the development of advanced optics for hyperspectral detection of meteorites from LEO (VESNA payload, SLAVIA ambitious cubesat mission) in cooperation with SAB Aerospace. Currently, the company is involved in the development of a fiber laser for LiDAR (LLD payload, TROLL cubesat mission) that is funded by private resources of the TRL Space company. The major achievement of the company is the project ISRA (In-Situ Resource Analyzer) which has been funded by ESRIC and ESA. This project will support the business and technical feasibility of a LIBS payload implemented on landers/rovers for prospecting of lunar regolith.

entityDescription:
The ESRF - The European Synchrotron Radiation Facility - is the most intense source of synchrotron-generated light, producing X-rays 100 billion times brighter than the X-rays used in hospitals. These X-rays, endowed with exceptional properties, are produced at the ESRF by the high energy electrons that race around the storage ring, a circular tunnel measuring 844 metres in circumference.

Each year, the demand to use these X-ray beams increases and near to 9000 scientists from around the world come to Grenoble, to “beamlines”, each equipped with state-of-the-art instrumentation, operating 24 hours a day, seven days a week.

Thanks to the brilliance and quality of its X-rays, the ESRF functions like a "super-microscope" which "films" the position and motion of atoms in condensed and living matter, and reveals the structure of matter in all its beauty and complexity. It provides unrivalled opportunities for scientists in the exploration of materials and living matter in many fields: chemistry, material physics, archaeology and cultural heritage, structural biology and medical applications, environmental sciences, information science and nanotechnologies.

Thirty years ago the ESRF made history as the world’s first third-generation synchrotron light source. Today, the ESRF continues to lead the way with the Extremely Brilliant Source (EBS), a brand-new generation of high-energy synchrotron, improving X-ray performances of brilliance and coherence once again by a factor of 100. This new concept, based on innovative technology, paves the way for a new standard of synchrotrons around the world. ESRF-EBS will contribute to tackling global challenges in key areas such as health, environment, energy and new industrial materials, and to unveiling hidden secrets of our natural and cultural heritage through the non-destructive investigation of precious artifacts and palaeontological treasures.

entityDescription:
We produce special optical elements e.g. for satelite laser communication.

We automate the production of nanostructured fibres and flat lenses to enable the development of novel technologies and products utilising beam shaping and photonic phenomena. This key technology is crucial for addressing immediate needs in healthcare, communication, detection, and cybersecurity markets with significant impacts on disease treatment; quality of life; environmental monitoring; reliability, safety, and data transmission speed. Our objective is to improve existing machine from TRL7 to TRL9 and begin reliable serial production meeting industry standards. The main source of revenue will come from series production of preforms and optical elements, while also offering R&D services to customers and partners whose products lead to serial production or enable SYGLASS technology to enter new markets. This approach will benefit in the future in the form of high-volume orders and will educate the market about the capabilities of our services. The current SYGLASS demonstrator (TRL7) has shown promising results, manufacturing elements that were evaluated in laboratories and by early customers. The new machine will incorporate a series of improvements based on the requirements of the initial target markets. Each of the requirements has been extensively researched and improvements to the machine will be introduced according to the coherent technological plan we have developed. New flat gradient lenses and nanostructured core fibres setups are being developed for use in space, cybersecurity and healthcare markets. Those optical elements will be used not only as demonstrators of the technology but also as early SYGLASS applications and core products with proprietary technology aimed for sale and licensing.

entityDescription: Aerial Tools ApS (AT) is a Copenhagen based deep tech start-up that develops a revolutionary Vertical Take-Off and Landing (VTOL) Unmanned Aerial System (UAS) with a patented payload interface unit. The drone performs vertical take-off and landing, giving the same flexibility in operations that conventional drones. The advantage of this type of drone is that it does not need a large area to reach its operational height or any supporting mechanism like run aways or catapults. The drone is larger than many drones with a wingspan of 4 meters, designed to carry up to 3 kg payload-weight, which is more than most standard drones (about 1.5kg), making it flexible to carry out different kind of activities. By tilting the rotors, it flies forward taking advantage of its aerodynamics. Thereby, it can continuously fly for a long time (4 hours/flight opposed to 20-40 mins for most standard drones) without battery replacement or charging. AT’s drone platform can cover large and remote areas with high data quality acquisition. The patented payload interface unit is designed to plug and play any advanced specialized sensor as well as multiple sensors at the same time to collect data more efficiently and precisely than current drone solutions. The aim is to improve aerial data acquisition in B2B commercial inspections and monitoring. Therefore, the product is designed to improve the overall operational capacity, providing a better end user customer experience, reducing operational mapping costs, and facilitating better and quicker customers decision making. AT services depend on the customer needs. To offer customers exactly what fits into their operational needs, we provide tailored data acquisition, processing, and analysis. Our final goal is to create an impact by developing scalable, accessible, and sustainable solutions.

Organization, including the nature of its operations: Timezyx Inc. is a tech start-up incorporated in Sweden in 2023 by two founders, Dr. Kamyab Zandi (a former university professor in Structural Engineering) and Dr. Adele Khavari (scientist in Material Science). Timezyx's aim is to facilitate adapting the built environment to widespread and severe climate change fallouts. Our goal is to predict the response of infrastructure when subjected to episodes of extreme climatic events, such as floods, hurricanes and earthquakes, and enable infrastructure owners to manage the built environment in an effective way. Europe has massive urban/rural transport infrastructure (bridges, roads and railways) and is among the regions that is fast experiencing the consequence of climate change through extreme climate events. Timezyx is set out to develop Digital Twin technologies to enhance infrastructures’ resilience under extreme climate conditions.

Managerial capacity: The founding team has a proven record of success in managing and leading research projects. Dr. Zandi, Director and CTO, was the director of Digital Twin Lab, a joint Chalmers/Stanford initiative (2018–2021), including 15 team members, with the goal to create a strategic alliance and a complementary cooperation on a transatlantic level opening scientific platforms and national markets to each other with the focus on the managing of the aging infrastructure in EU and North America. Dr Khavari, Director and COO, has 15 years’ experience in research. She mentored more than 30 undergraduate/graduate students and managed several projects with a total value of 6M EUR.

description:
ParaLoon develops inflatable / unfoldable "parabolic balloon" concentrator photovoltaic (CPV) structures to collect both photonic and thermal solar energy for applications in space, on earth and on other planets. 
Applications in space would include satellites, space stations, habitats or mission vehicles. On earth, these structures could be used for remote areas, campsites or mobile applications. 
The ParaLoon system combines lightweight, inflatable / unfoldable, parabolic structures and thermo-photo-voltaic (TPV) technologies for the efficient conversion of both light and heat to electric energy. 
If wireless power beaming becomes a reality, the electric energy could also be transferred in space, on Earth and even on the Moon or other planets by satellites or a satellite network in the future.

Founded in 2008, SARL QUALISAT is a dynamic company, active in all phases of a space project. Our company offers to support its customers in areas ranging from design to data analysis, via the technical implementation stages, while applying the quality rules associated with scientific space instruments. In short, QUALISAT’s mission is to support scientific laboratories in the development of on-board instrumentation. Since its creation, QUALISAT has specialized in the outsourcing of engineering services, seconded to the customer’s site as required, and has made continuous improvement its leitmotif. Through various subcontracts, the company has participated, and continues to participate, in the development of many space programs.
QUALISAT has all the skills, expertise and resources required to carry out the AP/AQI tasks requested by the CNRS. QUALISAT is able to offer a wide range of support for projects of all sizes, types and development phases. In addition to mastering the tools required, our consultants all have a solid technical background, supplemented by ongoing training, and are familiar with the technologies developed in space projects. Our company offers consultants with the right profile for the job. Our consultants are also fluent in spoken and written English. Moreover, customer satisfaction remains our company’s prime directive. QUALISAT, through its consultants and network, is able to provide you with expert advice in a highly responsive manner. Among other things, QUALISAT will provide you with tailored space engineering solutions, from the very design of the instrument to the archiving and processing of mission results.

Italian company specialized in design, research and development of wearables and protective tools for humans in space.
REA was founded in 2022 with the purpose to help astronauts facing microgravity diseases. The company - with a legal office in Acquaviva delle Fonti and an operational one in Turin -is founded privately by four shareholders, all of them with more than 10 years of experience in different fields from Textile to aerospace. During these months we participated in the Takeoff Accelerator program and we have been incubated by ESA-BIC Turin starting from Jan 2023.Our target is to reach medical and technological validation and finalize the development of a full MVP of our EMSi space suit.
Our mission is to offer astronauts a solution to face long journeys in space without physiological and biochemical issues. The space environment, as we know, presents many challenges, including the management of the perpetual condition of microgravity, limited possibilities for movement and constant need to maintain a sterile environment.
EMSi could be used for all microgravity missions and in the future for Lunar exploration

description: As a small team with extensive experience, MultiOne provides clients with flawless service in the fields of geospatial data engineering and data science, ecological modelling, application of mathematical and numerical methods in data analytics, software development and database architecture. entityDescription:

entityDescription:
In 4D-Mater, we draw our inspiration from Nature, Arts and Geometry, for the development of smart materials and products with unique capabilities. Our vision is to invent and produce advanced materials of the future. The name of the company is originated from the term “4D Materials”.
We have developed stimuli responsive materials are low-cost smart materials that change their shape as a function of temperature. They act similar to shape memory materials and they have developed with the purpose to replace shape memory polymers. We control the bending or twisting mode through the anisotropic thermo-mechanical properties of the material. Possible applications can be found in thermal control for Space sector, soft actuators and robotics.

With unique background and know-how in materials science & engineering, we use non-conventional and advanced manufacturing techniques for the realization of materials with unforeseen properties.

entityDescription:
MultiPull One is a mobile, flexible, pocket-sized training station that makes heavy and bulky steel weights superfluous and makes you completely independent of gravity. An electric motor converts the energy from a high-performance battery unit into up to 80 kg of pulling force - and the power of your muscles back into electrical energy. The device itself weighs only 5 kg. The battery stores excess energy charges your mobile devices and can be easily removed for use as a power bank. With the help of the versatile mounting options, you can train not only at home, but also in the park on a tree or a lamppost, whether for endurance or highly efficient strength training.
In addition, MultiPull One will be the world's first fitness device that allows users to train together remotely, feeling each other. Interactive live challenges in the community, such as digital tug-of-war, are made possible by the app, which is the central control unit. With new features like cooperative or competitive mini-games, an automatic training plan and a detailed health monitoring for sport enthusiasts or astronauts we are revolutionising the fitness market and inspiring people in a new way for healthy sport and exercise. As a future extension of the portfolio, the next step will be to develop a lightweight version for an especially portable use in space or everyday life

We design, fabricate and commercialize miniature optical systems, for scientific, industrial, medical and telecommunication applications.

entityDescription: Founded in 2006, Geo Search SRL is a Romanian company that specialises in geotechnical studies, usually complemented by technical support activities such as ground monitoring or consultancy. One of it's main activities consists of analysing slope stability, which is crucial in understanding the causes of landslides and preventing the onset of movements, taking measurements to reduce the risks and hazards of potential landslides including the significant damage they can cause. To do so, geotechnical studies are carried out, which provide pivotal data to examine the land in question and its potential construction design. Geotechnical studies are vital for cost-effective construction and involve subsoil exploration (drilling, in-situ field tests), characterising soil conditions (analysing soil samples, groundwater) and the use of various monitoring systems (inclinometers, piezometers, geodesy, InSAR).

description:
1985 - The foundation of the company
The birth of Metodi and our links with the local territory 
In the 'fabulous 80s', a small company was established, inspired by the desire to do business using new technologies, most of which came from the US at the time, and were very expensive. Metodi began its journey in Liguria, alongside the big names that are synonymous with Ligurian industry: Rinaldo Piaggio, Italsider, Ansaldo. The core business of the company during this period was the engineering element of production, specifically with regard to the design of equipment and machines. At this time, the company was also active within another sector, providing topography and mapping services for customers such as Enel, Sip and Autostrade. 
1990 - The turning point:
The crisis and internationalisation 
The Italian industrial crisis hit Liguria hard, and in the early 90s, the company was faced with a dramatic decline in work as a result of the fact that all of its major local customers also found themselves in serious difficulty. Driven by necessity, the company extended its horizons to encompass the rest of Italy and beyond, expanding into totally new sectors (the paper, medical and automotive industries). Without the internet and all of the other technologies that facilitate contact between people and companies today, with suitcase in hand, Metodi headed abroad, specifically to southern France, where the foundations of what has become Europe's leading aerospace centre were laid. 
TODAY 
2000 and today 
Having consolidated its presence in the sectors into which it moved in response to the turmoil of the 90s, METODI is now firmly established in the world of engineering services as a highly qualified supplier for the aerospace, aeronautics and automotive industries. The process of broadening its activities continues for the company, as it undertakes various international rail programmes, thus making its entry into this sector. Building on the experience and successes of the past, METODI remains dedicated to expanding the areas in which it operates, moving towards more niche sectors such as particle physics.

entityName: University of Bucharest - Faculty of Geography
entityDescription:
The Faculty of Geography is one of the oldest faculties of the University of Bucharest. The symbolic date of its establishment is considered to be the 3rd of November 1900, when the first Geography lecture was held (The Object and the Definition of Geography) by Professor Simion Mehedinţi, the founder of Romanian modern Geography and founder of the Geography Department, created in 1899 within the Faculty of Letters and Philosophy.
Starting with the academic year 1909-1910, Professor Simion Mehedinţi founded the Geography Seminar, and in 1927 the Geography Department, General Physics is created, followed by the Department of General Geography, Anthropogeography and Ethnography in 1929.
During 1948-1949, the faculty exists as the Faculty of History-Geography, and starting with the academic year 1949-1950, the Geography Department becomes a distinct component within the Geology-Geography department. In 1986 there is a fusion between the Faculty of Biology and the Faculty of Geology-Geography, the new structure becoming the Faculty of Biology-Geography-Geology. The students were taught in the field of Geography, in a foreign language.
Since 1990, the institution has been called the Faculty of Geography.
The faculty teaches every year over 2000 students, master students and Ph.D. students.
The Faculty of Geography has four departments: Geomorphology – Pedology – Geomatics, Humanistic and Economic Geography, Meteorology – Hydrology and Regional Geography and the Environment.

Company and technology established in 2022.Distributor of distributed software systems.

Inventor of the Portable Contract Document (P.C.D.) and Portable Request Document (P.R.D.) formats; enabling smart processes strictly between stakeholders (human or machine), verifiable via blockchain timestamps.

These formats consist of tagged messages designed for collaboration and the integration of self-contained digital agreements and rights, with user-side validation. They are comprehensible and usable by all programming languages, as well as by humans, and can be seamlessly integrated into various processes. They ensure security and confidentiality with decentralized rights management, and the contracts can be directly integrated into business workflows.

Inventor of a multi-layered network system: user-side validation, decentralized access network, decentralized message relays, decentralized secret sharing network, message timestamping side chain, and side chain timestamping on Bitcoin. This decentralized network replaces traditional platforms, operating a full range of services strictly between stakeholders with decentralized process discovery and access, independent of cloud infrastructures.

Creator of an MPC-based identity management system that enables directories without direct identifiers, offering an identity management solution that is both sovereign and secure. This system also provides a free, disintermediated, and highly secure method for 2FA (Two-Factor Authentication).

Host of 4NK relays: a peer-to-peer network for relays and timestamping, anonymous, fungible, and devoid of storage. This network facilitates the timestamping of millions of messages (including signatures) on a blockchain, which is certified by a daily transaction in a block mined on Bitcoin, with 100% energy-efficient erasure into green infrastructures auto-funded.

description:
Space DOTS is a UK-based New Space start-up pioneering the in-space R&D, testing and quality control of advanced space materials. At Space DOTS, we are proposing an evolution to the legacy approach of testing and qualifying materials for space.
Our mission is to revolutionize space commercialization and exploration by expediting in-orbit qualification of advanced materials, making it faster, cheaper, and simpler. Our goal is to reduce capital expenditure and time to market for novel materials, to help Space Industry Leaders accelerate advanced materials uptake, and catalyse technology applications across all space environments.
Our key enabling technology is called ‘Barnacle DOT’: the first pocket-size, scalable and hostable labs that combine mechanical, thermal and electrical materials’ properties testing on-orbit.

Over the years Navi Merchants has built strong relationships with the main ship owners and operators in the Coaster, Handy size, Supramax & Panamax segments, predominantly focussing on the coaster and handy size segments. Creating a stronger and synergetic position in the global trade of commodities, COPMER is also investing actively in infrastructure related to enhancing port and terminal operations in the Baltic region and U.S.A.

entityDescription:
The Klarifi data platform offers detailed insights on wastewater for 100,000+ industrial facilities in Europe and North America.
We collect publicly available data on wastewater for industrial facilities and display it on our platform. We have data on which compounds are discharged, how much, into which water bodies, what the facility permit allows and much more.
Our platform can be used to answer questions such as:
· Which plants in the USA discharge 1,4-dioxane, a potentially carcinogenic substance?
· Who are the largest dischargers of nitrogen to polluted waterways in a specific area?
· What is the wastewater infrastructure for each industrial facility?
Our target clients for the solution are wastewater solution providers, e.g., producers of wastewater treatment systems.
We provide our clients with the ability to identify and analyze the industrial facilities with a specific wastewater challenge (say, dioxane discharge) – which makes it easy for them to identify the customers with the biggest need.

entityDescription:
Erica, Espectroscopía Raman e Infrarroja aplicado a Cosmogeoquímica y Astrobiología, is a research group of the Department of Applied Physics of the University of Valladolid. Emeritus Prof. Fernando Rull and Dr. Guillermo Lopez-Reyes lead the group and its area of specialization is the application of advanced spectroscopy techniques, mainly vibrational spectroscopy and Laser Induced Breakdown Spectroscopy, to planetary exploration.
Our group is currently participating in the development of instruments that are or will be on board of different missions to Mars. One is the RLS instrument that will be part of the scientific payload of ESA’s next mission to Mars, Exomars. Another is Supercam that is onboard the Perseverance rover of the NASA Mars 2020 mission, currently operating on the surface of Mars. In addition, the group is participating in the development of the RAX instrument onboard MMX mission to Phobos and in the preparatory plans for the Moon exploration. 
Besides, of the work in space exploration, Erica is currently participating in several projects with different industries as part of this group compromise with the technology transfer of advanced spectroscopy from the lab to the industry and society.

entityName: Technical university of Košice - Faculty of Materials, Metallurgy and Recycling
entityDescription:
The Faculty of Materials, Metallurgy and Recycling, Technical University of Košice (FMMR, TUKE) is a dynamic faculty which operates in the areas of education, research, development, technology, and innovation and is focused on key areas in metallurgy, digitalization of metallurgical processes, materials research based on the development of hydrogen batteries, waste treatment and recycling. We are focused on preparing successful international engineers and researchers with strong technical and analytical skills, the ability to understand complex systems, good team workers with strong communication skills, and critical thinkers. We join science and practice. We work with industrial partners from different areas and negotiate with city governments and politicians to set similar goals. We participate as an important partner in projects dedicated to developing innovative technologies. We are involved, lead and work on projects reducing CO2 emissions in iron and steel production, developing new modern materials and nanomaterials for special applications in medicine and environmental protection, and seeking environmental approaches to recycling metal-bearing and nonmetallic new waste streams. We reflect on the trends of the European Union to reduce CO2 emissions in industry and on the circular economy, and we also work in collaborative multidisciplinary teams to achieve industrial symbiosis.

The research team at the FMMR TUKE has decades of experience in the preparation of metallic and non-metallic materials. Since 2016 is focusing on preparation and characterization of thermoelectric materials. So far, they have prepared several half Heusler alloy systems, a series of completely new material compounds for wearable thermoelectric modules. 
We have over 20 years of experience with diffraction and spectroscopic methodologies at synchrotron, neutron and FEL sources and mathematical modelling of ordered and disordered structures. 
We also offer expertise in Material analysis of components intended for the space environment, and we could be partner in project with our know-how in material sciences using light, electron microscopy (SEM, TEM, HR-TEM), X-ray or neutron diffraction and spectroscopy. Our team has experience modelling atomic structures using the reverse Monte Carlo method.

entityDescription:
Founded in 2020 with the goal of establishing Portugal’s first commercial spaceport, ASC is a 100% private and Portuguese-owned partnership between OPTIMAL Structural Solutions and Ilex Space. This collaboration combines complementary expertise: OPTIMAL specializes in the design and maintenance of metallic and composite structures, while Ilex Space leads the commercial strategy and international business development. Together, they provide ASC with a strong technological and commercial foundation, enabling a comprehensive range of services—from launch operations to re-entry and recovery support.

ASC has developed critical technical capabilities to operate and manage a spaceport on the island of Santa Maria to meet Europe’s growing demand for launch sites. ASC’s mission also extends beyond infrastructure development; from facilitating satellite launches to developing custom-built ground support equipment and navigating complex regulatory landscapes, ASC is dedicated to advancing European space capabilities. Its activities align with the strategic objectives outlined in the Portuguese and Azorean Space Strategies, positioning the Azores as a pivotal space hub in the Atlantic and a gateway for Europe’s growing space ambitions. The ASC is committed to fostering strong local partnerships, creating an effective and competitive value chain, and solidifying the Azores as a thriving space hub, while preserving its pristine natural environment. The company is currently hosted at Incuba+, in Vila do Porto.
Looking to the future, the Atlantic Spaceport Consortium is aiming to being an enabler of Europe’s growing space ambitions. By sustainably enhancing launch and return capabilities at Santa Maria and throughout the Atlantic region, ASC is poised to leave a legacy of flexibility, strengthened international collaboration, and expanded opportunities for Europe in space.
Atlantic Spaceport Consortium (ASC) secured a licence to operate a Spaceport in Santa Maria, Azores, Portugal.
This is the first ever Spaceport licence to be issued by the Portuguese Space Authority (ANACOM) under the Portuguese legal framework updated in 2024.
The Malbusca Launch Centre, located at 36º55’57”N, 25º04’12”W, offers several competitive advantages, including: low air traffic density, integrated into the Santa Maria Oceanic Flight Information Region (FIR), managed by NAV Portugal; low maritime traffic density and a vast area of the Atlantic Ocean that will allow for safe flights and re-entry; and the ability to use launch trajectories that will eventually allow space objects to be placed in commercially attractive orbits.
Located in Portugal, within the European Union, the Malbusca Launch Centre is positioned to contribute to greater European autonomy in access to space and to add value to the global space economy.

entityDescription:
Demcon multiphysics is an engineering agency with high-end expertise in the area of heat transfer, fluid dynamics, structural mechanics, acoustics, electromagnetism and nuclear physics. We support clients from a wide variety of market sectors and help them achieve their goals in research and development with deep physical insights.
We combine fundamental physical knowledge from an analytical approach with Computer Aided Engineering (CAE) simulations tools from ANSYS, MATHWORKS, COMSOL, STAR-CCM+ and FLUKA to setup, execute, analyze and evaluate numerical simulations. The use of Computational Fluid Dynamics (CFD), Finite Element Analysis (FEM / FEA), Lumped Element Modelling (LEM), Computational Electromagnetics (CEM) and Monte Carlo simulations enables us to make a virtual prototype of your design. With these techniques we can simulate the fluid and gas flows, energy exchange, heat and mass transfer, stresses, strains and vibrations in structures and the interaction of electromagnetic fields with other physical aspects like heat generation. Simulation-driven product development increases the development efficiency and reduces the product development time. Our services can therefore fully support you in the designing phase, from idea up to prototype, from prototype to final design.

entityDescription:
Croatian Academic and Research Network – CARNET is a public institution operating within the Ministry of Science and Education in the field of information and communication technology and its application in education. CARNET began operating in 1991 as a project of the then Ministry of Science and Technology and became the first and only provider of Internet services in Croatia. Four years later, the Government of the Republic of Croatia adopted the Decree on the establishment of CARNET institution with the aim of innovating the education system and encouraging the progress of individuals and the society as a whole through ICT (information and communication technology).
CARNET network is a private network of the academic, scientific and research community of the Republic of Croatia, as well as the institution within the primary and secondary education system. Our services are available to primary and secondary schools, institutions from the science and higher education institutions, as well as to numerous public institutions such as certain ministries, hospitals, etc. 4130 locations across Croatia are connected to CARNET network. Our individual users are students, teachers, professors, scientists and other staff members of CARNET members, and all citizens of the Republic of Croatia in the segment of security on the Internet.
Focus on users is a core motivation for more than 200 CARNET’s employees in eight cities – Zagreb, Rijeka, Osijek, Split, Pula, Dubrovnik, Zadar and Slavonski Brod – who, with their knowledge and experience, improve the daily operation of the institution.
Following the latest trends in ICT, infrastructure and education over the years, we have devised a number of projects and developed new services. Currently, we offer more than 70 services, from education and training to multimedia, computer security and customer support. They access all services through the electronic identity in the AAI@EduHr system.
In addition, we provide user support for the systems of the Ministry of Science and Education – e-Matica and the National Information System for Applications and Enrollments into Secondary Schools. For accessing e-Citizens system we have developed e-Citizens mToken credential. Our most popular service is e-Class Register – a web application for the management of the class register in electronic form, which is used by most schools in the Republic of Croatia.
With the aim of building a digitally mature society, from 2015 to 2023, we have implemented the program “e-Schools: Comprehensive digitization of school operations and teaching processes to create digitally mature schools for the 21st century.”
CARNET also participates in a number of international activities and cooperates with other European academic and research networks, the GÉANT Association organisation and the organisations responsible for managing the internet resources in the world.

Our services are available to primary and secondary schools, institutions from the science and higher education institutions, as well as to numerous public institutions such as certain ministries, hospitals, etc. 4130 locations across Croatia are connected to CARNET network. Our individual users are students, teachers, professors, scientists and other staff members of CARNET members, and all citizens of the Republic of Croatia in the segment of security on the Internet.
Focus on users is a core motivation for more than 200 CARNET’s employees in eight cities – Zagreb, Rijeka, Osijek, Split, Pula, Dubrovnik, Zadar and Slavonski Brod – who, with their knowledge and experience, improve the daily operation of the institution.
Following the latest trends in ICT, infrastructure and education over the years, we have devised a number of projects and developed new services. Currently, we offer more than 70 services, from education and training to multimedia, computer security and customer support. They access all services through the electronic identity in the AAI@EduHr system.
In addition, we provide user support for the systems of the Ministry of Science and Education – e-Matica and the National Information System for Applications and Enrollments into Secondary Schools. For accessing e-Citizens system we have developed e-Citizens mToken credential. Our most popular service is e-Class Register – a web application for the management of the class register in electronic form, which is used by most schools in the Republic of Croatia.
With the aim of building a digitally mature society, from 2015 to 2023, we have implemented the program “e-Schools: Comprehensive digitization of school operations and teaching processes to create digitally mature schools for the 21st century.”
CARNET also participates in a number of international activities and cooperates with other European academic and research networks, the GÉANT Association organisation and the organisations responsible for managing the internet resources in the world.

entityDescription:
eAgronom is an agriculture-focused climate tech company dedicated to helping farmers adopt sustainable practices for the good of their farms and the entire planet. 
Acting as both a knowledge hub and a partner in modernising farms, eAgronom works closely with farmers to implement sustainable practices in a financially viable way. By providing real-time crop monitoring from fields, automated reporting, crop and yield plans, farm activity schedules, and more, the company provides detailed insights tailored specifically to individual farms’ needs and integral to future-proofing their businesses. 
Soil health is at the heart of eAgronom’s work and integral to the company’s carbon program (offsetting and insetting), which subsidises farms working to restore and regenerate soil, the second-largest natural carbon sink on Earth. By bringing food companies and farms together, we help producers reach their scope-3 targets.
Through eAgronom’s GHG monitoring, data verification and program certification capabilities, financial institutions are able to reshape their loan portfolio by providing more favourable terms to farmers who are EU taxonomy aligned. eAgronom’s soil health monitoring capacity allows landowners to bring a Sustainable Land Management Programme to tenants and reward sustainable practices.

entityDescription:
Open Source Clock Synchronisation
At Timebeat we believe that the difficulties behind clock synchronisation and the dissemination of accurate time no longer need to be shrouded in complication. It is becoming more and more important to synchronise systems to maintain efficiency, auditability, and more. With the increase of distributed systems, IoT, and Blockchain, timing is coming to the forefront of developers minds, ensuring consistency within a global environment.
Although several platforms exist, not all are created equal. Whether that be the reduced effectiveness across operating systems or the lack of effective monitoring to accommodate modern requirements such as compliance with regulations. We seek to put an end to this with one single platform.
Simplicity, effectiveness & reliable
Timebeat has been built with three core principles in mind. Simplicity. Effectiveness. Reliability.
It is with these principles we have created a platform that is easy to deploy with nearly no configuration required to get up and running. Reporting & monitoring with varying levels of detail to be effective for any use case including compliance. Features that enable ultimate redundancy from your synchronisation client ensuring reliability at every possible point for the modern 100% uptime world.
Time and synchronisation don't need to be a topic for experts to understand and discuss, it should be a simple commodity available to all. Timebeat aims to lead the industry into the modern world of on-demand, click and play, and ultimately a service-based organisation with a user-centric ethos.

PERPROT specializes in research, development and production of technologically advanced electronic and optoelectronic products in the field of:

- industrial control systems - microprocessor controllers for the supervision and management of robotics systems and the automation of production processes,
- Internet of Things (IoT) - wireless and wired sensors for acquiring and processing environmental data, equipped with artificial intelligence algorithms, 
- wireless communication systems - low power systems for short and long range radio communication (eg LoRa) and systems for wireless optical communication (Li-Fi, VLC),
- positioning and navigation systems - global positioning systems (GPS, GNSS) and local solutions based on radio distance measurement systems (time-of-flight measurement) and inertial navigation systems,
- monitoring and protection of health and life - methods and devices for monitoring and imaging the vital functions of the human body and for detecting disease states,
- physical property sensors - in particular using visible and near-infrared spectroscopy,
- energy harvesting power systems – sourcing electrical power from sunlight, wind power, electromagnetic wave energy, vibration, thermal energy and biochemical power.

We make sure that the devices developed in the company meet the relevant regulatory requirements (CE, FCC, FDA).

entityDescription:
“MLK Technology and Science Ltd” is a startup company (and business-to-business company) primarily engaged in scientific research on wormholes and technology development. To clarify, it can be said that the company is engaged in the creation of know-how. Know-how describes the physics of wormholes and their technical creation. The limited company is non-profit working on developing technology and science in the field of wormholes. The company is registered in the Republic of Estonia (EE, EST), which is a member state of the European Union (EU).

It has been generally acknowledged in the scientific world that it is possible to travel in time through spacetime tunnels or wormholes. Wormholes also help in space travel as by moving through a spacetime tunnel, vast distances in space will get a lot closer to us. A spacetime tunnel, popularly known as a wormhole, is a curve of time and space that joins to points in spacetime and enables to move from one moment in time into another or move from one point in space into another in a moment or 0 seconds. Theoretical physics has discussed the actual existence of wormholes extensively, which mainly arises from the existence of different interpretation of the physics theories of time and space. For example, a black hole can simultaneously be the entrance and exit of spacetime. As we know, gravitation is a curve in spacetime and on the Schwarzschild event horizon that is in the centre of black holes, spacetime has curved to infinity. Figuratively, the Schwarzschild event horizon is a border of spacetime, where the existence of time and space actually ends. By now, a new theory of physics has been developed that proves that the event horizon, on which time and space have curved to infinity, can also be physically interpreted as the entrance and exit of spacetime. Therefore, it can be said that spacetime tunnels exist in the Universe as black holes exist.

For a long time, the issue of energy was the greatest obstacle in creating spacetime tunnels. But now, new discoveries in theoretical physics have found a completely new way to practically solve this problem. It has become clear that there are two ways to actually create spacetime tunnels, the same way as in nuclear energetics, nuclear energy can actually be produced in two different ways. For example, the nuclear energy produced by humans is based on the energy released by splitting heavy nuclei or joining light atomic nuclei Something similar applies to creating spacetime tunnels. For example, a spacetime tunnel can be artificially created by using massive energies (as was mentioned above), but also by using extremely small energies. As energy amounts equivalent to the mass of planets cannot be produced or used in practice, the only remaining option is to use extremely small energies, which is certainly within the current technical capacities of the humankind. In addition to mass, time and space are also warped by energy and, for example, an electrical field has energy. Therefore, the mass and electrical charge of a physical body affect the geometry of spacetime. But what are extremely small energies? This is covered by scientific analysis in Marek-Lars Kruusen’s physics theory of time-travel that describes the technical possibility of humans actually travelling in time.

entityDescription: Plantvoice is a biosensor, the size of a toothpick, which, by insertion inside the stem of the plant, allows real-time analysis of the sap. Plantvoice is biocompatible and identifies in real time variations in sap salinity, which are correlated with plant stress situations. Each type of stress is identifiable: water stress, biotic stress (bacteria or fungi), abiotic stress (chemicals or salts in the soil).Plantvoice detects direct data regarding the phytology of the plant and this allows for the timely detection (after just a few hours) of anomalies in the state of health of the plant. The latency of standard sensors available on the market is minimized.Plantvoice satisfies two main needs: 1. preserving the health of crops with high added value (vines, olive trees, etc.) or high productivity; 2. optimize water use to limit costs for companies and to allow water to remain available even in areas where it is often scarce.Furthermore, plantvoice has a cloud platform that can integrate all the data from other installed smart farming sensors. This allows us to eliminate the fragmentation of the data collection of the instrumentation described above, which turns out to be a problem that has a major impact on the usability of these technologies. In addition to this, the farmer often equips himself with many sensors, many of which are superimposable as outputs provided.The Plantvoice team is composed by Matteo Beccatelli, a chemist and the inventor of Plantvoice, a groundbreaking technology enabling plant-to-farmer communication through chemical signals. His pioneering work forms the project's foundation, promising to revolutionize agriculture. Tommaso Beccatelli, an additive manufacturing specialist, designs and produces crucial hardware components through 3D printing. Prof. Tommaso Ganino, an agronomist at the University of Parma, offers invaluable expertise, bridging scientific research and practical application. He contributes a solid understanding of the agricultural sector. Giovanni Collinetti, a communications expert, is responsible for conveying Plantvoice's message to the world. His strategic communication skills and media relationships ensure the innovation reaches the right audience. Massimo Ferri, a computer engineer specializing in artificial intelligence and data analysis allows efficient interpretation of plant chemical signals. Lastly Pierluigi Lodi Rizzini, an IP lawyer, who safeguards the team's innovations through legal protection.

entityDescription:
The Innovation and Development Institute of the University of Ljubljana (IRI UL)is a research and development organisation that actively co-designs, creates and disseminates technological and societal solutions tailored to people and the environment. In line with our mission, we identify the needs of the economy, design and manage international research and development projects within the framework of EU programmes, and support the implementation of project results into practice. In cooperation with industry, NGOs, government institutions and other non-academic actors, we create a bridge between university knowledge and the needs of society and the environment.
Our paradigm is based on active engagement with local stakeholders and the integration of anthropological research methods, approaches and knowledge. Our in-depth understanding of the needs of different social groups enables us to develop innovations that contribute to positive social change.
We focus on sustainable energy production, storage and use, and promote energy efficiency, the integration of renewable energy sources and the establishment of smart energy networks through advice and strategies. With our expertise in energy and material efficiency in the built environment, we actively address today’s challenges, working to reduce emissions and optimise energy and material flows. Our approach to building renovation is based on the concepts of embodied energy and energy efficiency of building performance. In line with the European Industrial Strategy, we support the transition of the built environment and industry towards carbon neutrality targets by 2050.
Our commitment to responsible research and innovation ensures standards of transparency, ethics and safety. Involving diverse groups of people in our R&D activities brings diverse perspectives that help us better understand the potential social and environmental impacts of our work. In doing so, we aim to set an example of responsible and ethical action, co-create a sustainable society and foster innovation for a green future.

entityDescription:
Croatian Transmission System Operator's mission is electric power system’s operation and maintenance, electricity transmission, as well as construction and development of electricity transmission network in order to maintain security of supply with minimal costs and environmental protection.
 
Pursuant to the Decision of the Commercial Court in Zagreb no. Tt-22/17075-2 from 11th April 2022, the conversion of the Croatian Transmission System Operator as limited liability company into a joint stock company was entered in the court register. The company operates and participates in legal transactions under the company /name Croatian Transmission System operator Plc. (abbreviated HOPS d.d.).
 
HOPS d.d. is the sole electricity transmission system operator in the Republic of Croatia, and the owner of the entire Croatian transmission network (400 kV, 220kV and 110kV included voltage levels), and has a license to carry out the energy activity of electricity transmission as a regulated public service.
 
The business activity of HOPS d.d. is regulated by the Energy Act (Official Gazette 120/2012, 14/2014, 95/2015, 102/2015, 68/18), the Electricity Market Act (Official Gazette 111/21), and other national and international regulations.
 
The company performs its functions transparently and independently in accordance with the Croatian Companies Act.
 
HOPS operates as an independent transmission system operator, which implies functional independence from the parent company, Hrvatska elektroprivreda d.d., and its affiliated companies, and non-discriminatory behavior towards all transmission system users.

entityDescription: AETHON Engineering is a start-up company based in Athens, Greece created by individuals with European working experience and extensive academic knowledge. AETHON specializes in the implementation of innovative ideas and development of sustainable solutions for transport and mobility. Our transport engineering solutions merge advanced scientific methodologies to planning, functional design, operation and management tasks for infrastructure and for all modes of transportation aiming to provide safe, efficient, rapid, comfortable, convenient, economical and environmentally friendly movement of people and goods. entityDescription:
UVision develops and produces the UVision 3D scanner which is an integrated HW & SW solution that transforms underwater objects being surveyed, into photorealistic and measurable 3D models, making underwater inspection easier, safer and far more effective.
Underwater inspections are essential for man-made underwater structures. However they are typically costly, involve risk for divers and ensuring inspection quality is difficult. Video provides limited visibility, is cumbersome to analyse and difficult to compare over time.

UVision’s business customers fall within three segments: Infrastructure owners, consulting engineers and commercial divers across the following sectors: civil infrastructure, maritime, energy, planetary health, national security and defense.
Since finalising our MVP product mid 2023, we have been performing demonstrations for the various sectors and segments, including scans of offshore windmill foundations, harbours, bridge foundations and vessels. We are in dialogue with potential customers, including energy companies, civil engineers, and commercial divers in Denmark and also in the UK. We are currently selling “scanning as a service” to gain experience and have sold our first scans.
Over its two years life, the company has grown from one to three people - two experienced founders and a skilled developer. It has received funding from the Danish Innovation Fund and the Danish Maritime Fund.
For more details please see our 2 minute explainer video here: www.uvision.dk

Blockchain & Log Security

- An Extra Layer of Security: With its intrinsic security-focused nature, blockchain can be implemented to existing infrastructures as an additional security layer.

LambSpace aims to revolutionize the small satellite industry, firstly by producing high-performance polymer structures for small satellites from PEEK using injection molding. This approach shortens production time compared to aluminum structures, lowers costs, minimizes resource use and offers advantages such as lower mass, better corrosion resistance and a lower carbon footprint. 
On the other hand, LambSpace aims to develop and manufacture new innovative small actuators based on shape memory alloys. This technology is particularly well suited for space applications due to its light weight and robustness. Shape memory actuators can be used for various locking and unlocking tasks, such as solar panel and antenna modules.

Hydromars AB is science-based deep-tech company that develops a circular water system for deep space missions.
Based on proprietary technology from its parent company, Hydromars uses a new unit operation that aims to make it possible to perform the main task of recycling in the spaceship and achieve complete recovery and 100% clean water.

Hydromars collaborates with leading Institutes (German Aerospace Centre (DLR), Swedish Environmental Research Institute (IVL), KTH Royal Institute of Technology (KTH), Interuniversity Microelectronics Centre (imec)) and multinationals (Airbus Defence & Space) and has received initial funding from ESA BIC Sweden and Seal of Excellence from the EU.

Spin-offs from Hydromars will contribute to a new circular economy on Earth for optimal recycling of resources. This will contribute to environmental improvements such as mitigation of global warming and resource depletion.

- Sirius is a suite of innovative data science solutions that helps scientists and their institutions to automate tasks to map, manage, analyse, and promote their results to all stakeholders of research.

entityDescription:
Remote Sensing Business Solutions (RSBS) is the parent company of Four Point and the owner of the intellectual property for TerraEye. RSBS is a forward-thinking company specializing in leveraging advanced satellite data and artificial intelligence for innovative solutions in the mineral exploration and mining industries. Their flagship product, TerraEye, epitomizes their commitment to revolutionizing these sectors with cutting-edge technology.
Company Overview:
- Name: Remote Sensing Business Solutions (RSBS)
- IP Ownership: Holds the intellectual property rights for TerraEye, a state-of-the-art platform designed for mineral exploration and mining.
- Specialization: Focused on integrating diverse data streams from satellites, drones, and ground sensors to provide comprehensive insights into exploration sites.
- Technological Edge: Utilizes advanced machine learning algorithms and extensive datasets to translate complex environmental patterns into actionable intelligence for more precise and efficient mineral exploration.
Key Features of TerraEye:
- Unified Data Streams: Integration of data from various satellite constellations, UAVs, ground sensors, and existing company datasets.
- Advanced Data Processing: Proprietary machine learning algorithms are employed to ensure high levels of accuracy and relevance in data interpretation.
- Comprehensive Monitoring: Offers a blend of real-time data streams, historical pattern analysis, and predictive analytics in a user-friendly application.
- Sustainability & Responsibility: Aims to mitigate the environmental impact of mining and exploration, aligning with global sustainability trends.
Market Position:
- Unique Selling Proposition: Unlike traditional geological services or generic data analysis platforms, TerraEye by RSBS offers a comprehensive, integrated approach combining satellite data insights with UAV and ground sensor data.
- Competitive Landscape: TerraEye stands out in a market that includes traditional geological services, satellite-only data providers, generic data analysis platforms, environmental monitoring tools, and dedicated mining software. Its integration of real-time geospatial data and advanced analytics sets it apart.
Company Strategy:
- Innovation Focused: Continually seeks to innovate and enhance its offerings in the mineral exploration sector.
- IP Strategy: Proactive in protecting and leveraging its intellectual property, TerraEye, as a competitive asset and business lever.
- Sustainable Practices: Emphasizes sustainable mining practices, balancing economic benefits with environmental responsibility.
Future Outlook:
RSBS aims to maintain its leadership in the field of remote sensing and AI for mineral exploration by continuously evolving TerraEye and exploring new technological frontiers. Their approach not only offers significant benefits to the mining industry but also contributes to environmentally responsible practices, making them a pivotal player in the intersection of technology, exploration, and sustainability.

entityDescription:
Grupo Sureste, founded in 1993 in Murcia, initially focused on Private Security, leveraging the extensive experience of its professionals. With over 2,000 highly qualified staff, including 57 Higher University Graduates, the company operates 24/7 in the Autonomous Community of the Region of Murcia.
The company prioritizes clients, emphasizing peace of mind for individuals, institutions, and companies relying on their outsourcing services. Grupo Sureste rejects improvisation, opting for systematic auditing, diagnosis, and efficient provision of necessary systems and resources.
Investment in personnel training has been a cornerstone of their growth. Holding licenses for surveillance and security installations, Grupo Sureste complies with various authorizations from the Directorate General of Security.
Quality policy is paramount, with certifications such as ISO 9001:2000, ISO 14001, and OHSAS 18001. The company's commitment to responsible communication is acknowledged by the Responsible Communication Seal.
The company's infrastructure boasts a 2,500 m2 intelligent building serving as its central headquarters, including an Alarm Receiving Center—the largest in the Mediterranean Arch. With authorized delegations in several Autonomous Communities, Grupo Sureste has a national presence, complemented by commercial offices in each capital.
Operational capacity is enhanced by the Operational Control Center (OCC) located in Murcia. The OCC, compliant with the law on Private Security, facilitates surveillance, protection, and response functions, ensuring constant contact with security forces and emergency services.
Technologically advanced, the OCC allows immediate information retrieval, extensive knowledge of security systems, and reliable responses. Communication systems include RTC, mobile telephony, and IP, with redundancy for network security.
The OCC's hardware and software integrate video verification, call recording, and web access for clients. Integration of systems allows the reception of signals from various security systems, enabling faster verification.
Alarm processing involves qualified personnel, ensuring proper verification. Key custody services include on-site visits and response to alarms, carried out by security guards in compliance with regulations.
Grupo Sureste's commitment extends to quality certifications, environmental responsibility, and corporate social responsibility. The company's continuous improvement policy, supported by an in-house occupational health and safety prevention department, reflects its dedication to excellence.
In summary, Grupo Sureste's operational excellence, technological prowess, and commitment to quality and security make it a reliable partner for diverse sectors, contributing to its national prominence in the private security domain.

Operational capacity is enhanced by the Operational Control Center (OCC) located in Murcia. The OCC, compliant with the law on Private Security, facilitates surveillance, protection, and response functions, ensuring constant contact with security forces and emergency services.
Technologically advanced, the OCC allows immediate information retrieval, extensive knowledge of security systems, and reliable responses. Communication systems include RTC, mobile telephony, and IP, with redundancy for network security.
The OCC's hardware and software integrate video verification, call recording, and web access for clients. Integration of systems allows the reception of signals from various security systems, enabling faster verification.
Alarm processing involves qualified personnel, ensuring proper verification. Key custody services include on-site visits and response to alarms, carried out by security guards in compliance with regulations.
Grupo Sureste's commitment extends to quality certifications, environmental responsibility, and corporate social responsibility. The company's continuous improvement policy, supported by an in-house occupational health and safety prevention department, reflects its dedication to excellence.
In summary, Grupo Sureste's operational excellence, technological prowess, and commitment to quality and security make it a reliable partner for diverse sectors, contributing to its national prominence in the private security domain.

entityDescription: Neutron Star Systems (NSS) is a space start-up revolutionising near-Earth operations, in-space logistics and deep space missions. We are a market enabler for high power missions focused on delivering disruptive and innovative electric propulsion systems incorporating the latest high temperature superconductor technology (HTS). Our product offering offers superior flexibility and versatility, customisable to a wide range of spacecraft mission scenarios. This translates into mission optimisation and millions in cost savings for our customers. Closing the gap between R&D and commercialization for Applied Field Magnetoplasmadynamic (AF-MPD) technology, we build disruptive and robust electric propulsion (EP) systems and subsystems based on the latest superconductor technology. Our unique selling proposition addresses the needs of five main markets: 1. On-Orbit Servicing, Assembly, and Manufacture 2. GEO satellites for multi-domain and multi-level secure communications 3. Solar weather monitoring and detection constellations 4. Lunar and cis-lunar transportation 5. Mars and asteroid cargo missions A Unique Idea NSS is developing the SUPREME thruster – an EP technology that offers a unique combination of features based on superior operational flexibility, scalability, cost-effectiveness, and thrust efficiency compared to the competition. SUPREME offers a wide operational range and operation on alternative, cheap propellants. Our throttleable technology can be optimised to almost any mission scenario, allowing maximum utilisation of propellant. Our operational flexibility opens new possibilities for hybrid chemical/electric propulsion systems while reducing the dependence on rare and expensive propellants such as Xenon. Our efficient technology and use of propellants such as Argon and Ammonia leads to significant savings in mission costs, with savings growing exponentially towards higher powers. Unlike many other potential high-power EP systems, AF-MPD thrusters have a 60-year research and flight heritage and their technology is well understood, simple, reliable and robust. MPD thrusters have been previously limited by the large mass of the electrical components however, with the introduction of HTS, these obstacles can be overcome. The larger magnetic fields which can be generated with HTS enable an increase in thruster performance and an extension of the thruster lifetime. NSS is in close partnership with the institute of space systems (IRS) at the University of Stuttgart. IRS brings a long-lasting heritage of electric propulsion R&D development, in particular MPD thrusters, along with world-class facilities for the testing of high power EP systems. In the past years, they have designed and tested the SX3 thruster, an AF-MPD thruster which has reached ground-breaking thrust efficiencies of 62%. Concept Our design concept exploits the significant research heritage of AF-MPD thrusters and combines this with key enabling HTS technology to produce lightweight, compact and energy efficient thrusters. Unlike traditional electromagnets, the use of HTS coils, with their high current densities, will allow magnetic fields up to 1T to be generated. This in turn allows thruster operation at lower discharge currents and higher voltage, resulting in lifetime increases and improved operational performance.

entityDescription:
Celebrating 30 years, Inforlandia presents itself with a deep knowledge and experience in the technological sector, at local and international level, with successes that speak for themselves. Today it is the largest manufacturer of computer equipment in Portugal, with an offer adjusted and developed to the needs of customers and with a strong weight in exports. The ambition that dictated its path continues to outline its growth and consolidation strategies. With the aim of making technology increasingly accessible, both for Education and for the business and public sectors, it has been developing production methods and strategies that ensure unmatched flexibility and high levels of quality, with the utmost efficiency. The commitment to quality has been rewarded with certifications at the highest level, and Inforlandia’s objective is to continue to be one of the national companies with the highest number of product, process and business-level certifications.
It has ISO 9001 quality certifications; environmental ISO 14001; social responsibility SA 8000, ecology and sustainability EPEAT and TCO and Energy Star energy efficiency. Inforlandia is specialized in the production of customized series using internally developed and patented production technologies.
Since 1990, Inforlandia has developed, designed, manufactured and custom tailored personal computers, servers, tablets, smartphones and other consumer electronic products, under its brands (INSYS, Matrixx), on an EMS/ODM basis for large worldwide clients under Private Label brands. Market leader in several segments, namely, being the largest manufacturer in South Europe of mainstream notebook computers and smart phones.
Inforlandia R&D patented several innovative solutions, currently embedded in several of its products, namely the “CUCo security”, an anti-theft and contract compliance technology for remote hardware device lockdown and “EduPro” devices for teachers, education and schools.
Inforlandia has a robust financial structure with registered capital of €20M (≈$19M) and a low debt/assets ratio. With up to 100 employees, 20% with a University degree, has topped yearly sales of €127M (≈$125M). We are part of a large industrial group (VAGA) that reaches combined sales in excess of €200M (≈$300M) per year (>1000 employees).

entityDescription:
MIERSCH SUESS ARCHITECTURAL OFFICESis a German-International Design, Engineering and Innovation Studiofor Architecture, Urban development and Engineering Structures. We shape transformation and innovation in order to create sustainable values ​​for the 21st century.

MIERSCH SUESS ARCHITECTURAL OFFICESis headed by its founder Ines Miersch-Süß.
Ines Miersch-Süßis a German architectwith 30 years of experience. As Creative Director of her Dresden-based studio, she inspires an interdisciplinary team of people from a wide range of design disciplines up to and including engineering, driven by a belief in the need for SUSTAINABILITY MODERNITY architecture, an experimental curiosity and a keen understanding of innovation.
Each project of theMSAOis personally and directly developed and attended byInes Miersch-Süß. All the company's resources and the extensive experience of the company's partners are at hand to support the design work and to drive it forward through technical development and overall project management.MSAOhas extensive experience in the design and technical development of building systems and structures, as well as highly qualified management of complex projects.
MSAO Establishing Sustainable Towns (MSAO EST)

MSAO EST – ESTABLISHING SUSTAINABLE TOWNS of MSAO Miersch Suess Architectural Offices INNOVATION ARCHITECTS - is the Innovation Diplomatic Department for Green Transition working on large scale projects to develop and design sustainable and innovative industrial regions through sustainable and innovative urban design and architecture. Five areas of work form the umbrella brand MSAO EST in Innovation Industries:
a. MIDEST (Mining, raw materials)
b. WIDEST (waste, recycling, urban mining)
c. VIDEST (New Short Distance Industry, New Space Industry, Vertical High Rice Industry)
d. AIDEST (Architecture Investment Design)
e. UXDEST (User Oriented City Design)
f. HRDEST (Human Resource Design)
Through the six areas, we can create innovative overall concepts in master plans that consider various innovation aspects in context. Through precise analysis, we look at the initial situation of the region, the potentials, dangers and weaknesses and work out a vision together with the client, which, through concrete strategies for action, timetables and cost plans, form the basis for the investment plans. Investor partners receive the necessary clear overview of the project parameters, qualities and quantities.

MSAO EST ensures a reliable investment policy combined with innovation diplomacy. 
MSAO has extensive experience in the negotiation, development and design of large regional, industrial and infrastructure projects. We are partners for governments in Germany and abroad. As architects and engineers, we combine design and technology to create innovation projects with visionary appeal as state-of-the-art projects.
For the MOON Economy Project we take part with MSAO EST / VIDEST combined with WIDEST.

Re CAE, a LLC based in Switzerland, aims to help de-risk space operations by offering access to comprehensive cloud-based tools that ensure precise orbital forecasts and in-depth spacecraft assessments. The platform offers a unique solution for a comprehensive assessment of spacecraft lifecycle, such as orbital propagation and collision risk assessment, and post-mission disposal analysis for end-of-life, including re-entry prediction, ground impact risk and uncertainty quantification. 
Re CAE also designed an API for satellite pass to provide accurate visibility predictions with real-time updates on satellite passes. This customizable platform allows users to personnalize the API to their specific needs. The ultimate goal of this API is to enhance space mission operations and optimize celestrial observations. 
The overreaching objective of Re CAE is to empower self-driving spacecraft by harnessing deep neural networks and reinforcement learning for efficient orbital manoeuvers and controlled re-entries with high-degree of safety and precision.

entityDescription:
Genevation is a private enterprise founded in 2014 with the goal to design and build unlimited class competition aerobatic aircraft. Using our team’s theoretical knowledge and practical research experience in aerospace engineering we built our first product in 2016. We built it starting with the initial concept design, evolving the design through numerous reviews and modifications. We have manufactured all production tooling in house and then built our first prototype to set up series airplane manufacturing, then for ground, and flight testing. We only use the most advanced materials available starting with our first aircraft. Our initial team of 8 has grown into today’s 33 highly trained professionals.
Genevation has a wide range of experience in the design, development and manufacturing of composite structures and metal constructions for aerospace. Our current products were designed and tested according to EASA CS23, CS27, CS-LSA / LTF – UL / ASTM F 2352:14.
Our company is certified and operates according to ISO 9001; AS9100D, ISO 3834-2, NATO AQAP quality standards.
Today we manufacture light sport aircraft, provide lightweight solutions, develop special UAV products for various industries like in agriculture, and in the defense sector.
Our vision is to expand our services into the space sector, backed by our hard-earned experience and expertise from our activities in the aerospace and defense industry. We believe space exploration is key for technological development, sustainability, the prosperity of mankind, therefore is our future.
Genevation has the engineering and manufacturing capabilities to deliver the following services:
Ø Design and development via NX Nastran and SolidWorks CAD platforms
Ø Design and tool manufacturing for composite parts production and jigs for metal structures
Ø Prototyping of composite, metal and hybrid structures
Ø Composite parts production via out of autoclave prepreg and wet lay-up technologies
Ø Welded metal (steel, titanium) structures – TIG technology with inert gas chamber
Ø Metal-composite hybrid structures
Ø Aircraft assembly
Ø Component and complex system load (static and cyclic) testing on ground and in flight
Ø Carry out R&D projects from idea to mass manufacturing

entityName: HUN-REN Research Centre for Natural Sciences
entityDescription:
HUN-REN Research Centre for Natural Sciences (HUN-REN RCNS) is an organisational unit of HUN-REN Hungarian Research Network (a legal entity performing a public service function with a special legal status) and has a legal personality of its own. As a non-profit organisational unit of HUN-REN, RCNS qualifies as a research institution (a research and knowledge dissemination organisation), conducting multidisciplinary research in the natural sciences, including both the life sciences and the physical sciences. HUN-REN RCNS is entitled to apply for grants in its own name as well as receive grant funding and enter into contracts.
The HUN-REN Research Centre for Natural Sciences carries out multidisciplinary research in natural sciences in the fields of cognitive neuroscience and psychology, enzymology, organic chemistry, as well as materials- and environmental chemistry. Research Centre for Basic psychological research is performed both for pure scientific purposes and for direct or indirect application in Hungary. Research areas cover social, comparative cultural, cognitive and developmental psychology and psychophysiology. Research takes a broad approach to scientific issues, and embraces other branches of science and social science. Research centre staff is also engaged in adapting and developing new psychological research methods. Vocational and basic education at both undergraduate and postgraduate level is another area where research centre staff is active.

Digit Soil is a team of experts in soil science, biotechnology, agronomy, and software engineering that aims to revolutionize agriculture and regenerate soils. Our company is built on the conviction that farmers need accurate and directly interpretable information to farm sustainably, starting with indication on the optimal amount, type, and timing of fertilizer application to improve their efficiency and foster the use of organic fertilizer. 
At Digit Soil, we have developed a technology that provides farmers with the information they need to optimize the use of both synthetic and organic fertilizers. Our device measures soil enzymatic activity, the biochemical process responsible for releasing nutrients to plants in the soil. By combining this data with current agronomic models and deep-learning approaches, we can provide farmers with the optimal timing, amount, and composition of fertilizer to increase nutrient uptake by crops, leading to a more sustainable and productive farming.

entityName: Institute of Advanced Materials, IAAM AB
entityDescription:
The Institute of Advanced Materials (IAM) is a hub of innovation and research dedicated to harnessing the potential of materials science, engineering and technology for a variety of industries. Since its inception, IAM has been at the forefront of materials innovations, working to develop and promote cutting-edge research that can be translated into practical applications with real-world benefits.

IAM's mission is rooted in the belief that advancements in new age technology are key to solving some of the most pressing challenges facing humanity, from clean energy production to environmental sustainability and healthcare. By focusing on translational research, IAM strives to bridge the gap between theoretical discoveries and their implementation in products and technologies that can improve quality of life.

The institute is not only a research entity but also a consultancy body, offering expertise in R&D, technology transfer, and infrastructural development. This ensures that research outcomes do not remain confined to academic papers but evolve into tangible, commercially viable, and significant products that serve the end-user.

IAM's global reach is expanded through its network of partnerships and collaborations with some of the world’s leading researchers, institutes, and scientists. This collaborative environment fosters a culture of innovation and a multidisciplinary approach to problem-solving, which is essential in the complex field of materials science and technology.

The areas of focus for IAM include, but are not limited to, energy—where the development of new innovation for energy, climate technology and health are crucial; environment—where new materials and digital technology can play a role in pollution control and sustainable resource management; and health—where innovative materials can lead to advanced medical devices and drug delivery systems.
